senses.example: The hikers were grateful for the tree's shade after walking for hours under the hot sun.
senses.definition: feeling or showing gratitude
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as grateful is feeling or showing gratitude.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为感激的东西是感觉或表现出感激之情。
senses.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者在烈日下走了几个小时后，很感激这棵树的阴凉。

senses.example: He was overwhelmed with gratitude for their help.
senses.definition: a feeling of thankfulness and appreciation
senses.definitionSentence: Gratitude is a feeling of thankfulness and appreciation.
senses.definitionZh: 一种感恩和欣赏的感觉。
senses.exampleZh: 他对他们的帮助感激不尽。

senses.example: Loud music greeted him when he entered the apartment.
senses.definition: be perceived by
senses.definitionSentence: To greet means to be perceived by.
senses.definitionZh: 被感知。
senses.exampleZh: 当他进入公寓时，响亮的音乐迎接他。

senses.example: Rebs who owned slaves occasionally would include in their letters admonitions or greetings to members of the Negro community.
senses.definition: (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)
senses.definitionSentence: Greeting means (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting).
senses.definitionZh: （通常是复数）确认或表达善意（尤其是在见面时）。
senses.exampleZh: 拥有奴隶的共和党人偶尔会在信中对黑人社区成员提出警告或问候。

senses.definition: relatively large in size or number or extent; larger than others of its kind
senses.definitionSentence: Relatively large in size or number or extent; larger than others of its kind.
senses.definitionZh: 规模、数量或范围相对较大；比其他同类产品更大。
senses.example: The dam holds back a great volume of water stretching many kilometers upstream.
senses.exampleZh: 大坝拦住了向上游延伸数公里的大量水。

senses.example: Had a great time at the party.
senses.definition: very good
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as great is very good.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为伟大的东西是非常好的。
senses.exampleZh: 在聚会上玩得很开心。

senses.example: The doctor called her after reviewing the test results.
senses.exampleZh: 医生查看检查结果后给她打了电话。
senses.definitionSentence: She (objective case of she).
senses.definitionZh: 她（她的客观情况）。

senses.example: Her passport expired one week before the flight.
senses.exampleZh: 她的护照在航班起飞前一周过期了。
senses.definitionSentence: Her (possessive case of she).
senses.definitionZh: 她（她的所有格）。

senses.example: She stood still over the leg of lamb, rubbing herbs into it, quite suddenly conscious of a nausea in her stomach and a feeling of wrath, a sensation of violence that started her shivering.
senses.definition: aromatic potherb used in cookery for its savory qualities
senses.definitionSentence: Herb means aromatic potherb used in cookery for its savory qualities.
senses.definitionZh: 烹饪中使用的芳香野菜，因其味道鲜美。
senses.exampleZh: 她一动不动地站在羊腿旁，往里面擦草药，突然感到胃里一阵恶心，还有一种愤怒的感觉，一种暴力的感觉，让她开始发抖。

senses.example: The company herds were being raided less often, and cabins and soddies all over the range were standing deserted.
senses.definition: a group of cattle or sheep or other domestic mammals all of the same kind that are herded by humans
senses.definitionSentence: Herd is a group of cattle or sheep or other domestic mammals all of the same kind that are herded by humans.
senses.definitionZh: 人类放养的一群牛、羊或其他同类家养哺乳动物。
senses.exampleZh: 连队的牛群遭到袭击的次数减少了，整个范围内的小屋和马匹都空无一人。

senses.example: When the gate opened, the frightened cattle herded together and moved as one group toward the field.
senses.definition: move together, like a herd
senses.definitionSentence: To herd means to move together, like a herd.
senses.definitionZh: 像群体一样一起移动。
senses.exampleZh: 当大门打开时，受惊的牛群聚集在一起，成群结队地向田野移动。

senses.example: Who will be herding the cattle when the cowboy dies?
senses.definition: keep, move, or drive animals
senses.definitionSentence: To herd means to keep, move, or drive animals.
senses.definitionZh: 饲养、移动或驱赶动物。
senses.exampleZh: 牛仔死后谁来放牛？

senses.example: Radio waves received here on Earth.
senses.definition: in or at this place; where the speaker or writer is
senses.definitionSentence: Here means in or at this place; where the speaker or writer is.
senses.definitionZh: 在这个地方；说话者或作者在哪里。
senses.exampleZh: 在地球上接收到的无线电波。

senses.example: The family estate became her legal heritage after her father's death.
senses.definition: that which is inherited; a title or property or estate that passes by law to the heir on the death of the owner
senses.definitionSentence: Heritage means that which is inherited; a title or property or estate that passes by law to the heir on the death of the owner.
senses.definitionZh: 继承的；所有者去世后依法转移给继承人的所有权、财产或遗产。
senses.exampleZh: 在她父亲去世后，家族财产成为她的合法遗产。

senses.example: RAF pilots were the heroes of the Battle of Britain.
senses.definition: a man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength
senses.definitionSentence: Hero is a man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength.
senses.definitionZh: 一个以非凡的勇气、高贵和力量而著称的人。
senses.exampleZh: 英国皇家空军飞行员是不列颠之战的英雄。

senses.example: He saw Sweden as a country of smug and narrow provincialism, indifferent to the heroic spirit of its former glory.
senses.definition: relating to or characteristic of heroes of antiquity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as heroic is relating to or characteristic of heroes of antiquity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为英雄的事物与古代英雄有关或具有古代英雄的特征。
senses.exampleZh: 他认为瑞典是一个自鸣得意、狭隘地方主义的国家，对其昔日辉煌的英雄精神漠不关心。

senses.example: The firefighter became a national heroine after rescuing three children from the burning house.
senses.definition: a woman possessing heroic qualities or a woman who has performed heroic deeds
senses.definitionSentence: Heroine is a woman possessing heroic qualities or a woman who has performed heroic deeds.
senses.definitionZh: 具有英雄品质的女性或表现出英雄事迹的女性。
senses.exampleZh: 消防员从着火的房屋中救出三名儿童后成为民族英雄。

senses.example: The red bicycle is hers, not mine.
senses.exampleZh: 那辆红色自行车是她的，不是我的。
senses.definitionSentence: Her, her thing.
senses.definitionZh: 她的，她的事。

senses.example: She taught herself to repair the old sewing machine.
senses.exampleZh: 她自学了如何修理那台旧缝纫机。
senses.definitionSentence: Herself (reflexive usage).
senses.definitionZh: 她自己（反射性用法）。

senses.meaning: 她本人，她亲自（强调用法）
senses.example: The director herself answered every question from the staff.
senses.exampleZh: 主任亲自回答了员工提出的每一个问题。
senses.definitionSentence: Herself, herself (emphasis on usage).
senses.definitionZh: 她自己，她自己（强调用法）。

senses.example: Some delay is inherent in the approval process because every application must pass three separate reviews.
senses.definition: in the nature of something though not readily apparent
dictionaryCandidates: 固有的， 内在的， 天生的
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as inherent is in the nature of something though not readily apparent.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为固有的东西存在于事物的本质中，尽管并不明显。
senses.exampleZh: 审批过程中存在一定的延迟，因为每个申请都必须通过三项单独的审核。

senses.example: I inherited a castle from my French grandparents.
senses.definition: obtain from someone after their death
senses.definitionSentence: To inherit means to obtain from someone after their death.
senses.definitionZh: 在某人死后从某人那里获得。
senses.exampleZh: 我从法国祖父母那里继承了一座城堡。

senses.example: I inherited my good eyesight from my mother.
senses.definition: receive by genetic transmission
senses.definitionSentence: To inherit means to receive by genetic transmission.
senses.definitionZh: 通过基因传递来接受。
senses.exampleZh: 我从母亲那里继承了良好的视力。

senses.example: He shepherded the sheep across the hillside and into a fenced field before nightfall.
senses.definition: tend as a shepherd, as of sheep or goats
senses.definitionSentence: To shepherd means to tend as a shepherd, as of sheep or goats.
senses.definitionZh: 像牧羊人一样照顾绵羊或山羊。
senses.exampleZh: 夜幕降临前，他牧羊穿过山坡，进入一片有围栏的田野。

senses.example: The adviser shepherded the young researchers through their first difficult field study.
senses.definition: watch over like a shepherd, as a teacher of her pupils
senses.definitionSentence: To shepherd means to watch over like a shepherd, as a teacher of her pupils.
senses.definitionZh: 像牧羊人一样看护她的学生。
senses.exampleZh: 顾问带领年轻的研究人员完成了他们的第一次困难的实地研究。

senses.example: Will this wallpaper adhere to the wall?
senses.definition: stick to firmly
senses.definitionSentence: To adhere means to stick to firmly.
senses.definitionZh: 牢固地粘附。
senses.exampleZh: 这张壁纸会粘在墙上吗？

senses.example: You must adhere to the rules.
senses.definition: be compatible or in accordance with
senses.definitionSentence: To adhere means to be compatible or in accordance with.
senses.definitionZh: 兼容或符合。
senses.exampleZh: 您必须遵守规则。

senses.example: The residents of this village adhered to Catholicism.
senses.definition: be a devoted follower or supporter
senses.definitionSentence: To adhere means to be a devoted follower or supporter.
senses.definitionZh: 成为忠实的追随者或支持者。
senses.exampleZh: 该村居民信奉天主教。

senses.example: She was more coherent than she had been just after the accident.
senses.definition: capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as coherent is capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为连贯的事物能够以清晰一致的方式思考和表达自己。
senses.exampleZh: 与事故发生后相比，她的思路更加清晰。

senses.example: Clear goals and mutual trust turned the separate departments into a cohesive team.
senses.definition: cohering or tending to cohere; well integrated
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as cohesive is cohering or tending to cohere; well integrated.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为内聚的东西是内聚或趋于内聚；集成良好。
senses.exampleZh: 明确的目标和相互信任使各个部门变成了一个有凝聚力的团队。

senses.example: Authorities hesitate to quote exact figures.
senses.definition: pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness
senses.definitionSentence: To hesitate means to pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness.
senses.definitionZh: 在不确定或不情愿的情况下暂停或退缩。
senses.exampleZh: 当局不愿引用确切的数字。

senses.example: When the fighter jet caught fire, the pilot ejected in his emergency seat and descended by parachute.
senses.definition: leave an aircraft rapidly, using an ejection seat or capsule
senses.definitionSentence: To eject means to leave an aircraft rapidly, using an ejection seat or capsule.
senses.definitionZh: 使用弹射座椅或太空舱快速离开飞机。
senses.exampleZh: 当战斗机起火时，飞行员在紧急座椅上弹射并通过降落伞降落。

senses.example: The patient injected insulin beneath her skin to control her blood glucose.
senses.definition: take by injection
senses.definitionSentence: To inject means to take by injection.
senses.definitionZh: 通过注射服用。
senses.exampleZh: 患者在皮下注射胰岛素以控制血糖。

senses.example: It was full of rackets, balls and other objects.
senses.definition: a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow
senses.definitionSentence: Object is a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow.
senses.definitionZh: 有形可见的实体；可以投射阴影的实体。
senses.exampleZh: 里面装满了球拍、球和其他物体。

senses.example: She never objected to the amount of work her boss charged her with.
senses.definition: express or raise an objection or protest or criticism or express dissent
senses.definitionSentence: To object means to express or raise an objection or protest or criticism or express dissent.
senses.definitionZh: 表达或提出反对、抗议、批评或表达异议。
senses.exampleZh: 她从不反对老板交给她的大量工作。

senses.example: But it is an answer which opens the door wide to an onrush of objections and denials.
senses.definition: the speech act of objecting
senses.definitionSentence: Objection is the speech act of objecting.
senses.definitionZh: 反对的言语行为。
senses.exampleZh: 但这是一个为反对和否认的浪潮敞开大门的答案。

senses.example: How long has it been since you reviewed the objectives of your benefit and service program?
senses.definition: the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)
senses.definitionSentence: Objective is the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable).
senses.definitionZh: 要实现的目标（并且被认为是可以实现的）。
senses.exampleZh: 您审核福利和服务计划的目标已有多长时间了？

senses.example: Thus, man can readily deduce that the primary objective end of the conjugal act is procreation, the propagation of the race.
senses.definition: undistorted by emotion or personal bias; based on observable phenomena
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as objective is undistorted by emotion or personal bias; based on observable phenomena.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为客观的事物不会因情感或个人偏见而扭曲；基于可观察到的现象。
senses.exampleZh: 因此，人类可以很容易地推断出婚姻行为的主要目标是繁衍，即种族的繁衍。

senses.example: In 'The teacher praised him,' the pronoun 'him' is in the objective case.
senses.definition: serving as or indicating the object of a verb or of certain prepositions and used for certain other purposes
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as objective is serving as or indicating the object of a verb or of certain prepositions and used for certain other purposes.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为客观的东西充当或指示动词或某些介词的宾语并用于某些其他目的。
senses.exampleZh: 在“老师表扬了他”中，代词“他”是宾格。

senses.example: Arlen, too, worked on other projects at the same time with old friend Ted Koehler.
senses.definition: any piece of work that is undertaken or attempted
senses.definitionSentence: Project means any piece of work that is undertaken or attempted.
senses.definitionZh: 已进行或尝试的任何工作。
senses.exampleZh: Arlen 也与老朋友 Ted Koehler 同时从事其他项目。
senses.audioAuthor: No machine-readable author provided. Denelson83 assumed (based on copyright claims).
senses.audioAttribution: No machine-readable source provided. Own work assumed (based on copyright claims).

senses.example: The images are projected onto the screen.
senses.definition: project on a screen
senses.definitionSentence: To project means to project on a screen.
senses.definitionZh: 在屏幕上投影。
senses.exampleZh: 图像被投影到屏幕上。
senses.audioAttribution: Self, recorded using the program Shtooka .

senses.example: One struck the muzzle of one of the rifles that projected from the shoulder pack.
senses.definition: extend out or project in space
senses.definitionSentence: To project means to extend out or project in space.
senses.definitionZh: 在空间中延伸或投射。
senses.exampleZh: 其中一支击中了从肩包伸出的一支步枪的枪口。
senses.audioAttribution: Self, recorded using the program Shtooka .

senses.example: The lecturer connected her laptop to the projector and displayed the diagram on a large screen.
senses.definition: an optical instrument that projects an enlarged image onto a screen
dictionaryCandidates: 放映机， 幻灯机， 投影仪
senses.definitionSentence: Projector is an optical instrument that projects an enlarged image onto a screen.
senses.definitionZh: 一种将放大图像投影到屏幕上的光学仪器。
senses.exampleZh: 讲师将笔记本电脑连接到投影仪，并在大屏幕上显示图表。

senses.example: Smith flatly rejected the offer, and Mister Sam thereupon decided to join the rebels.
senses.definition: refuse to accept
senses.definitionSentence: To reject means to refuse to accept.
senses.definitionZh: 拒绝接受。
senses.exampleZh: 史密斯断然拒绝了这个提议，山姆先生随即决定加入叛军。

senses.example: His body rejected the liver of the donor.
senses.definition: resist immunologically the introduction of some foreign tissue or organ
senses.definitionSentence: To reject means to resist immunologically the introduction of some foreign tissue or organ.
senses.definitionZh: 通过免疫学抵抗某些外来组织或器官的引入。
senses.exampleZh: 他的身体排斥捐赠者的肝脏。

senses.example: The court rejected the appeal and refused to consider it further.
senses.definition: dismiss from consideration or a contest
senses.definitionSentence: To reject means to dismiss from consideration or a contest.
senses.definitionZh: 排除考虑或竞赛。
senses.exampleZh: 法院驳回上诉并拒绝进一步考虑。

senses.definition: cause to experience or suffer or make liable or vulnerable to
senses.definitionSentence: Cause to experience or suffer or make liable or vulnerable to.
senses.definitionZh: 导致经历或遭受或承担责任或容易遭受。
senses.example: The experiment subjected the metal to extreme heat and pressure for several hours.
senses.exampleZh: 该实验将金属置于极高的温度和压力下几个小时。

senses.example: He didn't want to discuss that subject.
senses.definition: the subject matter of a conversation or discussion
senses.definitionSentence: Subject is the subject matter of a conversation or discussion.
senses.definitionZh: 对话或讨论的主题。
senses.exampleZh: 他不想讨论这个话题。

senses.example: Teachers should be well trained in their subject.
senses.definition: a branch of knowledge
senses.definitionSentence: Subject is a branch of knowledge.
senses.definitionZh: 知识的一个分支。
senses.exampleZh: 教师应在其学科方面接受良好的培训。

senses.example: The invading army subjected the province to military rule and removed its elected leaders.
senses.definition: make subservient; force to submit or subdue
senses.definitionSentence: To subject means to make subservient; force to submit or subdue.
senses.definitionZh: 服从；强迫屈服或征服。
senses.exampleZh: 侵略军将该省置于军事统治之下，并罢免了民选领导人。

senses.example: But there's a subjective side to that utopian outlook.
senses.definition: taking place within the mind and modified by individual bias
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as subjective is taking place within the mind and modified by individual bias.
senses.definitionZh: 一些被描述为主观的东西正在头脑中发生，并被个人偏见所修改。
senses.exampleZh: 但这种乌托邦式的前景也有主观的一面。

senses.example: There the name vaguely connotes new-rich wealth, a reputation for eccentricity, and an ardor for collecting art.
senses.definition: get or gather together
senses.definitionSentence: To collect means to get or gather together.
senses.definitionZh: 获得或聚集在一起。
senses.exampleZh: 这个名字隐约意味着新贵的财富、古怪的名声以及对艺术品收藏的热情。

senses.example: We collected over a million dollars in outstanding debts.
senses.definition: call for and obtain payment of
senses.definitionSentence: To collect means to call for and obtain payment of.
senses.definitionZh: 要求并获得付款。
senses.exampleZh: 我们收回了超过一百万美元的未偿债务。

senses.example: Manthey maintained a valuable collection of physical and chemical apparatus which was at Oersted's disposal during and after his graduation.
senses.definition: several things grouped together or considered as a whole
senses.definitionSentence: Collection means several things grouped together or considered as a whole.
senses.definitionZh: 将多个事物组合在一起或视为一个整体。
senses.exampleZh: 曼泰收藏了一系列珍贵的物理和化学仪器，供奥斯特在毕业期间和毕业后使用。

senses.example: At the very end, when the audience was silent and breathless, a collection was taken and then slowly everyone filed out.
senses.definition: request for a sum of money
senses.definitionSentence: Collection means request for a sum of money.
senses.definitionZh: 索要一笔钱款。
senses.exampleZh: 最后，当观众们鸦雀无声、气喘吁吁时，大家开始集合，然后慢慢地鱼贯而出。

senses.example: They include both individual fears and collective ones.
senses.definition: done by or characteristic of individuals acting together
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as collective is done by or characteristic of individuals acting together.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为集体的事物是由共同行动的个人完成的或具有共同行动的特征。
senses.exampleZh: 它们包括个人恐惧和集体恐惧。

senses.example: The immigrants spoke an odd dialect of English.
senses.definition: the usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people
senses.definitionSentence: Dialect is the usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people.
senses.definitionZh: 特定人群特有的用法或词汇。
senses.exampleZh: 移民说着一种奇怪的英语方言。

senses.example: We elected him chairman of the board.
senses.definition: select by a vote for an office or membership
senses.definitionSentence: To elect means to select by a vote for an office or membership.
senses.definitionZh: 通过投票选出职位或成员资格。
senses.exampleZh: 我们选举他为董事会主席。

senses.example: I elected to have my funds deposited automatically.
senses.definition: choose
senses.definitionSentence: To elect means to choose.
senses.definitionZh: 选择。
senses.exampleZh: 我选择自动存入资金。

senses.example: Membership was limited to an elect circle of exceptionally accomplished artists chosen by the academy.
senses.definition: selected as the best
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as elect is selected as the best.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项所描述的事物被选为最好的。
senses.exampleZh: 会员资格仅限于由学院选出的杰出艺术家组成的圈子。

senses.example: Intellectual workers engaged in creative literary or artistic or scientific labor.
senses.definition: appealing to or using the intellect
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as intellectual is appealing to or using the intellect.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为智力的东西是吸引或使用智力。
senses.exampleZh: 从事创造性文学、艺术或科学劳动的智力劳动者。

senses.example: Although he is perfectly willing to cooperate with Scotland Yard, Holmes has nothing but contempt for the intelligence and mentality of the police.
senses.definition: the ability to comprehend; to understand and profit from experience
senses.definitionSentence: Intelligence is the ability to comprehend; to understand and profit from experience.
senses.definitionZh: 理解的能力；理解并从经验中获益。
senses.exampleZh: 尽管福尔摩斯非常愿意与苏格兰场合作，但他对警察的智力和心态只有蔑视。

senses.example: Field agents supplied fresh intelligence about troop movements and recent attacks.
senses.definition: information about recent and important events
senses.definitionSentence: Intelligence means information about recent and important events.
senses.definitionZh: 有关最近发生的重要事件的信息。
senses.exampleZh: 外勤特工提供了有关部队调动和最近袭击的最新情报。

senses.example: Of course his love was expressed in intelligent care.
senses.definition: exercising or showing good judgment
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as intelligent is exercising or showing good judgment.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为聪明的东西是锻炼或表现出良好的判断力。
senses.exampleZh: 他的爱当然是用智慧的关怀来表达的。

senses.example: The medieval was the most important to Chambers because he sought to place Thomas More, the author of Utopia, in some intelligible relation with St. Thomas More, the martyr.
senses.definition: capable of being apprehended or understood
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as intelligible is capable of being apprehended or understood.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为可理解的事物能够被理解或理解。
senses.exampleZh: 中世纪对钱伯斯来说是最重要的，因为他试图将《乌托邦》的作者托马斯·莫尔与烈士圣·托马斯·莫尔建立起某种可以理解的关系。

senses.example: He attended a lecture on telecommunications.
senses.definition: a speech that is open to the public
senses.definitionSentence: Lecture is a speech that is open to the public.
senses.definitionZh: 向公众开放的演讲。
senses.exampleZh: 他参加了有关电信的讲座。

senses.example: Mr. Kennedy did not neglect to cultivate the personal friendship of reporters.
senses.definition: fail to do something; leave something undone
senses.definitionSentence: To neglect means to fail to do something; leave something undone.
senses.definitionZh: 没有做某事；留下一些未完成的事情。
senses.exampleZh: 肯尼迪先生并没有忽视培养记者的个人友谊。

senses.example: The house was in a terrible state of neglect.
senses.definition: the state of something that has been unused and neglected
senses.definitionSentence: Neglect is the state of something that has been unused and neglected.
senses.definitionZh: 某物未被使用和被忽视的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 这所房子处于严重被忽视的状态。

senses.example: On the contrary, he was pleased that his face showed a neglect of several days.
senses.definition: willful lack of care and attention
senses.definitionSentence: Neglect means willful lack of care and attention.
senses.definitionZh: 故意缺乏照顾和关注。
senses.exampleZh: 相反，他很高兴自己的脸上露出了几天来的疏忽。

senses.example: After studying the old photograph, she recollected the name of the teacher from her childhood.
senses.definition: recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
senses.definitionSentence: To recollect means to recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection.
senses.definitionZh: 从记忆中回忆起知识；有回忆。
senses.exampleZh: 研究了旧照片后，她想起了小时候老师的名字。

senses.example: She selected a pair of shoes from among the dozen the salesgirl had shown her.
senses.definition: pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives
senses.definitionSentence: To select means to pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives.
senses.definitionZh: 挑选、选择或从多个备选方案中选择。
senses.exampleZh: 她从售货员给她展示的十几双鞋中选择了一双。

senses.example: The auction offered a select collection of museum-quality paintings chosen for their superior condition and importance.
senses.definition: of superior grade
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as select is of superior grade.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项所描述的事物是高级的。
senses.exampleZh: 此次拍卖提供了精选的博物馆级画作收藏，这些画作因其优越的条件和重要性而被选中。

senses.example: The store carried a large selection of shoes.
senses.definition: an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
senses.definitionSentence: Selection is an assortment of things from which a choice can be made.
senses.definitionZh: 可以从中做出选择的事物的分类。
senses.exampleZh: 商店出售多种鞋子。

senses.example: She pushed down the long lever, using the pivoting bar and its fulcrum to lift the heavy stone.
senses.definition: a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum
senses.definitionSentence: Lever is a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum.
senses.definitionZh: 一个绕支点旋转的刚性杆。
senses.exampleZh: 她按下长杠杆，利用枢轴杆及其支点举起了沉重的石头。

senses.example: It has identified itself with the very tension and terror it once did so much to alleviate.
senses.definition: make easier
senses.definitionSentence: To alleviate means to make easier.
senses.definitionZh: 变得更容易。
senses.exampleZh: 它已经将自己与曾经竭尽全力缓解的紧张和恐怖联系在一起。

senses.example: Nick Skorich, the line coach for the football champion Philadelphia Eagles, was elevated today to head coach.
senses.definition: give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
senses.definitionSentence: To elevate means to give a promotion to or assign to a higher position.
senses.definitionZh: 晋升或分配到更高的职位。
senses.exampleZh: 橄榄球冠军费城老鹰队的主教练尼克·斯科里奇今天被提升为主教练。

senses.example: At its most ecstatic moments, husband and wife are elevated far above worldly cares.
senses.definition: raise from a lower to a higher position
senses.definitionSentence: To elevate means to raise from a lower to a higher position.
senses.definitionZh: 从较低的位置提升到较高的位置。
senses.exampleZh: 在最欣喜若狂的时刻，丈夫和妻子远远超越了世俗的忧虑。

senses.example: Feed is put in with an elevator.
senses.definition: lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building
senses.definitionSentence: Elevator means lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building.
senses.definitionZh: 由平台或轿厢组成的提升装置，该平台或轿厢在垂直轴中机械升降，以便将人员从建筑物中的一层移动到另一层。
senses.exampleZh: 饲料通过升降机投入。

senses.example: The pilot raised the aircraft's elevator, lifting the nose and beginning the climb.
senses.definition: the airfoil on the tailplane of an aircraft that makes it ascend or descend
senses.definitionSentence: Elevator is the airfoil on the tailplane of an aircraft that makes it ascend or descend.
senses.definitionZh: 飞机水平尾翼上的机翼，使飞机上升或下降。
senses.exampleZh: 飞行员升起飞机升降舵，抬起机头并开始爬升。

senses.example: A high level of care is required.
senses.definition: a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality
senses.definitionSentence: Level is a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality.
senses.definitionZh: 强度、数量或质量的等级。
senses.exampleZh: 需要高水平的护理。

senses.example: As the concrete spread across the floor, its surface gradually leveled into a smooth, even plane.
senses.definition: become level or even
senses.definitionSentence: To level means to become level or even.
senses.definitionZh: 变得水平或均匀。
senses.exampleZh: 随着混凝土在地板上铺展，其表面逐渐平整成光滑、均匀的平面。

senses.example: In addition to the collection of service charges, the special districts levy annual property taxes of approximately $ 450000.
senses.definition: impose and collect
senses.definitionSentence: To levy means to impose and collect.
senses.definitionZh: 征收和征收。
senses.exampleZh: 除收取服务费外，各特区每年征收约45万美元的财产税。

senses.definition: of comparatively little physical weight or density
senses.definitionSentence: Of comparatively little physical weight or density.
senses.definitionZh: 物理重量或密度相对较小。
senses.example: The folding chair is light enough for one person to carry with one hand.
senses.exampleZh: 折叠椅足够轻，一个人可以用一只手搬动。

senses.example: He stopped the car and turned off the lights.
senses.definition: any device serving as a source of illumination
senses.definitionSentence: Light means any device serving as a source of illumination.
senses.definitionZh: 充当照明源的任何设备。
senses.exampleZh: 他停下车并关掉灯。

senses.example: He found a match in his pocket and lit it.
senses.definition: cause to start burning; subject to fire or great heat
senses.definitionSentence: To light means to cause to start burning; subject to fire or great heat.
senses.definitionZh: 开始燃烧；易受火或高温的影响。
senses.exampleZh: 他在口袋里找到一根火柴并点燃了它。

senses.example: Another Virginia sight and a photographic adventure are the Luray Caverns, lit by photofloodlights.
senses.definition: make lighter or brighter
senses.definitionSentence: To light means to make lighter or brighter.
senses.definitionZh: 变得更亮或更亮。
senses.exampleZh: 弗吉尼亚州的另一个景点和摄影冒险是卢雷洞穴 (Luray Caverns)，由泛光灯照亮。

senses.example: A room that is light when the shutters are open.
senses.definition: characterized by or emitting light
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as light is characterized by or emitting light.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为光的事物的特征是发光或发射光。
senses.exampleZh: 百叶窗打开时光线明亮的房间。

senses.example: The introduction highlighted the speaker's distinguished career in linguistics.
senses.definition: move into the foreground to make more visible or prominent
senses.definitionSentence: To highlight means to move into the foreground to make more visible or prominent.
senses.definitionZh: 移至前景以使其更加可见或突出。
senses.exampleZh: 引言强调了演讲者在语言学领域的杰出职业生涯。

senses.example: The highlight of the tour was our visit to the Vatican.
senses.definition: the most interesting or memorable part
senses.definitionSentence: Highlight is the most interesting or memorable part.
senses.definitionZh: 最有趣或最难忘的部分。
senses.exampleZh: 这次旅行的亮点是我们参观梵蒂冈。

senses.example: The search resumed in daylight after sunrise, when natural light made the mountain path visible.
senses.definition: the time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside
senses.definitionSentence: Daylight is the time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside.
senses.definitionZh: 日出之后、日落之前室外光线充足的时间。
senses.exampleZh: 搜索在日出后的白天恢复，此时自然光使山路清晰可见。

senses.example: He had spent two hours riding around the ranch that morning, and in broad daylight it was even less inviting than Judith Pierce had made it seem.
senses.definition: light during the daytime
senses.definitionSentence: Daylight means light during the daytime.
senses.definitionZh: 白天的光。
senses.exampleZh: 那天早上，他在牧场周围骑了两个小时，光天化日之下，这里甚至没有朱迪思·皮尔斯所说的那么吸引人。

senses.example: Displayed as lamps, the puppets delight the children and are decorative accent.
senses.definition: give pleasure to or be pleasing to
senses.definitionSentence: To delight means to give pleasure to or be pleasing to.
senses.definitionZh: 给予快乐或取悦他人。
senses.exampleZh: 这些木偶以灯的形式展示，让孩子们感到高兴，并且具有装饰性。

senses.meaning: 给予宗教或精神上的启迪
senses.example: Years of prayer and meditation enlightened the monk and deepened his spiritual understanding.
senses.definition: give spiritual insight to; in religion
senses.definitionSentence: To enlighten means to give spiritual insight to; in religion.
senses.definitionZh: 给予精神洞察力；在宗教中。
senses.exampleZh: 多年的祈祷和冥想启发了僧侣并加深了他的精神理解。

senses.example: A flash of lightning lit the sky when electricity discharged between the storm cloud and the ground.
senses.definition: the flash of light that accompanies an electric discharge in the atmosphere (or something resembling such a flash); can scintillate for a second or more
senses.definitionSentence: Lightning is the flash of light that accompanies an electric discharge in the atmosphere (or something resembling such a flash); can scintillate for a second or more.
senses.definitionZh: 伴随大气中放电的闪光（或类似闪光的东西）；可以闪烁一秒或更长时间。
senses.exampleZh: 当暴风雨云和地面之间放电时，一道闪电照亮了天空。

senses.example: When typical reaction cells to which 0.3 of an atmosphere of oxygen had been added were illuminated, chlorine and phosgene were produced.
senses.definition: make lighter or brighter
senses.definitionSentence: To illuminate means to make lighter or brighter.
senses.definitionZh: 变得更亮或更亮。
senses.exampleZh: 当照亮已添加0.3个大气压的氧气的典型反应池时，产生氯和光气。

senses.example: The promise of easy money was a powerful lure for inexperienced investors.
senses.definition: anything that serves as an enticement
senses.definitionSentence: Lure means anything that serves as an enticement.
senses.definitionZh: 任何具有诱惑作用的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 轻松赚钱的承诺对于缺乏经验的投资者来说是一个强大的诱惑。

senses.example: He lured me into temptation.
senses.definition: provoke someone to do something through (often false or exaggerated) promises or persuasion
senses.definitionSentence: To lure means to provoke someone to do something through (often false or exaggerated) promises or persuasion.
senses.definitionZh: 通过（通常是虚假或夸大的）承诺或说服来刺激某人做某事。
senses.exampleZh: 他引诱我陷入诱惑。

senses.example: The angler attached a bright lure to the line to attract trout toward the hook.
senses.definition: something used to lure fish or other animals into danger so they can be trapped or killed
senses.definitionSentence: Lure means something used to lure fish or other animals into danger so they can be trapped or killed.
senses.definitionZh: 用来引诱鱼类或其他动物陷入危险以便被困或杀死的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 钓鱼者在钓线上安装了一个明亮的诱饵，以吸引鳟鱼靠近鱼钩。

senses.example: It was then that Picasso and Braque were confronted with a unique dilemma: they had to choose between illusion and representation.
senses.definition: an erroneous mental representation
senses.definitionSentence: Illusion is an erroneous mental representation.
senses.definitionZh: 一种错误的心理表征。
senses.exampleZh: 就在那时，毕加索和布拉克面临着一个独特的困境：他们必须在幻觉和再现之间做出选择。

senses.example: The magician created the illusion that his assistant had vanished from the box.
senses.definition: an illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers
senses.definitionSentence: Illusion is an illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers.
senses.definitionZh: 虚幻的壮举；被天真的观察者认为是神奇的。
senses.exampleZh: 魔术师制造了他的助手从盒子里消失的假象。

senses.example: A hypothetical example will illustrate this point.
senses.definition: clarify by giving an example of
senses.definitionSentence: To illustrate means to clarify by giving an example of.
senses.definitionZh: 通过举例来阐明。
senses.exampleZh: 一个假设的例子将说明这一点。

senses.example: The teacher offered the melting ice cap as an illustration of rapid climate change.
senses.definition: an item of information that is typical of a class or group
senses.definitionSentence: Illustration is an item of information that is typical of a class or group.
senses.definitionZh: 一个类别或群体的典型信息项。
senses.exampleZh: 老师用融化的冰盖来说明气候的快速变化。

senses.example: The anatomy textbook includes a labeled illustration showing every chamber of the human heart.
senses.definition: a visual representation (a picture or diagram) that is used make some subject more pleasing or easier to understand
senses.definitionSentence: Illustration is a visual representation (a picture or diagram) that is used make some subject more pleasing or easier to understand.
senses.definitionZh: 一种视觉表示（图片或图表），用于使某些主题更令人愉悦或更容易理解。
senses.exampleZh: 这本解剖学教材配有一幅标注插图，展示了人类心脏的每个腔室。

senses.example: Their luxury was visible in the marble mansion, private yacht, and lavish dinners.
senses.definition: wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living
senses.definitionSentence: Luxury means wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living.
senses.definitionZh: 财富，如奢华的生活所证明的那样。
senses.exampleZh: 他们的奢华体现在大理石豪宅、私人游艇和丰盛的晚餐上。

senses.meaning: 局部的，当地的，地方性的
senses.example: The local newspaper reports council decisions, neighborhood events, and issues affecting the surrounding town.
senses.definition: of or belonging to or characteristic of a particular locality or neighborhood
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as local is of or belonging to or characteristic of a particular locality or neighborhood.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为本地的事物属于或属于特定地区或社区或具有特定地区或社区的特征。
senses.exampleZh: 当地报纸报道议会决定、社区活动以及影响周边城镇的问题。

senses.example: The dentist injected a local before drilling, so only the patient's jaw became numb.
senses.definition: anesthetic that numbs a particular area of the body
senses.definitionSentence: Local means anesthetic that numbs a particular area of the body.
senses.definitionZh: 使身体特定区域麻木的麻醉剂。
senses.exampleZh: 牙医在钻孔前注射了局部，所以只有病人的下巴变得麻木。

senses.example: I am allocating a loaf of bread to everyone on a daily basis.
senses.definition: distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose
senses.definitionSentence: To allocate means to distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 根据计划分配或为特殊目的预留。
senses.exampleZh: 我每天给每个人分配一条面包。

senses.example: Fourth, the type of vocational training programs should be related to the employment opportunities in the general locality.
senses.definition: a surrounding or nearby region
senses.definitionSentence: Locality is a surrounding or nearby region.
senses.definitionZh: 周围或附近的区域。
senses.exampleZh: 第四，职业培训项目的类型应与当地的就业机会相关。

senses.definition: discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining
senses.definitionSentence: Discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining.
senses.definitionZh: 发现……的位置；确定地点；通过搜索或检查找到。
senses.example: Rescuers used the phone signal to locate the missing hikers in the forest.
senses.exampleZh: 救援人员利用电话信号找到了森林中失踪的徒步旅行者。

senses.example: Our sense of sight enables us to locate objects in space.
senses.definition: determine or indicate the place, site, or limits of, as if by an instrument or by a survey
senses.definitionSentence: To locate means to determine or indicate the place, site, or limits of, as if by an instrument or by a survey.
senses.definitionZh: 确定或指示地点、地点或限制，就像通过仪器或调查一样。
senses.exampleZh: 我们的视觉使我们能够定位空间中的物体。

senses.example: Check your cafeteria location to make sure it's convenient for most employees.
senses.definition: a point or extent in space
senses.definitionSentence: Location is a point or extent in space.
senses.definitionZh: 空间中的一个点或范围。
senses.exampleZh: 检查您的自助餐厅位置，确保对大多数员工来说方便。

senses.example: The diesel locomotive pulled twenty freight cars along the railway track.
senses.definition: a wheeled vehicle consisting of a self-propelled engine that is used to draw trains along railway tracks
senses.definitionSentence: Locomotive is a wheeled vehicle consisting of a self-propelled engine that is used to draw trains along railway tracks.
senses.definitionZh: 一种由自行式发动机组成的轮式车辆，用于沿着铁轨牵引火车。
senses.exampleZh: 内燃机车沿着铁轨牵引着二十节货车。

senses.example: Strong locomotive muscles allow the animal to run, climb, and leap efficiently.
senses.definition: of or relating to locomotion
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as locomotive is of or relating to locomotion.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为机车的东西属于运动或与运动相关。
senses.exampleZh: 强大的运动肌肉使动物能够有效地奔跑、攀爬和跳跃。

senses.example: By the logic of supply and demand, a scarce product with many buyers should become more expensive.
senses.definition: the principles that guide reasoning within a given field or situation
senses.definitionSentence: Logic is the principles that guide reasoning within a given field or situation.
senses.definitionZh: 在给定领域或情况下指导推理的原则。
senses.exampleZh: 根据供需逻辑，拥有众多买家的稀缺产品应该变得更贵。

senses.example: The mechanism of this coupling has been studied in some detail with non-enzymatic systems in vitro and can be simulated by certain di-iodotyrosine analogues (Pitt-Rivers and James, 1958).
senses.definition: something having the property of being analogous to something else
senses.definitionSentence: Analogue means something having the property of being analogous to something else.
senses.definitionZh: 具有与其他事物类似的属性的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 这种偶联的机制已经在体外用非酶系统进行了一些详细研究，并且可以通过某些二碘酪氨酸类似物进行模拟（Pitt-Rivers 和 James，1958）。

senses.example: The situation with regard to our attitude and `` control '' of disease contains close analogies to problems confronting us with respect to people.
senses.definition: an inference that if things agree in some respects they probably agree in others
senses.definitionSentence: Analogy is an inference that if things agree in some respects they probably agree in others.
senses.definitionZh: 一种推论，即如果事物在某些方面一致，那么它们在其他方面也可能一致。
senses.exampleZh: 我们对疾病的态度和“控制”情况与我们面对的与人有关的问题非常相似。

senses.example: The play opens with a tense dialog between the detective and the suspect.
senses.definition: a conversation between two persons
senses.definitionSentence: Dialog is a conversation between two persons.
senses.definitionZh: 两个人之间的对话。
senses.exampleZh: 该剧以侦探和嫌疑人之间紧张的对话开始。

senses.example: All evening she was eloquent and pleased with herself.
senses.definition: expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as eloquent is expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively.
senses.definitionZh: 雄辩是指轻松、清晰、有效地表达自己。
senses.exampleZh: 整个晚上她都能言善辩，对自己很满意。

senses.example: He slumped against a log fence rail, then tried to lift himself.
senses.definition: a segment of the trunk of a tree when stripped of branches
senses.definitionSentence: Log is a segment of the trunk of a tree when stripped of branches.
senses.definitionZh: 树干被剥去树枝后的一段。
senses.exampleZh: 他跌倒在木栅栏栏杆上，然后试图站起来。

senses.meaning: 合乎逻辑的，有逻辑的，有逻辑头脑的，符合逻辑的
senses.example: The entire concept of cerebral imagery as the physical basis of a mental image can find no logical support.
senses.definition: capable of or reflecting the capability for correct and valid reasoning
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as logical is capable of or reflecting the capability for correct and valid reasoning.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为逻辑的东西能够或反映正确和有效推理的能力。
senses.exampleZh: 大脑意象作为心理意象的物理基础的整个概念找不到逻辑支持。

senses.example: Rain was a logical expectation, given the time of year.

senses.definitionSentence: To coordinate means to bring into common action, movement, or condition.
senses.definitionZh: 采取共同的行动、运动或条件。
senses.exampleZh: 与同事协调他的行动。

senses.example: The files are in complete disorder.
senses.definition: a condition in which things are not in their expected places
senses.definitionSentence: Disorder is a condition in which things are not in their expected places.
senses.definitionZh: 事物未处于预期位置的情况。
senses.exampleZh: 文件完全混乱。

senses.example: The doctor prescribed some medicine for the disorder.
senses.definition: a physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning
senses.definitionSentence: Disorder is a physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning.
senses.definitionZh: 一种正常功能受到干扰的身体状况。
senses.exampleZh: 医生开了一些治疗这种疾病的药物。

senses.example: Her extraordinary capacity for work allowed her to manage three major projects without missing a deadline.
senses.definition: beyond what is ordinary or usual; highly unusual or exceptional or remarkable
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as extraordinary is beyond what is ordinary or usual; highly unusual or exceptional or remarkable.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为非凡的事物超出了普通或平常的事物；非常不寻常或异常或非凡。
senses.exampleZh: 她非凡的工作能力使她能够在没有错过最后期限的情况下管理三个主要项目。

senses.example: The orderly workshop had every clean tool labeled and stored in its proper place.
senses.definition: clean or organized
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as orderly is clean or organized.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为有序的东西是干净的或有组织的。
senses.exampleZh: 车间井然有序，每件干净的工具都贴上标签，存放在适当的位置。

senses.example: Businessmen deduct all ordinary and necessary expenses attributable to a trade or business.
senses.definition: not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as ordinary is not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为普通的事物在任何方面都不例外，尤其是在质量、能力、大小或程度方面。
senses.exampleZh: 商人扣除归因于贸易或业务的所有普通和必要费用。

senses.example: A snowfall in July is far outside the ordinary for this normally warm region.
senses.definition: the expected or commonplace condition or situation
senses.definitionSentence: Ordinary is the expected or commonplace condition or situation.
senses.definitionZh: 预期的或常见的情况或情况。
senses.exampleZh: 对于这个通常温暖的地区来说，7 月的降雪量远远超出正常水平。

senses.example: From the enlisted men he pistol-whipped to the subordinate officer whose wife he tried to rape, a lot of men had plenty of reason heartily to dislike Marcus Reno.
senses.definition: lower in rank or importance
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as subordinate is lower in rank or importance.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为下属的事物的级别或重要性较低。
senses.exampleZh: 从他用手枪鞭打的士兵到他试图强奸妻子的下属军官，很多男人都有充分的理由不喜欢马库斯·雷诺。

senses.meaning: 发白的，失色的，灰白的，苍白的
senses.example: He stretched a pale hand out to the scattered papers on his desk.
senses.definition: very light colored; highly diluted with white
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as pale is very light colored; highly diluted with white.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为苍白的东西是非常浅的颜色；用白色高度稀释。
senses.exampleZh: 他将苍白的手伸向桌上散落的文件。

senses.example: The pale light of a half moon.
senses.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as pale is (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“苍白”的东西是指（光）缺乏强度或亮度；暗淡或微弱。
senses.exampleZh: 半月的苍白光芒。

senses.example: The cruelty shown in the video appalled viewers and filled them with disgust.
senses.definition: strike with disgust or revulsion
senses.definitionSentence: To appal means to strike with disgust or revulsion.
senses.definitionZh: 厌恶或厌恶地进行打击。
senses.exampleZh: 视频中表现出的残酷行为让观众感到震惊并充满厌恶。

senses.example: The king received foreign ambassadors in the royal palace.
senses.definition: official residence of an exalted person (as a sovereign)
senses.definitionSentence: Palace means official residence of an exalted person (as a sovereign).
senses.definitionZh: 尊贵人士（作为君主）的官邸。
senses.exampleZh: 国王在王宫接见外国大使。

senses.example: He saw Mose squatting by the hearth, breaking up hardtack into a pan.
senses.definition: cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel
senses.definitionSentence: Pan means cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel.
senses.definitionZh: 由宽金属容器组成的烹饪器具。
senses.exampleZh: 他看到摩西蹲在炉边，把硬面包打碎到锅里。

senses.example: Heart attacks are accompanied by distruction of heart tissue.
senses.definition: be present or associated with an event or entity
senses.definitionSentence: To accompany means to be present or associated with an event or entity.
senses.definitionZh: 出现或与事件或实体相关。
senses.exampleZh: 心脏病发作伴随着心脏组织的破坏。

senses.definition: a friend who is frequently in the company of another
senses.definitionSentence: A friend who is frequently in the company of another.
senses.definitionZh: 经常与另一个人在一起的朋友。
senses.example: A trained guide was her companion throughout the long mountain journey.
senses.exampleZh: 一位训练有素的向导陪伴着她度过了漫长的山路旅程。

senses.example: A trained dog companions the elderly man and stays beside him throughout the day.
senses.definition: be a companion to somebody
senses.definitionSentence: To companion means to be a companion to somebody.
senses.definitionZh: 成为某人的同伴。
senses.exampleZh: 一只训练有素的狗陪伴着老人，全天陪伴在他身边。

senses.definition: an institution created to conduct business
senses.definitionSentence: An institution created to conduct business.
senses.definitionZh: 为开展业务而设立的机构。
senses.example: The technology company designs software and employs more than two thousand people.
senses.exampleZh: 这家科技公司设计软件，拥有员工两千多人。

senses.example: She loved him and missed his company.
senses.definition: the state of being with someone
senses.definitionSentence: Company is the state of being with someone.
senses.definitionZh: 与某人在一起的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 她爱他，想念他的陪伴。

senses.example: Headquarters of the Nassau system is an increasingly busy place these days, threatening to expand beyond its boundaries.
senses.definition: extend in one or more directions
senses.definitionSentence: To expand means to extend in one or more directions.
senses.definitionZh: 向一个或多个方向扩展。
senses.exampleZh: 拿骚系统的总部如今变得越来越繁忙，有可能扩展到其边界之外。

senses.example: The author expanded the brief claim with evidence, examples, and a detailed explanation.
senses.definition: add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing
senses.definitionSentence: To expand means to add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing.
senses.definitionZh: 添加细节，例如帐户或想法；以学到的方式（通常是书面形式）阐明含义和话语。
senses.exampleZh: 作者用证据、示例和详细解释扩展了简短的主张。

senses.example: Ex Oriole Clint Courtney, now catching for the A's is all for the American League's 1961 expansion to the West Coast.
senses.definition: the act of increasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope
senses.definitionSentence: Expansion is the act of increasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope.
senses.definitionZh: 增加（某物）大小、体积、数量或范围的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 前金莺克林特考特尼 (Oriole Clint Courtney)，现在为 A 队效力，一切都是为了美国联盟 1961 年向西海岸的扩张。

senses.example: The second chapter is an expansion of the brief argument, adding evidence and historical detail.
senses.definition: adding information or detail
senses.definitionSentence: Expansion means adding information or detail.
senses.definitionZh: 添加信息或细节。
senses.exampleZh: 第二章是对简短论点的扩展，添加了证据和历史细节。

senses.example: There was a blur just under my focus of vision, a crash; the car's far windshield panel turned into a silver web with a dark hole in the center.
senses.definition: sheet that forms a distinct (usually flat and rectangular) section or component of something
senses.definitionSentence: Panel means sheet that forms a distinct (usually flat and rectangular) section or component of something.
senses.definitionZh: 形成某物的独特（通常是平坦和矩形）截面或组件的片材。
senses.exampleZh: 我的视线焦点下方出现一片模糊，发生了碰撞；汽车远处的挡风玻璃面板变成了一张银色的网，中间有一个黑洞。

senses.example: He checked the instrument panel.
senses.definition: electrical device consisting of a flat insulated surface that contains switches and dials and meters for controlling other electrical devices
senses.definitionSentence: Panel means electrical device consisting of a flat insulated surface that contains switches and dials and meters for controlling other electrical devices.
senses.definitionZh: 由平坦绝缘表面组成的电气设备，其中包含用于控制其他电气设备的开关、刻度盘和仪表。
senses.exampleZh: 他检查了仪表板。

senses.example: Panic swept the stock market as frightened investors rushed to sell their shares at any price.
senses.definition: sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events
senses.definitionSentence: Panic means sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events.
senses.definitionZh: 对预期事件突然发生的大规模恐惧和焦虑。
senses.exampleZh: 恐慌席卷了股市，惊恐的投资者纷纷以不惜一切代价出售股票。

senses.example: From the summit, a panorama of valleys, lakes, and distant mountains filled our view.
senses.definition: the visual percept of a region
senses.definitionSentence: Panorama is the visual percept of a region.
senses.definitionZh: 一个区域的视觉感知。
senses.exampleZh: 从山顶看去，山谷、湖泊和远山的全景尽收眼底。

senses.meaning: 局部，要素，部位，部分，部分-整体关系
senses.example: He wanted to feel a part of something bigger than himself.
senses.definition: something determined in relation to something that includes it
senses.definitionSentence: Part means something determined in relation to something that includes it.
senses.definitionZh: 与包含它的事物相关的确定的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 他想要感受到比自己更伟大的事物的一部分。

senses.definitionSentence: To some degree but not completely.
senses.definitionZh: 达到某种程度，但并不完全。
senses.example: The old warehouse is now part office and part art studio.
senses.exampleZh: 那座旧仓库现在一部分用作办公室，一部分用作艺术工作室。
senses.definition: To some degree but not completely.

senses.definitionSentence: To separate or move apart.
senses.definitionZh: 分开或彼此移开。
senses.example: The curtains began to part slowly, revealing the stage.
senses.exampleZh: 幕布开始慢慢分开，露出了舞台。
senses.definition: To separate or move apart.

senses.example: Existed over the centuries as a world apart.
senses.definition: remote and separate physically or socially
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as apart is remote and separate physically or socially.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为分离的事物在物理上或社交上是遥远且分离的。
senses.exampleZh: 作为一个截然不同的世界存在了几个世纪。

senses.example: People can't tell the twins apart.
senses.definition: one from the other
senses.definitionSentence: Apart means one from the other.
senses.definitionZh: 一个与另一个。
senses.exampleZh: 人们无法区分这对双胞胎。

senses.example: He occupied a two bedroom apartment on the fourth floor, using the second bedroom as his office.
senses.definition: a suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house
senses.definitionSentence: Apartment is a suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house.
senses.definitionZh: 一套房间，通常位于公寓的一层。
senses.exampleZh: 他占据了四楼的一套两居室公寓，将第二间卧室用作他的办公室。

senses.example: Sports Writer Ensign Ritchie of the Ogden Standard Examiner went to his compartment to talk with him.
senses.definition: a partitioned section, chamber, or separate room within a larger enclosed area
senses.definitionSentence: Compartment is a partitioned section, chamber, or separate room within a larger enclosed area.
senses.definitionZh: 较大封闭区域内的分隔部分、室或单独房间。
senses.exampleZh: 奥格登标准审查员的体育记者少尉里奇去他的包厢与他交谈。

senses.example: He was about to leave them, to depart from this world, and return to His Father in Heaven.
senses.definition: go away or leave
senses.definitionSentence: To depart means to go away or leave.
senses.definitionZh: 走开或离开。
senses.exampleZh: 他即将离开他们，离开这个世界，回到天父身边。

senses.example: Its entire complement of non-commissioned officers on the platoon level had departed as cadre for another unit, and its vehicles were still those used in the drive across Luzon in World War 2,.
senses.definition: leave
senses.definitionSentence: To depart means to leave.
senses.definitionZh: 离开。
senses.exampleZh: 其全部排级士官已作为骨干前往另一个部队，其车辆仍是第二次世界大战中穿越吕宋岛时使用的车辆。

senses.example: Linguistic charting of the transcribed interview flags points where the patient's voice departs from expected norms.
senses.definition: be at variance with; be out of line with
senses.definitionSentence: To depart means to be at variance with; be out of line with.
senses.definitionZh: 不符合；格格不入。
senses.exampleZh: 转录访谈的语言图表标记了患者声音偏离预期规范的点。

senses.example: You'll find it in the hardware department.
senses.definition: a specialized division of a large organization
senses.definitionSentence: Department is a specialized division of a large organization.
senses.definitionZh: 一个大型组织的专门部门。
senses.exampleZh: 您可以在硬件部门找到它。

senses.example: These were the early departures; in half an hour the reception would be over.
senses.definition: the act of departing
senses.definitionSentence: Departure is the act of departing.
senses.definitionZh: 离开的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 这些是早期离开；半个小时后，招待会就结束了。

senses.example: Impart a new skill to the students.
senses.definition: transmit (knowledge or skills)
senses.definitionSentence: To impart means to transmit (knowledge or skills).
senses.definitionZh: 传播（知识或技能）。
senses.exampleZh: 向学生传授新技能。

senses.example: Oak barrels impart a smoky flavor and golden color to the wine.
senses.definition: bestow a quality on
senses.definitionSentence: To impart means to bestow a quality on.
senses.definitionZh: 赋予品质。
senses.exampleZh: 橡木桶赋予葡萄酒烟熏味和金色。

senses.meaning: 偏爱的，不公平的，偏袒的
senses.example: The referee was partial to the home team and ignored several obvious fouls.
senses.definition: showing favoritism
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as partial is showing favoritism.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为部分的事物表现出偏袒。
senses.exampleZh: 裁判偏袒主队，忽视了几次明显的犯规。

senses.example: For we have said, in effect, that of the two alternatives to his position variously represented by the other participants in the demythologizing discussion, only one is really an alternative.
senses.definition: someone who takes part in an activity
senses.definitionSentence: Participant means someone who takes part in an activity.
senses.definitionZh: 参加活动的人。
senses.exampleZh: 因为我们实际上已经说过，在去神话化讨论中其他参与者以不同方式代表他的立场的两种替代方案中，只有一种是真正的替代方案。

senses.example: Students from every department participated in the campus cleanup.
senses.definition: take part in or become involved in an activity
senses.definitionSentence: To take part in or become involved in an activity.
senses.definitionZh: 参加某项活动或参与其中。
senses.exampleZh: 各院系的学生都参加了校园清洁活动。

senses.example: A tiny particle of dust entered the camera and left a dark spot on every photograph.
senses.definition: (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
senses.definitionSentence: Particle means (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything.
senses.definitionZh: （非技术用法）任何东西的一小部分。
senses.exampleZh: 微小的灰尘颗粒进入相机并在每张照片上留下黑点。

senses.example: Whipple (1955) extends the effects to include the solar corpuscular radiation pressure, which increases both the minimum particle size and the drag.
senses.definition: a body having finite mass and internal structure but negligible dimensions
senses.definitionSentence: Particle is a body having finite mass and internal structure but negligible dimensions.
senses.definitionZh: 具有有限质量和内部结构但尺寸可忽略不计的物体。
senses.exampleZh: Whipple (1955) 将影响扩展到包括太阳粒子辐射压，这会增加最小颗粒尺寸和阻力。

senses.example: Has a particular preference for Chinese art.
senses.definition: unique or specific to a person or thing or category
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as particular is unique or specific to a person or thing or category.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为特定的东西是独特的或特定于人、事物或类别的。
senses.exampleZh: 对中国艺术有着特殊的偏好。

senses.example: Very particular about how her food was prepared.
senses.definition: exacting especially about details
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as particular is exacting especially about details.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为特殊的东西尤其是细节方面的要求很高。
senses.exampleZh: 她对食物的准备方式非常讲究。

senses.example: I felt partly to blame.
senses.definition: in part; in some degree; not wholly
senses.definitionSentence: Partly means in part; in some degree; not wholly.
senses.definitionZh: 部分；在某种程度上；不完全。
senses.exampleZh: 我觉得自己有部分责任。

senses.example: The partners each bring to it unselfish love, and each takes away an equal share of pleasure and joy.
senses.definition: a person's partner in marriage
senses.definitionSentence: Partner is a person's partner in marriage.
senses.definitionZh: 一个人的婚姻伴侣。
senses.exampleZh: 伴侣各自给它带来无私的爱，同时各自带走平等的快乐和欢乐。

senses.example: Each partner invested money in the firm and shared its profits and debts.
senses.definition: a person who is a member of a partnership
senses.definitionSentence: Partner is a person who is a member of a partnership.
senses.definitionZh: 合伙企业的成员。
senses.exampleZh: 每个合伙人向公司投资并分享其利润和债务。

senses.example: In 1992 Perot tried to organize a third party at the national level.
senses.definition: an organization to gain political power
senses.definitionSentence: Party is an organization to gain political power.
senses.definitionZh: 获得政治权力的组织。
senses.exampleZh: 1992 年，佩罗试图在国家层面组织第三方。

senses.definitionSentence: A social gathering where people meet for pleasure or celebration.
senses.definitionZh: 人们为了娱乐或庆祝而举行的社交聚会。
senses.example: They held a small party to celebrate her graduation.
senses.exampleZh: 他们举办了一个小型聚会来庆祝她毕业。
senses.definition: A social gathering where people meet for pleasure or celebration.

senses.example: The soldiers parachuted from the aircraft and landed behind enemy lines.
senses.definition: jump from an airplane and descend with a parachute
senses.definitionSentence: To parachute means to jump from an airplane and descend with a parachute.
senses.definitionZh: 从飞机上跳下来并带着降落伞下降。
senses.exampleZh: 士兵们从飞机上跳伞，降落在敌后。

senses.definitionSentence: A device that fills with air to slow a person's or object's fall.
senses.definitionZh: 一种充气展开后可减缓人员或物体下落速度的装置。
senses.example: His parachute opened safely after he jumped from the aircraft.
senses.exampleZh: 他跳下飞机后，降落伞安全打开了。
senses.definition: A device that fills with air to slow a person's or object's fall.

senses.example: Brief snips of actual events were shown: parades, dances, street scenes.
senses.definition: a ceremonial procession including people marching
senses.definitionSentence: Parade is a ceremonial procession including people marching.
senses.definitionZh: 一种包括人们游行的仪式游行。
senses.exampleZh: 显示了实际事件的简短片段：游行、舞蹈、街头场景。

senses.example: If all forms of a paradigm are grouped together within the dictionary, a considerable reduction in the amount of information required is possible.
senses.definition: systematic arrangement of all the inflected forms of a word
senses.definitionSentence: Paradigm means systematic arrangement of all the inflected forms of a word.
senses.definitionZh: 单词所有变形形式的系统排列。
senses.exampleZh: 如果范式的所有形式都在字典中分组在一起，则可以大大减少所需的信息量。

senses.example: `I always lie' is a paradox because if it is true it must be false.
senses.definition: (logic) a statement that contradicts itself
senses.definitionSentence: Paradox means (logic) a statement that contradicts itself.
senses.definitionZh: （逻辑）自相矛盾的陈述。
senses.exampleZh: “我总是撒谎”是一个悖论，因为如果它是真的，那么它一定是假的。

senses.example: The dancers formed two parallel rows that remained the same distance apart across the stage.
senses.definition: being everywhere equidistant and not intersecting
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as parallel is being everywhere equidistant and not intersecting.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓平行是指处处等距且不相交。
senses.exampleZh: 舞者排成两排平行，在舞台上保持相同的距离。

senses.example: Historians drew a parallel between the two revolutions because both began with food shortages and unfair taxation.
senses.definition: something having the property of being analogous to something else
senses.definitionSentence: Parallel means something having the property of being analogous to something else.
senses.definitionZh: 某事物具有与其他事物相似的属性。
senses.exampleZh: 历史学家将两次革命进行了比较，因为两次革命都始于粮食短缺和不公平的税收。

senses.meaning: 使瘫痪，使失去活动能力
senses.example: The spinal injury may paralyze the muscles below the waist.
senses.exampleZh: 脊柱损伤可能使腰部以下的肌肉瘫痪。
senses.definitionSentence: Cause to be paralyzed and immobile.
senses.definitionZh: 导致全身瘫痪，无法动弹。

senses.example: The female parasite spends much time in her efforts to find a nest of her host.
senses.definition: an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host
senses.definitionSentence: Parasite is an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host.
senses.definitionZh: 生活在宿主（另一种动物或植物）体内或之上的动物或植物；它从宿主那里获取营养，而不会使宿主受益或杀死宿主。
senses.exampleZh: 雌性寄生虫花费大量时间来寻找宿主的巢穴。

senses.example: As you see, the professor has designed a piece of apparatus that forces the bodybuilder to use a wide grip.
senses.definition: equipment designed to serve a specific function
senses.definitionSentence: Apparatus means equipment designed to serve a specific function.
senses.definitionZh: 设计用于实现特定功能的设备。
senses.exampleZh: 正如您所看到的，教授设计了一种装置，迫使健美运动员使用宽握距。

senses.example: The effects of the drought are apparent to anyone who sees the parched fields.
senses.definition: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as apparent is clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为明显的事物清楚地揭示给头脑、感官或判断。
senses.exampleZh: 干旱的影响对于任何看到干涸田野的人来说都是显而易见的。

senses.example: For all his apparent wealth he had no money to pay the rent.
senses.definition: appearing as such but not necessarily so
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as apparent is appearing as such but not necessarily so.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为显而易见的事物确实如此出现，但不一定如此。
senses.exampleZh: 尽管他表面上很富有，但他却没有钱付房租。

senses.example: Of course, these works are not comparable, even though the same brain conceived them.
senses.definition: able to be compared or worthy of comparison
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as comparable is able to be compared or worthy of comparison.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为可比较的事物是能够比较或值得比较的。
senses.exampleZh: 当然，这些作品没有可比性，即使是同一个大脑构思的。

senses.example: In conclusion, these findings suggest the need for a comparative physiology, pathology, and histology of mammalian lungs.
senses.definition: relating to or based on or involving comparison
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as comparative is relating to or based on or involving comparison.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为比较的事物与比较相关、基于比较或涉及比较。
senses.exampleZh: 总之，这些发现表明需要对哺乳动物肺部进行比较生理学、病理学和组织学。

senses.example: John compared his haircut to his friend's.
senses.definition: examine and note the similarities or differences of
senses.definitionSentence: To compare means to examine and note the similarities or differences of.
senses.definitionZh: 检查并注意到相同点或不同点。
senses.exampleZh: 约翰将他的发型与他朋友的进行了比较。

senses.example: Selecting bunks by economic comparison is usually an individual problem.
senses.definition: relation based on similarities and differences
senses.definitionSentence: Comparison means relation based on similarities and differences.
senses.definitionZh: 基于相似性和差异性的关系。
senses.exampleZh: 通过经济比较选择铺位通常是个人问题。

senses.example: Each family received an equal parcel of land from the divided estate.
senses.definition: the allotment of some amount by dividing something
senses.definitionSentence: Parcel is the allotment of some amount by dividing something.
senses.definitionZh: 通过划分而得到的一份、一个部分或一定数量。
senses.exampleZh: 庄园分割后，每户家庭都得到了一份面积相等的土地。

senses.example: The developers parceled the land.
senses.definition: divide into parts
senses.definitionSentence: To parcel means to divide into parts.
senses.definitionZh: 分成几部分。
senses.exampleZh: 开发商对土地进行了分割。

senses.example: The courier delivered a sealed parcel containing three books wrapped together in cardboard.
senses.definition: a collection of things wrapped or boxed together
senses.definitionSentence: Parcel is a collection of things wrapped or boxed together.
senses.definitionZh: 包裹或装箱在一起的物品的集合。
senses.exampleZh: 快递员递送了一个密封包裹，其中包含用纸板包裹在一起的三本书。

senses.example: `` Please pardon me again, Sandalphon '', said Hal.
senses.definition: accept an excuse for
senses.definitionSentence: To pardon means to accept an excuse for.
senses.definitionZh: 接受借口。
senses.exampleZh: “请再次原谅我，Sandalphon”，哈尔说。

senses.example: The governor signed a pardon that released the prisoner from the rest of his sentence.
senses.definition: a warrant granting release from punishment for an offense
senses.definitionSentence: Pardon is a warrant granting release from punishment for an offense.
senses.definitionZh: 一项免除犯罪处罚的令状。
senses.exampleZh: 州长签署了一份赦免书，释放了该囚犯的剩余刑期。

senses.example: In 1958, the Conference endorsed birth control as the responsibility laid by God on parents everywhere.
senses.definition: a father or mother; one who begets or one who gives birth to or nurtures and raises a child; a relative who plays the role of guardian
senses.definitionSentence: Parent is a father or mother; one who begets or one who gives birth to or nurtures and raises a child; a relative who plays the role of guardian.
senses.definitionZh: 父亲或母亲；生育或生育或养育和抚养儿童的人；扮演监护人角色的亲戚。
senses.exampleZh: 1958 年，会议认可节育是上帝赋予世界各地父母的责任。

senses.example: Parliament debated the tax bill before its elected members voted to pass the new law.
senses.definition: a legislative assembly in certain countries
senses.definitionSentence: Parliament is a legislative assembly in certain countries.
senses.definitionZh: 某些国家的立法议会。
senses.exampleZh: 议会在当选议员投票通过新法律之前对税收法案进行了辩论。

senses.example: Their preparation was more than adequate.
senses.definition: the state of having been made ready or prepared for use or action (especially military action)
senses.definitionSentence: Preparation is the state of having been made ready or prepared for use or action (especially military action).
senses.definitionZh: 已经准备好或准备好使用或行动（尤其是军事行动）的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 他们的准备工作绰绰有余。

senses.example: They lacked time to prepare the Congo, as the British and French had prepared their colonies.
senses.definition: make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
senses.definitionSentence: To prepare means to make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc.
senses.definitionZh: 为特定目的或某些用途、事件等提前准备好或适合或装备。
senses.exampleZh: 他们缺乏时间来准备刚果，因为英国和法国已经准备好了他们的殖民地。

senses.definitionSentence: To make food ready for eating by applying heat or combining ingredients.
senses.definitionZh: 通过加热或组合食材把食物制作成可食用的状态。
senses.example: The cook prepared the vegetables by roasting them with herbs until they were tender.
senses.exampleZh: 厨师把蔬菜加香草烤至软熟。
senses.definition: To make food ready for eating by applying heat or combining ingredients.

senses.example: The twins sleep in separate rooms on opposite sides of the hall.
senses.exampleZh: 这对双胞胎分别睡在走廊两侧的房间里。
senses.definitionSentence: Independent; not united or joint.
senses.definitionZh: 独立的;不团结或联合。

senses.example: A glass wall separates the laboratory from the public viewing area.
senses.exampleZh: 一面玻璃墙把实验室与公众参观区隔开。
senses.definitionSentence: Separate into parts or portions.
senses.definitionZh: 分成几部分或几部分。

senses.example: Many cells, bacteria, and other microorganisms are transparent to visible light and must be stained for microscopic investigation.
senses.definition: transmitting light; able to be seen through with clarity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as transparent is transmitting light; able to be seen through with clarity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为透明的东西是透光的；能够清晰地看透。
senses.exampleZh: 许多细胞、细菌和其他微生物对可见光是透明的，必须进行染色才能进行显微镜研究。

senses.example: The director was transparent about the budget, publishing every payment and explaining each decision.
senses.definition: free of deceit
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as transparent is free of deceit.
senses.definitionZh: 公开清楚、没有隐瞒或欺骗的。
senses.exampleZh: 主管对预算保持透明，公布每笔付款并解释每项决定。

senses.example: One morning, we discovered not only that the pennies were missing from the idol but that a cigarette had been stubbed out in its lap.
senses.definition: a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound
senses.definitionSentence: Penny is a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound.
senses.definitionZh: 爱尔兰和英国的分数货币单位；等于百分之一磅。
senses.exampleZh: 一天早上，我们发现神像身上不仅不见了硬币，而且在它的腿上还发现一根香烟被掐灭了。

senses.definitionSentence: A regular payment made to support someone after retirement.
senses.definitionZh: 退休后定期领取的生活保障金。
senses.example: She receives a monthly pension after thirty years of public service.
senses.exampleZh: 从事公共服务三十年后，她每月领取养老金。
senses.definition: A regular payment made to support someone after retirement.

senses.meaning: 发给养老金，发给退休金
senses.example: The company pensioned the injured worker and paid him a monthly retirement income.
senses.definition: grant a pension to
senses.definitionSentence: To pension means to grant a pension to.
senses.definitionZh: 向其发放养老金。
senses.exampleZh: 公司为受伤工人发放养老金，并每月向他支付退休收入。

senses.example: She was compensated for the loss of her arm in the accident.
senses.definition: make amends for; pay compensation for
senses.definitionSentence: To compensate means to make amends for; pay compensation for.
senses.definitionZh: 弥补；支付赔偿金。
senses.exampleZh: 她因事故中失去手臂而获得赔偿。

senses.example: Does your management climate and your management compensation plan attract and keep top-notch marketing people?
senses.definition: something (such as money) given or received as payment or reparation (as for a service or loss or injury)
senses.definitionSentence: Compensation means something (such as money) given or received as payment or reparation (as for a service or loss or injury).
senses.definitionZh: 作为付款或赔偿（如服务或损失或伤害）而给予或收到的东西（例如金钱）。
senses.exampleZh: 您的管理氛围和管理薪酬计划是否吸引并留住了顶尖的营销人员？

senses.example: Employees deduct expenses of travel, meals and lodging while away from home in connection with the performance of their services as employees.
senses.definition: amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)
senses.definitionSentence: Expense means amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures).
senses.definitionZh: 为目前可以免税的商品和服务支付的金额（与资本支出相对）。
senses.exampleZh: 员工根据其作为员工提供的服务，扣除离家期间的交通费、餐费和住宿费。

senses.example: On the other hand, the process of obsoleting an old product and introducing the new one is usually mighty expensive.
senses.definition: high in price or charging high prices
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as expensive is high in price or charging high prices.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为昂贵的东西是指价格高或收取高价。
senses.exampleZh: 另一方面，淘汰旧产品并引入新产品的过程通常非常昂贵。

senses.meaning: 不可或缺的，必不可少的
senses.example: Clean water is indispensable to human survival because the body cannot function long without it.
senses.definition: not to be dispensed with; essential
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as indispensable is not to be dispensed with; essential.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为必不可少的东西并不是可以被省略的；基本的。
senses.exampleZh: 干净的水对于人类的生存是不可或缺的，因为没有它，身体就无法长期运作。

senses.example: Done in the modern style of a `` confession '', Fink tells in exquisite detail how he came to know, and, more important, love his mother's pet salamander, Alicia.
senses.definition: a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement
senses.definitionSentence: Pet is a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement.
senses.definitionZh: 为了陪伴或娱乐而饲养的动物。
senses.exampleZh: 芬克以现代风格的“忏悔”方式完成，以精致的细节讲述了他如何认识，更重要的是，爱他母亲的宠物火蜥蜴艾丽西亚。

senses.example: The long walk gave the children a healthy appetite before dinner.
senses.definition: a feeling of craving something
senses.definitionSentence: A natural desire for food, or a strong desire for something.
senses.definitionZh: 对食物的自然欲望，或对某事物的强烈渴望。
senses.exampleZh: 长途步行让孩子们在晚饭前胃口大开。

senses.example: The only day they `` have a chance to compete with large supermarkets is on Sunday '', the council's resolution said.
senses.definition: compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
senses.definitionSentence: To compete means to compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others.
senses.definitionZh: 为某事而竞争；参加比赛；衡量自己与他人的比较。
senses.exampleZh: 该委员会的决议称，他们“有机会与大型超市竞争的唯一一天是周日”。

senses.example: Brian Thayer was a thoroughly honest and competent administrator.
senses.definition: properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as competent is properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为有能力的事物是适当或充分合格或有能力或高效的。
senses.exampleZh: Brian Thayer 是一位非常诚实且称职的管理员。

senses.example: Periodic bulletins of the accomplishment in each province made the registration process into a kind of competition among provincial officials.
senses.definition: an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
senses.definitionSentence: Competition is an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants.
senses.definitionZh: 从两名或两名以上参赛者中选出获胜者的场合。
senses.exampleZh: 各省定期通报成绩，使登记过程成为省级官员之间的竞争。

senses.example: Carroll was sharp and military, but he was up against tough competition for that RA berth, and he wanted to play it cool.
senses.definition: the act of competing as for profit or a prize
senses.definitionSentence: Competition is the act of competing as for profit or a prize.
senses.definitionZh: 为了利润或奖品而进行的竞争行为。
senses.exampleZh: 卡罗尔很敏锐，也很军事化，但他在 RA 席位上面临着激烈的竞争，他想保持冷静。

senses.example: Several airlines lowered fares to improve their competitive position and attract passengers from their rivals.
senses.definition: involving competition or competitiveness
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as competitive is involving competition or competitiveness.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓竞争性的事物涉及竞争或竞争力。
senses.exampleZh: 多家航空公司降低票价以提高竞争地位并吸引竞争对手的乘客。

senses.example: A strong tailwind gave the sailing boat fresh impetus and moved it rapidly forward.
senses.definition: a force that moves something along
senses.definitionSentence: Impetus is a force that moves something along.
senses.definitionZh: 一种推动物体前进的力量。
senses.exampleZh: 强劲的顺风给了帆船新的动力，让它快速前进。

senses.example: Ann Catt was a lonely, devoted soul, never married, conducting a spotless home and devoted to her church, but a perpetual dissenter and born critic.
senses.definition: continuing forever or indefinitely
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as perpetual is continuing forever or indefinitely.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为永久的事物是指永远或无限期地持续。
senses.exampleZh: 安·卡特（Ann Catt）是一个孤独、忠诚的灵魂，从未结过婚，拥有一尘不染的家庭并致力于她的教会，但她是一个永远的持不同政见者和天生的批评家。

senses.example: The petition listed the mayor's occupation as `` attorney '' and his age as 71.
senses.definition: a formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority
senses.definitionSentence: Petition is a formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority.
senses.definitionZh: 请求向当局提交某些内容的正式消息。
senses.exampleZh: 请愿书将市长的职业列为“律师”，年龄为 71 岁。

senses.example: His petty refusal to share credit revealed a narrow and ungenerous outlook.
senses.definition: contemptibly narrow in outlook
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as petty is contemptibly narrow in outlook.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为琐碎的事物的观点是极其狭隘的。
senses.exampleZh: 他对分享信用的小小拒绝暴露了他狭隘而吝啬的观点。

senses.example: She slipped the cloth puppet over her hand and moved its mouth with her fingers.
senses.definition: a doll with a hollow head of a person or animal and a cloth body; intended to fit over the hand and be manipulated with the fingers
senses.definitionSentence: Puppet is a doll with a hollow head of a person or animal and a cloth body; intended to fit over the hand and be manipulated with the fingers.
senses.definitionZh: 一种人或动物头部空心，身体布制的玩偶；旨在适合戴在手上并用手指操纵。
senses.exampleZh: 她将布偶滑到手上，并用手指移动它的嘴。

senses.example: Some experiments are composed of repetitions of independent trials, each with two possible outcomes.
senses.definition: an event that repeats
senses.definitionSentence: Repetition is an event that repeats.
senses.definitionZh: 重复的事件。
senses.exampleZh: 一些实验由独立试验的重复组成，每个试验都有两种可能的结果。

senses.example: The musician pressed the trumpet's valves and blew through its narrow brass tube and flared bell.
senses.definition: a brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone; has a narrow tube and a flared bell and is played by means of valves
senses.definitionSentence: Trumpet is a brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone; has a narrow tube and a flared bell and is played by means of valves.
senses.definitionZh: 一种铜管乐器，音色绚丽；有一个狭窄的管子和一个喇叭形的喇叭，通过阀门演奏。
senses.exampleZh: 音乐家按下小号的阀门并通过其狭窄的铜管和喇叭形喇叭吹奏。

senses.example: Repeated polls have disclosed that most married couples are now using contraceptives in the practice of birth control.
senses.definition: an inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people
senses.definitionSentence: Poll is an inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people.
senses.definitionZh: 通过采访随机样本来进行的民意调查。
senses.exampleZh: 多次民意调查显示，大多数已婚夫妇现在在节育实践中使用避孕药具。

senses.example: The winning candidate polled 18,000 votes, nearly twice as many as her nearest rival.
senses.definition: get the votes of
senses.definitionSentence: To poll means to get the votes of.
senses.definitionZh: 获得选票。
senses.exampleZh: 获胜候选人获得了 18,000 票，几乎是最接近的竞争对手的两倍。

senses.meaning: 作民意调查，民意测验，民意调查
senses.example: This was the chief reason for a so-so sales outlook given by two-thirds of 56 builders polled by the National Housing Center.
senses.definition: get the opinions (of people) by asking specific questions
senses.definitionSentence: To poll means to get the opinions (of people) by asking specific questions.
senses.definitionZh: 通过提出具体问题来获取（人们的）意见。
senses.exampleZh: 这是国家住房中心调查的 56 家建筑商中三分之二的人认为销售前景一般的主要原因。

senses.example: The police credited him with twenty-five murders but he was never brought to trial for one of them.
senses.definition: the force of policemen and officers
senses.definitionSentence: Police is the force of policemen and officers.
senses.definitionZh: 警察和警官的力量。
