senses.exampleZh: 警方认定他犯有 25 起谋杀案，但他从未因其中一桩而受审。

senses.definition: a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
senses.definitionSentence: A plan of action adopted by an individual or social group.
senses.definitionZh: 个人或社会团体通过的行动计划。
senses.example: The school adopted a safety policy requiring goggles in every chemistry laboratory.
senses.exampleZh: 学校采取了一项安全政策，要求每个化学实验室都佩戴护目镜。

senses.example: You should have read the small print on your policy.
senses.definition: written contract or certificate of insurance
senses.definitionSentence: Policy means written contract or certificate of insurance.
senses.definitionZh: 书面合同或保险凭证。
senses.exampleZh: 您应该阅读保单上的小字。

senses.example: They did; though contemptuous, they were still polite.
senses.definition: showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as polite is showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.
senses.definitionZh: 礼貌是指在举止、言语、行为等方面表现出对他人的尊重。
senses.exampleZh: 他们做到了；虽然很轻蔑，但还是很有礼貌。

senses.example: His polite manners, careful dress, and refined conversation suited the formal dinner.
senses.definition: marked by refinement in taste and manners
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as polite is marked by refinement in taste and manners.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为礼貌的事物以品味和举止的精致为标志。
senses.exampleZh: 他彬彬有礼的举止、精心的着装和优雅的谈吐很适合正式的晚宴。

senses.example: "calling a meeting is a political act in itself"- Daniel Goleman.
senses.definition: involving or characteristic of politics or parties or politicians
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as political is involving or characteristic of politics or parties or politicians.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为政治的事物涉及政治、政党或政客或具有政治、政党或政客的特征。
senses.exampleZh: “召开会议本身就是一种政治行为”- Daniel Goleman。

senses.example: The politician campaigned for her party, debated legislation, and sought reelection to parliament.
senses.definition: a person active in party politics
senses.definitionSentence: Politician is a person active in party politics.
senses.definitionZh: 活跃于政党政治的人。
senses.exampleZh: 这位政客为她的政党竞选，辩论立法，并寻求议会连任。

senses.example: Office politics is often counterproductive.
senses.definition: social relations involving intrigue to gain authority or power
senses.definitionSentence: Politics means social relations involving intrigue to gain authority or power.
senses.definitionZh: 涉及为了获得权威或权力而进行的阴谋的社会关系。
senses.exampleZh: 办公室政治常常适得其反。

senses.example: She apologised for missing the deadline and acknowledged that the delay was her fault.
senses.definition: acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing
senses.definitionSentence: To apologise means to acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing.
senses.definitionZh: 承认错误、缺点或失败。
senses.exampleZh: 她对错过最后期限表示歉意，并承认延误是她的错。

senses.example: He wrote a letter of apology to the hostess.
senses.definition: an expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone
senses.definitionSentence: Apology is an expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone.
senses.definitionZh: 对给某人造成麻烦而表示的遗憾。
senses.exampleZh: 他给女主人写了一封道歉信。

senses.meaning: 书面辩护，书面辩解，正式辩解
senses.example: The philosopher published an apology defending his beliefs against the formal accusations.
senses.definition: a formal written defense of something you believe in strongly
senses.definitionSentence: Apology is a formal written defense of something you believe in strongly.
senses.definitionZh: 对您坚信的事物的正式书面辩护。
senses.exampleZh: 这位哲学家发表了一份道歉声明，针对正式指控捍卫了自己的信仰。

senses.example: The crowded metropolis contains millions of residents across several urban districts.
senses.definition: a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts
senses.definitionSentence: Metropolis is a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts.
senses.definitionZh: 一个面积大、人口密集的城市地区；可能包括几个独立的行政区。
senses.exampleZh: 这座拥挤的大都市拥有分布在多个城区的数百万居民。

senses.definitionSentence: A place where ships, people, or goods enter or leave a country.
senses.definitionZh: 船只、人员或货物进出一国的港口或口岸。
senses.example: The cargo ship reached the port before sunrise.
senses.exampleZh: 货船在日出前抵达了港口。
senses.definition: A place where ships, people, or goods enter or leave a country.

senses.example: Plug the external drive into the USB port so the computer can read its files.
senses.definition: (computer science) computer circuit consisting of the hardware and associated circuitry that links one device with another (especially a computer and a hard disk drive or other peripherals)
senses.definitionSentence: Port means (computer science) computer circuit consisting of the hardware and associated circuitry that links one device with another (especially a computer and a hard disk drive or other peripherals).
senses.definitionZh: （计算机科学）计算机电路，由将一个设备与另一个设备（尤其是计算机和硬盘驱动器或其他外围设备）连接的硬件和相关电路组成。
senses.exampleZh: 将外部驱动器插入 USB 端口，以便计算机可以读取其文件。

senses.example: To port was a point 200 feet high rising behind to a precipice of 2000 feet.
senses.definition: the left side of a ship or aircraft to someone who is aboard and facing the bow or nose
senses.definitionSentence: Port is the left side of a ship or aircraft to someone who is aboard and facing the bow or nose.
senses.definitionZh: 船舶或飞机上面向船头或机头的人员的左侧。
senses.exampleZh: 左舷是一个 200 英尺高的点，后面是 2000 英尺的悬崖。

senses.example: The captain ordered the helmsman to port the wheel and turn the ship to the left.
senses.definition: put or turn on the left side, of a ship
senses.definitionSentence: To port means to put or turn on the left side, of a ship.
senses.definitionZh: 在船的左侧放置或转向。
senses.exampleZh: 船长命令舵手左转舵轮，将船转向左侧。

senses.example: I saw holes in planes at the airport and in cars in the streets.
senses.definition: an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo
senses.definitionSentence: Airport is an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo.
senses.definitionZh: 一个配备有控制塔和机库以及乘客和货物住宿的机场。
senses.exampleZh: 我在机场的飞机和街上的汽车上看到了洞。

senses.example: The rise of the giant corporations in Western Europe and the United States dates from the period 1880 - 1900.
senses.definition: a business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state
senses.definitionSentence: Corporation is a business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state.
senses.definitionZh: 一家商业公司，其公司章程已在某些州获得批准。
senses.exampleZh: 西欧和美国大公司的崛起可以追溯到 1880 年至 1900 年期间。

senses.example: Miscellaneous soils, which primarily include sticky substances and colorless liquids which evaporate to leave a residue.
senses.definition: lose or cause to lose liquid by vaporization leaving a more concentrated residue
senses.definitionSentence: To evaporate means to lose or cause to lose liquid by vaporization leaving a more concentrated residue.
senses.definitionZh: 通过蒸发而损失或导致损失液体，留下更浓缩的残留物。
senses.exampleZh: 杂项土壤，主要包括粘性物质和无色液体，蒸发后留下残留物。

senses.example: We export less than we import and have a negative trade balance.
senses.definition: sell or transfer abroad
senses.definitionSentence: To export means to sell or transfer abroad.
senses.definitionZh: 出售或转移到国外。
senses.exampleZh: 我们的出口量少于进口量，并且贸易余额为负。

senses.example: It could stop Cuban re export of guns and propaganda materials to South America.
senses.definition: commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country
senses.definitionSentence: Export means commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country.
senses.definitionZh: 出售给外国的商品（货物或服务）。
senses.exampleZh: 它可以阻止古巴向南美再出口枪支和宣传材料。

senses.example: Jean Fardulli's Blue Angel is the first top local club to import that crazy new dance, the Twist.
senses.definition: bring in from abroad
senses.definitionSentence: To import means to bring in from abroad.
senses.definitionZh: 从国外引进。
senses.exampleZh: Jean Fardulli 的 Blue Angel 是第一家引进疯狂新舞蹈 Twist 的当地顶级俱乐部。

senses.example: The import of his announcement was ambiguous.
senses.definition: the message that is intended or expressed or signified
senses.definitionSentence: Import is the message that is intended or expressed or signified.
senses.definitionZh: 意图、表达或表示的消息。
senses.exampleZh: 他的声明的重要性不明确。

senses.example: Capital imports drawn from a number of sources must be employed and combined skillfully enough to permit domestic investment programming to go forward.
senses.definition: commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country
senses.definitionSentence: Import means commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country.
senses.definitionZh: 从国外购买的商品（商品或服务）。
senses.exampleZh: 必须巧妙地利用和组合来自多个来源的资本进口，以允许国内投资计划得以推进。

senses.example: The importance of a well-balanced diet.
senses.definition: the quality of being important and worthy of note
senses.definitionSentence: Importance is the quality of being important and worthy of note.
senses.definitionZh: 重要且值得注意的品质。
senses.exampleZh: 均衡饮食的重要性。

senses.meaning: 值得注意的，有意义的，重大的，重要的
senses.example: Sometimes strong stress serves to focus an important secondary relationship.
senses.definition: important in effect or meaning
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as important is important in effect or meaning.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为重要的事物在效果或意义上是重要的。
senses.exampleZh: 有时，强大的压力有助于集中重要的次要关系。

senses.example: The holiday gave us the opportunity to visit Washington.
senses.definition: a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
senses.definitionSentence: Opportunity is a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances.
senses.definitionZh: 由于有利的环境组合而产生的可能性。
senses.exampleZh: 假期让我们有机会参观华盛顿。

senses.example: They attached a portable outboard motor to the small boat and removed it after landing.
senses.definition: of a motor designed to be attached to the outside of a boat's hull
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as portable is of a motor designed to be attached to the outside of a boat's hull.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为便携式的东西是设计用于连接到船体外部的电机。
senses.exampleZh: 他们在小船上安装了一个便携式舷外发动机，并在着陆后将其拆除。

senses.example: The hotel porter carried our suitcases from the taxi to our room and placed them beside the wardrobe.
senses.definition: a person employed to carry luggage and supplies
senses.definitionSentence: Porter is a person employed to carry luggage and supplies.
senses.definitionZh: 受雇搬运行李和用品的人员。
senses.exampleZh: 酒店行李员把我们的行李箱从出租车上搬到我们的房间，放在衣柜旁边。

senses.example: I read a portion of the manuscript.
senses.definition: something determined in relation to something that includes it
senses.definitionSentence: Portion means something determined in relation to something that includes it.
senses.definitionZh: 与包含它的事物相关的确定的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 我阅读了部分手稿。

senses.example: Nevertheless, `` we feel that in the future Fulton County should receive some portion of these available funds '', the jurors said.
senses.definition: the allotment of some amount by dividing something
senses.definitionSentence: Portion is the allotment of some amount by dividing something.
senses.definitionZh: 通过划分某物来分配一定数量的。
senses.exampleZh: 尽管如此，“我们认为未来富尔顿县应该收到这些可用资金的一部分”，陪审员说。

senses.example: Years of public service and an early death formed the tragic portion that fate allotted him.
senses.definition: your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)
senses.definitionSentence: Portion means your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you).
senses.definitionZh: 您生活中的总体情况或状况（包括发生在您身上的所有事情）。
senses.exampleZh: 多年的公共服务和英年早逝构成了命运赋予他的悲惨部分。

senses.example: Volunteers portioned food and blankets among the displaced families.
senses.definition: give out
senses.definitionSentence: To portion means to give out.
senses.definitionZh: 给予。
senses.exampleZh: 志愿者为流离失所的家庭分发食物和毯子。

senses.example: The photographer made excellent portraits.
senses.definition: any likeness of a person, in any medium
senses.definitionSentence: Portrait means any likeness of a person, in any medium.
senses.definitionZh: 在任何媒介中的任何人像。
senses.exampleZh: 摄影师拍摄了出色的肖像。

senses.example: The father is portrayed as a good-looking man in this painting.
senses.definition: represent abstractly, for example in a painting, drawing, or sculpture
senses.definitionSentence: To portray means to represent abstractly, for example in a painting, drawing, or sculpture.
senses.definitionZh: 抽象地表现，例如在绘画、素描或雕塑中。
senses.exampleZh: 在这幅画中，父亲被描绘成一个英俊的男人。

senses.example: A large proportion of the survey participants supported the proposal.
senses.definition: the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole
senses.definitionSentence: Proportion is the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole.
senses.definitionZh: 部分的大小除以整体的大小得到的商。
senses.exampleZh: 调查参与者中有很大一部分支持这项提议。

senses.example: The building's broad base and narrow tower create a pleasing proportion between its parts.
senses.definition: harmonious arrangement or relation of parts or elements within a whole (as in a design)
senses.definitionSentence: Proportion means harmonious arrangement or relation of parts or elements within a whole (as in a design).
senses.definitionZh: 整体内各部分或元素的和谐排列或关系（如在设计中）。
senses.exampleZh: 该建筑宽阔的底座和狭窄的塔楼在其各部分之间形成了令人愉悦的比例。

senses.definition: to give an account or representation of in words
senses.definitionSentence: To give an account or representation of in words.
senses.definitionZh: 用文字描述或表述。
senses.example: The journalist reported the election results live from the counting center.
senses.exampleZh: 记者从计票中心现场报道了选举结果。

senses.example: I should like to underline four points I made in my first report with respect to vocational education.
senses.definition: a written document describing the findings of some individual or group
senses.definitionSentence: Report is a written document describing the findings of some individual or group.
senses.definitionZh: 描述某些个人或团体的调查结果的书面文件。
senses.exampleZh: 我想强调我在第一份报告中就职业教育提出的四点。

senses.example: The newspaper's report of the minister's speech quoted its main claims and described the audience's response.
senses.definition: a short account of the news
senses.definitionSentence: Report is a short account of the news.
senses.definitionZh: 该新闻的简短报道。
senses.exampleZh: 该报对部长讲话的报道引用了其主要主张并描述了听众的反应。

senses.example: New Yorkers were kept informed of scores by reporters who telegraphed fifteen to twenty thousand words daily to the metropolitan newspapers.
senses.definition: a person who investigates and reports or edits news stories
senses.definitionSentence: Reporter is a person who investigates and reports or edits news stories.
senses.definitionZh: 调查、报道或编辑新闻报道的人。
senses.exampleZh: 记者每天向都市报纸电报十五至两万字，向纽约人通报分数。

senses.example: The evidence supports her claim that the treatment reduces infection.
senses.exampleZh: 证据支持她关于这种治疗能减少感染的说法。
senses.definitionSentence: Support with evidence or authority or make more certain or confirm.
senses.definitionZh: 用证据或权威支持或更加确定或确认。

senses.example: Four steel columns support the weight of the roof.
senses.exampleZh: 四根钢柱支撑着屋顶的重量。
senses.definitionSentence: Be the physical support of; carry the weight of.
senses.definitionZh: 成为以下人员的物质支持；承载.的重量。

senses.example: She works two jobs to support her children and pay their school fees.
senses.exampleZh: 她做两份工作来抚养孩子并支付他们的学费。
senses.definitionSentence: Support materially or financially.
senses.definitionZh: 物质或经济上的支持。

senses.example: Family support helped him recover after the serious accident.
senses.exampleZh: 家人的支持帮助他从严重事故中康复。
senses.definitionSentence: Something providing immaterial assistance to a person or cause or interest.
senses.definitionZh: 为某人、事业或利益提供非物质帮助的事物。

senses.example: A wooden support keeps the damaged branch from falling.
senses.exampleZh: 一个木支架托住受损的树枝，防止它掉落。
senses.definitionSentence: Supporting structure that holds up or provides a foundation.
senses.definitionZh: 支撑或提供基础的支撑结构。

senses.example: The research project depends on financial support from the university.
senses.exampleZh: 这个研究项目依靠大学提供的经费支持。
senses.definitionSentence: The financial means whereby one lives.
senses.definitionZh: 一个人赖以生存的财务手段。

senses.example: A Gator trailer, Model 565, is used to transport the boat to the waterways.
senses.definition: move something or somebody around; usually over long distances
senses.definitionSentence: To transport means to move something or somebody around; usually over long distances.
senses.definitionZh: 移动某物或某人；通常是长距离。
senses.exampleZh: 565 型 Gator 拖车用于将船运输到水道。

senses.example: Oxygen transport across the cell membrane moves molecules from one side to the other.
senses.definition: an exchange of molecules (and their kinetic energy and momentum) across the boundary between adjacent layers of a fluid or across cell membranes
senses.definitionSentence: Transport is an exchange of molecules (and their kinetic energy and momentum) across the boundary between adjacent layers of a fluid or across cell membranes.
senses.definitionZh: 分子（及其动能和动量）穿过流体相邻层之间的边界或穿过细胞膜的交换。
senses.exampleZh: 氧气穿过细胞膜的运输将分子从一侧移动到另一侧。

senses.example: The music carried her into a transport of joy so intense that she forgot the audience around her.
senses.definition: a state of being carried away by overwhelming emotion
senses.definitionSentence: Transport is a state of being carried away by overwhelming emotion.
senses.definitionZh: 一种被压倒性的情绪带走的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 音乐将她带入一种强烈的喜悦之中，以至于她忘记了周围的观众。

senses.example: The founders incorporated the business as a legal company before selling shares to investors.
senses.definition: form a corporation
senses.definitionSentence: To incorporate means to form a corporation.
senses.definitionZh: 组建一家公司。
senses.exampleZh: 创始人在向投资者出售股票之前将公司注册为合法公司。

senses.example: The formerly separate villages are now incorporate within one united municipality.
senses.definition: formed or united into a whole
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as incorporate is formed or united into a whole.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为合并的事物形成或结合成一个整体。
senses.exampleZh: 以前独立的村庄现已合并为一个统一的市镇。

senses.example: The architect incorporated solar panels and rainwater tanks into the building's design.
senses.definition: include or contain; have as a component
senses.definitionSentence: To incorporate means to include or contain; have as a component.
senses.definitionZh: 包括或含有；作为一个组件。
senses.exampleZh: 建筑师将太阳能电池板和雨水箱纳入建筑物的设计中。

senses.example: The composer Salieri was contemporary with Mozart.
senses.definition: occurring in the same period of time
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as contemporary is occurring in the same period of time.
senses.definitionZh: 发生或存在于同一时期的。
senses.exampleZh: 作曲家萨列里与莫扎特是同时代人。

senses.example: Like his friend and contemporary August Strindberg he had little patience with collective mediocrity.
senses.definition: a person of nearly the same age as another
senses.definitionSentence: Contemporary is a person of nearly the same age as another.
senses.definitionZh: 与另一个人年龄几乎相同的人。
senses.exampleZh: 和他的朋友、同时代的奥古斯特·斯特林堡一样，他对集体的平庸没有什么耐心。

senses.example: This necessitated the construction of temporary sewage treatment facilities with an expected life from 5 to 15 yrs..
senses.definition: not permanent; not lasting
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as temporary is not permanent; not lasting.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为临时的东西并不是永久的；不持久。
senses.exampleZh: 这就需要建设临时污水处理设施，预计使用寿命为 5 至 15 年。

senses.definitionSentence: A posture assumed for a photograph or work of art.
senses.definitionZh: 为拍照或艺术创作而摆出的姿势。
senses.example: The photographer asked the model to hold the pose for a few seconds.
senses.exampleZh: 摄影师请模特保持这个姿势几秒钟。
senses.definition: A posture assumed for a photograph or work of art.

senses.example: This poses an interesting question.
senses.definition: introduce
senses.definitionSentence: To pose means to introduce.
senses.definitionZh: 介绍。
senses.exampleZh: 这提出了一个有趣的问题。

senses.example: We don't know the woman who posed for Leonardo so often.
senses.definition: assume a posture as for artistic purposes
senses.definitionSentence: To pose means to assume a posture as for artistic purposes.
senses.definitionZh: 出于艺术目的而采取的姿势。
senses.exampleZh: 我们不认识那个经常为莱昂纳多摆姿势的女人。

senses.example: Don't pay any attention to him--he is always posing to impress his peers!
senses.definition: behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others
senses.definitionSentence: To pose means to behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others.
senses.definitionZh: 为了给别人留下深刻印象而做出做作或不自然的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 别理他——他总是摆出各种姿势来给同龄人留下深刻印象！

senses.example: Greed and ambition composed his personality.
senses.definition: form the substance of
senses.definitionSentence: To compose means to form the substance of.
senses.definitionZh: 形成其实质内容。
senses.exampleZh: 贪婪和野心构成了他的性格。

senses.example: This is precisely what makes lucid, straightforward music so difficult to compose - the clarity must be new, not old ''.
senses.definition: write music
senses.definitionSentence: To compose means to write music.
senses.definitionZh: 写音乐。
senses.exampleZh: 这正是为什么清晰、直接的音乐如此难以创作的原因——清晰度必须是新的，而不是旧的”。

senses.example: He drew toward the composite design from his meticulously accurate memory, without need to consult his sketches.
senses.definition: consisting of separate interconnected parts
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as composite is consisting of separate interconnected parts.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为复合材料的东西由单独的互连部件组成。
senses.exampleZh: 他根据自己一丝不苟的准确记忆绘制了复合设计，无需查阅草图。

senses.example: The sunflower is a composite plant whose flower head contains many tiny flowers.
senses.definition: of or relating to or belonging to the plant family Compositae
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as composite is of or relating to or belonging to the plant family Compositae.
senses.definitionZh: 属于、涉及或具有菊科植物特征的。
senses.exampleZh: 向日葵属于菊科植物，其头状花序由许多小花组成。

senses.example: The composition is written in four movements.
senses.definition: a musical work that has been created
senses.definitionSentence: Composition is a musical work that has been created.
senses.definitionZh: 已创作的音乐作品。
senses.exampleZh: 乐曲由四个乐章组成。

senses.example: (1) central cities tend to be areas of residence for lower social classes; (2) central cities tend to be more heterogeneous in social composition.
senses.definition: the way in which someone or something is composed
senses.definitionSentence: Composition is the way in which someone or something is composed.
senses.definitionZh: 某人或某物的组合方式。
senses.exampleZh: （1）中心城市往往是下层社会阶层的居住区； (2)中心城市的社会构成往往更加异质化。

senses.example: He got an A on his composition.
senses.definition: an essay (especially one written as an assignment)
senses.definitionSentence: Composition is an essay (especially one written as an assignment).
senses.definitionZh: 一篇文章（尤其是作为作业撰写的文章）。
senses.exampleZh: 他的作文得了 A。

senses.example: The label lists the composition of the alloy as iron, carbon, chromium, and nickel.
senses.definition: a mixture of ingredients
senses.definitionSentence: Composition is a mixture of ingredients.
senses.definitionZh: 多种成分的混合物。
senses.exampleZh: 标签列出了合金的成分为铁、碳、铬和镍。

senses.definitionSentence: To put money into a bank account.
senses.definitionZh: 把钱存入银行账户。
senses.example: Please deposit the cheque into your savings account before Friday.
senses.exampleZh: 请在星期五前把支票存入你的储蓄账户。
senses.definition: To put money into a bank account.

senses.definitionSentence: To put, place, or leave something in a particular location.
senses.definitionZh: 把某物放置或留在特定位置。
senses.example: Floodwaters often deposit a layer of silt along the riverbanks.
senses.exampleZh: 洪水常常会在河岸沉积一层淤泥。
senses.definition: To put, place, or leave something in a particular location.

senses.example: Her salary is paid into a bank deposit that earns interest and can be withdrawn when needed.
senses.definition: money deposited in a bank or some similar institution
senses.definitionSentence: Deposit means money deposited in a bank or some similar institution.
senses.definitionZh: 存入银行或类似机构的资金。
senses.exampleZh: 她的工资存入银行存款，可以赚取利息，并可以在需要时提取。

senses.example: The river left a thick deposit of sand and silt after the flood.
senses.definition: matter that has been deposited by some natural process
senses.definitionSentence: Deposit means matter that has been deposited by some natural process.
senses.definitionZh: 通过某种自然过程沉积的物质。
senses.exampleZh: 洪水过后，河流留下了厚厚的沙子和淤泥。

senses.example: We paid a ten-percent deposit when ordering the car and will pay the balance on delivery.
senses.definition: a partial payment made at the time of purchase; the balance to be paid later
senses.definitionSentence: Deposit is a partial payment made at the time of purchase; the balance to be paid later.
senses.definitionZh: 购买时支付的部分款项；余款稍后支付。
senses.exampleZh: 我们在订购汽车时支付了百分之十的定金，并将在交货时支付余款。

senses.example: His deposit was refunded when he returned the car.
senses.definition: money given as security for an article acquired for temporary use
senses.definitionSentence: Deposit means money given as security for an article acquired for temporary use.
senses.definitionZh: 作为临时使用物品的担保而提供的资金。
senses.exampleZh: 还车时押金已退还。

senses.example: Years of mineral deposit formed a thick layer of sediment on the cave floor.
senses.definition: the natural process of laying down a deposit of something
senses.definitionSentence: Deposit is the natural process of laying down a deposit of something.
senses.definitionZh: 存放某物的自然过程。
senses.exampleZh: 多年的矿藏在洞穴底部形成了一层厚厚的沉积物。

senses.example: SBA works closely with the principal property disposal installations of the Federal Government in reviewing proposed sales programs and identifying those types of property that small business concerns are most likely to be interested in purchasing.
senses.definition: a method of tending to or managing the affairs of a some group of people (especially the group's business affairs)
senses.definitionSentence: Disposal is a method of tending to or managing the affairs of a some group of people (especially the group's business affairs).
senses.definitionZh: 照顾或管理某个群体的事务（尤其是该群体的商业事务）的一种方法。
senses.exampleZh: SBA 与联邦政府的主要财产处置机构密切合作，审查拟议的销售计划并确定小型企业最有可能有兴趣购买的财产类型。

senses.example: She disposed of her parents' possessions.
senses.definition: give, sell, or transfer to another
senses.definitionSentence: To dispose means to give, sell, or transfer to another.
senses.definitionZh: 给予、出售或转让给他人。
senses.exampleZh: 她处置了父母的财产。

senses.example: He has a happy disposition.
senses.definition: your usual mood
senses.definitionSentence: Disposition means your usual mood.
senses.definitionZh: 您平时的心情。
senses.exampleZh: 他性格开朗。

senses.example: His cautious disposition favored saving the money rather than investing it in a risky venture.
senses.definition: an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
senses.definitionSentence: Disposition is an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others.
senses.definitionZh: 一种心态，尤其是倾向于一种选择而不是其他选择的态度。
senses.exampleZh: 他谨慎的性格倾向于把钱存起来，而不是投资于有风险的企业。

senses.meaning: 使了解，使接触到，使暴露，使知悉，让受到
senses.example: Expose your students to art.
senses.definition: expose or make accessible to some action or influence
senses.definitionSentence: To expose means to expose or make accessible to some action or influence.
senses.definitionZh: 暴露某些行为或影响或使其受到某些行为或影响的影响。
senses.exampleZh: 让您的学生接触艺术。

senses.example: Workers removed the damaged panels to expose the pipes behind the wall.
senses.definition: disclose to view as by removing a cover
senses.definitionSentence: To expose means to disclose to view as by removing a cover.
senses.definitionZh: 移去遮盖物，使某物显露出来。
senses.exampleZh: 工人拆下受损面板，使墙后的管道显露出来。

senses.example: Mayor Wagner's shortcomings have perhaps been more mercilessly exposed than those of Mr. Levitt who left an impression of quiet competence in his more protected state post.
senses.definition: make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
senses.definitionSentence: To expose means to make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret.
senses.definitionZh: 将以前只有少数人知道或本应保密的信息公之于众。
senses.exampleZh: 瓦格纳市长的缺点可能比莱维特先生的缺点更无情地暴露出来，莱维特先生在其更受保护的国家职位上给人留下了安静能干的印象。

senses.example: The Final Solution proved that the Jew-baiter of any variety exposes himself as being implicated in the criminality and madness of others.
senses.definition: to show, make visible or apparent
senses.definitionSentence: Expose means to show, make visible or apparent.
senses.definitionZh: 展示、使可见或显而易见。
senses.exampleZh: 最终解决方案证明，任何类型的犹太人煽动者都会暴露自己与他人的犯罪和疯狂有牵连。

senses.example: "exposure to the weather" or "they died from exposure"
senses.definition: vulnerability to the elements; to the action of heat or cold or wind or rain
senses.definitionSentence: Exposure means vulnerability to the elements; to the action of heat or cold or wind or rain.
senses.definitionZh: 易受自然因素影响；热或冷或风或雨的作用。
senses.exampleZh: “暴露于天气”或“他们因暴露而死亡”

senses.example: He used the wrong exposure.
senses.definition: the intensity of light falling on a photographic film or plate
senses.definitionSentence: Exposure is the intensity of light falling on a photographic film or plate.
senses.definitionZh: 落在照相胶片或底片上的光的强度。
senses.exampleZh: 他使用了错误的曝光。

senses.definition: compel to behave in a certain way
senses.definitionSentence: Compel to behave in a certain way.
senses.definitionZh: 强迫以某种方式行事。
senses.example: The occupying army imposed strict rules that forced residents to remain indoors at night.
senses.exampleZh: 占领军制定了严格的规定，迫使居民晚上留在室内。

senses.example: Similar payroll tax boosts would be imposed on those under the railroad retirement system.
senses.definition: impose and collect
senses.definitionSentence: To impose means to impose and collect.
senses.definitionZh: 强加和征收。
senses.exampleZh: 铁路退休制度下的人员也将享受类似的工资税优惠。

senses.meaning: 不可能存在的，不可能的
senses.example: There were other roofs, less convenient but not impossible.
senses.definition: not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as impossible is not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为不可能的事情是不可能发生、完成或处理的。
senses.exampleZh: 还有其他屋顶，不太方便，但并非不可能。

senses.example: We oppose the ban on abortion.
senses.definition: be against; express opposition to
senses.definitionSentence: To oppose means to be against; express opposition to.
senses.definitionZh: 反对；表示反对。
senses.exampleZh: 我们反对禁止堕胎。

senses.example: "And I on the opposite shore will be, ready to ride and spread the alarm"- Longfellow.
senses.definition: being directly across from each other; facing
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as opposite is being directly across from each other; facing.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为相反的东西是直接面对面；面对。
senses.exampleZh: “而我将在对岸，准备好骑行并传播警报” - 朗费罗。

senses.example: Her cheerful optimism was the exact opposite of his constant pessimism.
senses.definition: something inverted in sequence or character or effect
senses.definitionSentence: Opposite means something inverted in sequence or character or effect.
senses.definitionZh: 顺序、特征或效果颠倒的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 她的乐观态度与他一贯的悲观态度完全相反。

senses.example: The unpleasant situation (or position) of having to choose between two evils.
senses.definition: a condition or position in which you find yourself
senses.definitionSentence: Position is a condition or position in which you find yourself.
senses.definitionZh: 您发现自己所处的状况或位置。
senses.exampleZh: 必须在两种邪恶之间做出选择的不愉快的情况（或位置）。

senses.example: Atheists do not enjoy a favorable position in American life.
senses.definition: the relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society
senses.definitionSentence: Position is the relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society.
senses.definitionZh: 社会中事物（尤其是人）的相对位置或地位。
senses.exampleZh: 无神论者在美国人的生活中并不享有有利的地位。

senses.example: This is important to understanding the position that doctrinaire liberals found themselves in after World War 2, and our great democratic victory that brought no peace.
senses.definition: a rationalized mental attitude
senses.definitionSentence: Position is a rationalized mental attitude.
senses.definitionZh: 一种合理化的心理态度。
senses.exampleZh: 这对于理解第二次世界大战后教条主义自由主义者所处的位置以及我们伟大的民主胜利并没有带来和平非常重要。

senses.example: Research into several cultures has proven her position to be a mistaken one.
senses.definition: a way of regarding situations or topics etc.
senses.definitionSentence: Position is a way of regarding situations or topics etc.
senses.definitionZh: 一种看待情况或主题等的方式。
senses.exampleZh: 对多种文化的研究证明她的立场是错误的。

senses.example: The technician positioned the sensor beside the engine where heat was greatest.
senses.definition: put into a certain place or abstract location
senses.definitionSentence: To position means to put into a certain place or abstract location.
senses.definitionZh: 放入某个地方或抽象位置。
senses.exampleZh: 技术人员将传感器放置在热量最大的发动机旁边。

senses.definitionSentence: Expressing affirmation, confidence, or acceptance.
senses.definitionZh: 表示肯定、信心或接受的。
senses.example: She remained positive despite the difficulties facing the team.
senses.exampleZh: 尽管团队面临困难，她仍保持积极态度。
senses.definition: Expressing affirmation, confidence, or acceptance.

senses.meaning: 带正电的，带正电荷的，正的，阳性的
senses.example: The proton carries a positive electric charge, while the electron carries a negative one.
senses.definition: having a positive charge
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as positive is having a positive charge.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为正的东西具有正电荷。
senses.exampleZh: 质子带有正电荷，而电子带有负电荷。

senses.example: The laboratory reported that the sample had tested positive for the virus.
senses.definition: indicating existence or presence of a suspected condition or pathogen
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as positive is indicating existence or presence of a suspected condition or pathogen.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为阳性的事物表明存在或存在疑似病症或病原体。
senses.exampleZh: 实验室报告称，该样本的病毒检测结果呈阳性。

senses.example: In 'The keys are under the table,' 'under' is a preposition linking the keys to the table.
senses.definition: a function word that combines with a noun or pronoun or noun phrase to form a prepositional phrase that can have an adverbial or adjectival relation to some other word
senses.definitionSentence: Preposition is a function word that combines with a noun or pronoun or noun phrase to form a prepositional phrase that can have an adverbial or adjectival relation to some other word.
senses.definitionZh: 一个功能词，与名词或代词或名词短语组合形成介词短语，可以与其他单词具有状语或形容词关系。
senses.exampleZh: 在“钥匙位于桌子下面”中，“under”是将钥匙链接到桌子的介词。

senses.example: They listened to her proposal.
senses.definition: the act of making a proposal
senses.definitionSentence: Proposal is the act of making a proposal.
senses.definitionZh: 提出提案的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 他们听取了她的建议。

senses.example: It was nothing that he said or did, but it seemed so natural to her that she should be working for him, looking forward to his eventual proposal.
senses.definition: an offer of marriage
senses.definitionSentence: Proposal is an offer of marriage.
senses.definitionZh: 求婚。
senses.exampleZh: 他没有说过或做过什么，但她似乎很自然地认为她应该为他工作，期待他最终的求婚。

senses.example: The senator proposed to abolish the sales tax.
senses.definition: make a proposal, declare a plan for something
senses.definitionSentence: To propose means to make a proposal, declare a plan for something.
senses.definitionZh: 提出建议、宣布某事的计划。
senses.exampleZh: 参议员提议废除销售税。

senses.example: The committee proposed Dr. Chen for the position of department chair.
senses.definition: put forward; nominate for appointment to an office or for an honor or position
senses.definitionSentence: To propose means to put forward; nominate for appointment to an office or for an honor or position.
senses.definitionZh: 任命，提名。
senses.exampleZh: 委员会提名陈博士担任系主任。

senses.example: She proposes to complete the field research before the rainy season begins.
senses.definition: propose or intend
senses.definitionSentence: To intend or plan to do something.
senses.definitionZh: 打算或计划做某事。
senses.exampleZh: 她打算在雨季开始前完成实地研究。

senses.example: `` Exterminatin ' cow thieves is just a business proposition with me '', he 'd blandly announce.
senses.definition: a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
senses.definitionSentence: Proposition is a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection.
senses.definitionZh: 供接受或拒绝的提案。
senses.exampleZh: “消灭”偷牛贼对我来说只是一个商业提议”，他温和地宣布。

senses.example: But still, the proposition is worth examination.
senses.definition: (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false
senses.definitionSentence: Proposition means (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false.
senses.definitionZh: （逻辑）肯定或否定某事且为真或为假的陈述。
senses.exampleZh: 但是，这个命题仍然值得检验。

senses.example: When Prokofieff forged his new clarity of `` lucid, straightforward music, so difficult to compose '', he shaped his talents to his purpose.
senses.definition: an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions
senses.definitionSentence: Purpose is an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions.
senses.definitionZh: 预期的结果或指导您计划的行动的预期结果。
senses.exampleZh: 当普罗科菲耶夫打造出“清晰、直接的音乐，很难创作”的新清晰度时，他根据自己的目的塑造了自己的才能。

senses.example: I purpose to finish the research before applying for the grant.
senses.definition: propose or intend
senses.definitionSentence: To purpose means to propose or intend.
senses.definitionZh: 提议或打算。
senses.exampleZh: 我打算在申请资助之前完成研究。

senses.example: Scientists supposed that large dinosaurs lived in swamps.
senses.definition: to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
senses.definitionSentence: Suppose means to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds.
senses.definitionZh: 相信，尤其是在不确定或暂定的基础上。
senses.exampleZh: 科学家推测大型恐龙生活在沼泽中。

senses.example: At the cancer symposium, five researchers presented new findings before answering questions from the audience.
senses.definition: a meeting or conference for the public discussion of some topic especially one in which the participants form an audience and make presentations
dictionaryCandidates: 讨论会， 专题报告会
senses.definitionSentence: Symposium is a meeting or conference for the public discussion of some topic especially one in which the participants form an audience and make presentations.
senses.definitionZh: 针对某个主题进行公开讨论的会议或会议，特别是参与者组成观众并进行演示的会议。
senses.exampleZh: 在癌症研讨会上，五位研究人员在回答观众问题之前介绍了新发现。

senses.example: He possesses great knowledge about the Middle East.
senses.definition: have as an attribute, knowledge, or skill
senses.definitionSentence: To possess means to have as an attribute, knowledge, or skill.
senses.definitionZh: 拥有属性、知识或技能。
senses.exampleZh: 他对中东拥有丰富的了解。

senses.example: What possessed you to buy this house?
senses.definition: enter into and control, as of emotions or ideas
senses.definitionSentence: To possess means to enter into and control, as of emotions or ideas.
senses.definitionZh: 进入和控制，例如情绪或想法。
senses.exampleZh: 是什么让你买了这套房子？

senses.example: By the death of his father in 1888 he had come into possession of the family estate and had re-assumed its traditions.
senses.definition: the act of having and controlling property
senses.definitionSentence: Possession is the act of having and controlling property.
senses.definitionZh: 拥有和控制财产的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 1888 年，他的父亲去世后，他继承了家族庄园，并重新继承了家族的传统。

senses.meaning: 意志力，毅力，自制力，自我控制
senses.example: Even under provocation, she kept possession of herself and controlled her behavior.
senses.definition: the trait of resolutely controlling your own behavior
senses.definitionSentence: Possession is the trait of resolutely controlling your own behavior.
senses.definitionZh: 坚决控制自己行为的特质。
senses.exampleZh: 即使受到挑衅，她仍能控制自己并控制自己的行为。

senses.example: The villagers believed his violent trance was caused by possession by an evil spirit.
senses.definition: being controlled by passion or the supernatural
senses.definitionSentence: Possession means being controlled by passion or the supernatural.
senses.definitionZh: 被激情或超自然力量所控制。
senses.exampleZh: 村民们认为他的剧烈恍惚是由于被邪灵附体造成的。

senses.example: The possibilities of selling the property later on for suburban subdivision.
senses.definition: capability of existing or happening or being true
senses.definitionSentence: Possibility means capability of existing or happening or being true.
senses.definitionZh: 存在、发生或成为真实的能力。
senses.exampleZh: 稍后出售该房产以进行郊区细分的可能性。

senses.example: Engineers are studying possible uses of nuclear power, including electricity generation and spacecraft propulsion.
senses.definition: existing in possibility
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as possible is existing in possibility.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为可能的事物存在于可能性中。
senses.exampleZh: 工程师正在研究核能的可能用途，包括发电和航天器推进。

senses.definition: by chance
senses.definitionSentence: By chance.
senses.definitionZh: 偶然。
senses.example: The flight was delayed, possibly because thick fog covered the airport runway.
senses.exampleZh: 航班延误，可能是因为机场跑道被大雾覆盖。

senses.meaning: 尽可能地，以可行的方式
senses.example: They can't possibly get here in time for the funeral?
senses.definition: to a degree possible of achievement or by possible means
senses.definitionSentence: Possibly means to a degree possible of achievement or by possible means.
senses.definitionZh: 在一定程度上可能实现或通过可能的方式实现。
senses.exampleZh: 他们不可能及时赶到这里参加葬礼吗？

senses.example: I pray you to reconsider, because the families have nowhere else to go.
senses.definition: call upon in supplication; entreat
senses.definitionSentence: To pray means to call upon in supplication; entreat.
senses.definitionZh: 祈求；恳求。
senses.exampleZh: 我请求您重新考虑，因为这些家庭无处可去。

senses.example: In the prayer Jesus taught his disciples to pray we find these words, `` Forgive us our debts ''.
senses.definition: address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer
senses.definitionSentence: To pray means to address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer.
senses.definitionZh: 向神灵、先知、圣人或崇拜的对象讲话；说一个祈祷。
senses.exampleZh: 在耶稣教导门徒祈祷的祷告中，我们发现这样的话：“免我们的债”。

senses.example: Only within the framework of a mature relationship characterized by honest appraisals of performance can we provide telling assistance.
senses.definition: the classification of someone or something with respect to its worth
senses.definitionSentence: Appraisal is the classification of someone or something with respect to its worth.
senses.definitionZh: 对某人或某物的价值进行分类。
senses.exampleZh: 只有在以诚实评估绩效为特征的成熟关系框架内，我们才能提供有说服力的帮助。

senses.example: The priest sank to his knees in prayer.
senses.definition: the act of communicating with a deity (especially as a petition or in adoration or contrition or thanksgiving)
senses.definitionSentence: Prayer is the act of communicating with a deity (especially as a petition or in adoration or contrition or thanksgiving).
senses.definitionZh: 与神灵沟通的行为（尤其是作为请愿或崇拜、忏悔或感恩）。
senses.exampleZh: 牧师跪下祈祷。

senses.example: He puts a high price on his services.
senses.definition: the property of having material worth (often indicated by the amount of money something would bring if sold)
senses.definitionSentence: Price is the property of having material worth (often indicated by the amount of money something would bring if sold).
senses.definitionZh: 具有物质价值的属性（通常以某物出售后所能带来的金额来表示）。
senses.exampleZh: 他对自己的服务定价很高。

senses.example: The price of success is hard work.
senses.definition: value measured by what must be given or done or undergone to obtain something
senses.definitionSentence: Price means value measured by what must be given or done or undergone to obtain something.
senses.definitionZh: 通过为获得某物而必须给予、完成或经历的事情来衡量的价值。
senses.exampleZh: 成功的代价是努力工作。

senses.definitionSentence: To assign money or another resource to a particular purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 把资金或其他资源拨给某个特定用途。
senses.example: Parliament appropriated additional funds to rebuild schools damaged by the flood.
senses.exampleZh: 议会拨出额外资金，用于重建被洪水损坏的学校。
senses.definition: To assign money or another resource to a particular purpose.

senses.example: It seems that an apology is appropriate.
senses.definition: suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as appropriate is suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为适当的事物适合特定的人、地点或条件等。
senses.exampleZh: 看来道歉是合适的。

senses.example: The land he conquered comprised several provinces.
senses.definition: be composed of
senses.definitionSentence: To comprise means to be composed of.
senses.exampleZh: 他征服的土地包括多个省份。

senses.example: A growing enterprise must have a bold leader.
senses.definition: an organization created for business ventures
senses.definitionSentence: Enterprise is an organization created for business ventures.
senses.definitionZh: 为商业投资而创建的组织。
senses.exampleZh: 一个成长中的企业必须有一个大胆的领导者。

senses.example: He takes pride in his son's success.
senses.definition: satisfaction with your (or another's) achievements
senses.definitionSentence: Pride means satisfaction with your (or another's) achievements.
senses.definitionZh: 对您（或他人）的成就感到满意。
senses.exampleZh: 他为儿子的成功感到自豪。

senses.meaning: 祭司，非基督教宗教的神职人员
senses.example: Dr. Hilprecht was uncertain as to the language used by the ancient priest in his dream.
senses.definition: a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion
senses.definitionSentence: Priest is a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion.
senses.definitionZh: 在非基督教中履行宗教职责和仪式的人。
senses.exampleZh: Hilprecht 博士不确定古代祭司在梦中使用的语言。

senses.example: But, in general, we may argue that the student can direct the primary emphasis of his attention toward one or the other.
senses.definition: of first rank or importance or value; direct and immediate rather than secondary
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as primary is of first rank or importance or value; direct and immediate rather than secondary.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为主要的事物具有第一等级或重要性或价值；直接和立即的而不是次要的。
senses.exampleZh: 但是，一般来说，我们可能会认为学生可以将注意力的主要重点转向其中一个。

senses.example: Thus, man can readily deduce that the primary objective end of the conjugal act is procreation, the propagation of the race.
senses.definition: most important element
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as primary is most important element.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为主要的元素是最重要的元素。
senses.exampleZh: 因此，人类可以很容易地推断出婚姻行为的主要目标是繁衍，即种族的繁衍。

senses.meaning: 主要的，首要的，最重要的
senses.definitionSentence: First in rank, quality, or importance.
senses.definitionZh: 在等级、质量或重要性上居首位的。
senses.example: Engineers treated safety as the prime consideration in designing the new bridge.
senses.exampleZh: 工程师把安全视为新桥设计中的首要考虑。
senses.definition: First in rank, quality, or importance.

senses.meaning: 全盛期，巅峰，最高点，鼎盛时期
senses.example: The athlete reached her prime at twenty-eight, winning more races than at any other period.
senses.definition: the period of greatest prosperity or productivity
senses.definitionSentence: Prime is the period of greatest prosperity or productivity.
senses.definitionZh: 最繁荣或生产力最高的时期。
senses.exampleZh: 这位运动员在二十八岁时达到了巅峰，赢得的比赛比任何其他时期都多。

senses.example: Primitive living conditions in the Appalachian mountains.
senses.definition: belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as primitive is belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为原始的东西属于技术发展的早期阶段；其特点是简单和（通常）粗糙。
senses.exampleZh: 阿巴拉契亚山脉的原始生活条件。

senses.example: The Prince visited the hospital of Operation Brotherhood, supported by the Junior Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines, and fed rice to two pet elephants he kept at his residence at Pak Song.
senses.definition: a male member of a royal family other than the sovereign (especially the son of a sovereign)
senses.definitionSentence: Prince is a male member of a royal family other than the sovereign (especially the son of a sovereign).
senses.definitionZh: 君主以外的王室男性成员（特别是君主的儿子）。
senses.exampleZh: 王子参观了由菲律宾青年商会支持的兄弟会行动医院，并给他在 Pak Song 住所养的两只宠物大象喂了米饭。

senses.example: As the king's daughter, the princess represented the royal family at the state ceremony.
senses.definition: a female member of a royal family other than the queen (especially the daughter of a sovereign)
senses.definitionSentence: Princess is a female member of a royal family other than the queen (especially the daughter of a sovereign).
senses.definitionZh: 王后以外的王室女性成员（尤其是君主的女儿）。
senses.exampleZh: 作为国王的女儿，公主代表王室出席国礼。

senses.example: These conditions are unobtainable - are not even approachable in the qualified sense I have indicated - without the prior defeat of world Communism.
senses.definition: earlier in time
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as prior is earlier in time.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为先验的事物在时间上较早。
senses.exampleZh: 如果没有世界共产主义的事先失败，这些条件是无法实现的——甚至在我所指出的限定意义上是不可能实现的。

senses.example: National independence takes priority over class struggle.
senses.definition: status established in order of importance or urgency
senses.definitionSentence: Priority means status established in order of importance or urgency.
senses.definitionZh: 按重要性或紧急程度顺序确定的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 民族独立优先于阶级斗争。

senses.example: Caught at last, he was sentenced to prison.
senses.definition: a correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment
senses.definitionSentence: Prison is a correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment.
senses.definitionZh: 在审判或惩罚期间关押人员的惩教机构。
senses.exampleZh: 最后被捕，他被判入狱。

senses.example: Severe illness turned his bedroom into a prison from which he felt unable to escape.
senses.definition: a prisonlike situation; a place of seeming confinement
senses.definitionSentence: Prison is a prisonlike situation; a place of seeming confinement.
senses.definitionZh: 类似监狱的情况；一个看似禁闭的地方。
senses.exampleZh: 严重的疾病把他的卧室变成了一座监狱，他感到无法逃脱。

senses.example: Wilson, shackled and snarling, was thrown with the other prisoners and was soon joined by Green, McKee and McKinley.
senses.definition: a person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war
senses.definitionSentence: Prisoner is a person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war.
senses.definitionZh: 被监禁的人；尤其是战俘。
senses.exampleZh: 威尔逊戴着脚镣，咆哮着，与其他囚犯一起被扔进监狱，很快格林、麦基和麦金利也加入了进来。

senses.example: He had picked out this pathless trail, instead of the common one, in a moment of romantic fancy, to give them privacy on their honeymoon.
senses.definition: the condition of being concealed or hidden
senses.definitionSentence: Privacy is the condition of being concealed or hidden.
senses.definitionZh: 被隐藏或隐藏的情况。
senses.exampleZh: 他在浪漫的幻想中选择了这条无路的小路，而不是常见的小路，以便在蜜月期间给他们带来隐私。

senses.example: The writer sought privacy in a remote cabin where no visitors could disturb her.
senses.definition: the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others
senses.definitionSentence: Privacy is the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others.
senses.definitionZh: 远离他人的存在或观点的品质。
senses.exampleZh: 这位作家到偏僻的小屋中寻求清静，以免受到访客打扰。

senses.definitionSentence: A soldier holding the lowest enlisted rank in an army.
senses.definitionZh: 在军队中担任最低士兵军衔的人。
senses.example: The young private saluted the captain and returned to his guard post.
senses.exampleZh: 年轻的列兵向上尉敬礼后返回警戒岗位。
senses.definition: A soldier holding the lowest enlisted rank in an army.

senses.example: She kept the deeply private details of her marriage and medical history out of the interview.
senses.definition: concerning things deeply private and personal
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as private is concerning things deeply private and personal.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为私人的事物涉及非常私人和个人的事情。
senses.exampleZh: 她在采访中保留了有关婚姻和病史的私密细节。

senses.example: Mason had to earn the privilege of devoting himself exclusively to painting.
senses.definition: a special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all
senses.definitionSentence: Privilege is a special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all.
senses.definitionZh: 并非所有人都享有的特殊优势或豁免权或福利。
senses.exampleZh: 梅森必须赢得专门致力于绘画的特权。

senses.example: The law privileges emergency vehicles to pass through red lights when responding to danger.
senses.definition: bestow a privilege upon
senses.definitionSentence: To privilege means to bestow a privilege upon.
senses.definitionZh: 授予特权。
senses.exampleZh: 法律规定紧急车辆在应对危险时可以闯红灯。

senses.example: The prize was a free trip to Europe.
senses.definition: something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery
senses.definitionSentence: Prize means something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery.
senses.definitionZh: 为在比赛或比赛中获胜或获得优势或赢得彩票而给予的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 奖品是免费欧洲之旅。

senses.example: I prize these old photographs.
senses.definition: hold dear
senses.definitionSentence: To prize means to hold dear.
senses.definitionZh: 珍惜。
senses.exampleZh: 我珍惜这些老照片。

senses.example: Police recovered the thieves' prize: cash and jewelry taken during the robbery.
senses.definition: goods or money obtained illegally
senses.definitionSentence: Prize means goods or money obtained illegally.
senses.definitionZh: 非法获得的物品或金钱。
senses.exampleZh: 警方追回了窃贼的战利品：抢劫过程中拿走的现金和珠宝。

senses.example: Police surprised the burglars inside the warehouse before the criminals knew they had been discovered.
senses.definition: come upon or take unawares
senses.definitionSentence: To surprise means to come upon or take unawares.
senses.definitionZh: 意外地发现或采取意外。
senses.exampleZh: 在罪犯意识到自己被发现之前，警方对仓库内的窃贼进行了突击。

senses.example: But his first few days with Troop H were full of surprises, beginning with First Sergeant Robert Early.
senses.definition: a sudden unexpected event
senses.definitionSentence: Surprise is a sudden unexpected event.
senses.definitionZh: 突然发生的意外事件。
senses.exampleZh: 但他在 H 部队的头几天充满了惊喜，从中士罗伯特·厄尔开始。

senses.example: There were unclaimed square miles of seating space around them, but he appreciated the kindliness of her gesture none the less.
senses.definition: recognize with gratitude; be grateful for
senses.definitionSentence: To appreciate means to recognize with gratitude; be grateful for.
senses.definitionZh: 感激地认识；心存感激。
senses.exampleZh: 他们周围有无人认领的座位空间，但他仍然欣赏她的善意举动。

senses.example: Do you appreciate the full meaning of this letter?
senses.definition: be fully aware of; realize fully
senses.definitionSentence: To appreciate means to be fully aware of; realize fully.
senses.definitionZh: 充分了解；充分认识到。
senses.exampleZh: 您理解这封信的全部含义吗？

senses.example: Diamonds, sapphires, rubies, and emeralds are precious stones.
senses.definition: of high worth or cost
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as precious is of high worth or cost.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为珍贵的东西具有很高的价值或成本。
senses.exampleZh: 钻石、蓝宝石、红宝石和祖母绿都是宝石。

senses.example: The train arrived at the precise scheduled moment, exactly 8:17 and not a second later.
senses.definition: sharply exact or accurate or delimited
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as precise is sharply exact or accurate or delimited.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为精确的事物是非常精确的、准确的或有界限的。
senses.exampleZh: 火车准时到达，8点17分，一秒也不晚。

senses.example: Note the meticulous precision of his measurements.
senses.definition: the quality of being reproducible in amount or performance
senses.definitionSentence: Precision is the quality of being reproducible in amount or performance.
senses.definitionZh: 数量或性能上可再现的质量。
senses.exampleZh: 请注意他测量的一丝不苟的精确度。

senses.example: She proved to be right.
senses.definition: be shown or be found to be
senses.definitionSentence: To prove means to be shown or be found to be.
senses.definitionZh: 被证明或被发现。
senses.exampleZh: 事实证明她是对的。

senses.example: The laboratory proved the new alloy by exposing samples to heat, pressure, and repeated impact.
senses.definition: put to the test, as for its quality, or give experimental use to
senses.definitionSentence: To prove means to put to the test, as for its quality, or give experimental use to.
senses.definitionZh: 证明手段对其质量进行测试，或进行实验使用。
senses.exampleZh: 实验室通过将样品暴露在热量、压力和反复冲击下来验证这种新合金。

senses.example: His decision merited the approval of any sensible person.
senses.definition: the formal act of approving
senses.definitionSentence: Approval is the formal act of approving.
senses.definitionZh: 批准的正式行为。
senses.exampleZh: 他的决定值得任何明智之人的认可。

senses.example: John Templeman `` Approved, Timothy Palmer '' This chain bridge proved less durable than the wooden arch on the Salisbury end.
senses.definition: judge to be right or commendable; think well of
senses.definitionSentence: To approve means to judge to be right or commendable; think well of.
senses.definitionZh: 判断是正确的或值得赞扬的；好好想想。
senses.exampleZh: 约翰·坦普尔曼“批准，蒂莫西·帕尔默” 事实证明，这座链桥不如索尔兹伯里端的木拱桥耐用。

senses.example: The council approved the revised building plan after the safety review.
senses.definition: give sanction to
senses.definitionSentence: To approve means to give sanction to.
senses.definitionZh: 正式批准、准许或认可。
senses.exampleZh: 安全审查后，委员会批准了修订后的建筑方案。

senses.meaning: 使更好，修改，修正，变好，增进，提高，改善，改正，改良，改进
senses.example: The editor improved the manuscript with his changes.
senses.definition: to make better
senses.definitionSentence: Improve means to make better.
senses.definitionZh: 做得更好。
senses.exampleZh: 编辑通过修改改进了手稿。

senses.example: The new school represents a great improvement.
senses.definition: a condition superior to an earlier condition
senses.definitionSentence: Improvement is a condition superior to an earlier condition.
senses.definitionZh: 优于早期状况的状况。
senses.exampleZh: 新学校代表着巨大的进步。

senses.example: Miraculously, the bottle was still in my hand, foam still geysering over my (luckily) waterproof watch.
senses.definition: not permitting the passage of water
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as waterproof is not permitting the passage of water.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓防水是指不允许水通过。
senses.exampleZh: 奇迹般的是，瓶子仍然在我手里，泡沫仍然在我的（幸运的是）防水手表上冒出。

senses.example: He put on a yellow waterproof before walking into the heavy rain.
senses.definition: a water-resistant coat
senses.definitionSentence: Waterproof is a water-resistant coat.
senses.definitionZh: 防水外套。
senses.exampleZh: 他在走进大雨之前穿上了黄色防水服。

senses.example: If you have any proof for what you say, now is the time to produce it.
senses.definition: any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something
senses.definitionSentence: Proof means any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something.
senses.definitionZh: 有助于确定某事真相的任何事实证据。
senses.exampleZh: 如果你有任何证据证明你所说的话，现在就是拿出来的时候了。

senses.example: The geometry proof used a sequence of logical steps to show that the two angles were equal.
senses.definition: a formal series of statements showing that if one thing is true something else necessarily follows from it
senses.definitionSentence: Proof is a formal series of statements showing that if one thing is true something else necessarily follows from it.
senses.definitionZh: 一系列正式的陈述，表明如果一件事是正确的，则必然会得出其他的结论。
senses.exampleZh: 这份几何证明通过一系列逻辑步骤说明两个角相等。

senses.example: If it were the enemy, tactically his position was correct.
senses.definition: free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as correct is free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为正确的内容没有错误；特别是符合事实或真相。
senses.exampleZh: 如果是敌人，从战术上来说他的位置是正确的。

senses.example: The inadequacy of our library system will become critical unless we act vigorously to correct this condition.
senses.definition: make reparations or amends for
senses.definitionSentence: To correct means to make reparations or amends for.
senses.definitionZh: 进行补偿或修正。
senses.exampleZh: 除非我们积极采取行动纠正这种情况，否则我们图书馆系统的不足将变得至关重要。

senses.example: It could, by avoiding direct intervention, provide a short-of war strategy to meet short-of war infiltration.
senses.definition: direct in spatial dimensions; proceeding without deviation or interruption; straight and short
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as direct is direct in spatial dimensions; proceeding without deviation or interruption; straight and short.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为直接的东西在空间维度上是直接的；不间断地进行；又直又短。
senses.exampleZh: 它可以通过避免直接干预，提供一种短时战争策略来满足短时战争渗透。

senses.example: We want the past forgiven, but at the same time we must be willing for God to direct the future.
senses.definition: be in charge of
senses.definitionSentence: To direct means to be in charge of.
senses.definitionZh: 负责。
senses.exampleZh: 我们希望过去得到宽恕，但同时我们必须愿意让上帝指引未来。

senses.example: I couldn't follow the direction of his thoughts.
senses.definition: a general course along which something has a tendency to develop
senses.definitionSentence: Direction is a general course along which something has a tendency to develop.
senses.definitionZh: 事物有发展趋势的一般过程。
senses.exampleZh: 我无法跟随他的思想方向。

senses.example: In these cases a graduate may enter directly into an apprentice program, saving a year because of his vocational courses in grades 11 and 12.
senses.definition: without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening
senses.definitionSentence: Directly means without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening.
senses.definitionZh: 毫不拖延或毫不犹豫；没有时间干预。
senses.exampleZh: 在这些情况下，毕业生可以直接进入学徒计划，因为 11 年级和 12 年级的职业课程可以节省一年的时间。

senses.example: The first program was sponsored by Abraham + Strauss, Hempstead, New York, under the direction of Special Events director Jennings Dennis.
senses.definition: someone who controls resources and expenditures
senses.definitionSentence: Director means someone who controls resources and expenditures.
senses.definitionZh: 控制资源和支出的人。
senses.exampleZh: 第一个项目由纽约亨普斯特德的 Abraham + Strauss 赞助，并在特别活动总监 Jennings Dennis 的指导下进行。

senses.example: Too bad your number is in the directory ''.
senses.definition: an alphabetical list of names and addresses
senses.definitionSentence: Directory is an alphabetical list of names and addresses.
senses.definitionZh: 按字母顺序排列的名称和地址列表。
senses.exampleZh: 太糟糕了，你的号码在目录“”中。

senses.definitionSentence: Upright in position or posture rather than bent or lying down.
senses.definitionZh: 位置或姿势保持竖直，而不是弯曲或躺倒。
senses.example: The guard stood erect at the gate, with his back straight and his eyes forward.
senses.exampleZh: 卫兵挺直地站在门口，背部笔直，目视前方。
senses.definition: Upright in position or posture rather than bent or lying down.

senses.example: Will your local bus company erect and / or maintain the bus stops at your plant?
senses.definition: construct, build, or erect
senses.definitionSentence: To erect means to construct, build, or erect.
senses.definitionZh: 构建、构建或建立。
senses.exampleZh: 您当地的巴士公司会在您的工厂建立和/或维护巴士站吗？

senses.example: Workers erected a flagpole in the square and raised the national flag.
senses.definition: cause to rise up
senses.definitionSentence: To erect means to cause to rise up.
senses.definitionZh: 导致上升。
senses.exampleZh: 工人们在广场上竖起了旗杆并升起了国旗。

senses.example: The carpenter drew a rectangle with two long sides, two short sides, and four right angles.
senses.definition: a parallelogram with four right angles
senses.definitionSentence: Rectangle is a parallelogram with four right angles.
senses.definitionZh: 有四个直角的平行四边形。
senses.exampleZh: 木匠画了一个长方形，有两条长边、两条短边和四个直角。

senses.example: Counseling helped him rectify his dishonest behavior and repay the money he had stolen.
senses.definition: bring, lead, or force to abandon a wrong or evil course of life, conduct, and adopt a right one
senses.definitionSentence: To rectify means to bring, lead, or force to abandon a wrong or evil course of life, conduct, and adopt a right one.
senses.definitionZh: 带来、引导或强迫放弃错误或邪恶的生活方式、行为并采取正确的生活方式。
senses.exampleZh: 咨询帮助他纠正了自己的不诚实行为并偿还了他所偷的钱。

senses.example: This road is the same one we were on yesterday.
senses.definition: same in identity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as same is same in identity.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为相同的事物在同一性上是相同的。
senses.exampleZh: 这条路和我们昨天走过的路是同一条路。

senses.example: My answer is the same as yours, including the final calculation.
senses.exampleZh: 我的答案和你的一样，连最后的计算也相同。
senses.definitionSentence: The same person or thing.
senses.definitionZh: 同一个人或同一件事。

senses.example: In a sample of new members of Pittsburgh churches, almost 60 per cent were recruited by initial `` contacts with friendly members ''.
senses.definition: a small part of something intended as representative of the whole
senses.definitionSentence: Sample is a small part of something intended as representative of the whole.
senses.definitionZh: 代表整体的一小部分。
senses.exampleZh: 在匹兹堡教会的新成员样本中，近 60% 是通过最初的“与友好成员接触”而招募的。

senses.example: (Which is understandable - if you 've ever sampled the exotic, peppery fare).
senses.definition: take a sample of
senses.definitionSentence: To sample means to take a sample of.
