senses.definitionSentence: To prosecute means to conduct a prosecution in a court of law.
senses.definitionZh: 在法庭上进行起诉。
senses.exampleZh: 当地警方犹豫是否起诉他们，因为即使是最简单的犯罪行为也会涉及高昂的法庭费用。

senses.example: The stone will be hauled to a secondary crusher.
senses.definition: being of second rank or importance or value; not direct or immediate
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as secondary is being of second rank or importance or value; not direct or immediate.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为次要的东西是第二等级或重要性或价值；不直接或立即。
senses.exampleZh: 石头将被拖至二级破碎机。

senses.example: His decision had depressing consequences for business.
senses.definition: a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
senses.definitionSentence: Consequence is a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon.
senses.definitionZh: 由先前的某些现象引起的后续现象。
senses.exampleZh: 他的决定给企业带来了令人沮丧的后果。

senses.example: He had good reason to be grateful for the opportunities which they had made available to him and which consequently led to the good position he now held.
senses.definition: as a consequence
senses.definitionSentence: Consequently means as a consequence.
senses.definitionZh: 结果。
senses.exampleZh: 他有充分的理由感谢他们为他提供的机会，并因此使他获得了现在的良好职位。

senses.example: He invented a technique to determine the sequence of base pairs in DNA.
senses.definition: serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern
senses.definitionSentence: Sequence means serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern.
senses.definitionZh: 事物按逻辑顺序或循环模式遵循的串行排列。
senses.exampleZh: 他发明了一种确定 DNA 碱基对序列的技术。

senses.example: The subsequent two-weeks wait made the crew quarrelsome.
senses.definition: following in time or order
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as subsequent is following in time or order.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为后续的事物在时间或顺序上遵循。
senses.exampleZh: 随后两周的等待让船员们吵得不可开交。

senses.example: In the dark he had to depend on touch and on his senses of smell and hearing.
senses.definition: the faculty through which the external world is apprehended
senses.definitionSentence: Sense is the faculty through which the external world is apprehended.
senses.definitionZh: 理解外部世界的能力。
senses.exampleZh: 在黑暗中，他必须依靠触觉以及嗅觉和听觉。

senses.example: The dictionary gave several senses for the word.
senses.definition: the meaning of a word or expression; the way in which a word or expression or situation can be interpreted
senses.definitionSentence: Sense is the meaning of a word or expression; the way in which a word or expression or situation can be interpreted.
senses.definitionZh: 单词或表达式的含义；解释单词、表达方式或情况的方式。
senses.exampleZh: 字典给出了这个词的几种含义。

senses.example: Sometimes such people sense that they are being used; sometimes not.
senses.definition: perceive by a physical sensation, e.g., coming from the skin or muscles
senses.definitionSentence: To sense means to perceive by a physical sensation, e.g., coming from the skin or muscles.
senses.definitionZh: 通过身体感觉来感知，例如来自皮肤或肌肉的感觉。
senses.exampleZh: 有时，这些人会感觉到自己被利用了；有时不是。

senses.example: He was surprised by the absence of any explanation.
senses.definition: the state of being absent
senses.definitionSentence: Absence is the state of being absent.
senses.definitionZh: 缺席的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 他对没有任何解释感到惊讶。

senses.example: The usual congratulatory crowd was conspicuously absent; the place had the air of a morgue.
senses.definition: not being in a specified place
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as absent is not being in a specified place.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为不存在的东西并不位于指定的地方。
senses.exampleZh: 平常的祝贺人群明显缺席了；这个地方有一种太平间的气氛。

senses.example: The lack of consensus reflected differences in theoretical positions.
senses.definition: agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
senses.definitionSentence: Consensus means agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole.
senses.definitionZh: 群体整体达成的判断或意见一致。
senses.exampleZh: 缺乏共识反映了理论立场的差异。

senses.example: Further, do our reforming friends really believe that the cartoonists will consent to the banishment of the tiger from their zoo?
senses.definition: give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to
senses.definitionSentence: To consent means to give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to.
senses.definitionZh: 给予肯定答复；积极响应。
senses.exampleZh: 此外，我们的改革派朋友真的相信漫画家会同意将老虎逐出他们的动物园吗？

senses.definition: permission or agreement given for something to happen
senses.definitionSentence: Consent is permission or agreement given for something to happen.
senses.definitionZh: 允许某事发生或同意做某事。
senses.example: The clinic obtained the patient's written consent before beginning the treatment.
senses.exampleZh: 诊所开始治疗前取得了患者的书面同意。

senses.example: For Plato, `` imitation '' is twice removed from reality, being a poor copy of physical appearance, which in itself is a poor copy of ideal essence.
senses.definition: the choicest or most essential or most vital part of some idea or experience
senses.definitionSentence: Essence is the choicest or most essential or most vital part of some idea or experience.
senses.definitionZh: 某些想法或经验中最精选的或最本质的或最重要的部分。
senses.exampleZh: 对于柏拉图来说，“模仿”双重地脱离了现实，是对物理外观的拙劣复制，而它本身又是对理想本质的拙劣复制。

senses.meaning: 基本的，必要的，必不可少的，精华的
senses.example: The mythological private eye differs from his counterpart in real life in two essential ways.
senses.definition: basic and fundamental
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as essential is basic and fundamental.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为必要的东西是基本的和根本的。
senses.exampleZh: 神话中的私家侦探与现实生活中的私家侦探有两个基本不同之处。

senses.example: The essentials of the good life.
senses.definition: anything indispensable
senses.definitionSentence: Essential means anything indispensable.
senses.definitionZh: 任何不可或缺的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 美好生活的必需品。

senses.example: In narrative, time is essential, as it is in film.
senses.definition: of the greatest importance
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as essential is of the greatest importance.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为必要的东西是最重要的。
senses.exampleZh: 在叙事中，时间至关重要，就像在电影中一样。

senses.example: He tested for the presence of radon.
senses.definition: the state of being present; current existence
senses.definitionSentence: Presence is the state of being present; current existence.
senses.definitionZh: 存在的状态；当前的存在。
senses.exampleZh: 他测试了氡气的存在。

senses.example: The ambassador's calm voice, upright bearing, and measured courtesy gave her a commanding presence at the tense meeting.
senses.definition: dignified manner or conduct
senses.definitionSentence: Presence means dignified manner or conduct.
senses.definitionZh: 有尊严的方式或行为。
senses.exampleZh: 大使平静的声音、端正的举止和分寸的礼节，让她在紧张的会议中展现出一种居高临下的气势。

senses.example: Perhaps the public's present attitude toward business stems from the fact that the `` rugged capitalist entrepreneur '' no more exists in America.
senses.definition: temporal sense; intermediate between past and future; now existing or happening or in consideration
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as present is temporal sense; intermediate between past and future; now existing or happening or in consideration.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项在此处意为“现在的”，指处于过去与未来之间、正在存在或发生的。
senses.exampleZh: 也许公众目前对商业的态度源于这样一个事实：“粗犷的资本主义企业家”在美国已不复存在。

senses.example: He lives in the present with no thought of tomorrow.
senses.definition: the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech
senses.definitionSentence: Present is the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项在此处指“现在”，即包括说话这一刻在内的当前时段。
senses.exampleZh: 他活在当下，不考虑明天。

senses.example: In time she presents her aristocratic husband with a coal-black child.
senses.definition: hand over formally
senses.definitionSentence: To present means to hand over formally.
senses.definitionZh: “提出”，即正式地递交或交付。
senses.exampleZh: 最终，她为她的贵族丈夫带来了一个煤黑色的孩子。

senses.example: Politics-ridden St. Clair county in Illinois presents another piece of the problem of metropolitan development.
senses.definition: introduce
senses.definitionSentence: To present means to introduce.
senses.definitionZh: “呈现、介绍”。
senses.exampleZh: 伊利诺伊州充满政治色彩的圣克莱尔县提出了大都市发展的另一个问题。

senses.example: Then O ' Banion was presented with a platinum watch set with rubies and diamonds.
senses.definition: give, especially as an honor or reward
senses.definitionSentence: To present means to give, especially as an honor or reward.
senses.definitionZh: “赠送”，尤指作为荣誉或奖励送给某人。
senses.exampleZh: 随后，O ' Banion 获赠镶有红宝石和钻石的铂金腕表。

senses.example: The murderer is present in this room.
senses.definition: being or existing in a specified place
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as present is being or existing in a specified place.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项在此处意为“出席的”，指身处某个指定地点。
senses.exampleZh: 凶手就在这个房间里。

senses.example: His tie was a present from his wife.
senses.definition: something presented as a gift
senses.definitionSentence: Present means something presented as a gift.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项在此处指“礼物”，即赠送给别人的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 他的领带是他妻子送给他的礼物。

senses.example: He is presently our ambassador to the United Nations.
senses.definition: at this time or period; now
senses.definitionSentence: Presently means at this time or period; now.
senses.definitionZh: 此时​​或该时期；现在。
senses.exampleZh: 他目前是我们驻联合国大使。

senses.example: This period is represented by Beethoven.
senses.definition: be representative or typical for
senses.definitionSentence: To represent means to be representative or typical for.
senses.definitionZh: 具有代表性或典型性。
senses.exampleZh: 这一时期的代表人物是贝多芬。

senses.example: Frequent fog and mild winters represent the region's coastal climate.
senses.definition: be a characteristic example or expression of something
senses.definitionSentence: To represent something means to be a characteristic example or expression of it.
senses.definitionZh: 成为某事物的典型例子或表现。
senses.exampleZh: 多雾和冬季温和是该地区沿海气候的典型特征。

senses.example: If such person is deceased or is under a legal disability, payment shall be made to his legal representative:.
senses.definition: a person who represents others
senses.definitionSentence: Representative is a person who represents others.
senses.definitionZh: 代表他人的人。
senses.exampleZh: 如果该人已故或处于法律上无行为能力，则应向其法定代表人付款：。

senses.example: Tone analysis will continue to be difficult and unsatisfactory until a more representative selection of systems is familar to every practicing field linguist.
senses.definition: serving to represent or typify
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as representative is serving to represent or typify.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为代表性的事物用于代表或典型。
senses.exampleZh: 声调分析将继续是困难和不令人满意的，直到每个现场语言学家都熟悉更具代表性的系统选择。

senses.example: State representatives decided Thursday against taking a poll on what kind of taxes Texans would prefer to pay.
senses.definition: a member of the United States House of Representatives
senses.definitionSentence: Representative is a member of the United States House of Representatives.
senses.definitionZh: 美国众议院议员。
senses.exampleZh: 州代表周四决定不对德克萨斯人愿意缴纳何种税种进行民意调查。

senses.example: She resents being paid less than her co-workers.
senses.definition: feel bitter or indignant about
senses.definitionSentence: To resent means to feel bitter or indignant about.
senses.definitionZh: 感到痛苦或愤慨。
senses.exampleZh: 她对自己的工资低于同事感到不满。

senses.meaning: 参议院，拥有高级立法权的议会
senses.example: A similar resolution passed in the Senate by a vote of 29 - 5.
senses.definition: assembly possessing high legislative powers
senses.definitionSentence: Senate means assembly possessing high legislative powers.
senses.definitionZh: 拥有高度立法权的议会。
senses.exampleZh: 参议院以 29 票对 5 票通过了类似的决议。

senses.example: `` Senator '', said an interviewer, `` your constituents can n't understand from your speech last night just how you stand on the question ''.
senses.definition: a member of a senate
senses.definitionSentence: Senator is a member of a senate.
senses.definitionZh: 参议院的成员。
senses.exampleZh: “参议员”，一位采访者说，“你的选民无法从你昨晚的演讲中理解你在这个问题上的立场”。

senses.meaning: 地位较高的，资格较老的
senses.example: In 1927 his father's business collapsed, and, rather than go bankrupt, Mercer senior turned his firm over to a bank for liquidation.
senses.definition: older; higher in rank; longer in length of tenure or service
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as senior is older; higher in rank; longer in length of tenure or service.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为高级的东西是较旧的；级别较高；任期或服务期限更长。
senses.exampleZh: 1927 年，他父亲的企业倒闭了，老默瑟并没有破产，而是将他的公司交给了一家银行进行清算。

senses.example: Nerves in the skin provide the sensation through which we feel heat, pressure, and pain.
senses.definition: the faculty through which the external world is apprehended
senses.definitionSentence: Sensation is the faculty through which the external world is apprehended.
senses.definitionZh: 理解外部世界的能力。
senses.exampleZh: 皮肤中的神经提供我们感受热、压力和疼痛的感觉。

senses.example: The news caused a sensation.
senses.definition: a state of widespread public excitement and interest
senses.definitionSentence: Sensation is a state of widespread public excitement and interest.
senses.definitionZh: 公众普遍兴奋和感兴趣的一种状态。
senses.exampleZh: 这个消息引起了轰动。

senses.example: About that same time John Crosby's TV series on the popular arts proved again that giving jazz ample breathing space is one of the most sensible things a producer can do.
senses.definition: showing reason or sound judgment
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sensible is showing reason or sound judgment.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为明智的事物是表现出理由或合理的判断。
senses.exampleZh: 大约在同一时间，约翰·克罗斯比 (John Crosby) 的流行艺术电视连续剧再次证明，给予爵士乐充足的喘息空间是制作人能做的最明智的事情之一。

senses.example: A mimosa's leaves are sensitive to touch.
senses.definition: responsive to physical stimuli
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sensitive is responsive to physical stimuli.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为敏感的东西对物理刺激有反应。
senses.exampleZh: 含羞草的叶子对触摸很敏感。

senses.example: The sensitive detector can perceive radiation levels far too weak for ordinary instruments to register.
senses.definition: able to feel or perceive
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sensitive is able to feel or perceive.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为敏感的事物能够感觉或感知。
senses.exampleZh: 灵敏的探测器可以感知到的辐射水平对于普通仪器来说太弱而无法记录。

senses.example: He always spoke in grammatical sentences.
senses.definition: a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language
senses.definitionSentence: Sentence is a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language.
senses.definitionZh: 满足语言语法规则的一串单词。
senses.exampleZh: 他总是用符合语法的句子说话。

senses.example: In the eastern section of the state the newspapers ' reaction to Brown's trial and sentence were basically identical.
senses.definition: (criminal law) a final judgment of guilty in a criminal case and the punishment that is imposed
senses.definitionSentence: Sentence means (criminal law) a final judgment of guilty in a criminal case and the punishment that is imposed.
senses.definitionZh: （刑法）对刑事案件有罪的最终判决和所施加的处罚。
senses.exampleZh: 在该州东部，报纸对布朗审判和判决的反应基本相同。

senses.example: A couple of sobs escaped him, followed by a sentiment that revealed his emotional state.
senses.definition: tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion
senses.definitionSentence: Sentiment means tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion.
senses.definitionZh: 温柔、浪漫或怀旧的感觉或情感。
senses.exampleZh: 他抽泣了几声，接着是一种情绪，揭示了他的情绪状态。

senses.definition: a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location
senses.definitionSentence: A place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location.
senses.definitionZh: 相对于中心或参考位置确定的区域内的地点。
senses.example: Please park on the left side of the road, opposite the post office.
senses.exampleZh: 请把车停在道路左侧、邮局对面。

senses.example: The house was built on the side of a mountain.
senses.definition: an elevated geological formation
senses.definitionSentence: Side is an elevated geological formation.
senses.definitionZh: 一个高架地质构造。
senses.exampleZh: 房子建在山边。

senses.meaning: 争论中的一个方面，方面
senses.example: There are two sides to every question.
senses.definition: an opinion that is held in opposition to another in an argument or dispute
senses.definitionSentence: Side is an opinion that is held in opposition to another in an argument or dispute.
senses.definitionZh: 在争论或争议中反对另一方的观点。
senses.exampleZh: 每个问题都有两个方面。

senses.example: In an aside, the actor whispered his secret plan to the audience while the other characters remained unaware.
senses.definition: a line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage
senses.definitionSentence: Aside is a line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage.
senses.definitionZh: 演员对观众说的台词，但不适合舞台上的其他人。
senses.exampleZh: 在旁白中，演员向观众低声讲述了他的秘密计划，而其他角色却一无所知。

senses.definition: to or on one side, away from the main position
senses.definitionSentence: Aside means to or on one side, away from the main position.
senses.definitionZh: 移到或位于一旁，离开主要位置。
senses.example: She stepped aside to let the paramedics carry the stretcher through.
senses.exampleZh: 她走到一旁，让急救人员抬着担架通过。

senses.example: The rescue boat drew alongside the damaged yacht so the two vessels floated side by side.
senses.definition: side by side
senses.definitionSentence: Alongside means side by side.
senses.definitionZh: 并排。
senses.exampleZh: 救援船靠近受损游艇，因此两艘船并排漂浮。

senses.example: The new bicycle path runs alongside the river for ten kilometers.
senses.exampleZh: 新建的自行车道沿河延伸十公里。
senses.definitionSentence: Beside..., with.
senses.definitionZh: 旁边……，与。

senses.example: The nurse placed the medicine beside the patient's bed.
senses.exampleZh: 护士把药放在病床旁边。
senses.definitionSentence: Next to; at the side of.
senses.definitionZh: 旁边;在.的旁边。

senses.example: The course teaches grammar; besides, it includes weekly speaking practice.
senses.definition: in addition
senses.definitionSentence: Besides means in addition.
senses.definitionZh: 此外。
senses.exampleZh: 该课程教授语法；此外，它还包括每周的口语练习。

senses.example: Besides English, she speaks French and Japanese fluently.
senses.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还能流利地说法语和日语。
senses.definitionSentence: In addition, in addition to.
senses.definitionZh: 另外，此外。

senses.example: Consider the possibility of moving.
senses.definition: give careful consideration to
senses.definitionSentence: To consider means to give careful consideration to.
senses.definitionZh: 仔细考虑。
senses.exampleZh: 考虑搬家的可能性。

senses.example: Most critics consider the novel a major work of modern literature.
senses.definition: judge or regard; look upon; judge
senses.definitionSentence: To consider means to judge or regard; look upon; judge.
senses.definitionZh: 判断或认为；把……看作。
senses.exampleZh: 大多数评论家认为这部小说是现代文学的主要作品。

senses.example: Spent a considerable amount of time on the problem.
senses.definition: large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as considerable is large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“相当大”的事物在数量、数量、范围或程度上是大的或相对大的。
senses.exampleZh: 在这个问题上花费了大量的时间。

senses.meaning: 体贴的，顾及他人感受的
senses.example: Friends considerate enough to leave us alone.
senses.definition: showing concern for the rights and feelings of others
dictionaryCandidates: 考虑周到的， 体谅的
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as considerate is showing concern for the rights and feelings of others.
senses.definitionZh: 体贴是指关心他人的权利和感受。
senses.exampleZh: 朋友足够体贴，让我们独自一人。

senses.example: Location theorists have given these matters much consideration.
senses.definition: the process of giving careful thought to something
senses.definitionSentence: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something.
senses.definitionZh: 仔细思考某事的过程。
senses.exampleZh: 位置理论家对这些问题给予了很多考虑。

senses.meaning: 体谅，体贴，关切，考虑周到
senses.example: He showed no consideration for her feelings.
senses.definition: kind and considerate regard for others
senses.definitionSentence: Consideration means kind and considerate regard for others.
senses.definitionZh: 对他人友善和体贴的尊重。
senses.exampleZh: 他没有考虑她的感受。

senses.definition: within a building
senses.definitionSentence: Within a building.
senses.definitionZh: 在建筑物内。
senses.example: The rain became heavier, so everyone went inside and closed the doors.
senses.exampleZh: 雨越下越大，大家都进屋并关上了门。

senses.example: The historian's business is to penetrate to the inside of the actions with which he is dealing and reconstruct or rather rethink the thoughts which constituted them.
senses.definition: the region that is inside of something
senses.definitionSentence: Inside is the region that is inside of something.
senses.definitionZh: 某物内部的区域。
senses.exampleZh: 历史学家的职责是深入他正在处理的行为的内部，并重建或更确切地说重新思考构成这些行为的思想。

senses.example: The confidential documents are locked inside the steel safe.
senses.exampleZh: 机密文件锁在钢制保险柜里。
senses.definitionSentence: Inside means within the boundaries or interior of a place or object.
senses.definitionZh: 在某个地方或物体的边界以内。
senses.definition: within the boundaries or interior of a place or object
outside a building
senses.definitionSentence: Outside a building.
senses.definitionZh: 建筑物外。
senses.example: The children played outside in the garden while their parents prepared dinner indoors.
senses.exampleZh: 孩子们在外面的花园里玩耍，而父母则在室内准备晚餐。

senses.example: This stain often disrupts the normal cell activity or else colors only the outside.
senses.definition: the outer side or surface of something
senses.definitionSentence: Outside is the outer side or surface of something.
senses.definitionZh: 某物的外侧或表面。

senses.example: Reporters waited outside the courthouse for the verdict.
senses.exampleZh: 记者在法院外等待判决结果。
senses.definitionSentence: Outside, beyond the range of.
senses.definitionZh: 外面，超出范围。

senses.example: The chief justice will preside over the hearing, maintain order, and rule on questions of law.
senses.definition: act as president
senses.definitionSentence: To preside means to act as president.
senses.definitionZh: 担任主席。
senses.exampleZh: 首席法官将主持听证会、维持秩序并对法律问题作出裁决。

senses.example: For a time the President received hundreds of them every day, most of them worthless.
senses.definition: the chief executive of a republic
senses.definitionSentence: President is the chief executive of a republic.
senses.definitionZh: 共和国的最高行政长官。
senses.exampleZh: 有一段时间，总统每天都会收到数百封邮件，其中大多数毫无价值。

senses.example: The first speaker was Amos C. Barstow who had been unanimously chosen president of the meeting.
senses.definition: the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization
senses.definitionSentence: President is the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization.
senses.definitionZh: 主持组织会议的官员。
senses.exampleZh: 第一位发言者是 Amos C. Barstow，他被一致推选为会议主席。

senses.example: He wanted to achieve power and prestige.
senses.definition: a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.
senses.definitionSentence: Prestige is a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.
senses.definitionZh: 通过成功、影响力或财富等获得的崇高地位。
senses.exampleZh: 他想要获得权力和威望。

senses.example: A person can have several residences.
senses.definition: any address at which you dwell more than temporarily
senses.definitionSentence: Residence means any address at which you dwell more than temporarily.
senses.definitionZh: 您超过临时居住的任何地址。
senses.exampleZh: 一个人可以拥有多个住所。

senses.example: Nearly 18 per cent of West Berlin's 2200000 residents are sixty-five or older, only 12.8 per cent are under fifteen.
senses.definition: someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
senses.definitionSentence: Resident means someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there.
senses.definitionZh: 在特定地点长期居住或出生于该地点的人。
senses.exampleZh: 西柏林 2200000 名居民中，近 18% 年龄在 65 岁或以上，只有 12.8% 年龄在 15 岁以下。

senses.example: Under unusual circumstances a resident individual may be granted an extension of time to file a return.
senses.definition: living in a particular place
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as resident is living in a particular place.
senses.definitionZh: 居民被描述为居住在特定的地方。
senses.exampleZh: 在特殊情况下，居民个人可以获准延长提交申报表的时间。

senses.example: Families spent the summer at the seaside, swimming in the ocean and walking along the beach.
senses.definition: the shore of a sea or ocean regarded as a resort
senses.definitionSentence: Seaside is the shore of a sea or ocean regarded as a resort.
senses.definitionZh: 被视为度假胜地的大海或海洋的海岸。
senses.exampleZh: 一家人在海边度过了夏天，在海里游泳，沿着海滩散步。

senses.example: The crab made a sideways movement across the sand instead of walking straight ahead.
senses.definition: (of movement) at an angle
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sideways is (of movement) at an angle.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为侧面的东西是（运动的）成一定角度。
senses.exampleZh: 螃蟹在沙子上横向移动，而不是笔直向前行走。

senses.example: The car slipped sideways into the ditch.
senses.definition: toward one side
senses.definitionSentence: Sideways means toward one side.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项 表示朝向一侧。
senses.exampleZh: 汽车侧滑进沟里。

senses.example: A subsidy for research in artificial intelligence.
senses.definition: a grant paid by a government to an enterprise that benefits the public
senses.definitionSentence: Subsidy is a grant paid by a government to an enterprise that benefits the public.
senses.definitionZh: 政府向造福公众的企业提供的补助。
senses.exampleZh: 人工智能研究补贴。

senses.example: Or have a sign on his car that says, ' Here Comes the Paxton Kidnapper '' '?
senses.definition: structure displaying a board on which advertisements can be posted
senses.definitionSentence: Sign means structure displaying a board on which advertisements can be posted.
senses.definitionZh: 显示可张贴广告的板的结构。
senses.exampleZh: 或者他的车上有一个标牌，上面写着“帕克斯顿绑架者来了”？

senses.example: He showed signs of strain.
senses.definition: a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)
senses.definitionSentence: Sign is a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened).
senses.definitionZh: 一种可感知的指示，表明某些事情并不立即明显（作为某事发生的可见线索）。
senses.exampleZh: 他表现出紧张的迹象。

senses.example: The interpreter made the sign for "hospital" with her hands so the deaf patient understood the destination.
senses.definition: a gesture that is part of a sign language
senses.definitionSentence: Sign is a gesture that is part of a sign language.
senses.definitionZh: 一种手势，是手语的一部分。
senses.exampleZh: 手语翻译用双手打出“医院”的手势，让失聪患者明白目的地。

senses.example: She signed the letter and sent it off.
senses.definition: mark with one's signature; write one's name (on)
senses.definitionSentence: To sign means to mark with one's signature; write one's name (on).
senses.definitionZh: 用自己的签名进行标记； (在)上写上一个人的名字。
senses.exampleZh: 她签署了这封信并将其寄出。

senses.example: We were assigned new uniforms.
senses.definition: give out
senses.definitionSentence: To assign means to give out.
senses.definitionZh: 给予。
senses.exampleZh: 我们被分配了新制服。

senses.example: Assign a series of catechism questions to be memorized.
senses.definition: give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)
senses.definitionSentence: To assign means to give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person).
senses.definitionZh: 将某个职位分配给（一个人），或者给（一个人）分配一个任务。
senses.exampleZh: 分配一系列要记忆的教义问答题。

senses.example: Can your plant nurse be replaced by a trained first-aid man who works full-time on some other assignment?
senses.definition: a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)
senses.definitionSentence: Assignment is a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces).
senses.definitionZh: 您被指派执行的职责（尤其是在武装部队中）。
senses.exampleZh: 您的工厂护士可以由经过培训、全职从事其他任务的急救人员代替吗？

senses.example: Completed and opened for traffic in 1852, the bridge was designed and built by Lemuel Chenoweth and his brother, Eli, of Beverly.
senses.definition: make a design of; plan out in systematic, often graphic form
senses.definitionSentence: To design means to make a design of; plan out in systematic, often graphic form.
senses.definitionZh: 进行设计；以系统的、通常是图形形式进行计划。
senses.exampleZh: 该桥于 1852 年竣工并通车，由来自贝弗利的 Lemuel Chenoweth 和他的兄弟 Eli 设计和建造。

senses.example: The awkward design of the keyboard made operation difficult.
senses.definition: an arrangement scheme
senses.definitionSentence: Design is an arrangement scheme.
senses.definitionZh: 一种排列方案。
senses.exampleZh: 键盘的笨拙设计使操作变得困难。

senses.example: The coach had a design on the doors.
senses.definition: a decorative or artistic work
senses.definitionSentence: Design is a decorative or artistic work.
senses.definitionZh: 一种装饰或艺术作品。
senses.exampleZh: 这辆客车的车门上有一个装饰图案。

senses.example: A red arrow designates the emergency exit on the map.
senses.definition: indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
senses.definitionSentence: To designate means to indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively.
senses.definitionZh: 指示地点、方向、人或事物；无论是空间上还是形象上。
senses.exampleZh: 红色箭头表示地图上的紧急出口。

senses.example: The major part of this collection is in the central headquarters building, and the remainder is divided among five libraries in the system designated as subject centers.
senses.definition: give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)
senses.definitionSentence: To designate means to give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person).
senses.definitionZh: 将某个职位分配给（人），或者将任务分配给（人）。
senses.exampleZh: 该馆藏的主要部分位于中央总部大楼，其余部分分布在系统中指定为学科中心的五个图书馆中。

senses.example: The chairman resigned when he was found to have misappropriated funds.
senses.definition: leave (a job, post, or position) voluntarily
senses.definitionSentence: To resign means to leave (a job, post, or position) voluntarily.
senses.definitionZh: 自愿离开（工作、岗位或职位）。
senses.exampleZh: 董事长因被发现挪用资金而辞职。

senses.example: Resign a claim to the throne.
senses.definition: part with a possession or right
senses.definitionSentence: To resign means to part with a possession or right.
senses.definitionZh: 放弃占有或权利。
senses.exampleZh: 放弃对王位的要求。

senses.example: Signals from the boat suddenly stopped.
senses.definition: any nonverbal action or gesture that encodes a message
senses.definitionSentence: Signal means any nonverbal action or gesture that encodes a message.
senses.definitionZh: 编码消息的任何非语言动作或手势。
senses.exampleZh: 船上的信号突然停止了。

senses.example: In the Blue Ridge meeting, the audience was warned that entering a candidate for governor would force it to take petitions out into voting precincts to obtain the signatures of registered voters.
senses.definition: your name written in your own handwriting
senses.definitionSentence: Signature means your name written in your own handwriting.
senses.definitionZh: 您亲笔书写的姓名。
senses.exampleZh: 在蓝岭会议上，观众被警告说，输入州长候选人将迫使其将请愿书带到投票区以获得登记选民的签名。

senses.example: This rate of increase does not signify anything in itself.
senses.definition: denote or connote
senses.definitionSentence: To signify means to denote or connote.
senses.definitionZh: 表示或暗示。
senses.exampleZh: 这个增长率本身并不意味着什么。

senses.example: The hospital has used the money to assist in alterations on the fifth floor of the Jane Brown Hospital, part of Rhode Island Hospital.
senses.definition: give help or assistance; be of service
senses.definitionSentence: To assist means to give help or assistance; be of service.
senses.definitionZh: 给予帮助或协助；提供服务。
senses.exampleZh: 医院已使用这笔资金协助改建简·布朗医院（罗德岛医院的一部分）的五楼。

senses.example: He gave me an assist with the housework.
senses.definition: the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
senses.definitionSentence: Assist is the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 为满足需求或促进努力或目的做出贡献的活动。
senses.exampleZh: 他协助我做家务。

senses.example: The midfielder earned an assist by passing the ball to the striker who scored the goal.
senses.definition: (sports) the act of enabling another player to make a good play
senses.definitionSentence: Assist means (sports) the act of enabling another player to make a good play.
senses.definitionZh: （体育）使另一名球员能够打出精彩比赛的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 中场球员将球传给进球的前锋，从而获得助攻。

senses.example: After the injury, she could not walk without assistance from crutches and a physical therapist.
senses.definition: the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
senses.definitionSentence: Assistance is the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 为满足需求或促进努力或目的做出贡献的活动。
senses.exampleZh: 受伤后，如果没有拐杖和物理治疗师的帮助，她无法行走。

senses.example: He was there one season before rejoining the Steelers as an assistant coach.
senses.definition: of or relating to a person who is subordinate to another
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as assistant is of or relating to a person who is subordinate to another.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为助手的事物是属于另一个人的下属或与之相关。
senses.exampleZh: 他在那里待了一个赛季，然后以助理教练的身份重新加入钢人队。

senses.example: Orvis even needed to hire an assistant, Clark J. Wait.
senses.definition: a person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
senses.definitionSentence: Assistant is a person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 为满足需求或促进努力或目的做出贡献的人。
senses.exampleZh: Orvis 甚至需要聘请一名助手 Clark J. Wait。

senses.example: The value of the method consists in its simplicity and reliability.
senses.definition: have a particular quality or idea as the essential feature
senses.definitionSentence: To consist in something means to have it as the essential feature.
senses.definitionZh: 以某种性质或观念为本质特征；在于。
senses.exampleZh: 这种方法的价值在于它简单而可靠。

senses.example: What does this dish consist of?
senses.definition: be composed of
senses.definitionSentence: To consist means to be composed of.
senses.definitionZh: 由...组成。
senses.exampleZh: 这道菜由什么组成？

senses.example: Desires are to be satisfied only so far as consists with an approved end.
senses.definition: be consistent in form, tenor, or character; be congruous
senses.definitionSentence: To consist means to be consistent in form, tenor, or character; be congruous.
senses.definitionZh: 在形式、主旨或特征上一致；保持一致。
senses.exampleZh: 只有在获得批准的结果的情况下才能满足愿望。

senses.example: "I have decided that the course of conduct which I am following is consistent with my sense of responsibility as president in time of war"- FDR.
senses.definition: (sometimes followed by `with') in agreement or consistent or reliable
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as consistent is (sometimes followed by `with') in agreement or consistent or reliable.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为一致的事物是一致的、一致的或可靠的（有时后跟“与”）。
senses.exampleZh: “我决定我所遵循的行为方针符合我作为战时总统的责任感”——罗斯福。

senses.example: Berger insisted that `` we know enough to sue for the full amount ''.
senses.definition: be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge
senses.definitionSentence: To insist means to be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge.
senses.definitionZh: 强调或坚决并且拒绝让步。
senses.exampleZh: 伯杰坚持认为“我们知道的足够多，可以起诉全额”。

senses.example: Belief in the traditional way of life persists much more in the older states than in the new ones.
senses.definition: continue to exist
senses.definitionSentence: To persist means to continue to exist.
senses.definitionZh: 继续存在。
senses.exampleZh: 对传统生活方式的信仰在旧州比在新州更持久。

senses.example: He persisted to call me every night.
senses.definition: be persistent, refuse to stop
senses.definitionSentence: To persist means to be persistent, refuse to stop.
senses.definitionZh: 坚持，拒绝停止。
senses.exampleZh: 他坚持每天晚上给我打电话。

senses.example: The reinforced door resisted the force of the flood and remained shut.
senses.definition: oppose or withstand the force or effect of someone or something
senses.definitionSentence: To resist means to oppose or withstand the force or effect of someone or something.
senses.definitionZh: 抵抗或顶住某人、某物的力量或作用。
senses.exampleZh: 加固后的门顶住了洪水的冲击，仍然紧闭。

senses.meaning: 不同意，反对，对抗，抗议，抵制，抵抗
senses.example: The miserable people of China, the largest cast ever conscripted to enact an ideological passion play, cannot themselves resist overtly.
senses.definition: express opposition through action or words
senses.definitionSentence: To resist means to express opposition through action or words.
senses.definitionZh: 通过行动或言语表达反对。
senses.exampleZh: 悲惨的中国人民，有史以来规模最大的演员阵容，被征召上演一场意识形态激情剧，但他们自己却无法公开反抗。

senses.example: He encountered a general feeling of resistance from many citizens.
senses.definition: the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with
senses.definitionSentence: Resistance is the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with.
senses.definitionZh: 反对您不赞成或不同意的事物的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 他遇到了许多公民的普遍抵制情绪。

senses.example: Plastic highly resistant to steam and water.
senses.definition: incapable of absorbing or mixing with
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as resistant is incapable of absorbing or mixing with.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为抗性的东西是无法吸收或混合的。
senses.exampleZh: 塑料高度耐蒸汽和水。

senses.example: My sister married a musician.
senses.definition: a female person who has the same parents as another person
senses.definitionSentence: Sister is a female person who has the same parents as another person.
senses.definitionZh: 与另一个人有相同父母的女性。
senses.exampleZh: 我姐姐嫁给了一位音乐家。

senses.example: This original capsule contained a battery and a transistor oscillator and was about 1 cm. in diameter.
senses.definition: a semiconductor device capable of amplification
senses.definitionSentence: Transistor is a semiconductor device capable of amplification.
senses.definitionZh: 一种能够放大的半导体器件。
senses.exampleZh: 这个原始胶囊包含电池和晶体管振荡器，长约 1 厘米。直径。

senses.example: A vast system of production and distribution and consumption keep the country going.
senses.definition: a group of independent but interrelated elements comprising a unified whole
senses.definitionSentence: System is a group of independent but interrelated elements comprising a unified whole.
senses.definitionZh: 一组独立但又相互关联的元素，组成一个统一的整体。
senses.exampleZh: 庞大的生产、分配和消费体系维持着国家的运转。

senses.example: The investigation was very systematic.
senses.definition: characterized by order and planning
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as systematic is characterized by order and planning.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为系统性的事物的特征是秩序和计划。
senses.exampleZh: 调查非常系统。
