senses.example: The museum uses a systematic classification to group insects by order, family, genus, and species.
senses.definition: of or relating to taxonomy
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as systematic is of or relating to taxonomy.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为系统的东西属于分类学或与分类学相关。
senses.exampleZh: 博物馆采用系统分类法，按目、科、属和种对昆虫进行分组。

senses.example: This help is offered to applicants who ordinarily would not undertake the exploration under present conditions or circumstances at their sole expense and who are unable to obtain funds from commercial sources on reasonable terms.
senses.definition: not divided or shared with others
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sole is not divided or shared with others.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为唯一的东西不与他人分割或共享。
senses.exampleZh: 此帮助是为那些通常不会在目前条件或情况下自费进行勘探以及无法以合理条款从商业来源获得资金的申请人提供的。

senses.example: The chef grilled a fresh sole, the flatfish caught that morning in coastal waters.
senses.definition: right-eyed flatfish; many are valued as food; most common in warm seas especially European
senses.definitionSentence: Sole means right-eyed flatfish; many are valued as food; most common in warm seas especially European.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项 指右眼比目鱼；许多被视为食物；最常见于温暖的海洋，尤其是欧洲。
senses.exampleZh: 厨师烤了一条新鲜的鲽鱼，即早上在沿海水域捕获的比目鱼。

senses.example: She was the sole survivor, the only person rescued from the wreck.
senses.definition: being the only one; single and isolated from others
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sole is being the only one; single and isolated from others.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓唯一的东西是唯一的；单身且与他人隔绝。
senses.exampleZh: 她是唯一的幸存者，也是唯一从沉船中获救的人。

senses.example: Fax machines became largely obsolete after email and secure file sharing replaced them.
senses.definition: no longer in use
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as obsolete is no longer in use.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为过时的东西不再使用。
senses.exampleZh: 在电子邮件和安全文件共享取代传真机后，传真机基本上已过时。

senses.example: The resolute defenders refused every demand to surrender and held their position despite the attack.
senses.definition: firm in purpose or belief; characterized by firmness and determination
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as resolute is firm in purpose or belief; characterized by firmness and determination.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为坚决的东西是坚定的目的或信念；其特点是坚定和决心。
senses.exampleZh: 坚决的守军拒绝了所有投降要求，尽管遭到攻击，仍坚守阵地。

senses.example: They never did achieve a final resolution of their differences.
senses.definition: something settled or resolved; the outcome of decision making
senses.definitionSentence: Resolution means something settled or resolved; the outcome of decision making.
senses.definitionZh: 解决或解决的事情；决策的结果。
senses.exampleZh: 他们从未最终解决分歧。

senses.definition: the trait of being resolute
senses.definitionSentence: Resolution means the trait of being resolute.
senses.definitionZh: 意志坚定这一品质。
senses.example: The climber's resolution remained firm when bad weather delayed the expedition.
senses.exampleZh: 恶劣天气耽误了探险行程，但这名登山者的决心依然坚定。

senses.example: Even on the fictional level, however, the contradictions which give rise to the mystery story are not fully resolved.
senses.definition: understand the meaning of
senses.definitionSentence: To resolve means to understand the meaning of.
senses.definitionZh: 理解的含义。
senses.exampleZh: 然而，即使在虚构的层面上，引起神秘故事的矛盾也没有完全解决。

senses.example: Solar activities could presumably bring long periods of flood or drought.
senses.definition: relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solar is relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为太阳能的东西与太阳有关或源自太阳或利用太阳的能量。
senses.exampleZh: 太阳活动可能会带来长期的洪水或干旱。

senses.example: The soldiers stood at attention.
senses.definition: an enlisted man or woman who serves in an army
senses.definitionSentence: Soldier is an enlisted man or woman who serves in an army.
senses.definitionZh: 在军队服役的士兵。
senses.exampleZh: 士兵们立正。

senses.example: The judge was solemn as he pronounced sentence.
senses.definition: dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solemn is dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓庄严的事物是指在态度或性格上庄重而严肃，并致力于遵守诺言。
senses.exampleZh: 法官宣判时表情严肃。

senses.example: A film with a solemn social message.
senses.definition: characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solemn is characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为庄严的事物的特点是对你的观点的有效性有坚定而无幽默感的信念。
senses.exampleZh: 一部带有庄严社会信息的电影。

senses.example: Ice is water in the solid state.
senses.definition: of definite shape and volume; firm; neither liquid nor gaseous
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solid is of definite shape and volume; firm; neither liquid nor gaseous.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为固体的东西具有确定的形状和体积；公司;既不是液体也不是气体。
senses.exampleZh: 冰是固态的水。

senses.example: A very fine, gray solid (about 15 g) is formed, water-washed by centrifugation, and dried at 110 ` C.
senses.definition: matter that is solid at room temperature and pressure
senses.definitionSentence: Solid means matter that is solid at room temperature and pressure.
senses.definitionZh: 在室温和压力下为固体的物质。
senses.exampleZh: 形成非常细的灰色固体（约15克），通过离心水洗，并在110`C下干燥。

senses.example: The committee stood solid behind the proposal, with every member voting as one united group.
senses.definition: acting together as a single undiversified whole
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solid is acting together as a single undiversified whole.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为固体的东西作为一个单一的、单一的整体共同作用。
senses.exampleZh: 委员会坚决支持该提案，每位成员都作为一个团结的团体进行投票。

senses.example: The geometry model is a solid with length, width, and height rather than a flat shape.
senses.definition: a three-dimensional shape
senses.definitionSentence: Solid is a three-dimensional shape.
senses.definitionZh: 三维形状。
senses.exampleZh: 几何模型是具有长度、宽度和高度的实体，而不是平面形状。

senses.definition: strong, firm, and unlikely to break or give way
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solid is strong, firm, and unlikely to break or give way.
senses.definitionZh: 结实牢固，不容易破裂或倒塌。
senses.example: The carpenter checked that the repaired staircase was solid before allowing anyone to use it.
senses.exampleZh: 木匠确认修好的楼梯牢固后，才允许人们使用。

senses.example: One of these is the solidarity and the confidential relationship of marriage.
senses.definition: a union of interests or purposes or sympathies among members of a group
senses.definitionSentence: Solidarity is a union of interests or purposes or sympathies among members of a group.
senses.definitionZh: 群体成员之间利益、目的或同情的联合。
senses.exampleZh: 其中之一是婚姻的团结和保密关系。

senses.example: A man of a solitary disposition.
senses.definition: characterized by or preferring solitude
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solitary is characterized by or preferring solitude.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为孤独的事物的特征是孤独或喜欢孤独。
senses.exampleZh: 性格孤独的人。

senses.example: Investigators found a solitary instance of fraud among thousands of otherwise accurate transactions.
senses.definition: being the only one; single and isolated from others
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solitary is being the only one; single and isolated from others.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为孤独的事物是唯一的；单身且与他人隔绝。
senses.exampleZh: 调查人员在数千笔原本准确的交易中发现了一起欺诈事件。

senses.example: A solitary traveler crossed the desert without any companion.
senses.definition: lacking companions or companionship
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solitary is lacking companions or companionship.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为孤独的事物缺乏同伴或陪伴。
senses.exampleZh: 一个孤独的旅行者在没有任何同伴的情况下穿越沙漠。

senses.example: Her first solo came after months of supervised flight training.
senses.definition: any activity that is performed alone without assistance
senses.definitionSentence: Solo means any activity that is performed alone without assistance.
senses.definitionZh: 在没有帮助的情况下单独进行的任何活动。
senses.exampleZh: 经过数月的带飞训练，她完成了第一次单独飞行。

senses.example: The concerto opens with a solo clarinet passage before the rest of the orchestra joins.
senses.definition: composed or performed by a single voice or instrument
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as solo is composed or performed by a single voice or instrument.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为独奏的东西是由单个声音或乐器创作或演奏的。
senses.exampleZh: 协奏曲以单簧管独奏段落开始，然后管弦乐队的其他成员加入。

senses.definition: without companions or assistance
senses.definitionSentence: Solo means without companions or assistance.
senses.definitionZh: 没有同伴或协助，独自进行。
senses.example: He completed the final stage solo after his teammate withdrew with an injury.
senses.exampleZh: 队友因伤退出后，他独自完成了最后一个赛段。

senses.example: The first attempts to isolate TSH came a decade later, when Janssen and Loeser (1931) used trichloroacetic acid to separate the soluble TSH from insoluble impurities.
senses.definition: (of a substance) capable of being dissolved in some solvent (usually water)
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as soluble is (of a substance) capable of being dissolved in some solvent (usually water).
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为可溶的东西是指（物质的）能够溶解在某种溶剂（通常是水）中。
senses.exampleZh: 十年后，首次尝试分离 TSH，Janssen 和 Loeser (1931) 使用三氯乙酸将可溶性 TSH 与不溶性杂质分离。

senses.example: The solution took three hours.
senses.definition: the successful action of solving a problem
senses.definitionSentence: Solution is the successful action of solving a problem.
senses.definitionZh: 成功解决问题的过程或行动。
senses.exampleZh: 解决这个问题花了三个小时。

senses.example: He used a solution of peroxide and water.
senses.definition: a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution
senses.definitionSentence: Solution is a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution.
senses.definitionZh: 两种或多种物质的均匀混合物；通常（但不一定）是液体溶液。
senses.exampleZh: 他使用了过氧化物和水的溶液。

senses.definition: a method or plan for solving a problem
senses.definitionSentence: A solution is a method or plan for solving a problem.
senses.definitionZh: 解决某个问题的方法或方案。
senses.example: The engineers proposed a low-cost solution to the drainage problem.
senses.exampleZh: 工程师们针对排水问题提出了一个低成本解决方案。

senses.example: Did you solve the problem?
senses.definition: find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of
senses.definitionSentence: To solve means to find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of.
senses.definitionZh: 找到（问题或问题）的解决方案或理解其含义。
senses.exampleZh: 你解决问题了吗？

senses.example: Indeed their achievement scores were somewhat better on an absolute basis although the difference was not significant.
senses.definition: perfect or complete or pure
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as absolute is perfect or complete or pure.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为绝对的事物是完美的、完整的或纯粹的。
senses.exampleZh: 事实上，他们的成绩分数在绝对基础上要好一些，尽管差异并不显着。

senses.example: However, the sovereign was not Hobbes ' absolute monarch but rather the parliamentary sovereign of Austin.
senses.definition: not limited by law
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as absolute is not limited by law.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为绝对的事物不受法律限制。
senses.exampleZh: 然而，主权并不是霍布斯的绝对君主，而是奥斯汀的议会主权。

senses.example: No mortal being can influence the absolute.
senses.definition: something that is conceived or that exists independently and not in relation to other things; something that does not depend on anything else and is beyond human control; something that is not relative
senses.definitionSentence: Absolute means something that is conceived or that exists independently and not in relation to other things; something that does not depend on anything else and is beyond human control; something that is not relative.
senses.definitionZh: 某种被设想或独立存在且与其他事物无关的事物；不依赖于任何其他事物并且超出人类控制范围的东西；一些不相​​关的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 凡人无法影响绝对。

senses.example: Friends consoled the grieving father with quiet company, warm meals, and reminders that he was not alone.
senses.definition: give moral or emotional strength to
senses.definitionSentence: To console means to give moral or emotional strength to.
senses.definitionZh: 给予道德或情感力量。
senses.exampleZh: 朋友们用安静的陪伴、热腾腾的饭菜来安慰悲伤的父亲，并提醒他并不孤单。

senses.example: From the control console, the operator watched the displays and adjusted the reactor's temperature.
senses.definition: a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system)
senses.definitionSentence: Console is a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system).
senses.definitionZh: 一种由显示器和输入设备组成的科学仪器，操作员可以使用它来监视和控制系统（尤其是计算机系统）。
senses.exampleZh: 操作员通过控制台观看显示屏并调节反应器的温度。

senses.example: Consolidate one's hold on first place.
senses.definition: make firm or secure; strengthen
senses.definitionSentence: To consolidate means to make firm or secure; strengthen.
senses.definitionZh: 使坚固或安全；加强。
senses.exampleZh: 巩固第一名的地位。

senses.example: Years of war desolated the region, destroying villages, farms, and roads.
senses.definition: cause extensive destruction or ruin utterly
senses.definitionSentence: To desolate means to cause extensive destruction or ruin utterly.
senses.definitionZh: 造成广泛的破坏或彻底毁坏。
senses.exampleZh: 多年的战争使该地区变得荒凉，摧毁了村庄、农场和道路。

senses.example: The giant iceberg dissolved over the years during the global warming phase.
senses.definition: become or cause to become soft or liquid
senses.definitionSentence: To dissolve means to become or cause to become soft or liquid.
senses.definitionZh: 变得或导致变得柔软或液体。
senses.exampleZh: 在全球变暖阶段，这座巨大的冰山多年来不断融化。

senses.example: The political wing of the party dissolved after much internal fighting.
senses.definition: stop functioning or cohering as a unit
senses.definitionSentence: To dissolve means to stop functioning or cohering as a unit.
senses.definitionZh: 停止作为一个整体发挥作用或凝聚。
senses.exampleZh: 该党的政治派系在多次内部斗争后解散。

senses.example: The music arrived, taking him, its rhythm stroked him, snaked all through him, the lyrics lifted him, took him from one magic isle to another, stopping briefly at each.
senses.definition: a small island
senses.definitionSentence: Isle is a small island.
senses.definitionZh: 一个小岛。
senses.exampleZh: 音乐到来，带着他，它的节奏抚摸着他，蜿蜒穿过他，歌词提升了他，带他从一个魔法岛到另一个魔法岛，在每个魔法岛短暂停留。

senses.example: Doctors isolated the infected patient in a separate ward to prevent the virus from spreading.
senses.definition: set apart from others
senses.definitionSentence: To isolate means to set apart from others.
senses.definitionZh: 与他人分开。
senses.exampleZh: 医生把感染者隔离在单独的病房，以防病毒传播。

senses.example: All through July the Discovery picked her way along the 450 - mile long strait, avoiding ice and rocky islands.
senses.definition: a land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water
senses.definitionSentence: Island is a land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water.
senses.definitionZh: 被水包围的陆地（小于大陆）。
senses.exampleZh: 整个七月，发现号都沿着 450 英里长的海峡行驶，避开了冰层和岩石岛屿。

senses.example: They had to consult before arriving at a decision.
senses.definition: get or ask advice from
senses.definitionSentence: To consult means to get or ask advice from.
senses.definitionZh: 获得或询问建议。
senses.exampleZh: 他们必须在做出决定之前进行协商。

senses.example: SAAMI's field men have served as consultants and / or have participated in 75 Teen Hunter Club activities which have reached over 40000 enthusiastic young Americans.
senses.definition: an expert who gives advice
senses.definitionSentence: Consultant is an expert who gives advice.
senses.definitionZh: 提供建议的专家。
senses.exampleZh: SAAMI 的现场工作人员曾担任顾问和/或参加过 75 项青少年猎人俱乐部活动，这些活动覆盖了超过 40000 名热情的美国年轻人。

senses.example: We had his bedroom insulated before winter came.
senses.definition: protect from heat, cold, or noise by surrounding with insulating material
senses.definitionSentence: To insulate means to protect from heat, cold, or noise by surrounding with insulating material.
senses.definitionZh: 通过用绝缘材料包围来防止热、冷或噪音。
senses.exampleZh: 我们在冬天到来之前对他的卧室进行了隔热处理。

senses.example: They yelled insults at the visiting team.
senses.definition: a rude expression intended to offend or hurt
senses.definitionSentence: Insult is a rude expression intended to offend or hurt.
senses.definitionZh: 一种旨在冒犯或伤害的粗鲁表达。
senses.exampleZh: 他们对客队大声辱骂。
senses.audioAttribution: Self, recorded using the program Shtooka .

senses.definition: speak or behave toward someone in a rude and offensive way
senses.definitionSentence: To insult someone means to speak or behave toward that person in a rude and offensive way.
senses.definitionZh: 以粗鲁、冒犯的言行对待某人。
senses.example: The angry guest insulted the waiter with a personal remark, and the manager asked him to leave.
senses.exampleZh: 愤怒的客人用针对个人的言语侮辱服务员，经理随后请他离开。

senses.example: The result is a color picture of the specimen where the primary colors correspond to the three different ultraviolet wavelengths.
senses.definition: a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
senses.definitionSentence: Result is a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon.
senses.definitionZh: 随后出现的现象，并且是由某些先前现象引起的。
senses.exampleZh: 结果是样本的彩色图片，其中原色对应于三种不同的紫外线波长。

senses.example: This resulted in a great number of errors.
senses.definition: issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end
senses.definitionSentence: To result means to issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end.
senses.definitionZh: 后果，导致，结果是。
senses.exampleZh: 这导致了大量错误。

senses.meaning: 作为结果而产生的，随之发生的
senses.example: The resultant savings were considerable.
senses.definition: following or accompanying as a consequence
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as resultant is following or accompanying as a consequence.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为结果的事物是作为结果而跟随或伴随的。
senses.exampleZh: 由此产生的节省是相当可观的。

senses.example: Two facets of this aspect of the literary process have special significance for our time.
senses.definition: a distinct feature or element in a problem
senses.definitionSentence: Aspect is a distinct feature or element in a problem.
senses.definitionZh: 问题中的独特特征或元素。
senses.exampleZh: 文学过程的这方面的两个方面对我们这个时代具有特殊的意义。

senses.example: The verb form 'has finished' expresses perfect aspect because the action is already complete.
senses.definition: the beginning or duration or completion or repetition of the action of a verb
senses.definitionSentence: Aspect is the beginning or duration or completion or repetition of the action of a verb.
senses.definitionZh: 动词动作的开始、持续时间、完成或重复。
senses.exampleZh: 动词形式“已经完成”表达完成体，因为动作已经完成。

senses.example: The meteorologists are expecting rain for tomorrow.
senses.definition: regard something as probable or likely
senses.definitionSentence: To expect means to regard something as probable or likely.
senses.definitionZh: 认为某事是可能的或可能的。
senses.exampleZh: 气象学家预计明天会下雨。

senses.example: During the next five years the leaders of the Fair Deal reluctantly backed down from the optimistic expectations of the New Deal.
senses.definition: belief about (or mental picture of) the future
senses.definitionSentence: Expectation means belief about (or mental picture of) the future.
senses.definitionZh: 对未来的信念（或心理想象）。
senses.exampleZh: 在接下来的五年里，公平协议的领导人不情愿地放弃了新政的乐观预期。

senses.example: Contrary to these expectations we have found it impossible to obtain the degree of reproducibility one would wish, even with extensive efforts to prepare especially pure reagents.
senses.definition: anticipating with confidence of fulfillment
senses.definitionSentence: Expectation means anticipating with confidence of fulfillment.
senses.definitionZh: 满怀信心地期待实现。
senses.exampleZh: 与这些期望相反，我们发现即使付出大量努力来制备特别纯的试剂，也无法获得人们所希望的重现性程度。

senses.example: Please inspect your father's will carefully.
senses.definition: look over carefully
senses.definitionSentence: To inspect means to look over carefully.
senses.definitionZh: 仔细检查。
senses.exampleZh: 请仔细检查你父亲的遗嘱。

senses.example: The rule applies to everyone irrespective of age or income.
senses.exampleZh: 这项规定适用于所有人，不论年龄或收入。
senses.definitionSentence: Regardless, do not consider (used with of).
senses.definitionZh: 表示不受某项因素影响或不考虑该因素，通常与介词连用。

senses.example: But in looking at Faulkner against his background in Mississippi and the South, it is important not to lose the broader perspective.
senses.definition: a way of regarding situations or topics etc.
senses.definitionSentence: Perspective is a way of regarding situations or topics etc.
senses.definitionZh: 一种看待情况或主题等的方式。
senses.exampleZh: 但是，在审视福克纳在密西西比州和南方的背景时，重要的是不要失去更广阔的视野。

senses.example: The hotel window offers a wide prospect of the lake and surrounding mountains.
senses.definition: the visual percept of a region
senses.definitionSentence: Prospect is the visual percept of a region.
senses.definitionZh: 一个区域的视觉感知。
senses.exampleZh: 酒店的窗户可以看到广阔的湖泊和周围的群山。

senses.example: When we consider the electronic industry potential for human betterment, the prospect is staggering.
senses.definition: belief about (or mental picture of) the future
senses.definitionSentence: Prospect means belief about (or mental picture of) the future.
senses.definitionZh: 对未来的信念（或脑海中的想象）。
senses.exampleZh: 当我们考虑电子行业改善人类福祉的潜力时，前景是惊人的。

senses.example: His prospects as a writer are excellent.
senses.definition: the possibility of future success
senses.definitionSentence: Prospect is the possibility of future success.
senses.definitionZh: 未来成功的可能性。
senses.exampleZh: 他作为作家的前景非常好。

senses.example: Geologists prospected the valley for copper by testing rocks and drilling sample cores.
senses.definition: search for something desirable
senses.definitionSentence: To prospect means to search for something desirable.
senses.definitionZh: 寻找想要的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 地质学家通过测试岩石和钻取岩芯样本来勘探山谷中的铜矿。

senses.example: The statute is solely prospective in operation.
senses.definition: of or concerned with or related to the future
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as prospective is of or concerned with or related to the future.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为前瞻性的事物属于未来、涉及未来或与未来相关。
senses.exampleZh: 该法规仅适用于实际操作。

senses.definition: (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point
senses.definitionSentence: (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point.
senses.definitionZh: 某个具体的方面、细节或要点。
senses.example: The two plans are similar in cost but differ in one important respect: their environmental impact.
senses.exampleZh: 这两个计划的成本相似，但在一个重要方面有所不同：对环境的影响。

senses.example: While I respect his sincere concern for peace, he made four points that I would like to question.
senses.definition: regard highly; think much of
senses.definitionSentence: To respect means to regard highly; think much of.
senses.definitionZh: 高度重视；考虑很多。
senses.exampleZh: 虽然我尊重他对和平的真诚关心，但他提出了我想质疑的四点。

senses.example: As Hudson resumed his desperate criss-crossing of the little bay, every incident lessened the crew's respect for him.
senses.definition: the condition of being honored (esteemed or respected or well regarded)
senses.definitionSentence: Respect is the condition of being honored (esteemed or respected or well regarded).
senses.definitionZh: 受到尊重的条件（受尊重或受到尊重或受到良好尊重）。
senses.exampleZh: 当哈德森继续绝望地穿越小海湾时，每一起事件都削弱了船员对他的尊重。

senses.example: The method used for computing the respective Federal and State shares in total program costs is specifically set forth in the Act.
senses.definition: considered individually
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as respective is considered individually.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为各自的事物被单独考虑。
senses.exampleZh: 该法案具体规定了用于计算联邦和州在计划总成本中各自份额的方法。

senses.example: In old age, she retrospected the years of struggle that had shaped her career.
senses.definition: look back upon (a period of time, sequence of events); remember
senses.definitionSentence: To look back on and remember a past period or sequence of events.
senses.definitionZh: 回想并追溯过去的一段时期或一系列事件。
senses.exampleZh: 年老时，她回顾了那些塑造了她职业生涯的奋斗岁月。

senses.meaning: 壮观场面，引人注目的景象
senses.example: The launch of hundreds of glowing lanterns was a spectacular public spectacle.
senses.exampleZh: 数百盏发光灯笼同时升空，构成了一幅壮观的公共景象。
senses.definitionSentence: A very impressive show or scene.
senses.definitionZh: 令人印象深刻的表演或场景。

senses.meaning: 出丑的场面，令人尴尬的举动
senses.example: He made a spectacle of himself by shouting and dancing on the table.
senses.exampleZh: 他在桌上大喊大叫又跳舞，当众出了洋相。
senses.definitionSentence: A blunder that makes you look ridiculous; used in the phrase `make a spectacle of' yourself.
senses.definitionZh: 一个让你看起来很可笑的错误；用在“让自己大放异彩”这个短语中。

senses.example: She put on her spectacles so she could read the small print.
senses.exampleZh: 她戴上眼镜，以便看清小字。
senses.definitionSentence: A pair of lenses in a frame worn to improve or protect a person's sight.
senses.definitionZh: 镜框内的一对镜片，用于改善或保护人的视力。

senses.example: The divers made spectacular leaps from the cliff, turning in the air before entering the sea.
senses.definition: characteristic of spectacles or drama
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as spectacular is characteristic of spectacles or drama.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为壮观的事物是奇观或戏剧的特征。
senses.exampleZh: 潜水员从悬崖上进行了壮观的跳跃，在进入大海之前在空中翻转。

senses.example: The spectators applauded the performance.
senses.definition: a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)
senses.definitionSentence: Spectator is a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind).
senses.definitionZh: 近距离观察者；观看某物（例如某种展览）的人。
senses.exampleZh: 观众为表演鼓掌。

senses.example: Those antisera shown by immunoelectrophoresis to be of the `` broad spectrum '' type were selected for used in the present study.
senses.definition: a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities
senses.definitionSentence: Spectrum is a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities.
senses.definitionZh: 广泛的相关对象、价值观、品质、想法或活动。
senses.exampleZh: 那些经免疫电泳显示为“广谱”类型的抗血清被选择用于本研究。

senses.definition: an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave
senses.definitionSentence: A spectrum is an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave.
senses.definitionZh: 辐射或波的各个成分按顺序排列而成的阵列。
senses.example: The prism separated the beam into a spectrum of distinct colors.
senses.exampleZh: 棱镜把这束光分解成由不同颜色组成的光谱。

senses.example: Once again, Tom Horn was the first and most likely suspect, and he was brought in for questioning immediately.
senses.definition: someone who is under suspicion
senses.definitionSentence: Suspect means someone who is under suspicion.
senses.definitionZh: 受到怀疑的人。
senses.exampleZh: 汤姆·霍恩（Tom Horn）再次成为第一个也是最有可能的嫌疑人，他立即被带去接受审问。

senses.definition: imagine to be the case or true or probable
senses.definitionSentence: To suspect means to imagine something to be the case, true, or probable.
senses.definitionZh: 推测某种情况可能属实或很可能发生。
senses.example: I suspect the delay was caused by a fault in the control system.
senses.exampleZh: 我怀疑这次延误是控制系统故障造成的。

senses.example: Radio observations of Venus and Jupiter have already supplied unexpected experimental data on the physical conditions of these planets.
senses.definition: not expected or anticipated
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as unexpected is not expected or anticipated.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为意外的事情不是预期或预期的。
senses.exampleZh: 金星和木星的射电观测已经提供了有关这些行星物理状况的意想不到的实验数据。

senses.example: An especially (or specially) cautious approach to the danger.
senses.definition: to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
senses.definitionSentence: Especially means to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common.
senses.definitionZh: 比常见的范围或程度明显更大。
senses.exampleZh: 对危险采取特别（或特别）谨慎的态度。

senses.example: The special features of a computer.
senses.definition: unique or specific to a person or thing or category
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as special is unique or specific to a person or thing or category.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为特殊的东西是独特的或特定于人、事物或类别的。
senses.exampleZh: 计算​​机的特殊功能。

senses.example: Put on special buses for the big game.
senses.definition: added to a regular schedule
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as special is added to a regular schedule.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为特殊的内容已添加到常规时间表中。
senses.exampleZh: 为大型比赛搭乘专用巴士。

senses.example: Restorers used a special kind of paint formulated only for protecting historic outdoor murals.
senses.definition: adapted to or reserved for a particular purpose
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as special is adapted to or reserved for a particular purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为特殊的东西适用于或保留用于特定目的。
senses.exampleZh: 修复者使用了一种专门为保护历史户外壁画而配制的特殊涂料。

senses.example: If you can n't tell, get help from your county agricultural agent or other local specialist.
senses.definition: an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning
senses.definitionSentence: Specialist is an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning.
senses.definitionZh: 致力于某一职业或某一学科领域的专家。
senses.exampleZh: 如果您无法判断，请向您所在县的农业代理商或其他当地专家寻求帮助。

senses.example: Restoring damaged paintings is the museum conservator's valuable speciality.
senses.definition: an asset of special worth or utility
senses.definitionSentence: Speciality is an asset of special worth or utility.
senses.definitionZh: 具有特殊价值或效用的资产。
senses.exampleZh: 修复损坏的画作是博物馆管理员的宝贵专长。

senses.example: She specializes in honey bees.
senses.definition: devote oneself to a special area of work
senses.definitionSentence: To specialize means to devote oneself to a special area of work.
senses.definitionZh: 致力于特定的工作领域。
senses.exampleZh: 她专门研究蜜蜂。

senses.example: A. armata is much more beautiful in color, at least in the female of the species: a rich, velvety, rusty red.
senses.definition: (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
senses.definitionSentence: Species means (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed.
senses.definitionZh: 其成员可以杂交的（生物学）分类群。
senses.exampleZh: A. armata 的颜色更加美丽，至少在该物种的雌性中是这样：浓郁、天鹅绒般的铁锈红色。

senses.example: A specific and detailed account of the accident.
senses.definition: (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as specific is (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique.
senses.definitionZh: 特定的，独特的。
senses.exampleZh: 对事故的具体详细描述。

senses.meaning: 规格说明，设计标准的详细描述
senses.example: The engineering specification states the required dimensions, materials, load limits, and safety tolerances.
senses.definition: a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work
senses.definitionSentence: Specification is a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work.
senses.definitionZh: 对一件作品的设计标准的详细描述。
senses.exampleZh: 工程规范规定了所需的尺寸、材料、负载限制和安全公差。

senses.example: The coach specified two defenders for the task of marking the opposing striker.
senses.definition: select something or someone for a specific purpose
senses.definitionSentence: To specify means to select something or someone for a specific purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 为特定目的选择某物或某人。
senses.exampleZh: 教练指定两名后卫来负责盯防对方前锋。

senses.definition: state something clearly and in detail
senses.definitionSentence: To specify means to state something clearly and in detail.
senses.definitionZh: 清楚而具体地说明某事。
senses.example: The application form asks candidates to specify the dates when they are available.
senses.exampleZh: 申请表要求申请人明确填写自己有空的日期。

senses.example: Some observers speculated that this might be his revenge on his home town.
senses.definition: to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
senses.definitionSentence: Speculate means to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds.
senses.definitionZh: 相信，尤其是在不确定或暂定的基础上。
senses.exampleZh: 有观察人士猜测，这可能是他对家乡的报复。

senses.example: I bought this house not because I want to live in it but to sell it later at a good price, so I am speculating.
senses.definition: invest at a risk
senses.definitionSentence: To speculate means to invest at a risk.
senses.definitionZh: 冒险投资。
senses.exampleZh: 我买这个房子不是因为我想住进去，而是为了以后能卖个好价钱，所以我是在猜测。

senses.meaning: 公开的，公然的，露骨的，非常显眼的
senses.example: His conspicuous red coat made no attempt at concealment and was obvious across the crowded station.
senses.definition: without any attempt at concealment; completely obvious
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as conspicuous is without any attempt at concealment; completely obvious.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为引人注目的事物没有任何隐藏的企图；完全明显。
senses.exampleZh: 他那件显眼的红色外套毫不掩饰，在拥挤的车站里很明显。

senses.example: The spicy curry burned her tongue because it contained several hot chili peppers.
senses.definition: producing a burning sensation on the taste nerves
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as spicy is producing a burning sensation on the taste nerves.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为辛辣的东西会在味觉神经上产生灼烧感。
senses.exampleZh: 辣咖喱烫伤了她的舌头，因为里面有几个辣椒。

senses.meaning: 可口的，味香的，开胃的，风味极佳的
senses.example: Fresh ginger and black pepper gave the soup a spicy, pleasantly pungent flavor.
senses.definition: having an agreeably pungent taste
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as spicy is having an agreeably pungent taste.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为辛辣的东西具有令人愉快的辛辣味道。
senses.exampleZh: 新鲜生姜和黑胡椒给汤带来辛辣、令人愉悦的辛辣味道。

senses.example: The comedian's spicy jokes about the honeymoon embarrassed several guests at the wedding reception.
senses.definition: suggestive of sexual impropriety
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as spicy is suggestive of sexual impropriety.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为辛辣的东西暗示性行为不当。
senses.exampleZh: 这位喜剧演员关于蜜月的辛辣笑话让婚宴上的几位客人感到尴尬。

senses.example: They 'd have some suspicions to repeat to the police.
senses.definition: an impression that something might be the case
senses.definitionSentence: Suspicion is an impression that something might be the case.
senses.definitionZh: 一种印象，认为事情可能是这样的。
senses.exampleZh: 他们有一些怀疑需要向警方重复。

senses.example: `` Surely, Captain, you did not find my name on any suspicious paper or anything ''.
senses.definition: not as expected
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as suspicious is not as expected.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为可疑的内容与预期不符。
senses.exampleZh: ``当然，队长，你没有在任何可疑的文件或任何东西上找到我的名字''。

senses.definition: the vital principle or animating force within living things
senses.definitionSentence: The vital principle or animating force within living things.
senses.definitionZh: 生物体内的生命原理或动力。
senses.example: Many traditions describe the spirit as the part of a person that survives the body.
senses.exampleZh: 许多传统将精神描述为人的身体的一部分。

senses.example: He could learn at second hand from books, but could not thus capture the real Jewish spirit.
senses.definition: the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people
senses.definitionSentence: Spirit is the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people.
senses.definitionZh: 一个地方或情况的总体氛围及其对人们的影响。
senses.exampleZh: 他可以从书本上学习二手知识，但无法捕捉到真正的犹太精神。

senses.example: Each aspired to be a god in human form, but with each it was a different kind of god.
senses.definition: have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal
senses.definitionSentence: To aspire means to have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal.
senses.definitionZh: 有一个雄心勃勃的计划或一个崇高的目标。
senses.exampleZh: 每个人都渴望成为人类形态的神，但每个人都是不同类型的神。

senses.example: There seems to be almost a conspiracy of silence veiling it.
senses.definition: a plot to carry out some harmful or illegal act (especially a political plot)
senses.definitionSentence: Conspiracy is a plot to carry out some harmful or illegal act (especially a political plot).
senses.definitionZh: 实施某些有害或非法行为的阴谋（尤其是政治阴谋）。
senses.exampleZh: 似乎有一个沉默的阴谋掩盖着它。

senses.example: The solution came in a flash of inspiration while she was sketching the problem on a napkin.
senses.definition: a sudden intuition as part of solving a problem
senses.definitionSentence: Inspiration is a sudden intuition as part of solving a problem.
senses.definitionZh: 解决问题过程中突然出现的直觉。
senses.exampleZh: 当她在餐巾纸上画出问题的草图时，她灵光一现，找到了解决方案。

senses.example: It was at that party that, finally overcoming my timidity, inspired by tales only half understood and overheard among older boys, I asked Jessie to spend New Year's Eve with me.
senses.definition: spur on or encourage especially by cheers and shouts
senses.definitionSentence: To inspire means to spur on or encourage especially by cheers and shouts.
senses.definitionZh: 激励或鼓励，尤其是通过欢呼和喊叫。
senses.exampleZh: 正是在那次聚会上，我终于克服了胆怯，受到大男孩们半知半解和无意中听到的故事的启发，我邀请杰西和我一起度过除夕夜。

senses.example: The article about the artist inspired the exhibition of his recent work.
senses.definition: supply the inspiration for
senses.definitionSentence: To inspire means to supply the inspiration for.
senses.definitionZh: 提供灵感。
senses.exampleZh: 关于这位艺术家的文章启发了他最近作品的展览。

senses.example: A spiral staircase coils upward around a central post.
senses.definition: in the shape of a coil
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as spiral is in the shape of a coil.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为螺旋的东西是线圈的形状。
senses.exampleZh: 螺旋楼梯围绕中心柱向上盘旋。

senses.example: As represented by a spiral, history may, in some sense, be said to repeat itself; yet each historical event remains unique.
senses.definition: a plane curve traced by a point circling about the center but at increasing distances from the center
senses.definitionSentence: Spiral is a plane curve traced by a point circling about the center but at increasing distances from the center.
senses.definitionZh: 一条平面曲线，由围绕中心旋转但距中心距离逐渐增加的点绘制。
senses.exampleZh: 正如螺旋所代表的那样，历史在某种意义上可以说是在重演。然而，每一个历史事件仍然是独一无二的。

senses.meaning: 作螺旋式移动，盘旋前进，螺旋
senses.example: The damaged aircraft spiraled downward in tightening circles before the pilot regained control.
senses.definition: move in a spiral or zigzag course
senses.definitionSentence: To spiral means to move in a spiral or zigzag course.
senses.definitionZh: 以螺旋或之字形路线移动。
senses.exampleZh: 在飞行员重新控制之前，受损的飞机在紧缩的圆圈中盘旋下降。

senses.example: According to Whipple (1955), cometary debris is sufficient to replenish the material spiraling into the sun, maintaining a fairly steady state.
senses.definition: to wind or move in a spiral course
senses.definitionSentence: Spiral means to wind or move in a spiral course.
senses.definitionZh: 以螺旋路线缠绕或移动。
senses.exampleZh: 根据 Whipple (1955) 的说法，彗星碎片足以补充螺旋进入太阳的物质，保持相当稳定的状态。

senses.example: The mathematician drew a spiral that wound outward with each turn around the center.
senses.definition: a curve that lies on the surface of a cylinder or cone and cuts the element at a constant angle
senses.definitionSentence: Spiral is a curve that lies on the surface of a cylinder or cone and cuts the element at a constant angle.
senses.definitionZh: 位于圆柱体或圆锥体表面上并以恒定角度切割元件的曲线。
senses.exampleZh: 数学家画了一条螺旋线，每绕一圈就向外缠绕。

senses.example: Prayer and meditation support her spiritual life by giving her a sense of meaning beyond material concerns.
senses.definition: concerned with or affecting the spirit or soul
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as spiritual is concerned with or affecting the spirit or soul.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为精神的东西涉及或影响精神或灵魂。
senses.exampleZh: 祈祷和冥想给她一种超越物质关注的意义感，从而支持她的精神生活。

senses.meaning: 不顾一切的，铤而走险的
senses.example: Desperate to save his child, he crossed the flooded river despite the violent current.
senses.definition: desperately determined
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as desperate is desperately determined.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为绝望的事物是绝望的决心。
senses.exampleZh: 为了救自己的孩子，他不顾水流汹涌，跨过了被洪水淹没的河流。

senses.example: The desperate captors, convinced they had no escape, threatened the hostages with reckless violence.
senses.definition: (of persons) dangerously reckless or violent as from urgency or despair
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as desperate is (of persons) dangerously reckless or violent as from urgency or despair.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为绝望的事物是指（人）因紧急或绝望而危险地鲁莽或暴力。
senses.exampleZh: 绝望的绑架者确信他们无处可逃，以鲁莽的暴力威胁人质。

senses.example: If we could use all the small airfields we have in this country, we could disperse our strategic aircraft by a factor of 10 or more.
senses.definition: distribute loosely
senses.definitionSentence: To disperse means to distribute loosely.
senses.definitionZh: 松散地分布。
senses.exampleZh: 如果我们可以利用这个国家所有的小型机场，我们就可以将我们的战略飞机分散十倍或更多。

senses.example: Andy had no desire to linger himself but Hub reported that the mob outside was still large despite the efforts of the police to disperse them.
senses.definition: to cause to separate and go in different directions
senses.definitionSentence: Disperse means to cause to separate and go in different directions.
senses.definitionZh: 导致分离并走向不同的方向。
senses.exampleZh: 安迪不想逗留，但 Hub 报告说，尽管警方努力驱散，外面的暴徒仍然很多。

senses.example: The campaign used radio and social media to disperse news of the missing child across the country.
senses.definition: cause to become widely known
senses.definitionSentence: To disperse means to cause to become widely known.
senses.definitionZh: 导致广为人知。
senses.exampleZh: 该活动利用广播和社交媒体在全国范围内传播失踪儿童的消息。

senses.example: John Vernon had had all the patronage he cared for - he had prospered, but he could not retire from horsedom.
senses.definition: make steady progress; be at the high point in one's career or reach a high point in historical significance or importance
senses.definitionSentence: To prosper means to make steady progress; be at the high point in one's career or reach a high point in historical significance or importance.
senses.definitionZh: “繁荣”，即持续进步并发展到兴盛阶段。
senses.exampleZh: 约翰·弗农 (John Vernon) 得到了他所关心的所有赞助 - 他很繁荣，但他无法退出马术。

senses.example: `` Uncle Sam '' was, indeed, a rich uncle to Prokofieff, in those opulent, post-war victory years of peace and prosperity, bold speculations and extravaganzas, enjoyment and pleasure: `` The Golden Twenties ''.
senses.definition: an economic state of growth with rising profits and full employment
senses.definitionSentence: Prosperity is an economic state of growth with rising profits and full employment.
senses.definitionZh: 一种利润增长和充分就业的经济增长状态。
senses.exampleZh: “山姆大叔”确实是普罗科菲耶夫的富有叔叔，在那些富裕的战后胜利岁月里，和平与繁荣，大胆的投机和奢侈，享受和快乐：“黄金二十年代”。

senses.example: While no larger than Dutch Springs, this mining supply town had the appearance of being far busier and more prosperous.
senses.definition: very lively and profitable
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as prosperous is very lively and profitable.
senses.definitionZh: 形容繁荣的事物非常热闹，有利可图。
senses.exampleZh: 虽然这个采矿供应城镇并不比荷兰斯普林斯大，但它看起来更加繁忙和繁荣。

senses.definitionSentence: To communicate with someone by speaking, writing, calling, or sending a message.
senses.definitionZh: 通过交谈、写信、打电话或发送消息与某人取得联系。
senses.example: Contact customer support immediately if your bank card is lost or stolen.
senses.exampleZh: 银行卡丢失或被盗时，请立即联系客户服务。

senses.exampleZh: 在他的宗教誓言期间，他保持克制并避免发生性关系。

senses.example: Continual interruptions throughout the morning made it almost impossible to finish the report.
senses.definition: `continual' (meaning seemingly uninterrupted) is often used interchangeably with `continuous' (meaning without interruption)
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as continual is `continual' (meaning seemingly uninterrupted) is often used interchangeably with `continuous' (meaning without interruption).
senses.definitionZh: 描述为连续的事物是“连续”（意思是看似不间断）通常与“连续”（意思是不间断）互换使用。
senses.exampleZh: 整个上午的持续干扰使得报告几乎无法完成。

senses.example: We continued to work into the night.
senses.definition: continue a certain state, condition, or activity
senses.definitionSentence: To continue means to continue a certain state, condition, or activity.
senses.definitionZh: 继续某种状态、条件或活动。
senses.exampleZh: 我们继续工作到深夜。

senses.meaning: 不断的，不间断的，连续的，连续不断的
senses.example: "a continuous rearrangement of electrons in the solar atoms results in the emission of light"- James Jeans.
senses.definition: continuing in time or space without interruption
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as continuous is continuing in time or space without interruption.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为连续的事物在时间或空间上连续不断，没有中断。
senses.exampleZh: “太阳原子中电子的连续重新排列导致光的发射”- James Jeans。

senses.example: Over the rattling of fenders, humming of tires and chattering of gears there was a charming melody of whispers and tiny giggles.
senses.definition: very small
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as tiny is very small.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为微小的东西非常小。
senses.exampleZh: 在挡泥板的嘎嘎声、轮胎的嗡嗡声和齿轮的嘎嘎声中，传来迷人的低语和咯咯笑声。

senses.example: The record contains many old songs from the 1930's.
senses.definition: include or contain; have as a component
senses.definitionSentence: To contain means to include or contain; have as a component.
senses.definitionZh: 包含，容纳。
senses.exampleZh: 该唱片包含许多 1930 年代的老歌。

senses.example: Kate tried to contain her curiosity and foreboding at what the letter portended, at what involvement existed for Juanita.
senses.definition: lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits
senses.definitionSentence: To contain means to lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits.
senses.definitionZh: 降低强度；脾气;保持克制；保持或保持在一定限度内。
senses.exampleZh: 凯特试图抑制住自己对这封信所预示的内容以及胡安妮塔所涉及的内容的好奇心和不祥预感。

senses.example: Make sure milk for the coffee is placed in dispensers rather than in containers, if you are supplying the coffee.
senses.definition: any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)
senses.definitionSentence: Container means any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another).
senses.definitionZh: 可用于容纳物品的任何物体（尤其是标准化尺寸的大型金属盒状物体，可以从一种运输方式装载到另一种运输方式）。
senses.exampleZh: 如果您提供咖啡，请确保将咖啡牛奶放入分配器而不是容器中。

senses.example: Excellent in their way, they lack the wide appeal of The Charles Men, and need not detain us here.
senses.definition: deprive of freedom; take into confinement
senses.definitionSentence: To detain means to deprive of freedom; take into confinement.
senses.definitionZh: 剥夺自由；收监。
senses.exampleZh: 他们的方式很出色，但缺乏查尔斯人的广泛吸引力，因此不需要将我们留在这里。

senses.example: The host entertained the guests with music and games after dinner.
senses.definition: provide entertainment for
senses.definitionSentence: To entertain means to provide entertainment for.
senses.definitionZh: 通过活动或表演使某人感到愉快。
senses.exampleZh: 晚饭后，主人用音乐和游戏招待宾客。

senses.definition: receive guests as a host and provide them with food, drink, or other hospitality
senses.definitionSentence: To entertain means to receive guests as a host and provide them with food, drink, or other hospitality.
senses.definitionZh: 作为主人接待宾客，并为其提供饮食或其他款待。
senses.example: The couple entertain several neighbors at home every New Year's Eve, serving dinner and arranging guest rooms.
senses.exampleZh: 这对夫妇每年除夕都在家款待几位邻居，为他们准备晚餐和客房。

senses.example: She wrote gay plays about the girls for family entertainments, like `` Oh, What Fun!
senses.definition: an activity that is diverting and that holds the attention
senses.definitionSentence: Entertainment is an activity that is diverting and that holds the attention.
senses.definitionZh: 一种转移注意力并吸引注意力的活动。
senses.exampleZh: 她为家庭娱乐写了一些关于女孩的同性恋戏剧，比如“哦，多有趣！”

senses.example: How did you obtain the visa?
senses.definition: come into possession of
senses.definitionSentence: To obtain means to come into possession of.
senses.definitionZh: 占有。
senses.exampleZh: 您是如何获得签证的？

senses.example: I retain this drug for a long time.
senses.definition: hold back within
senses.definitionSentence: To retain means to hold back within.
senses.definitionZh: 保留在内部。
senses.exampleZh: 我保留这种药很长时间了。

senses.example: I cannot retain so much information.
senses.definition: keep in one's mind
senses.definitionSentence: To retain means to keep in one's mind.
senses.definitionZh: 牢记在心。
senses.exampleZh: 我无法保留这么多信息。

senses.example: She attained fluency only after years of study, daily conversation, and persistent effort.
senses.definition: to gain with effort
senses.definitionSentence: Attain means to gain with effort.
senses.definitionZh: 通过努力获得。
senses.exampleZh: 经过多年的学习、日常会话和坚持不懈的努力，她才达到流利程度。

senses.example: After climbing through the night, the rescue team finally attained the mountain summit at dawn.
senses.definition: reach a destination, either real or abstract
senses.definitionSentence: To attain means to reach a destination, either real or abstract.
senses.definitionZh: 到达目的地，无论是真实的还是抽象的。
senses.exampleZh: 经过一夜的攀登，救援队终于在黎明时分到达山顶。

senses.example: The Lenin tomb is obviously adequate for double occupancy, Moscow is a crowded city, and the creed of communism deplores waste.
senses.definition: a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone)
senses.definitionSentence: Tomb is a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone).
senses.definitionZh: 埋葬尸体的地方（尤其是在地下并有墓碑标记的地方）。
senses.exampleZh: 列宁墓显然足以容纳双人入住，莫斯科是一座拥挤的城市，共产主义的信条对浪费表示遗憾。

senses.example: The accustomed morning bell rang at seven, calling every student to assembly as usual.
senses.definition: commonly used or practiced; usual
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as accustomed is commonly used or practiced; usual.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为习惯的事物是普遍使用或实践的；通常。
senses.exampleZh: 习惯性的晨钟在七点钟响起，像往常一样召集每个学生集合。

senses.example: Each water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
senses.definition: (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element
senses.definitionSentence: Atom means (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element.
senses.definitionZh: （物理和化学）具有元素化学性质的元素的最小组成部分。
senses.exampleZh: 每个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

senses.example: There was not an atom of truth in the rumor, despite how widely it had spread.
senses.definition: (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
senses.definitionSentence: Atom means (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything.
senses.definitionZh: （非技术用法）任何事物的一小部分。
senses.exampleZh: 尽管谣言传播得如此广泛，但它没有一点真实性。

senses.example: They cringed under sodden covers, listening to the waves slop against the bottom.
senses.definition: the lower side of anything
senses.definitionSentence: Bottom is the lower side of anything.
senses.definitionZh: 任何东西的下侧。
senses.exampleZh: 他们在湿漉漉的被子下畏缩，聆听海浪拍击底部的声音。

senses.example: Particularly was this true when the norms previously applied were no longer satisfactory to many, when customs were rapidly changing as the forces of the new productivity were harnessed.
senses.definition: accepted or habitual practice
senses.definitionSentence: Custom means accepted or habitual practice.
senses.definitionZh: 接受或习惯的做法。
senses.exampleZh: 当以前应用的规范不再令许多人满意，当随着新生产力的力量被利用而习俗迅速变化时，情况尤其如此。

senses.example: Importers paid custom on the foreign goods before officials released the cargo.
senses.definition: money collected under a tariff
senses.definitionSentence: Custom means money collected under a tariff.
senses.definitionZh: 根据关税收取的款项。
senses.exampleZh: 进口商在官员放行货物之前为外国货物支付了关税。

senses.example: He took his customary morning walk at seven, following the same route he used every day.
senses.definition: commonly used or practiced; usual
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as customary is commonly used or practiced; usual.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为习惯的事物是普遍使用或实践的；通常。
senses.exampleZh: 他按照惯例早上七点散步，遵循他每天使用的路线。

senses.example: Providing good customer service requires as thorough a marketing and general management planning job as the original selling of the product.
senses.definition: someone who pays for goods or services
senses.definitionSentence: Customer means someone who pays for goods or services.
senses.definitionZh: 为商品或服务付款的人。
senses.exampleZh: 提供良好的客户服务需要与产品的原始销售一样彻底的营销和一般管理规划工作。

senses.example: He found a jar of preserved tomatoes and one of eggs that they had meant to save.
senses.definition: mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable
senses.definitionSentence: Tomato means mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable.
senses.definitionZh: 作为蔬菜食用的微酸红色或黄色果肉水果。
senses.exampleZh: 他发现了一罐腌制西红柿和一个他们本来想保存的鸡蛋。

senses.example: She sent the medical records to the specialist in Beijing.
senses.exampleZh: 她把病历寄给了北京的专科医生。
senses.definitionSentence: Used to indicate movement toward a place, direction, or recipient.
senses.definitionZh: 用于指示朝向某个地点、方向或接收者的移动。

senses.example: Abstract words like `truth' and `justice'
senses.definition: existing only in the mind; separated from embodiment
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as abstract is existing only in the mind; separated from embodiment.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为抽象的东西只存在于头脑中；与实施例分开。
senses.exampleZh: 像“真理”和“正义”这样的抽象词。

senses.example: The journal requires a 250-word abstract summarizing the paper's question, method, and main findings.
senses.definition: a sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory
senses.definitionSentence: Abstract is a sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory.
senses.definitionZh: 对论点或理论要点的粗略总结。
senses.exampleZh: 该期刊需要一份 250 字的摘要，总结论文的问题、方法和主要发现。

senses.example: The researcher abstracted the main findings from fifty pages of experimental results.
senses.definition: give an abstract (of)
senses.definitionSentence: To abstract means to give an abstract (of).
senses.definitionZh: 给出摘要。
senses.exampleZh: 研究人员从五十页的实验结果中提取了主要发现。

senses.example: He loved her only in the abstract--not in person.
senses.definition: a concept or idea not associated with any specific instance
senses.definitionSentence: Abstract is a concept or idea not associated with any specific instance.
senses.definitionZh: 与任何特定实例无关的概念或想法。
senses.exampleZh: 他只是抽象地爱她，而不是亲自爱她。

senses.example: In this model, we abstract from all non wage sources of cost changes, so that the `` public limit price '' only rises as the wage rate rises.
senses.definition: consider a concept without thinking of a specific example; consider abstractly or theoretically
senses.definitionSentence: To abstract means to consider a concept without thinking of a specific example; consider abstractly or theoretically.
senses.definitionZh: 考虑一个概念而不考虑具体的例子；抽象地或理论上地考虑。
senses.exampleZh: 在这个模型中，我们从所有非工资来源的成本变化中抽象出来，这样“公共限价”只会随着工资率的上升而上升。

senses.example: Her good looks attract the stares of many men.
senses.definition: direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
senses.definitionSentence: To attract means to direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes.
senses.definitionZh: 通过某种心理力量或身体属性来指向自己或自己。
senses.exampleZh: 她的美貌吸引了许多男人的目光。

senses.meaning: 吸引人的，有魅力的，有吸引力的
senses.example: A remarkably attractive young man.
senses.definition: pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as attractive is pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为有吸引力的东西是指赏心悦目或赏心悦目，尤其是通过美丽或魅力。
senses.exampleZh: 一个非常有魅力的年轻人。

senses.example: Contract - conceived as the free bargain of formal equals - replaced the implied obligations of a more static and status conscious society.
senses.definition: a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
senses.definitionSentence: Contract is a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law.
senses.definitionZh: 两人或多人之间具有约束力的协议，可依法强制执行。
senses.exampleZh: 合同——被视为正式平等的自由讨价还价——取代了一个更加静态和地位意识社会的隐含义务。

senses.example: It contracts with outside repair garages for much of the latter work.
senses.definition: engage by written agreement
senses.definitionSentence: To contract means to engage by written agreement.
senses.definitionZh: 通过书面协议进行约定。
senses.exampleZh: 它与外部修理厂签订了大部分后续工作的合同。

senses.example: The thief distracted the bystanders.
senses.definition: draw someone's attention away from something
senses.definitionSentence: To distract means to draw someone's attention away from something.
senses.definitionZh: 将某人的注意力从某件事上转移开。
senses.exampleZh: 小偷分散了旁观者的注意力。

senses.example: Extract information from the telegram.
senses.definition: remove, usually with some force or effort; also used in an abstract sense
senses.definitionSentence: To extract means to remove, usually with some force or effort; also used in an abstract sense.
senses.definitionZh: 移除，通常需要一定的力量或努力；也用于抽象意义上。
senses.exampleZh: 从电报中提取信息。

senses.example: The anthology includes a two-page extract selected from the middle of the much longer novel.
senses.definition: a passage selected from a larger work
senses.definitionSentence: Extract is a passage selected from a larger work.
senses.definitionZh: 选自较大作品的一段。
senses.exampleZh: 该选集包括从长得多的小说中间节选的两页摘录。

senses.example: A fund-raising drive to buy tractors and machinery was launched.
senses.definition: a wheeled vehicle with large wheels; used in farming and other applications
senses.definitionSentence: Tractor is a wheeled vehicle with large wheels; used in farming and other applications.
senses.definitionZh: 具有大轮子的轮式车辆；用于农业和其他应用。
senses.exampleZh: 发起了购买拖拉机和机械的筹款活动。

senses.example: This prefix was subtracted when the word was borrowed from French.
senses.definition: take off or away
senses.definitionSentence: To subtract means to take off or away.
senses.definitionZh: 起飞或离开。
senses.exampleZh: 当该词是从法语借用时，该前缀被减去。

senses.example: By 3: 00 A.M. they reached his house and found it vacant.
senses.definition: void of thought or knowledge
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as vacant is void of thought or knowledge.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为空的东西是指没有思想或知识。
senses.exampleZh: 凌晨 3:00 之前他们到达他的家，发现它空着。

senses.definition: without an occupant or incumbent
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as vacant is without an occupant or incumbent.
senses.definitionZh: 没有人占用，或没有人在任的。
senses.example: After the director resigned, the position remained vacant for three months.
senses.exampleZh: 主任辞职后，这个职位空缺了三个月。

senses.example: We get two weeks of vacation every summer.
senses.definition: leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
senses.definitionSentence: Vacation means leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure.
senses.definitionZh: 远离工作、专门用于休息或娱乐的闲暇时间。
senses.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们有两周的假期。

senses.example: She is vacationing at the Kennedy summer home in Hyannis Port, Mass., and in his welcoming remarks, the President said he was representing her.
senses.definition: spend or take a vacation
senses.definitionSentence: To vacation means to spend or take a vacation.
senses.definitionZh: 度过或休假。
senses.exampleZh: 她正在马萨诸塞州海恩尼斯港的肯尼迪避暑别墅度假，总统在欢迎辞中表示他代表她。

senses.example: Without their support he'll be ruling in a vacuum.
senses.definition: an empty area or space
senses.definitionSentence: Vacuum is an empty area or space.
senses.definitionZh: 空的区域或空间。
senses.exampleZh: 没有他们的支持，他将在真空中进行统治。

senses.example: She ran the vacuum over the carpet to suck up dust, crumbs, and pet hair.
senses.definition: an electrical home appliance that cleans by suction
senses.definitionSentence: Vacuum is an electrical home appliance that cleans by suction.
senses.definitionZh: 一种通过吸力进行清洁的家用电器。
senses.exampleZh: 她用吸尘器扫过地毯，吸走灰尘、面包屑和宠物毛发。

senses.example: Authorities evacuated residents from the coastal villages before the hurricane arrived.
senses.definition: move people from their homes or country
senses.definitionSentence: To evacuate means to move people from their homes or country.
senses.definitionZh: 将人们从家园或国家转移出去。
senses.exampleZh: 当局在飓风到来之前疏散了沿海村庄的居民。

senses.meaning: 含糊的，模糊的，不明确的
senses.example: "their descriptions of human behavior become vague, dull, and unclear"- P.A.Sorokin.
senses.definition: not clearly understood or expressed
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as vague is not clearly understood or expressed.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为模糊的内容没有被清楚地理解或表达。
senses.exampleZh: “他们对人类行为的描述变得模糊、乏味和不清楚”- P.A.Sorokin。

senses.example: Above all, do n't set up extravagant fringe benefits just to buy employee good will.
senses.definition: recklessly wasteful
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as extravagant is recklessly wasteful.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为奢侈的东西是不顾一切的浪费。
senses.exampleZh: 最重要的是，不要仅仅为了收买员工的善意而设立奢侈的附加福利。

senses.example: `` That is extravagant language, Mr. Wales.
senses.definition: unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as extravagant is unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings.
senses.definitionZh: 形容奢侈的东西是无拘无束的，特别是在感情方面。
senses.exampleZh: ``威尔士先生，这是过分的语言。

senses.definition: a person or thing equal to another in value or measure or force or effect or significance etc
senses.definitionSentence: A person or thing equal to another in value or measure or force or effect or significance etc.
senses.definitionZh: 一个人或事物在价值、尺度、力量、效果或重要性等方面与另一个人或事物相等。
senses.example: There is no exact English equivalent of this local expression, so the translator used a short explanation.
senses.exampleZh: 这个当地表达方式没有确切的英语对应词，因此译者使用了简短的解释。

senses.example: A wish that was equivalent to a command.
senses.definition: being essentially equal to something
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as equivalent is being essentially equal to something.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为等同的事物本质上等于某事物。
senses.exampleZh: 相当于命令的愿望。

senses.example: Chemists calculated the equivalent of the acid from the amount needed to combine with a standard mass of base.
senses.definition: the atomic weight of an element that has the same combining capacity as a given weight of another element; the standard is 8 for oxygen
dictionaryCandidates: 相等物， 等价物， 等值物
senses.definitionSentence: Equivalent is the atomic weight of an element that has the same combining capacity as a given weight of another element; the standard is 8 for oxygen.
senses.definitionZh: 与给定重量的另一种元素具有相同化合能力的元素的原子量；氧气的标准是8。
senses.exampleZh: 化学家根据与标准质量的碱混合所需的量计算出酸的当量。

senses.example: Sample copies of new books are on display at headquarters, where librarians may evaluate them by themselves or in workshop groups.
senses.definition: evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of
senses.definitionSentence: To evaluate means to evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of.
senses.definitionZh: 评估或估计其性质、质量、能力、程度或重要性。
senses.exampleZh: 新书的样本在总部展出，图书馆员可以自己或在研讨会小组中对其进行评估。

senses.example: This agreement is considered very good for such short time intervals.
senses.definition: a definite length of time marked off by two instants
senses.definitionSentence: Interval is a definite length of time marked off by two instants.
senses.definitionZh: 由两个瞬间划分的确定时间长度。
senses.exampleZh: 对于如此短的时间间隔，该协议被认为非常好。

senses.example: The unsigned contract is legally invalid and cannot be enforced in court.
senses.definition: having no cogency or legal force
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as invalid is having no cogency or legal force.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为无效的内容没有任何说服力或法律效力。
senses.exampleZh: 未签署的合同在法律上无效，不能在法庭上执行。

senses.definitionZh: 为特定目的而发明的工具。
