senses.definition: the aggregate of past events
senses.definitionSentence: History is the aggregate of past events.
senses.definitionZh: 过去事件的总和。
senses.exampleZh: 学校历史上的关键时刻。

senses.example: He fed the captain bits of history about the troops and the regiment.
senses.definition: a record or narrative description of past events
senses.definitionSentence: History is a record or narrative description of past events.
senses.definitionZh: 对过去事件的记录或叙述性描述。
senses.exampleZh: 他向队长讲述了有关部队和团的一些历史。

senses.example: Bring me the box from the other room.
senses.definition: take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
senses.definitionSentence: To bring means to take something or somebody with oneself somewhere.
senses.definitionZh: 将某物或某人带到某个地方。
senses.exampleZh: 把另一个房间的盒子给我拿来。

senses.example: Knowledge gained from studying earthquake waves has been applied in various fields.
senses.definition: the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning
senses.definitionSentence: Knowledge is the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning.
senses.definitionZh: 感知、学习和推理的心理结果。
senses.exampleZh: 通过研究地震波获得的知识已应用于各个领域。

senses.example: They traveled at a rate of 55 miles per hour.
senses.definition: a magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit
senses.definitionSentence: Rate is a magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit.
senses.definitionZh: 相对于时间单位的幅度或频率。
senses.exampleZh: 他们以每小时 55 英里的速度行驶。

senses.example: He works at a great rate.
senses.definition: the relative speed of progress or change
senses.definitionSentence: Rate is the relative speed of progress or change.
senses.definitionZh: 进展或变化的相对速度。
senses.exampleZh: 他工作效率很高。

senses.example: Wisconsin Dells, where fantastically scenic rocks carved by the Wisconsin River are overgrown with fern and other foliage, rates a stopover when traveling from Chicago.
senses.definition: be worthy of or have a certain rating
senses.definitionSentence: To rate means to be worthy of or have a certain rating.
senses.definitionZh: 值得或具有一定的评价。
senses.exampleZh: 威斯康星德尔斯 (Wisconsin Dells) 是从芝加哥出发旅行时的一个中途停留地，威斯康星河冲刷而成的岩石风景如画，长满了蕨类植物和其他树叶。

senses.example: The restaurant is rated highly in the food guide.
senses.definition: assign a rank or rating to
senses.definitionSentence: To rate means to assign a rank or rating to.
senses.definitionZh: 分配排名或评级。
senses.exampleZh: 该餐厅在美食指南中评价很高。

senses.example: Brooklyn College students have an ambivalent attitude toward their school.
senses.definition: a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution
senses.definitionSentence: Student is a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution.
senses.definitionZh: 在教育机构注册的学习者。
senses.exampleZh: 布鲁克林学院的学生对学校抱有矛盾的态度。

senses.example: Of course, it goes without saying that no student of ideas can justifiably ignore the contemporary scene.
senses.definition: a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
senses.definitionSentence: Student is a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines.
senses.definitionZh: 一个有学问的人（尤其是人文学科）；通过长期学习掌握一门或多门学科的人。
senses.exampleZh: 当然，不言而喻，任何思想学者都不能理直气壮地忽视当代场景。

senses.example: The sensitive often seems to smell definite odors, too, or subjectively feels emotions.
senses.definition: inhale the odor of; perceive by the olfactory sense
senses.definitionSentence: To smell means to inhale the odor of; perceive by the olfactory sense.
senses.definitionZh: 吸入以下气味；通过嗅觉来感知。
senses.exampleZh: 敏感的人似乎也经常闻到明确的气味，或者主观地感受到情绪。

senses.example: Horse smell was very strong, and he could hear the crunch of grain being ground between strong jaws.
senses.definition: any property detected by the olfactory system
senses.definitionSentence: Smell means any property detected by the olfactory system.
senses.definitionZh: 嗅觉系统检测到的任何特性。
senses.exampleZh: 马的气味非常强烈，他能听到强有力的下巴之间磨碎谷物的嘎吱声。

senses.example: Single chrysanthemums resemble daisies and may have more than one row of petals.
senses.definition: used of flowers having usually only one row or whorl of petals
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as single is used of flowers having usually only one row or whorl of petals.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为“单一”的事物通常用于仅具有一排或一圈花瓣的花朵。
senses.exampleZh: 单朵菊花类似于雏菊，可能有不止一排花瓣。

senses.example: Are you married or single?
senses.definition: not married or related to the unmarried state
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as single is not married or related to the unmarried state.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为单身的事物并未结婚或与未婚状态有关。
senses.exampleZh: 您已婚还是单身？

senses.example: The closure caused a serious loss of business, reducing weekly sales by almost half.
senses.definition: gradual decline in amount or activity
senses.definitionSentence: Loss means gradual decline in amount or activity.
senses.definitionZh: 数量或活动逐渐下降。
senses.exampleZh: 关闭导致业务严重损失，每周销售额减少了近一半。

senses.example: Assistant coach John Cudmore described victory as `` a good feeling, I think, on the part of the coaches and the players.
senses.definition: the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people
senses.definitionSentence: Feeling is the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people.
senses.definitionZh: 一个地方或情况的总体氛围及其对人们的影响。
senses.exampleZh: 助理教练约翰·库德莫尔将胜利描述为“我认为，对于教练和球员来说，这是一种很好的感觉。”

senses.example: When you buy these stocks you are gambling.
senses.definition: take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome
senses.definitionSentence: To gamble means to take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome.
senses.definitionZh: 冒险以期获得有利的结果。
senses.exampleZh: 当您购买这些股票时，您就是在赌博。

senses.example: Launching an untested drug without full safety trials would be a dangerous gamble with patients' lives.
senses.definition: a risky act or venture
senses.definitionSentence: Gamble is a risky act or venture.
senses.definitionZh: 一种冒险行为或冒险。
senses.exampleZh: 在没有进行全面安全试验的情况下推出未经测试的药物将是一场拿患者生命进行的危险赌博。

senses.example: He turned the paper over so the writing wouldn't show.
senses.definition: letters or symbols that are written or imprinted on a surface to represent the sounds or words of a language
senses.definitionSentence: Writing means letters or symbols that are written or imprinted on a surface to represent the sounds or words of a language.
senses.definitionZh: 书写或压印在表面上以表示语言的声音或单词的字母或符号。
senses.exampleZh: 他把纸翻过来，这样字迹就看不到了。

senses.definition: the act of creating written works
senses.definitionSentence: Writing is the act of creating written works.
senses.definitionZh: 创作书面作品的活动；写作。
senses.example: Writing helps her organize complex ideas before a presentation.
senses.exampleZh: 写作帮助她在演讲前整理复杂的想法。

senses.example: Our children share a love of music.
senses.definition: have in common
senses.definitionSentence: To share means to have in common.
senses.definitionZh: 有共同点。
senses.exampleZh: 我们的孩子都热爱音乐。

senses.example: NBC had gathered a lot of historical material which it was eager to share.
senses.definition: give out as one's portion or share
senses.definitionSentence: To share means to give out as one's portion or share.
senses.definitionZh: 把自己的一份分给别人。
senses.exampleZh: NBC 收集了许多渴望分享的历史材料。

senses.example: He wanted his share in cash.
senses.definition: assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group
senses.definitionSentence: Share means assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group.
senses.definitionZh: 属于个人或团体、属于个人或团体或由个人或团体贡献的资产。
senses.exampleZh: 他想要现金。

senses.example: She earns a lot in her new job.
senses.definition: earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages
senses.definitionSentence: To earn means to earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages.
senses.definitionZh: 通过某些商业或商业交易赚取收入；以薪水或工资的形式赚取。
senses.exampleZh: 她在新工作中赚了很多钱。

senses.example: He sent a three-word message.
senses.definition: a communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled
senses.definitionSentence: Message is a communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled.
senses.definitionZh: 一种书面、口头或信号形式的通信（通常很简短）。
senses.exampleZh: 他发送了一条三个字的消息。

senses.example: The schools comply with federal standards.
senses.definition: a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
senses.definitionSentence: Standard is a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated.
senses.definitionZh: 比较的基础；可以评估其他事物的参考点。
senses.exampleZh: 学校符合联邦标准。

senses.example: These deductions may not be claimed if you elect to use the Standard Deduction or tax Table.
senses.definition: conforming to or constituting a standard of measurement or value; or of the usual or regularized or accepted kind
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as standard is conforming to or constituting a standard of measurement or value; or of the usual or regularized or accepted kind.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为标准的事物符合或构成测量或价值标准；或通常的或正规化的或接受的类型。
senses.exampleZh: 如果您选择使用标准扣除额或税表，则可能无法申请这些扣除额。

senses.example: The mechanic replaced the custom part with a standard component sold by most suppliers.
senses.definition: regularly and widely used or sold
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as standard is regularly and widely used or sold.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为标准的东西经常被广泛使用或销售。
senses.exampleZh: 机械师用大多数供应商销售的标准组件替换了定制零件。

senses.example: An injury forced Skorich to quit after the 1948 season.
senses.definition: go away or leave
senses.definitionSentence: To quit means to go away or leave.
senses.definitionZh: 离开或离开。
senses.exampleZh: 受伤迫使斯科里奇在 1948 年赛季结束后退出。

senses.example: She quit the committee when its goals changed.
senses.definition: turn away from; give up
senses.definitionSentence: To quit means to turn away from; give up.
senses.definitionZh: 转身离开；放弃。
senses.exampleZh: 委员会的目标改变后，她退出了委员会。

senses.example: Quit teasing your little brother.
senses.definition: put an end to a state or an activity
senses.definitionSentence: To quit means to put an end to a state or an activity.
senses.definitionZh: 结束某种状态或活动。
senses.exampleZh: 别再逗你弟弟了。

senses.example: Although they trailed by four goals, the players refused to quit before the final whistle.
senses.definition: give up in the face of defeat or lack of hope; admit defeat
senses.definitionSentence: To quit means to give up in the face of defeat of lacking hope; admit defeat.
senses.definitionZh: 在没有希望的失败面前放弃；认输。
senses.exampleZh: 尽管他们落后四球，但球员们在终场哨响前拒绝退出。

senses.example: In Poughkeepsie, N. Y., in 1952, a Roman Catholic hospital presented seven Protestant physicians with an ultimatum to quit the Planned Parenthood Federation or to resign from the hospital staff.
senses.definition: give up or retire from a position
senses.definitionSentence: To quit means to give up or retire from a position.
senses.definitionZh: 放弃或从某个职位退休。
senses.exampleZh: 1952 年，纽约州波基普西市的一家罗马天主教医院向 7 名新教医生发出最后通牒，要求其退出计划生育联合会或辞去医院工作人员职务。

senses.example: The government railroaded the mining region, laying tracks that connected every major town to the port.
senses.definition: supply with railroad lines
senses.definitionSentence: To railroad means to supply with railroad lines.
senses.definitionZh: 提供铁路线。
senses.exampleZh: 政府在矿区修建了铁路，铺设了将每个主要城镇与港口连接起来的轨道。

senses.example: Ludie hopped rides on freight cars, and was chased by Mr. Yankton, the railroad guard.
senses.definition: line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight
senses.definitionSentence: Railroad means line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight.
senses.definitionZh: 负责运营拉动乘客或货物的火车运输系统的商业组织。
senses.exampleZh: Ludie 跳上货车，被铁路警卫 Yankton 先生追赶。

senses.definition: a collection of things sharing a common attribute
senses.definitionSentence: A collection of things sharing a common attribute.
senses.definitionZh: 具有共同属性的事物的集合。
senses.example: Biologists place animals with shared characteristics in the same class.
senses.exampleZh: 生物学家将具有共同特征的动物归为同一类。

senses.example: And it is precisely in this poorer economic class that one finds, and has always found, the most racial friction.
senses.definition: people having the same social, economic, or educational status
senses.definitionSentence: Class means people having the same social, economic, or educational status.
senses.definitionZh: 具有相同社会、经济或教育地位的人。
senses.exampleZh: 正是在这个较贫穷的经济阶层中，人们发现并且一直发现最严重的种族摩擦。

senses.definition: a group of students who are taught together
senses.definitionSentence: A class is a group of students who are taught together.
senses.definitionZh: 一起接受教学的一组学生；班级。
senses.example: The class meets in the science room every Tuesday morning.
senses.exampleZh: 这个班级每周二上午在科学教室上课。

senses.example: Subtracting seven from twelve leaves a difference of five.
senses.definition: the number that remains after subtraction; the number that when added to the subtrahend gives the minuend
senses.definitionSentence: Difference is the number that remains after subtraction; the number that when added to the subtrahend gives the minuend.
senses.definitionZh: 差值为相减后剩下的数；与减数相加得到被减数的数字。
senses.exampleZh: 十二减去七，差是五。

senses.example: I said that it did n't make any difference to me either, as far as I knew.
senses.definition: a disagreement or argument about something important
senses.definitionSentence: Difference is a disagreement or argument about something important.
senses.definitionZh: 对重要事物的分歧或争论。
senses.exampleZh: 据我所知，我说过这对我来说也没有任何区别。

senses.definition: the quality of being unlike or dissimilar
senses.definitionSentence: A difference is the quality of being unlike or dissimilar.
senses.definitionZh: 彼此不相同的性质；差异。
senses.example: The two plans share the same goal but differ in cost and timing.
senses.exampleZh: 这两个方案目标相同，但成本和时间安排不同。

senses.example: The mate, Robert Juet, who had kept the journal on the half Moon, was experienced - but he was a bitter old man, ready to complain or desert at any opportunity.
senses.definition: a daily written record of (usually personal) experiences and observations
senses.definitionSentence: Journal is a daily written record of (usually personal) experiences and observations.
senses.definitionZh: （通常是个人）经验和观察的每日书面记录。
senses.exampleZh: 大副，罗伯特·尤特（Robert Juet），在半个月亮上保留了日记，经验丰富 - 但他是一个苦涩的老人，随时准备抱怨或抛弃。

senses.example: He reads the medical journals.
senses.definition: a periodical dedicated to a particular subject
senses.definitionSentence: Journal is a periodical dedicated to a particular subject.
senses.definitionZh: 专门针对特定主题的期刊。
senses.exampleZh: 他阅读医学期刊。

senses.example: Rebs who owned slaves occasionally would include in their letters admonitions or greetings to members of the Negro community.
senses.definition: a person who is owned by someone
senses.definitionSentence: Slave is a person who is owned by someone.
senses.definitionZh: 某人所拥有的人。
senses.exampleZh: 拥有奴隶的共和党人偶尔会在信中对黑人社区成员提出警告或问候。

senses.example: She slaved over the report all weekend, working long hours without rest.
senses.definition: work very hard, like a slave
senses.definitionSentence: To slave means to work very hard, like a slave.
senses.definitionZh: 像奴隶一样努力工作。
senses.exampleZh: 她整个周末都在埋头苦干这份报告，长时间工作，没有休息。

senses.example: As in the theory of perception, established in psycho-physiology, the eye is recognized as an integral part of the brain.
senses.definition: that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord
senses.definitionSentence: Brain means that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord.
senses.definitionZh: 中枢神经系统的一部分，包括所有高级神经中枢；封闭在头骨内；与脊髓连续。
senses.exampleZh: 正如在心理生理学中建立的感知理论一样，眼睛被认为是大脑的一个组成部分。

senses.example: Use your brain to work through the logic puzzle instead of choosing an answer at random.
senses.definition: that which is responsible for one's thoughts and feelings; the seat of the faculty of reason
senses.definitionSentence: Brain means that which is responsible for one's thoughts and feelings; the seat of the faculty of reason.
senses.definitionZh: 负责一个人的思想和感受；理性学院的所在地。
senses.exampleZh: 用你的大脑来解决逻辑难题，而不是随机选择答案。

senses.example: She looked confused at this, and I felt sure it had been a wrong response for me to make.
senses.definition: a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation
senses.definitionSentence: Response is a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation.
senses.definitionZh: 为答复问题、请求、批评或指控而做出的声明（口头或书面）。
senses.exampleZh: 她对此感到困惑，我确信我的回答是错误的。

senses.example: When we consider the electronic industry potential for human betterment, the prospect is staggering.
senses.definition: the inherent capacity for coming into being
senses.definitionSentence: Potential is the inherent capacity for coming into being.
senses.definitionZh: 形成的内在能力。
senses.exampleZh: 当我们考虑电子行业改善人类福祉的潜力时，前景是惊人的。

senses.example: Just as Holmes the eccentric stands behind Holmes the detective, so Holmes the potential criminal lurks behind both.
senses.definition: existing in possibility
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as potential is existing in possibility.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为潜力的事物存在于可能性中。
senses.exampleZh: 正如古怪的福尔摩斯站在侦探福尔摩斯身后一样，潜在的罪犯福尔摩斯也潜伏在两人的身后。

senses.example: A good site for the school.
senses.definition: the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
senses.definitionSentence: Site is the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located).
senses.definitionZh: 某物位于（或将位于）的一块土地。
senses.exampleZh: 学校的好网站。

senses.definition: a computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages
senses.definitionSentence: A site can be a computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages.
senses.definitionZh: 由连接互联网的计算机维护的一组网页；网站。
senses.example: The museum launched a site with opening hours, maps, and ticket information.
senses.exampleZh: 博物馆上线了一个提供开放时间、地图和票务信息的网站。

senses.example: Postmaster General Burleson set about to protect the American people against radical propaganda that might be spread through the mails.
senses.definition: cause to become widely known
senses.definitionSentence: To spread means to cause to become widely known.
senses.definitionZh: 广为人知。
senses.exampleZh: 邮政局长伯勒森着手保护美国人民免受可能通过邮件传播的激进宣传的影响。

senses.example: He spread fertilizer over the lawn.
senses.definition: strew or distribute over an area
senses.definitionSentence: To spread means to strew or distribute over an area.
senses.definitionZh: 散布或分布在一个区域上。
senses.exampleZh: 他在草坪上撒了肥料。

senses.example: The rapid spread of the wildfire carried flames across thousands of hectares.
senses.definition: act of extending over a wider scope or expanse of space or time
senses.definitionSentence: Spread means act of extending over a wider scope or expanse of space or time.
senses.definitionZh: 在更广泛的范围或空间或时间上延伸的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 野火迅速蔓延，火势蔓延数千公顷。

senses.example: He had the attitude that work was fun.
senses.definition: a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways
senses.definitionSentence: Attitude is a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways.
senses.definitionZh: 一种复杂的心理状态，涉及信念、感受、价值观以及以某种方式行事的倾向。
senses.exampleZh: 他的态度是工作很有趣。

senses.example: The actor struck just the right attitude.
senses.definition: a theatrical pose created for effect
senses.definitionSentence: Attitude is a theatrical pose created for effect.
senses.definitionZh: 为达到效果而创建的戏剧姿势。
senses.exampleZh: 演员的态度恰到好处。

senses.example: Flowers, stones, and small creatures, living and dead.
senses.definition: pertaining to living persons
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as living is pertaining to living persons.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“活着”的东西与活着的人有关。
senses.exampleZh: 花朵、石头和小生物，活的和死的。

senses.example: The living image of her mother.
senses.definition: true to life; lifelike
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as living is true to life; lifelike.
senses.definitionZh: 与真实事物十分相像；栩栩如生的。
senses.exampleZh: 这幅画像把她母亲画得栩栩如生。

senses.example: Generally, the same level of living costs less in the country than in the city.
senses.definition: the condition of living or the state of being alive
senses.definitionSentence: Living is the condition of living or the state of being alive.
senses.definitionZh: 活着的条件或活着的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 一般来说，相同水平的生活成本在乡村比在城市要低。

senses.example: He earns his living by repairing bicycles, and that income pays for food and rent.

senses.example: The President was especially concerned about the deadlock in the nuclear test ban negotiations at Geneva.
senses.definition: be on the mind of
senses.definitionSentence: To concern means to be on the mind of.
senses.definitionZh: 关注。
senses.exampleZh: 总统特别关注日内瓦禁止核试验谈判的僵局。

senses.definitionSentence: To gain a point or goal in a game or competition.
senses.definitionZh: 在比赛或竞赛中取得分数或进球。
senses.example: The striker scored the winning goal in the final minute of the match.
senses.exampleZh: 前锋在比赛最后一分钟攻入制胜球。
senses.definition: To gain a point or goal in a game or competition.

senses.definitionSentence: To cut or scratch a shallow line into a surface.
senses.definitionZh: 在物体表面切出或划出一道浅痕。
senses.example: The carpenter scored a straight line across the wood before making the cut.
senses.exampleZh: 木匠下锯前先在木料表面划出一条直线。
senses.definition: To cut or scratch a shallow line into a surface.

senses.example: What was your score on your homework?
senses.definition: a number or letter indicating quality (especially of a student's performance)
senses.definitionSentence: Score is a number or letter indicating quality (especially of a student's performance).
senses.definitionZh: 表示质量（尤其是学生表现）的数字或字母。
senses.exampleZh: 你的家庭作业得分是多少？

senses.example: The carpenter cut a small score into the wood to record each completed piece.
senses.definition: a slight surface cut (especially a notch that is made to keep a tally)
senses.definitionSentence: Score is a slight surface cut (especially a notch that is made to keep a tally).
senses.definitionZh: 轻微的表面切割（尤其是用于记录计数的凹口）。
senses.exampleZh: 木匠在木头上切了一个小刻痕以记录每个完成的部件。

senses.definition: a collection containing a variety of sorts of things
senses.definitionSentence: A collection containing a variety of sorts of things.
senses.definitionZh: 包含各种事物的集合。
senses.example: The market sells a variety of fruit, including apples, mangoes, grapes, and oranges.
senses.exampleZh: 市场出售各种水果，包括苹果、芒果、葡萄和橙子。

senses.example: The range and variety of his work is amazing.
senses.definition: noticeable heterogeneity
senses.definitionSentence: Variety means noticeable heterogeneity.
senses.definitionZh: 明显的异质性。
senses.exampleZh: 他的作品的范围和多样性令人惊叹。

senses.example: Bach was unique in his handling of counterpoint.
senses.definition: radically distinctive and without equal
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as unique is radically distinctive and without equal.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为独特的东西是完全独特且无与伦比的。
senses.exampleZh: 巴赫在对位法的处理上是独一无二的。

senses.example: In turn each of us in our own way depended, as gods do, upon his worship ''.
senses.definition: be contingent upon (something that is elided)
senses.definitionSentence: To depend means to be contingent upon (something that is elided).
senses.definitionZh: 取决于（被忽略的东西）。
senses.exampleZh: 反过来，我们每个人都以自己的方式依赖于他的崇拜，就像神一样。

senses.meaning: 原子核的，核能的，原子能的
senses.example: We simply can n't tolerate further Russian weapons, including the possibility of long-range nuclear missiles, being located in Cuba.
senses.definition: (weapons) deriving destructive energy from the release of atomic energy
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as nuclear is (weapons) deriving destructive energy from the release of atomic energy.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为核的东西（武器）从原子能的释放中获得破坏性能量。
senses.exampleZh: 我们根本无法容忍俄罗斯在古巴部署更多武器，包括远程核导弹的可能性。

senses.example: The belief in immortality, where held, functions as a redress for the ills and disappointments of the here and now.
senses.definition: any cognitive content held as true
senses.definitionSentence: Belief means any cognitive content held as true.
senses.definitionZh: 任何被认为是真实的认知内容。
senses.exampleZh: 对不朽的信仰，如果持有的话，可以作为对此时此地的疾病和失望的补救。

senses.example: How are you spending your summer vacation?
senses.definition: pass time in a specific way
senses.definitionSentence: To spend means to pass time in a specific way.
senses.definitionZh: 以特定的方式打发时间。
senses.exampleZh: 你的暑假过得怎么样？

senses.example: In the $ 40000000 budget that has been submitted for Congressional approval, $ 26000000 would be spent through universities and private voluntary agencies.
senses.definition: pay out
senses.definitionSentence: To spend means to pay out.
senses.definitionZh: 支付。
senses.exampleZh: 在已提交国会批准的 4000 万美元预算中，2600 万美元将通过大学和私人志愿机构支出。

senses.example: I spend my pocket money in two days.
senses.definition: spend completely
senses.definitionSentence: To spend means to spend completely.
senses.definitionZh: 完全花费。
senses.exampleZh: 我两天就把零用钱花光了。

senses.example: It must be conceded that his native land provided Prokofieff with many of the necessary conditions for great creative incentive:.
senses.definition: absolutely essential
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as necessary is absolutely essential.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为必要的东西是绝对必要的。
senses.exampleZh: 必须承认，他的祖国为普罗科菲耶夫提供了许多激发创造力的必要条件：。

senses.example: The necessary consequences of one's actions.
senses.definition: unavoidably determined by prior circumstances
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as necessary is unavoidably determined by prior circumstances.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为必要的事物不可避免地由先前的情况决定。
senses.exampleZh: 一个人的行为的必然后果。

senses.example: For winter camping, a waterproof sleeping bag is an absolute necessary rather than an optional luxury.
senses.definition: anything indispensable
senses.definitionSentence: Necessary means anything indispensable.
senses.definitionZh: 任何不可缺少的事情。
senses.exampleZh: 对于冬季露营，防水睡袋是绝对必要的，而不是可选的奢侈品。

senses.example: Retirement meant dropping out of a whole network of people who had been part of my life.
senses.definition: an interconnected system of things or people
senses.definitionSentence: Network is an interconnected system of things or people.
senses.definitionZh: 事物或人的互连系统。
senses.exampleZh: 退休意味着退出我生活中的整个人际网络。

senses.example: The networks compete to broadcast important sports events.
senses.definition: (broadcasting) a communication system consisting of a group of broadcasting stations that all transmit the same programs
senses.definitionSentence: Network means (broadcasting) a communication system consisting of a group of broadcasting stations that all transmit the same programs.
senses.definitionZh: （广播）由一组传输相同节目的广播站组成的通信系统。
senses.exampleZh: 各网络竞相转播重要体育赛事。

senses.definition: communicate with and within a group to build useful contacts
senses.definitionSentence: To network means to communicate with and within a group to build useful contacts.
senses.definitionZh: 与群体中的人交流并建立有用的人际联系。
senses.example: She networked with local designers at the professional workshop.
senses.exampleZh: 她在专业研讨会上与当地设计师建立了联系。

senses.example: Certainly every educator involved in interior design should be a member and active in the work of one of these organizations.
senses.definition: a group of people who work together
senses.definitionSentence: Organization is a group of people who work together.
senses.definitionZh: 一群一起工作的人。
senses.exampleZh: 当然，每一位参与室内设计的教育工作者都应该是这些组织之一的成员并积极参与其工作。

senses.example: Dashiell Hammett resolved this contradiction by ceasing to write mystery stories and turning to other pursuits.
senses.definition: a search for an alternative that meets cognitive criteria
senses.definitionSentence: Pursuit is a search for an alternative that meets cognitive criteria.
senses.definitionZh: 对满足认知标准的替代方案的搜索。
senses.exampleZh: 达希尔·哈米特 (Dashiell Hammett) 通过停止写悬疑小说并转向其他追求来解决这一矛盾。

senses.example: They built a large plant to manufacture automobiles.
senses.definition: buildings for carrying on industrial labor
senses.definitionSentence: Plant means buildings for carrying on industrial labor.
senses.definitionZh: 进行工业劳动的建筑物。
senses.exampleZh: 他们建造了一座大型工厂来制造汽车。

senses.example: The result is that I included 70 animal names, but Swadesh only 4; and somewhat similarly for plants, 16 as against 4.
senses.definition: (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion
senses.definitionSentence: Plant means (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion.
senses.definitionZh: （植物学）缺乏运动能力的活有机体。
senses.exampleZh: 结果是我包含了 70 个动物名称，但 Swadesh 只有 4 个；对于植物来说也有些类似，16 与 4。

senses.example: Let's plant flowers in the garden.
senses.definition: put or set (seeds, seedlings, or plants) into the ground
senses.definitionSentence: To plant means to put or set (seeds, seedlings, or plants) into the ground.
senses.definitionZh: 将（种子、幼苗或植物）放入或种植到地下。
senses.exampleZh: 让我们在花园里种花吧。

senses.example: Wildlife officers planted young trout in the river to rebuild the fish population.
senses.definition: place into a river
senses.definitionSentence: To plant means to place into a river.
senses.definitionZh: 放入河流中。
senses.exampleZh: 野生动物保护官员在河中种植了幼鳟鱼以重建鱼类种群。

senses.example: "eternal truths will be neither true nor eternal unless they have fresh meaning for every new social situation"- Franklin D.Roosevelt.
senses.definition: the general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time
senses.definitionSentence: Situation is the general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time.
senses.definitionZh: 事物的一般状态；给定时间的情况的组合。
senses.exampleZh: “除非永恒的真理对于每一个新的社会情况都有新的意义，否则它们既不是真实的也不是永恒的”——富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

senses.example: The unpleasant situation (or position) of having to choose between two evils.
senses.definition: a condition or position in which you find yourself
senses.definitionSentence: Situation is a condition or position in which you find yourself.
senses.definitionZh: 您发现自己所处的状况或位置。
senses.exampleZh: 必须在两种邪恶之间做出选择的不愉快的情况（或位置）。

senses.example: A cat's natural aversion to water.
senses.definition: unthinking; prompted by (or as if by) instinct
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as natural is unthinking; prompted by (or as if by) instinct.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为自然的东西是不假思索的；由（或仿佛由）本能推动。
senses.exampleZh: 猫天生厌恶水。

senses.example: They speak a strange dialect.
senses.definition: use language
senses.definitionSentence: To speak means to use language.
senses.definitionZh: 使用语言。
senses.exampleZh: 他们说一种奇怪的方言。

senses.definitionSentence: To include someone or something as an important or prominent part.
senses.definitionZh: 把某人或某物作为重要或突出的部分纳入其中。
senses.example: The exhibition features early photographs of the city and letters from its first settlers.
senses.exampleZh: 展览重点展示这座城市的早期照片和首批定居者的书信。
senses.definition: To include someone or something as an important or prominent part.

senses.example: The map showed roads and other features.
senses.definition: a prominent attribute or aspect of something
senses.definitionSentence: Feature is a prominent attribute or aspect of something.
senses.definitionZh: 事物的突出属性或方面。
senses.exampleZh: 地图显示了道路和其他特征。

senses.example: An expression of pleasure crossed his features.
senses.definition: the characteristic parts of a person's face: eyes and nose and mouth and chin
senses.definitionSentence: Feature is the characteristic parts of a person's face: eyes and nose and mouth and chin.
senses.definitionZh: 人脸的特征部分：眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴和下巴。
senses.exampleZh: 他的脸上掠过一丝喜悦的表情。

senses.example: A photograph is a translation of a scene onto a two-dimensional surface.
senses.definition: the act of changing in form or shape or appearance
senses.definitionSentence: Translation is the act of changing in form or shape or appearance.
senses.definitionZh: 改变形式、形状或外观的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 照片是场景到二维表面的平移。

senses.definition: the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field
senses.definitionSentence: The property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field.
senses.definitionZh: 物体在引力场中具有重量的特性。
senses.example: A balance measures an object's mass in grams or kilograms.
senses.exampleZh: 天平测量物体的质量（以克或千克为单位）。

senses.example: The great, crushing ice masses coming into view made him sound like the voice of pure reason.
senses.definition: a body of matter without definite shape
senses.definitionSentence: Mass is a body of matter without definite shape.
senses.definitionZh: 没有确定形状的物质体。
senses.exampleZh: 巨大的、破碎的冰块映入眼帘，让他听起来像是纯粹理性的声音。

senses.example: A mass movement brought thousands of separate local groups together behind one national campaign.
senses.definition: formed of separate units gathered into a mass or whole
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as mass is formed of separate units gathered into a mass or whole.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为质量的东西是由聚集成质量或整体的单独单元形成的。
senses.exampleZh: 一场群众运动将数千个不同的地方团体聚集在一起支持一项全国性运动。

senses.example: Crowds were massing outside the palace.
senses.definition: join together into a mass or collect or form a mass
senses.definitionSentence: To mass means to join together into a mass or collect or form a mass.
senses.definitionZh: 连接在一起成为一团或聚集或形成一团。
senses.exampleZh: 人群聚集在宫殿外。

senses.definition: a large number, amount, or extent
senses.definitionSentence: A mass can refer to a large number, amount, or extent of something.
senses.definitionZh: 大量的人或物；很大的数量、程度或范围。
senses.example: A mass of documents arrived before the archive closed.
senses.exampleZh: 档案馆关闭前收到了大量文件。

senses.example: She achieved her goal despite setbacks.
senses.definition: to gain with effort
senses.definitionSentence: Achieve means to gain with effort.
senses.definitionZh: 通过努力而获得。
senses.exampleZh: 尽管遇到挫折，她还是实现了目标。

senses.example: We agreed on the terms of the settlement.
senses.definition: be in accord; be in agreement
senses.definitionSentence: To agree means to be in accord; be in agreement.
senses.definitionZh: 一致；达成一致。
senses.exampleZh: 我们同意和解条款。

senses.example: The trend of the stock market.
senses.definition: a general direction in which something tends to move
senses.definitionSentence: Trend is a general direction in which something tends to move.
senses.definitionZh: 事物趋于移动的总体方向。
senses.exampleZh: 股市走势。

senses.example: New England academies welcome fugitives from the provinces, South as well as West.
senses.definition: the territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation
senses.definitionSentence: Province is the territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation.
senses.definitionZh: 一个国家的行政区之一所占据的领土。
senses.exampleZh: 新英格兰学院欢迎来自南部和西部各省的逃亡者。

senses.example: In soccer, eleven players pass and kick the ball toward the opposing team's goal.
senses.definition: a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal
senses.definitionSentence: Soccer is a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal.
senses.definitionZh: 一项由 11 名球员组成的两队尝试将球踢入对方球门的足球比赛。
senses.exampleZh: 在足球比赛中，十一名球员将球传向对方球队的球门。

senses.example: His financial success encouraged him to look for a wife.
senses.definition: spur on
senses.definitionSentence: To encourage means to spur on.
senses.definitionZh: 鞭策。
senses.exampleZh: 他的经济成功鼓励他寻找妻子。

senses.example: Foreign aid programs were revamped to give greater emphasis to economic aid and to encourage political reform in recipient nations.
senses.definition: contribute to the progress or growth of
senses.definitionSentence: To encourage means to contribute to the progress or growth of.
senses.definitionZh: 为……的进步或成长做出贡献。
senses.exampleZh: 对外援助计划进行了修改，更加重视经济援助并鼓励受援国进行政治改革。

senses.definition: make a promise or commitment
senses.definitionSentence: Make a promise or commitment.
senses.definitionZh: 作出承诺或承诺。
senses.example: The contractor promised to finish the repairs before the school reopened.
senses.exampleZh: 承包商承诺在学校重新开放之前完成维修工作。

senses.example: This was nearly completed May 23, 1901 with a promise of lights by June 10, but the first light did not go on until September 28.
senses.definition: a verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future
senses.definitionSentence: Promise is a verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future.
senses.definitionZh: 一个人对另一个人同意在未来做（或不做）某事的口头承诺。
senses.exampleZh: 该工程于 1901 年 5 月 23 日几乎完成，并承诺在 6 月 10 日亮灯，但直到 9 月 28 日第一盏灯才亮起。

senses.definition: an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole
senses.definitionSentence: An investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole.
senses.definitionZh: 对整体的组成部分及其构成整体的关系的研究。
senses.example: Laboratory analysis of the water identified three harmful chemicals.
senses.exampleZh: 实验室分析水发现了三种有害化学物质。

senses.example: During Freudian analysis, the patient explored childhood memories and unconscious motives with her therapist.
senses.definition: a set of techniques for exploring underlying motives and a method of treating various mental disorders; based on the theories of Sigmund Freud
senses.definitionSentence: Analysis is a set of techniques for exploring underlying motives and a method of treating various mental disorders; based on the theories of Sigmund Freud.
senses.definitionZh: 一套探索潜在动机的技术和治疗各种精神障碍的方法；基于西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的理论。
senses.exampleZh: 在弗洛伊德分析期间，患者与治疗师一起探索童年记忆和无意识动机。

senses.example: The force of the authors ' analysis (if indeed it has any force) can be felt by the reader, I believe, only after three questions have been successfully answered.
senses.definition: the abstract separation of a whole into its constituent parts in order to study the parts and their relations
senses.definitionSentence: Analysis is the abstract separation of a whole into its constituent parts in order to study the parts and their relations.
senses.definitionZh: 将整体抽象地分离为其组成部分，以研究各部分及其关系。
senses.exampleZh: 我认为，只有在三个问题都得到圆满回答之后，读者才能感受到作者分析的说服力（如果它确有说服力的话）。

senses.example: I have to translate when my in-laws from Austria visit the U.S.
senses.definition: restate (words) from one language into another language
senses.definitionSentence: To translate means to restate (words) from one language into another language.
senses.definitionZh: 将（单词）从一种语言重述为另一种语言。
senses.exampleZh: 当我来自奥地利的姻亲访问美国时，我必须翻译。

senses.example: Braque translated collage into oil.
senses.definition: change from one form or medium into another
senses.definitionSentence: To translate means to change from one form or medium into another.
senses.definitionZh: 从一种形式或媒介转变为另一种形式或媒介。
senses.exampleZh: 布拉克把拼贴技法转化为油画形式。

senses.meaning: 熟练的，内行的，有经验的
senses.example: He was an expert florist, tenderly dextrous in the arrangement of bouquets and wreaths.
senses.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as expert is having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓专家是指拥有或表现出知识、技能和才能。
senses.exampleZh: 他是一位花艺专家，在花束和花圈的布置方面非常娴熟。

senses.example: But marriage experts say that such mutual contribution and mutual joy are seldom achieved.
senses.definition: a person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully
senses.definitionSentence: Expert is a person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully.
senses.definitionZh: 具有特殊知识或能力且表现熟练的人。
senses.exampleZh: 但婚姻专家表示，这种相互贡献、相互欢乐的情况很少能实现。

senses.example: His purpose, however, was not to establish an empire, but to assert the principle of divine justice.
senses.definition: the quality of being just or fair
senses.definitionSentence: Justice is the quality of being just or fair.
senses.definitionZh: 公正或公平的品质。
senses.exampleZh: 然而，他的目的不是建立帝国，而是维护神圣正义的原则。

senses.example: Three weeks later following his recovery, armed with a writ issued by the Catskill justice on affidavits prepared by the district attorney, Cook and Russell rode to arrest Martinez.
senses.definition: a public official authorized to decide questions brought before a court of justice
senses.definitionSentence: Justice is a public official authorized to decide questions brought before a court of justice.
senses.definitionZh: 被授权决定向法院提出的问题的公职人员。
senses.exampleZh: 康复三周后，库克和拉塞尔带着卡茨基尔法官根据地区检察官准备的宣誓书签发的令状，骑马逮捕了马丁内斯。

senses.example: He applied for a leave of absence.
senses.definition: ask (for something)
senses.definitionSentence: To apply means to ask (for something).
senses.definitionZh: 请求（某事）。
senses.exampleZh: 他申请了休假。

senses.example: Doctors applied the new treatment to patients whose infections had resisted standard antibiotics.
senses.definition: avail oneself to
senses.definitionSentence: To apply means to avail oneself to.
senses.definitionZh: 利用。
senses.exampleZh: 医生对感染对标准抗生素有抵抗力的患者应用了新的治疗方法。

senses.example: The same laws apply to you!
senses.definition: be pertinent or relevant or applicable
senses.definitionSentence: To apply means to be pertinent or relevant or applicable.
senses.definitionZh: 相关、相关或适用。
senses.exampleZh: 同样的法律适用于您！

senses.definition: apply a substance to a surface
senses.definitionSentence: To apply can mean to put a substance onto a surface.
senses.definitionZh: 把某种物质涂敷到表面上。
senses.example: He applied a thin coat of wax to the wooden table.
senses.exampleZh: 他在木桌上涂了一层薄薄的蜡。

senses.example: He spent hours looking for the source of that quotation.
senses.definition: a publication (or a passage from a publication) that is referred to
senses.definitionSentence: Source is a publication (or a passage from a publication) that is referred to.
senses.definitionZh: 引用的出版物（或出版物中的段落）。
senses.exampleZh: 他花了几个小时寻找该引文的来源。

senses.example: Burning coal is a major source of carbon dioxide because combustion releases the gas into the atmosphere.
senses.definition: (technology) a process by which energy or a substance enters a system
senses.definitionSentence: Source means (technology) a process by which energy or a substance enters a system.
senses.definitionZh: （技术）能量或物质进入系统的过程。
senses.exampleZh: 燃煤是二氧化碳的主要来源，因为燃烧会将气体释放到大气中。

senses.example: Splenomegaly was first noted in 1956, and a sternal marrow biopsy at that time showed `` scattered foci of fibrosis '' suggestive of myelofibrosis.
senses.definition: a central point or locus of an infection in an organism
senses.definitionSentence: Focus is a central point or locus of an infection in an organism.
senses.definitionZh: 生物体感染的中心点或部位。
senses.exampleZh: 脾肿大于 1956 年首次被发现，当时的胸骨骨髓活检显示“分散的纤维化病灶”，提示骨髓纤维化。

senses.example: Please focus on your studies and not on your hobbies.
senses.definition: direct one's attention on something
senses.definitionSentence: To focus means to direct one's attention on something.
senses.definitionZh: 将注意力集中在某件事上。
senses.exampleZh: 请专注于你的学习而不是你的爱好。

senses.example: Focus the light on this image.
senses.definition: cause to converge on or toward a central point
senses.definitionSentence: To focus means to cause to converge on or toward a central point.
senses.definitionZh: 会聚在或朝向中心点。
senses.exampleZh: 将光线聚焦在该图像上。

senses.definition: be asleep
senses.definitionSentence: Be asleep.
senses.definitionZh: 睡着了。
senses.example: After working through the night, he slept for ten hours without waking.
senses.exampleZh: 通宵工作后，他睡了十个小时，没有醒来。

senses.example: This tent sleeps six people.
senses.definition: be able to accommodate for sleeping
senses.definitionSentence: To sleep means to be able to accommodate for sleeping.
senses.definitionZh: 能够适应睡觉。
senses.exampleZh: 这个帐篷可容纳六人入住。

senses.example: He didn't get enough sleep last night.
senses.definition: a natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended
senses.definitionSentence: Sleep is a natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended.
senses.definitionZh: 一种自然且周期性的休息状态，在此期间世界意识暂停。
senses.exampleZh: 他昨晚没有睡够。

senses.example: For them demons were as much a part of reality as trees were.
senses.definition: all of your experiences that determine how things appear to you
senses.definitionSentence: Reality means all of your experiences that determine how things appear to you.
senses.definitionZh: 决定事物在你看来如何的所有经历。
senses.exampleZh: 对他们来说，恶魔就像树木一样是现实的一部分。

senses.example: The reality of his situation slowly dawned on him.
senses.definition: the state of being actual or real
senses.definitionSentence: Reality is the state of being actual or real.
senses.definitionZh: 实际或真实的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 他慢慢意识到自己的处境。

senses.example: The patient must drink several liters each day.
senses.definition: take in liquids
senses.definitionSentence: To drink means to take in liquids.
senses.definitionZh: 摄入液体。
senses.exampleZh: 患者每天必须喝几升水。

senses.example: As cheerfully as possible, he said, `` Well, I guess we could all do with a little drink ''.
senses.definition: any liquid suitable for drinking
senses.definitionSentence: Drink means any liquid suitable for drinking.
senses.definitionZh: 任何适合饮用的液体。
senses.exampleZh: 他尽可能高兴地说道，“好吧，我想我们都可以喝点酒了”。

senses.definition: the act of determining the properties of something, usually by research or calculation
senses.definitionSentence: The act of determining the properties of something, usually by research or calculation.
senses.definitionZh: 通常通过研究或计算来确定某物属性的行为。
senses.example: The study's main finding was that regular exercise reduced the risk of heart disease.
senses.exampleZh: 该研究的主要发现是定期锻炼可以降低患心脏病的风险。

senses.example: The findings in the gastrointestinal tract indicate that he died several hours after dinner.
senses.definition: something that is found
senses.definitionSentence: Finding means something that is found.
senses.definitionZh: 发现某事。
senses.exampleZh: 胃肠道检查结果表明他在晚餐后几小时死亡。

senses.definition: a vaguely specified concern
senses.definitionSentence: A vaguely specified concern.
senses.definitionZh: 模糊具体的关注。
senses.example: The committee met privately to discuss the urgent financial matter.
senses.exampleZh: 委员会私下开会讨论紧急的财务问题。

senses.example: Physicists study both the nature of matter and the forces which govern it.
senses.definition: that which has mass and occupies space
senses.definitionSentence: Matter means that which has mass and occupies space.
senses.definitionZh: 具有质量并占据空间的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 物理学家研究物质的本质和支配物质的力量。

senses.example: It does not matter much.
senses.definition: have weight; have import, carry weight
senses.definitionSentence: To matter means to have weight; have import, carry weight.
senses.definitionZh: 有重量；有进口，有重量。
senses.exampleZh: 这并不重要。

senses.example: During Oersted's attendance at the university, it was poorly equipped with physical apparatus for experimenting in the sciences.
senses.definition: relating to the sciences dealing with matter and energy; especially physics
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as physical is relating to the sciences dealing with matter and energy; especially physics.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为物理的东西与处理物质和能量的科学有关；尤其是物理。
senses.exampleZh: 奥斯特就读大学期间，学校用于科学实验的物理设备装备很差。

senses.example: Was sloppy about everything but her physical appearance.
senses.definition: involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as physical is involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为物理的东西涉及与思想或精神不同的身体。
senses.exampleZh: 除了外表之外，一切都很马虎。

senses.example: The classical lines of the church which Napoleon thought of as a Temple of Glory, dominated all the scene where we sat.
senses.definition: of or relating to the most highly developed stage of an earlier civilisation and its culture
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as classical is of or relating to the most highly developed stage of an earlier civilisation and its culture.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为古典的东西属于或涉及早期文明及其文化的最高度发展的阶段。
senses.exampleZh: 拿破仑认为是荣耀神殿的教堂的古典线条占据了我们所坐的所有场景。

senses.example: Newton's Principia remains a classical work whose authority shaped physics for centuries.
senses.definition: of recognized authority or excellence
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as classical is of recognized authority or excellence.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为经典的事物具有公认的权威或卓越性。
senses.exampleZh: 牛顿的《自然哲学的数学原理》仍是一部经典著作，其权威影响了数百年的物理学。

senses.example: It is merely the latest example of the leapfrog growth which formed the pattern of virtually all American cities.
senses.definition: a progression from simpler to more complex forms
senses.definitionSentence: Growth is a progression from simpler to more complex forms.
senses.definitionZh: 从简单形式到更复杂形式的进展。
senses.exampleZh: 这只是跨越式增长的最新例子，这种增长形成了几乎所有美国城市的格局。

senses.example: Definite information on the growth of senile individuals is lacking.
senses.definition: (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level
senses.definitionSentence: Growth means (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level.
senses.definitionZh: （生物学）个体有机体有机生长的过程；有机体所涉及的事件的纯粹生物学展开，从简单的水平逐渐转变为更复杂的水平。
senses.exampleZh: 缺乏关于老年人生长的明确信息。

senses.definition: a process of becoming larger, longer, more numerous, or more important
senses.definitionSentence: Growth is a process of becoming larger, longer, more numerous, or more important.
senses.definitionZh: 变大、变长、增多或变得更重要的过程；增长。
senses.example: The steady growth of the small business created several new jobs.
senses.exampleZh: 这家小企业的持续增长创造了几个新的就业岗位。

senses.example: I had no further trade with him.
senses.definition: a particular instance of buying or selling
senses.definitionSentence: Trade is a particular instance of buying or selling.
senses.definitionZh: 购买或出售的特殊实例。
senses.exampleZh: 我与他没有进一步的交易。

senses.example: He learned his trade as an apprentice.
senses.definition: the skilled practice of a practical occupation
senses.definitionSentence: Trade is the skilled practice of a practical occupation.
senses.definitionZh: 实际职业的熟练实践。
senses.exampleZh: 他作为学徒学习了自己的手艺。

senses.example: He went then to a 40 - year-old Basel art dealer named Ernst Beyeler, with whom he had long been trading pictures.
senses.definition: engage in the trade of
senses.definitionSentence: To trade means to engage in the trade of.
senses.definitionZh: 从事……贸易。
senses.exampleZh: 然后，他找到了一位 40 岁的巴塞尔艺术品经销商，名叫恩斯特·贝耶勒 (Ernst Beyeler)，他长期以来一直与他交易画作。

senses.example: Fresh hoofprints formed a clear track showing the animal's route through the snow.
senses.definition: a line or route along which something travels or moves
senses.definitionSentence: Track is a line or route along which something travels or moves.
senses.definitionZh: 物体或动物行进或移动的线路、路线或足迹。
senses.exampleZh: 新的蹄印形成了清晰的足迹，显示了动物在雪中的路线。

senses.example: To round out the blockading force, submarines would be needed - to locate, identify and track approaching vessels.
senses.definition: observe or plot the moving path of something
senses.definitionSentence: To track means to observe or plot the moving path of something.
senses.definitionZh: 观察或绘制某物的移动路径。
senses.exampleZh: 为了完善封锁力量，需要潜艇来定位、识别和跟踪接近的船只。

senses.example: I did not rest until I had tracked the mystery down.
senses.definition: go after with the intent to catch
senses.definitionSentence: To track means to go after with the intent to catch.
senses.definitionZh: 带着捕捉的意图去追赶。
senses.exampleZh: 我没有休息，直到我找到了这个谜团。

senses.example: We had to stand for the entire performance!
senses.definition: be standing; be upright
senses.definitionSentence: To stand means to be standing; be upright.
senses.definitionZh: 站立；保持正直。
senses.exampleZh: 整个表演我们必须站立！

senses.example: Another major church body had 4499608 members and twenty years later its membership stood at 4622444.
senses.definition: remain inactive or immobile
senses.definitionSentence: To stand means to remain inactive or immobile.
senses.definitionZh: 保持不动或不动。
senses.exampleZh: 另一个主要教会团体有 4499608 名成员，二十年后其成员人数达到 4622444 人。

senses.example: The senator took a firm stand against the bill and explained why she would vote no.
senses.definition: a mental position from which things are viewed
senses.definitionSentence: Stand is a mental position from which things are viewed.
senses.definitionZh: 一种观察事物的心理位置。
senses.exampleZh: 参议员坚决反对该法案，并解释了她为何投反对票。

senses.definition: the position where a thing or person stands
senses.definitionSentence: A stand can be the position where a thing or person stands.
senses.definitionZh: 物体或人所处的站立位置；立足处。
senses.example: The sign marks the stand where the guide waits for visitors.
senses.exampleZh: 这块标牌标出了导游等候游客的站位。

senses.definition: put up with something or someone unpleasant
senses.definitionSentence: To stand can mean to put up with something or someone unpleasant.
senses.definitionZh: 忍受或容忍令人不快的事物或人。
senses.example: I cannot stand the constant noise from the broken fan.
senses.exampleZh: 我无法忍受坏风扇持续发出的噪声。

senses.example: A perceptive journalist, Sam Lubell, has phrased it in the title of one of his books as The Revolt Of The Moderates.
senses.definition: a writer for newspapers and magazines
senses.definitionSentence: Journalist is a writer for newspapers and magazines.
senses.definitionZh: 报纸和杂志的撰稿人。
senses.exampleZh: 一位富有洞察力的记者 Sam Lubell 在他的一本书的书名《温和派的反抗》中表达了这一点。

senses.example: The judge assessed the threat in the setting of a bitter dispute that had lasted for months.
senses.definition: the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
senses.definitionSentence: Setting is the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event.
senses.definitionZh: 围绕某种情况或事件的一组事实或情况。
senses.exampleZh: 法官在持续数月的激烈纠纷中评估了威胁。

senses.example: The perfect setting for a ghost story.
senses.definition: the context and environment in which something is set
senses.definitionSentence: Setting is the context and environment in which something is set.
senses.definitionZh: 设置某些内容的上下文和环境。
senses.exampleZh: 鬼故事的完美背景。

senses.definitionSentence: A document that reports a taxpayer's income and tax liability to the government.
senses.definitionZh: 向政府申报纳税人收入和应纳税额的文件。
senses.example: The accountant filed the company's tax return before the April deadline.
senses.exampleZh: 会计在四月截止日期前提交了公司的纳税申报单。
senses.definition: A document that reports a taxpayer's income and tax liability to the government.

senses.example: The professor returned to his teaching position after serving as Dean.
senses.definition: go or come back to place, condition, or activity where one has been before
senses.definitionSentence: To return means to go or come back to place, condition, or activity where one has been before.
senses.definitionZh: 去或回到以前去过的地方、条件或活动。
senses.exampleZh: 教授在担任院长后重返教学岗位。

senses.example: On his return from Australia we gave him a welcoming party.
senses.definition: a coming to or returning home
senses.definitionSentence: Return is a coming to or returning home.
senses.definitionZh: 回到家或返回家。
senses.exampleZh: 他从澳大利亚回来后，我们为他举办了欢迎派对。

senses.example: The return of the overdue library book cleared the borrowing charge from her account.
senses.definition: getting something back again
senses.definitionSentence: Return means getting something back again.
senses.definitionZh: 再次拿回某些东西。
senses.exampleZh: 归还逾期的图书馆藏书后，她账户上的借阅费用被取消了。

senses.definition: give something back to the person or place it belongs to
senses.definitionSentence: To return can mean to give something back to the person or place it belongs to.
senses.definitionZh: 把某物归还给原来的所有者或所属地点。
senses.example: Please return the borrowed microscope to the science room by Friday.
senses.exampleZh: 请在周五前把借来的显微镜归还到科学教室。

senses.example: The relationship between mothers and their children.
senses.definition: a relation between people; (`relationship' is often used where `relation' would serve, as in `the relationship between inflation and unemployment', but the preferred usage of `relationship' is for human relations or states of relatedness)
senses.definitionSentence: Relationship is a relation between people; (`relationship' is often used where `relation' would serve, as in `the relationship between inflation and unemployment', but the preferred usage of `relationship' is for human relations or states of relatedness).
senses.definitionZh: 人与人之间的关系； （“关系”通常用在需要“关系”的地方，例如“通货膨胀与失业之间的关系”，但“关系”的首选用法是指人际关系或相关状态）。
senses.exampleZh: 母亲和孩子之间的关系。

senses.example: They changed their dietary pattern.
senses.definition: a customary way of operation or behavior
senses.definitionSentence: Pattern is a customary way of operation or behavior.
senses.definitionZh: 一种习惯的操作或行为方式。
senses.exampleZh: 他们改变了饮食模式。

senses.example: The air was cooler here, and the lacy pattern of the trees threw a dappled shadow on the grass, an effect which he found pleasant.
senses.definition: a decorative or artistic work
senses.definitionSentence: Pattern is a decorative or artistic work.
senses.definitionZh: 一种装饰或艺术作品。
senses.exampleZh: 这里的空气比较凉爽，树木的花边图案在草地上投下斑驳的影子，他觉得这种效果很愉快。

senses.example: Dark veins pattern the pale stone in irregular lines.
senses.definition: form a pattern
senses.definitionSentence: To pattern means to form a pattern.
senses.definitionZh: 形成某种图案或模式。
senses.exampleZh: 深色纹理在浅色石材上形成不规则的线条。

senses.example: The former President blithely ignored recent history in speaking of `` dollarette '' dollars under Kennedy Administration fiscal policies.
senses.definition: bar from attention or consideration
senses.definitionSentence: To ignore means to bar from attention or consideration.
senses.definitionZh: 阻止注意或考虑。
senses.exampleZh: 这位前总统在谈到肯尼迪政府财政政策下的“美元”美元时，轻率地忽略了最近的历史。

senses.example: Jeb cautioned him not to be too hopeful and then, ignoring his own advice, said excitedly, `` But it does sound good.
senses.definition: fail to notice
senses.definitionSentence: To ignore means to fail to notice.
senses.definitionZh: 没有注意到。
senses.exampleZh: 杰布警告他不要抱太大希望，然后无视他自己的建议，兴奋地说，“但这听起来确实不错。”

senses.example: Water flowed into the cave.
senses.definition: move along, of liquids
senses.definitionSentence: To flow means to move along, of liquids.
senses.definitionZh: 液体的移动。
senses.exampleZh: 水流入洞穴。

senses.example: The crowd flowed out of the stadium.
senses.definition: move or progress freely as if in a stream
senses.definitionSentence: To flow means to move or progress freely as if in a stream.
senses.definitionZh: 像在溪流中一样自由移动或前进。
senses.exampleZh: 人群流出体育场。

senses.example: The museum had planned carefully for the flow of visitors.
senses.definition: something that resembles a flowing stream in moving continuously
senses.definitionSentence: Flow means something that resembles a flowing stream in moving continuously.
senses.definitionZh: 类似流动的溪流不断移动的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 博物馆对参观人流进行了精心规划。

senses.example: The Doppler effect, using ultrasonic signals, can be employed to measure the flow of blood without cutting into the blood vessel.
senses.definition: the amount of fluid that flows in a given time
senses.definitionSentence: Flow is the amount of fluid that flows in a given time.
senses.definitionZh: 给定时间内流动的流体量。
senses.exampleZh: 使用超声波信号的多普勒效应可用于测量血流，而无需切入血管。

senses.meaning: 合适的，适用于特定场合的
senses.example: A tractor suitable (or fit) for heavy duty.
senses.definition: meant or adapted for an occasion or use
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as suitable is meant or adapted for an occasion or use.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为合适的东西是指或适合于某种场合或用途。
senses.exampleZh: 适合（或适合）重型作业的拖拉机。

senses.example: He longed for the comfortable environment of his living room.
senses.definition: the totality of surrounding conditions
senses.definitionSentence: Environment is the totality of surrounding conditions.
senses.definitionZh: 周围条件的总和。
senses.exampleZh: 他渴望客厅的舒适环境。

senses.definitionSentence: To use, carry out, or practice a right, power, skill, or profession.
senses.definitionZh: 运用、履行或实践某种权利、权力、技能或职业职能。
senses.example: Citizens exercised their right to vote and chose a new mayor.
senses.exampleZh: 市民行使投票权，选出了一位新市长。
senses.definition: To use, carry out, or practice a right, power, skill, or profession.

senses.example: The doctor recommended regular exercise.
senses.definition: the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
senses.definitionSentence: Exercise is the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit.
senses.definitionZh: 以各种方式锻炼肌肉以保持健康的活动。
senses.exampleZh: 医生建议定期锻炼。

senses.example: They should know simple exercises that could prepare less fortunate children for the sports we will demand be taught.
senses.definition: systematic training by multiple repetitions
senses.definitionSentence: Exercise means systematic training by multiple repetitions.
senses.definitionZh: 通过多次重复进行的系统训练。
senses.exampleZh: 他们应该知道简单的练习，可以让不幸的孩子为我们要求教授的运动做好准备。

senses.definition: do physical exercise
senses.definitionSentence: To exercise can mean to do physical exercise.
senses.definitionZh: 进行体育锻炼。
senses.example: She exercises before breakfast by cycling around the park.
senses.exampleZh: 她早餐前绕公园骑车锻炼身体。

senses.example: He hit with all the force he could muster.
senses.definition: physical energy or intensity
senses.definitionSentence: Force means physical energy or intensity.
senses.definitionZh: 物理能量或强度。
senses.exampleZh: 他用尽全力击打。

senses.example: Too much pressure will force the tool beyond its cutting capacity and result in rough cuts and jammed or broken tools.
senses.definition: move with force
senses.definitionSentence: To force means to move with force.
senses.definitionZh: 用力移动。
senses.exampleZh: 压力太大会迫使刀具超出其切削能力，导致粗切削以及刀具卡住或损坏。

senses.example: She forced him to take a job in the city.
senses.definition: to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means
senses.definitionSentence: Force means to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means.
senses.definitionZh: 通过压力或必要性，通过身体、道德或智力手段促使人们做某事。
senses.exampleZh: 她强迫他到城里找工作。

senses.definition: a unit that is part of a military service
senses.definitionSentence: A force can be a unit that is part of a military service.
senses.definitionZh: 军队中的一个单位；武装部队。
