senses.definitionSentence: To measure means to evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of.
senses.definitionZh: 评估或估计其性质、质量、能力、程度或重要性。
senses.exampleZh: 该装置还将用于测量大量其他元素的转移概率。

senses.definition: determine the dimensions or amount of something by measurement
senses.definitionSentence: To measure means to determine the dimensions or amount of something by measurement.
senses.definitionZh: 通过测量确定某物的尺寸或数量。
senses.example: The engineer measured the bridge span before ordering the replacement beam.
senses.exampleZh: 工程师测量了桥的跨度后才订购替换梁。

senses.example: Is the consent of the governed a numerical majority?
senses.definition: (elections) more than half of the votes
senses.definitionSentence: Majority means (elections) more than half of the votes.
senses.definitionZh: （选举）超过一半的选票。
senses.exampleZh: 被统治者的同意是否达到多数？

senses.example: When Peter had reached his majority at eighteen?
senses.definition: the age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs
senses.definitionSentence: Majority is the age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs.
senses.definitionZh: 人们被认为有能力管理自己事务的年龄。
senses.exampleZh: 彼得十八岁时成年？

senses.example: When all has been said, however, the big branch store remains a major break with history in the development of American retailing.
senses.definition: a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services
senses.definitionSentence: Store is a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services.
senses.definitionZh: 零售商品或服务的商业机构。
senses.exampleZh: 然而，总而言之，大型分店仍然是美国零售业发展史上的重大突破。

senses.example: He brought back a large store of Cuban cigars.
senses.definition: a supply of something available for future use
senses.definitionSentence: Store is a supply of something available for future use.
senses.definitionZh: 可供将来使用的物品的供应。
senses.exampleZh: 他带回了一大堆古巴雪茄。

senses.example: The bear stores fat for the period of hibernation when he doesn't eat.
senses.definition: keep or lay aside for future use
senses.definitionSentence: To store means to keep or lay aside for future use.
senses.definitionZh: 保留或放置以供将来使用。
senses.exampleZh: 熊在冬眠期间不吃东西时会储存脂肪。

senses.example: Disney's stories entertain adults as well as children.
senses.definition: a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
senses.definitionSentence: Story is a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program.
senses.definitionZh: 讲述行为、发生或事件过程的细节的消息；以书面、戏剧、电影或广播或电视节目的形式呈现。
senses.exampleZh: 迪士尼的故事让成人和儿童都感到愉悦。

senses.example: The story was on the 11 o'clock news.
senses.definition: a short account of the news
senses.definitionSentence: Story is a short account of the news.
senses.definitionZh: 新闻的简短描述。
senses.exampleZh: 这个故事出现在 11 点新闻中。

senses.definition: a structure consisting of rooms at one level along a vertical scale
senses.definitionSentence: A story is a level of a building containing a room or rooms.
senses.definitionZh: 建筑物中位于同一高度的一层或一组房间。
senses.example: The library occupies the entire third story of the building.
senses.exampleZh: 图书馆占据了这栋楼的整整三层。

senses.example: This Europeanization of the law was made explicit by a number of 19 th century scholars.
senses.definition: a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
senses.definitionSentence: Scholar is a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines.
senses.definitionZh: 有学识的人（尤其是人文学科）；通过长期学习掌握一门或多门学科的人。
senses.exampleZh: 一些 19 世纪的学者明确指出了法律的欧洲化。

senses.example: They acquired a new pet.
senses.definition: come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
senses.definitionSentence: To acquire means to come into the possession of something concrete or abstract.
senses.definitionZh: 拥有具体或抽象的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 他们获得了一只新宠物。

senses.example: The radar acquired the approaching aircraft and tracked its speed and direction.
senses.definition: locate (a moving entity) by means of a tracking system such as radar
senses.definitionSentence: To acquire means to locate (a moving entity) by means of a tracking system such as radar.
senses.definitionZh: 获取通过雷达等跟踪系统定位（移动实体）的方法。
senses.exampleZh: 雷达捕获了正在接近的飞机并跟踪其速度和方向。

senses.example: This action reflects his true beliefs.
senses.definition: manifest or bring back
senses.definitionSentence: To reflect means to manifest or bring back.
senses.definitionZh: 显现或带回来。
senses.exampleZh: 这一行动反映了他的真实信念。

senses.example: Sound is reflected well in this auditorium.
senses.definition: to throw or bend back (from a surface)
senses.definitionSentence: Reflect means to throw or bend back (from a surface).
senses.definitionZh: （从表面）投掷或向后弯曲。
senses.exampleZh: 这个礼堂的声音反射效果很好。

senses.example: There is little time for the men in the command centers to reflect about the implications of these clocks.
senses.definition: reflect deeply on a subject
senses.definitionSentence: To reflect means to reflect deeply on a subject.
senses.definitionZh: 对某个主题进行深入反思。
senses.exampleZh: 指挥中心的人员几乎没有时间思考这些时钟的含义。

senses.example: The sculpture has a global form, perfectly round like a ball from every direction.
senses.definition: having the shape of a sphere or ball
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as global is having the shape of a sphere or ball.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为全局的东西具有球体或球的形状。
senses.exampleZh: 该雕塑具有整体形状，从各个方向看都像球一样完美。

senses.definition: involving the entire earth and not limited to one region
senses.definitionSentence: Something global involves the entire earth and is not limited to one region.
senses.definitionZh: 涉及整个地球、并非局限于某一地区的。
senses.example: The company released a global safety standard for all its laboratories.
senses.exampleZh: 这家公司为所有实验室发布了全球统一的安全标准。

senses.example: The librarian sorted the returned books into history, science, fiction, and other subject categories.
senses.definition: arrange or order by classes or categories
senses.definitionSentence: To sort means to arrange or order by classes or categories.
senses.definitionZh: 按类或类别排列或排序。
senses.exampleZh: 图书管理员将归还的书籍分为历史、科学、小说和其他学科类别。

senses.example: A computerized sort separated the parcels by postal code and placed each destination in a different bin.
senses.definition: an operation that segregates items into groups according to a specified criterion
senses.definitionSentence: Sort is an operation that segregates items into groups according to a specified criterion.
senses.definitionZh: 根据指定标准将项目分成组的操作。
senses.exampleZh: 计算机分拣按邮政编码将包裹分开，并将每个目的地放入不同的垃圾箱中。

senses.example: She woke up to the sound of the alarm clock.
senses.definition: stop sleeping
senses.definitionSentence: To wake means to stop sleeping.
senses.definitionZh: 停止睡眠。
senses.exampleZh: 她被闹钟的声音吵醒了。

senses.example: But there is little doubt that in many marriages the wife is boss of the marital bed.
senses.definition: the state of being unsure of something
senses.definitionSentence: Doubt is the state of being unsure of something.
senses.definitionZh: 对某事不确定的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 但毫无疑问，在许多婚姻中，妻子是婚床的主人。

senses.example: There is little doubt that the warning system saved lives and reduced the damage.
senses.definition: uncertainty about the truth or factuality or existence of something
senses.definitionSentence: Doubt means uncertainty about the truth or factuality or existence of something.
senses.definitionZh: 对某事物的真相、事实或存在的不确定性。
senses.exampleZh: 毫无疑问，该警报系统挽救了生命并减少了损失。

senses.example: I doubt that she will accept his proposal of marriage.
senses.definition: consider unlikely or have doubts about
senses.definitionSentence: To doubt means to consider unlikely or have doubts about.
senses.definitionZh: 认为不太可能或有疑问。
senses.exampleZh: 我怀疑她会接受他的求婚。

senses.definitionSentence: To judge or suppose that something is likely to be true.
senses.definitionZh: 判断或推测某事很可能属实。
senses.example: I figured the train would be late after the storm damaged the tracks.
senses.exampleZh: 暴风雨损坏铁轨后，我估计火车会晚点。
senses.definition: To judge or suppose that something is likely to be true.

senses.example: This is substantially higher than the figures for the American population at large - 45.6 per cent for males and 29.2 per cent for females.
senses.definition: one of the elements that collectively form a system of numeration
senses.definitionSentence: Figure means one of the elements that collectively form a system of numeration.
senses.definitionZh: 共同构成计数系统的元素之一。
senses.exampleZh: 这大大高于美国广大人口的数字 - 男性为 45.6%，女性为 29.2%。

senses.example: He made a figure of Santa Claus.
senses.definition: a model of a bodily form (especially of a person)
senses.definitionSentence: Figure is a model of a bodily form (especially of a person).
senses.definitionZh: 身体形态（尤其是人）的模型。
senses.exampleZh: 他做了一个圣诞老人的雕像。

senses.example: Its form was a heavy figure in a fluttering soutane.
senses.definition: a combination of points and lines and planes that form a visible palpable shape
senses.definitionSentence: Figure is a combination of points and lines and planes that form a visible palpable shape.
senses.definitionZh: 点、线、面的组合，形成看得见摸得着的形状。
senses.exampleZh: 它的形状是一个飘扬的苏坦中的沉重人物。

senses.meaning: 人体，体形，体格，外形，肉体
senses.example: He ran his eye along the roof copings; almost at once a figure bulked up.
senses.definition: alternative names for the body of a human being
senses.definitionSentence: Figure means alternative names for the body of a human being.
senses.definitionZh: 人体的替代名称。
senses.exampleZh: 他的目光沿着屋顶边缘扫视；几乎立刻，一个人影就变大了。

senses.example: He joined the Modern Language Association.
senses.definition: a formal organization of people or groups of people
senses.definitionSentence: Association is a formal organization of people or groups of people.
senses.definitionZh: 人员或人员团体的正式组织。
senses.exampleZh: 他加入了现代语言协会。

senses.example: Flints were found in association with the prehistoric remains of the bear.
senses.definition: a relation resulting from interaction or dependence
senses.definitionSentence: Association is a relation resulting from interaction or dependence.
senses.definitionZh: 由交互或依赖产生的关系。
senses.exampleZh: 燧石被发现与史前熊的遗骸有关。

senses.example: A dominant motive is the poet's longing for his homeland and its boyhood associations: `` Not men folk, but the fields where I would stray, The stones where as a child I used to play ''.
senses.definition: the process of bringing ideas or events together in memory or imagination
senses.definitionSentence: Association is the process of bringing ideas or events together in memory or imagination.
senses.definitionZh: 将记忆或想象中的想法或事件结合在一起的过程。
senses.exampleZh: 诗人的主要动机是对家乡及其童年联想的渴望：“不是男人，而是我流浪的田野，我小时候玩耍的石头”。

senses.example: You cannot be convicted of criminal guilt by association.
senses.definition: the act of consorting with or joining with others
senses.definitionSentence: Association is the act of consorting with or joining with others.
senses.definitionZh: 与他人结盟或加入的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 您不能因关联而被定罪。

senses.definition: an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together
senses.definitionSentence: An abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together.
senses.definitionZh: 属于两个实体或部分的抽象或特征。
senses.example: Researchers found a clear relation between air pollution and breathing problems.
senses.exampleZh: 研究人员发现空气污染和呼吸问题之间存在明显的关系。

senses.example: He has distant relations back in New Jersey.
senses.definition: a person related by blood or marriage
senses.definitionSentence: Relation is a person related by blood or marriage.
senses.definitionZh: 有血缘或婚姻关系的人。
senses.exampleZh: 他在新泽西州有远房亲戚。

senses.example: She stopped in front of a store window.
senses.definition: come to a halt, stop moving
senses.definitionSentence: To stop means to come to a halt, stop moving.
senses.definitionZh: 停止、停止移动。
senses.exampleZh: 她停在商店橱窗前。

senses.example: He used a book as a stop to hold the door open.
senses.definition: a restraint that checks the motion of something
senses.definitionSentence: Stop is a restraint that checks the motion of something.
senses.definitionZh: 一种检查某物运动的约束。
senses.exampleZh: 他用一本书作为挡块来保持门打开。

senses.example: He spent the entire stop in his seat.
senses.definition: the state of inactivity following an interruption
senses.definitionSentence: Stop is the state of inactivity following an interruption.
senses.definitionZh: 中断后的不活动状态。
senses.exampleZh: 中断期间，他一直坐在座位上。

senses.definition: stop something from happening or developing
senses.definitionSentence: To stop can mean to prevent something from happening or developing.
senses.definitionZh: 阻止某事发生或发展。
senses.example: The barrier stopped the loose boxes from sliding onto the road.
senses.exampleZh: 挡板阻止松动的箱子滑到道路上。

senses.example: Indeed, the administration's curious position on the sales tax was a major factor in contributing to its defeat.
senses.definition: be conducive to
senses.definitionSentence: To contribute means to be conducive to.
senses.definitionZh: 有利于。
senses.exampleZh: 事实上，政府对销售税的好奇立场是导致其失败的一个主要因素。

senses.example: Many other vehicles with smaller sensitive area exposure time products contribute some information.
senses.definition: contribute to some cause
senses.definitionSentence: To contribute means to contribute to some cause.
senses.definitionZh: 为某种事业做出贡献。
senses.exampleZh: 许多其他具有较小敏感区域曝光时间产品的车辆提供了一些信息。

senses.example: We preserve these archeological findings.
senses.definition: keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction
senses.definitionSentence: To preserve means to keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction.
senses.definitionZh: 保持安全并防止伤害、腐烂、丢失或破坏。
senses.exampleZh: 我们保留这些考古发现。

senses.example: Rangers preserve the nesting birds from hunters, vehicles, and other sources of harm.
senses.definition: maintain in safety from injury, harm, or danger
senses.definitionSentence: To preserve means to maintain in safety from injury, harm, or danger.
senses.definitionZh: 保护手段以保持安全，免受伤害、伤害或危险。
senses.exampleZh: 护林员保护筑巢的鸟类免受猎人、车辆和其他来源的伤害。

senses.example: Preserve the peace in the family.
senses.definition: keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last
senses.definitionSentence: To preserve means to keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last.
senses.definitionZh: 保持或维持未改变的状态；导致保留或持续。
senses.exampleZh: 维护家庭和平。

senses.example: Medicine is no longer a male preserve.
senses.definition: a domain that seems to be specially reserved for someone
senses.definitionSentence: Preserve is a domain that seems to be specially reserved for someone.
senses.definitionZh: 一个似乎专门为某人保留的域。
senses.exampleZh: 医学不再是男性的专利。

senses.example: The customs agent examined the baggage.
senses.definition: observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect
senses.definitionSentence: To examine means to observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect.
senses.definitionZh: 观察、检查、仔细检查或检验。
senses.exampleZh: 海关人员检查了行李。

senses.meaning: 明显的，显著的，显而易见的
senses.example: It is obvious enough that linguists in general have been less successful in coping with tone systems than with consonants or vowels.
senses.definition: easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as obvious is easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为显而易见的事物很容易被感官感知或被头脑掌握。
senses.exampleZh: 很明显，语言学家在处理声调系统方面总体上不如处理辅音或元音成功。

senses.example: Sixty five per cent of the Jewish teen-agers of college age attend institutions of higher learning.
senses.definition: profound scholarly knowledge
senses.definitionSentence: Learning means profound scholarly knowledge.
senses.definitionZh: 深厚的学术知识。
senses.exampleZh: 65% 的大学年龄犹太青少年进入高等教育机构。

senses.example: By the death of his father in 1888 he had come into possession of the family estate and had re-assumed its traditions.
senses.definition: a specific practice of long standing
senses.definitionSentence: Tradition is a specific practice of long standing.
senses.definitionZh: 长期存在的具体实践。
senses.exampleZh: 1888 年，他的父亲去世后，他继承了家族庄园，并重新继承了家族的传统。

senses.example: Madden regretted not being able to find fault with so true a statement.
senses.definition: a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true
senses.definitionSentence: Statement is a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true.
senses.definitionZh: 作为某事真实的证据提供的事实或断言。
senses.exampleZh: Madden 很遗憾未能对如此真实的陈述进行挑剔。

senses.definition: a message that states or declares facts or particulars
senses.definitionSentence: A statement is a spoken or written message that states facts or particulars.
senses.definitionZh: 陈述事实或具体情况的口头或书面信息；声明。
senses.example: The manager issued a short statement about the change in opening hours.
senses.exampleZh: 经理就营业时间的变更发表了一份简短声明。

senses.example: Maestro's biggest stock in trade is his personality, and ability to establish a warm rapport with his audience.
senses.definition: set up or found
senses.definitionSentence: To establish means to set up or found.
senses.definitionZh: 建立指建立或发现。
senses.exampleZh: 大师最大的优点是他的个性以及与观众建立热情融洽关系的能力。

senses.example: The resettlement agency established the refugee families in furnished homes near schools and clinics.
senses.definition: place
senses.definitionSentence: To establish means to place.
senses.definitionZh: 放置。
senses.exampleZh: 安置机构在学校和诊所附近配备家具的房屋中安置了难民家庭。

senses.example: Smith replaced Miller as CEO after Miller left.
senses.definition: take the place or move into the position of
senses.definitionSentence: To replace means to take the place or move into the position of.
senses.definitionZh: 取代或移动到...的位置。
senses.exampleZh: 米勒离开后，史密斯接替米勒担任首席执行官。

senses.example: The insurance will replace the lost income.
senses.definition: substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)
senses.definitionSentence: To replace means to substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected).
senses.definitionZh: 用一个人或物来替代（另一个损坏的、效率低下的、丢失的、或者不再工作或无法产生预期效果的人或物）。
senses.exampleZh: 保险将弥补收入损失。

senses.example: Lacking his needed credits in those subjects, Fabian will not graduate with his old classmates next week.
senses.definition: be without
senses.definitionSentence: To lack means to be without.
senses.definitionZh: 没有。
senses.exampleZh: 由于缺少这些科目所需的学分，Fabian 下周将无法与他的老同学一起毕业。

senses.example: When there is employment opportunity for youth, this arrangement - or lack of arrangement - works out quite well.
senses.definition: the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
senses.definitionSentence: Lack is the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable.
senses.definitionZh: 需要某些东西不存在或不可用的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 当年轻人有就业机会时，这种安排（或缺乏安排）效果很好。

senses.example: Jupiter was the origin of the radiation.
senses.definition: the place where something begins, where it springs into being
senses.definitionSentence: Origin is the place where something begins, where it springs into being.
senses.definitionZh: 某事物开始、产生的地方。
senses.exampleZh: 木星是辐射的起源。

senses.example: He comes from good origins.
senses.definition: properties attributable to your ancestry
senses.definitionSentence: Origin means properties attributable to your ancestry.
senses.definitionZh: 归属于您祖先的财产。
senses.exampleZh: 他出身良好。

senses.example: The dynamic president of the firm.
senses.definition: characterized by action or forcefulness or force of personality
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dynamic is characterized by action or forcefulness or force of personality.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为动态的事物的特征是行动或力量或人格力量。
senses.exampleZh: 公司充满活力的总裁。

senses.example: The engineer used a dynamic model to calculate forces on the moving vehicle.
senses.definition: of or relating to dynamics
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dynamic is of or relating to dynamics.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为动态的事物属于动态或与动态相关。
senses.exampleZh: 工程师使用动态模型来计算移动车辆上的力。

senses.example: He also struck his aunt and wife, and during the melee the baby also suffered scratches.
senses.definition: undergo or be subjected to
senses.definitionSentence: To suffer means to undergo or be subjected to.
senses.definitionZh: 经历或遭受。
senses.exampleZh: 他还袭击了他的姨妈和妻子，在混战中，婴儿也被划伤。

senses.example: Boyer is suffering from a stiff neck.
senses.definition: feel physical pain
senses.definitionSentence: To suffer means to feel physical pain.
senses.definitionZh: 感受到身体上的痛苦。
senses.exampleZh: 博耶患有颈部僵硬。

senses.definition: an animal that produces gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes (spermatozoa)
senses.definitionSentence: An animal that produces gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes (spermatozoa).
senses.definitionZh: 产生可与雄配子（精子）受精的配子（卵子）的动物。
senses.example: The female laid her eggs in the nest while the male guarded the surrounding territory.
senses.exampleZh: 雌性在巢中产卵，而雄性则守卫周围的领地。

senses.definitionSentence: Belonging to the sex of a plant or animal that produces eggs or ova.
