senses.definitionZh: 众多细长的海洋肉食性鱼类中的任何一种，具有异尾鳍和覆盖有小齿状鳞片的坚韧皮肤。
senses.exampleZh: 鲨鱼在海中追鱼时露出一排排锋利的牙齿。

senses.example: The dishonest gambler sharked inexperienced players with marked cards and false promises.
senses.definition: play the shark; act with trickery
senses.definitionSentence: To shark means to play the shark; act with trickery.
senses.definitionZh: 诈骗。
senses.exampleZh: 不诚实的赌徒用标记的牌和虚假的承诺欺骗没有经验的玩家。

senses.example: On August 3, two massive headlands reared out of the mists - great gateways never before, so far as Hudson knew, seen by Europeans.
senses.definition: imposing in size or bulk or solidity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as massive is imposing in size or bulk or solidity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“巨大”的东西在尺寸、体积或坚固性上令人印象深刻。
senses.exampleZh: 8 月 3 日，两个巨大的岬角从迷雾中升起——据哈德逊所知，欧洲人从未见过这样的伟大门户。

senses.example: The patient's temperature remained steady at 37 degrees and did not rise or fall all night.
senses.definition: not liable to fluctuate or especially to fall
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as steady is not liable to fluctuate or especially to fall.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为稳定的东西不容易波动，尤其是不会下跌。
senses.exampleZh: 患者体温整夜稳定在37度，不升不降。

senses.example: According to Whipple (1955), cometary debris is sufficient to replenish the material spiraling into the sun, maintaining a fairly steady state.
senses.definition: not subject to change or variation especially in behavior
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as steady is not subject to change or variation especially in behavior.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为稳定的事物不会发生变化或变化，尤其是在行为方面。
senses.exampleZh: 根据 Whipple (1955) 的说法，彗星碎片足以补充螺旋进入太阳的物质，保持相当稳定的状态。

senses.meaning: 使安静，使稳定，使镇定，使镇静
senses.example: Lolotte held a patch of leather, Rev steadied something, a tiny brad, waiting for George's poised hammer.
senses.definition: make steady
senses.definitionSentence: To steady means to make steady.
senses.definitionZh: 稳定。
senses.exampleZh: 洛洛特拿着一块皮革，雷夫稳住了一个东西，一个小角钉，等待乔治的锤子。

senses.example: Adult literacy classes teach people to read notices and write simple letters.
senses.definition: the ability to read and write
senses.definitionSentence: Literacy is the ability to read and write.
senses.definitionZh: 读写的能力。
senses.exampleZh: 成人识字课程教人们阅读通知和写简单的信件。

senses.example: He wondered how they could go on in poverty, superstition, ignorance, with a complete lack of desire to make either their land or their lives flourish.
senses.definition: the lack of knowledge or education
senses.definitionSentence: Ignorance is the lack of knowledge or education.
senses.definitionZh: 缺乏知识或教育。
senses.exampleZh: 他想知道他们如何能够继续生活在贫困、迷信、无知中，完全缺乏让自己的土地或生活繁荣的愿望。

senses.example: The prison sentence was suspended.
senses.definition: render temporarily ineffective
senses.definitionSentence: To suspend means to render temporarily ineffective.
senses.definitionZh: 暂时无效。
senses.exampleZh: 刑期被缓刑。

senses.example: Three agreed, but four declined and were suspended.
senses.definition: bar temporarily; from school, office, etc.
senses.definitionSentence: To suspend means to bar temporarily; from school, office, etc.
senses.definitionZh: 暂时禁止；来自学校、办公室等。
senses.exampleZh: 三人同意，但四人拒绝并被暂停。

senses.example: It could have been anyone's infant, for it had not survived the bassinet.
senses.definition: a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
senses.definitionSentence: Infant is a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk.
senses.definitionZh: 尚未开始走路或说话的非常年幼的儿童（出生至 1 岁）。
senses.exampleZh: 它可能是任何人的婴儿，因为它没有从摇篮中幸存下来。

senses.example: He clamped his jaws to keep the fury from spilling out.
senses.definition: the part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth
senses.definitionSentence: Jaw is the part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth.
senses.definitionZh: 脊椎动物头骨的一部分，构成嘴巴并容纳牙齿。
senses.exampleZh: 他咬紧牙关，不让怒火外溢。

senses.example: He added a column of numbers.
senses.definition: a vertical array of numbers or other information
senses.definitionSentence: Column is a vertical array of numbers or other information.
senses.definitionZh: 数字或其他信息的垂直数组。
senses.exampleZh: 他添加了一列数字。

senses.example: The test tube held a column of white powder.
senses.definition: anything that approximates the shape of a column or tower
senses.definitionSentence: Column means anything that approximates the shape of a column or tower.
senses.definitionZh: 任何近似柱或塔形状的物体。
senses.exampleZh: 试管中装有一柱白色粉末。

senses.example: Four marble columns support the stone roof of the temple entrance.
senses.definition: (architecture) a tall vertical cylindrical structure standing upright and used to support a structure
senses.definitionSentence: Column means (architecture) a tall vertical cylindrical structure standing upright and used to support a structure.
senses.definitionZh: （建筑）直立的高垂直圆柱形结构，用于支撑结构。
senses.exampleZh: 四根大理石柱支撑着寺庙入口的石屋顶。

senses.example: More fuel is needed during the winter months.
senses.definition: a substance that can be consumed to produce energy
senses.definitionSentence: Fuel is a substance that can be consumed to produce energy.
senses.definitionZh: 一种可以消耗以产生能量的物质。
senses.exampleZh: 冬季需要更多燃料。

senses.example: He embodies all that is evil wrong with the system.
senses.definition: represent in bodily form
senses.definitionSentence: To embody means to represent in bodily form.
senses.definitionZh: 以身体形式表现。
senses.exampleZh: 他体现了系统中所有的邪恶错误。

senses.example: This painting embodies the feelings of the Romantic period.
senses.definition: represent or express something abstract in tangible form
senses.definitionSentence: To embody means to represent or express something abstract in tangible form.
senses.definitionZh: 以有形的形式代表或表达抽象的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 这幅画体现了浪漫主义时期的情怀。

senses.example: The cook placed a grilled beef patty, lettuce, and tomato inside the hamburger bun.
senses.definition: a sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients
senses.definitionSentence: Hamburger is a sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients.
senses.definitionZh: 一种三明治，由碎牛肉炸饼放在小圆面包上组成，通常还配有其他配料。
senses.exampleZh: 厨师将烤牛肉饼、生菜和番茄放入汉堡面包内。

senses.example: Beyond it the gray road stretched a long, long way.
senses.definition: an open way (generally public) for travel or transportation
senses.definitionSentence: Road is an open way (generally public) for travel or transportation.
senses.definitionZh: 用于旅行或运输的开放道路（通常是公共的）。
senses.exampleZh: 在那之后，灰色的路延伸了很长很长的路。

senses.example: He took a gentle jog around the park, running slowly enough to hold a conversation.
senses.definition: a slow pace of running
senses.definitionSentence: Jog is a slow pace of running.
senses.definitionZh: 一种慢速跑步。
senses.exampleZh: 他在公园里轻轻慢跑，跑得足够慢，足以进行对话。

senses.example: She jogs around the park every morning to improve her fitness.
senses.definition: run for exercise
senses.definitionSentence: To jog means to run for exercise.
senses.definitionZh: 跑步锻炼。
senses.exampleZh: 她每天早上在公园周围慢跑以提高身体素质。

senses.example: A major shortcoming of the phone is its weak battery, which rarely lasts through the day.
senses.definition: a failing or deficiency
senses.definitionSentence: Shortcoming is a failing or deficiency.
senses.definitionZh: 失败或不足。
senses.exampleZh: 这款手机的一个主要缺点是电池电量较弱，很少能坚持一整天。

senses.example: Scientists analysed the water sample into its chemical components and measured each contaminant.
senses.definition: break down into components or essential features
senses.definitionSentence: To analyse means to break down into components or essential features.
senses.definitionZh: 分解成组件或基本特征。
senses.exampleZh: 科学家分析了水样的化学成分并测量了每种污染物。

senses.example: Students must analyse the sentence into its subject, verb, object, and modifying clauses.
senses.definition: make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features
senses.definitionSentence: To analyse means to make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features.
senses.definitionZh: 进行数学、化学或语法分析；分解为组件或基本功能。
senses.exampleZh: 学生必须将句子分析为主语、动词、宾语和修饰从句。

senses.example: I talked to him on the telephone.
senses.definition: electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
senses.definitionSentence: Telephone means electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds.
senses.definitionZh: 将声音转换为可远距离传输的电信号，然后将接收到的信号转换回声音的电子设备。
senses.exampleZh: 我通过电话与他交谈。

senses.example: No friends are to arrive without an invitation or without at least telephoning beforehand.
senses.definition: get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone
senses.definitionSentence: To telephone means to get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone.
senses.definitionZh: 通过电话（与某人）进行或尝试进行通信。
senses.exampleZh: 没有邀请或至少事先打电话的情况下，任何朋友都不得前来。

senses.example: Nutrition labels use calories to report how much energy food can provide.
senses.definition: a unit of heat equal to the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of one kilogram of water by one degree at one atmosphere pressure; used by nutritionists to characterize the energy-producing potential in food
senses.definitionSentence: Calorie is a unit of heat equal to the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of one kilogram of water by one degree at one atmosphere pressure; used by nutritionists to characterize the energy-producing potential in food.
senses.definitionZh: 热量单位，等于在一个大气压下将一公斤水的温度升高一度所需的热量；营养学家用来描述食物中产生能量的潜力。
senses.exampleZh: 营养标签使用卡路里来报告食物可以提供多少能量。

senses.example: The poisonous mushroom can cause vomiting, organ failure, or death if eaten.
senses.definition: having the qualities or effects of a poison
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as poisonous is having the qualities or effects of a poison.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为有毒的东西是指具有毒药的品质或效果。
senses.exampleZh: 有毒蘑菇如果食用会导致呕吐、器官衰竭或死亡。

senses.example: A Mississippi soldier wrote: `` Our General Reub Davis is a vain, stuck-up, illiterate ass ''.
senses.definition: characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as vain is characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为虚荣的东西是虚假骄傲的特征；有一种夸大的自我重要感。
senses.exampleZh: 一名密西西比士兵写道：“我们的鲁布·戴维斯将军是一个虚荣、自以为是、文盲的混蛋”。

senses.example: In a broad sense, it would reaffirm the Monroe Doctrine by opposing Communist interference in the Western Hemisphere.
senses.definition: a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries
senses.definitionSentence: Interference is a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries.
senses.definitionZh: 干涉别国事务的政策。
senses.exampleZh: 从广义上讲，它将通过反对共产主义干涉西半球来重申门罗主义。

senses.example: Political interference obstructed the investigation by preventing detectives from questioning senior officials.
senses.definition: any obstruction that impedes or is burdensome
senses.definitionSentence: Interference means any obstruction that impedes or is burdensome.
senses.definitionZh: 任何阻碍或造成负担的障碍物。
senses.exampleZh: 政治干预阻止侦探询问高级官员，从而阻碍了调查。

senses.example: Properly mindful of all the cultures in existence today throughout the world, we must employ these resources without war or violent revolution.
senses.definition: acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as violent is acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为暴力的事物是指以巨大的力量、能量或情绪强度来行动、以巨大的力量或能量或情绪强度为标志或由其产生。
senses.exampleZh: 正确考虑当今世界各地存在的所有文化，我们必须在没有战争或暴力革命的情况下利用这些资源。

senses.example: Young Mercer showed a remarkable lack of aptitude for both instruments.
senses.definition: a device that requires skill for proper use
senses.definitionSentence: Instrument is a device that requires skill for proper use.
senses.definitionZh: 一种需要技巧才能正确使用的设备。
senses.exampleZh: Young Mercer 对这两种工具都表现出明显缺乏天赋。

senses.example: The violin is a stringed instrument that produces music when a bow moves across its strings.
senses.definition: any of various devices or contrivances that can be used to produce musical tones or sounds
senses.definitionSentence: Instrument means any of various devices or contrivances that can be used to produce musical tones or sounds.
senses.definitionZh: 可用于产生乐音或声音的各种设备或装置。
senses.exampleZh: 小提琴是一种弦乐器，当弓在琴弦上移动时会产生音乐。

senses.example: At the clinic, several doctors examine patients, prescribe medicine, and perform minor procedures.
senses.definition: a medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists
senses.definitionSentence: Clinic is a medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists.
senses.definitionZh: 由一群医学专家经营的医疗机构。
senses.exampleZh: 在诊所，几位医生检查患者、开药并进行小手术。

senses.example: After the earthquake, displaced families slept in a temporary shelter with beds and hot meals.
senses.definition: temporary housing for homeless or displaced persons
senses.definitionSentence: Shelter means temporary housing for homeless or displaced persons.
senses.definitionZh: 为无家可归者或流离失所者提供的临时住房。
senses.exampleZh: 地震发生后，流离失所的家庭睡在配有床铺和热饭的临时避难所里。

senses.example: The cave offered shelter from the freezing wind while the climbers waited for daylight.
senses.definition: the condition of being protected
senses.definitionSentence: Shelter is the condition of being protected.
senses.definitionZh: 受到保护的条件。
senses.exampleZh: 登山者在等待天亮时，洞穴为他们提供了躲避寒风的庇护所。

senses.example: The government chartered the new university, granting it legal authority to award degrees.
senses.definition: grant a charter to
senses.definitionSentence: To charter means to grant a charter to.
senses.definitionZh: 授予特许。
senses.exampleZh: 政府特许这所新大学，授予其授予学位的法定权力。

senses.example: In the past, the men and women have chartered planes to Las Vegas and Jamaica, buses to Mineral Wells and Kerrville and private railway coaches to Shreveport and Galveston.
senses.definition: hold under a lease or rental agreement; of goods and services
senses.definitionSentence: To charter means to hold under a lease or rental agreement; of goods and services.
senses.definitionZh: 根据租赁或租赁协议持有；的商品和服务。
senses.exampleZh: 过去，这些男人和女人曾包租飞机前往拉斯维加斯和牙买加，乘坐巴士前往矿井井和克尔维尔，以及乘坐私人铁路客车前往什里夫波特和加尔维斯顿。

senses.example: Accordingly, though the practice violated the no trading provision of the Selkirk charter which reserved all such activity in merchandise and furs to the Hudson's Bay Company, some settlers went into trade.
senses.definition: a document incorporating an institution and specifying its rights; includes the articles of incorporation and the certificate of incorporation
senses.definitionSentence: Charter is a document incorporating an institution and specifying its rights; includes the articles of incorporation and the certificate of incorporation.
senses.definitionZh: 成立机构并明确其权利的文件；包括公司章程和公司证书。
senses.exampleZh: 因此，尽管这种做法违反了《塞尔柯克宪章》的禁止贸易条款，该宪章将所有此类商品和毛皮活动保留给哈德逊湾公司，但一些定居者还是开始从事贸易。

senses.example: O ' Banion accepted his platinum watch and the tributes to his loyalty, and proceeded with the bigger and better Republican deal.
senses.definition: relating to or belonging to the Republican Party
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as republican is relating to or belonging to the Republican Party.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为共和党的事物与共和党有关或属于共和党。
senses.exampleZh: 奥巴尼恩接受了他的白金手表和对他忠诚的致敬，并继续进行更大更好的共和党协议。

senses.example: As a republican, he opposed hereditary monarchy and argued that citizens should elect the head of state.
senses.definition: an advocate of a republic (usually in opposition to a monarchy)
senses.definitionSentence: Republican is an advocate of a republic (usually in opposition to a monarchy).
senses.definitionZh: 共和制的拥护者（通常反对君主制）。
senses.exampleZh: 作为共和制拥护者，他反对世袭君主制，并主张由公民选举国家元首。

senses.example: However, as much time as possible should be spent within the shelter to hold radiation exposure to a minimum.
senses.definition: the smallest possible quantity
senses.definitionSentence: Minimum is the smallest possible quantity.
senses.definitionZh: 可能的最小数量。
senses.exampleZh: 然而，应尽可能多地呆在避难所内，以将辐射暴露降至最低。

senses.example: Make sure you have minimum age and time on the job requirements tied into your pension plan.
senses.definition: the least possible
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as minimum is the least possible.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为最小的东西是最不可能的。
senses.exampleZh: 确保您的养老金计划符合最低年龄和工作时间要求。

senses.example: John's reply was like a declaration of war.
senses.definition: a statement that is emphatic and explicit (spoken or written)
senses.definitionSentence: Declaration is a statement that is emphatic and explicit (spoken or written).
senses.definitionZh: 强调且明确的声明（口头或书面）。
senses.exampleZh: 约翰的回复就像宣战一样。

senses.example: The issue was sufficiently potent in 1935 to spark secession from the American Federation of Labor of its industrial union members.
senses.definition: put in motion or move to act
senses.definitionSentence: To spark means to put in motion or move to act.
senses.definitionZh: 启动或采取行动。
senses.exampleZh: 1935 年，该问题的影响力足以引发其产业工会成员脱离美国劳工联合会。

senses.meaning: 火星，燃烧物飞出的碎屑
senses.example: A glowing spark flew from the fire and landed on the dry carpet.
senses.definition: a small fragment of a burning substance thrown out by burning material or by friction
senses.definitionSentence: Spark is a small fragment of a burning substance thrown out by burning material or by friction.
senses.definitionZh: 因燃烧材料或摩擦而抛出的燃烧物质的小碎片。
senses.exampleZh: 火中飞出炽热的火花，落在干燥的地毯上。

senses.definitionSentence: All the actors who perform in a play, film, or television production.
senses.definitionZh: 参加戏剧、电影或电视作品演出的全体演员。
senses.example: The entire cast returned to the stage and took a bow after the final scene.
senses.exampleZh: 最后一幕结束后，全体演员回到舞台上谢幕。
senses.definition: All the actors who perform in a play, film, or television production.

senses.example: Millions of citizens cast their votes before the polls closed at eight.
senses.definition: deposit
senses.definitionSentence: To deposit or register a vote.
senses.definitionZh: 投下或登记选票。
senses.exampleZh: 数百万公民在投票站八点关闭前投下了选票。

senses.example: Unions stress fringe benefits, but the individual hourly worker prefers cash every time.
senses.definition: money in the form of bills or coins
senses.definitionSentence: Cash means money in the form of bills or coins.
senses.definitionZh: 纸币或硬币形式的货币。
senses.exampleZh: 工会强调附加福利，但小时工个人每次都更喜欢现金。

senses.example: He made a circle with his thumb and fingers.
senses.definition: the thick short innermost digit of the forelimb
senses.definitionSentence: Thumb is the thick short innermost digit of the forelimb.
senses.definitionZh: 前肢最内侧粗短的手指。
senses.exampleZh: 他用拇指和手指画了一个圆圈。

senses.meaning: 用拇指翻书页，翻书页，翻动书页
senses.example: He thumbed through the report.
senses.definition: look through a book or other written material
senses.definitionSentence: To thumb means to look through a book or other written material.
senses.definitionZh: 翻阅书籍或其他书面材料。
senses.exampleZh: 他翻阅了报告。

senses.example: The museum displayed a silk garment sewn as clothing for a royal child.
senses.definition: an article of clothing
senses.definitionSentence: Garment is an article of clothing.
senses.definitionZh: 一件衣服。
senses.exampleZh: 博物馆展示了一件为皇室孩子缝制的丝绸服装。

senses.example: The discovery will undoubtedly change how doctors treat the disease.
senses.exampleZh: 这项发现无疑会改变医生治疗这种疾病的方式。
senses.definitionSentence: Without doubt; certainly.
senses.definitionZh: 毫无疑问；当然。

senses.example: It was destroyed by the strength of the gale.
senses.definition: physical energy or intensity
senses.definitionSentence: Strength means physical energy or intensity.
senses.definitionZh: 身体能量或强度。
senses.exampleZh: 它被大风摧毁了。

senses.example: Individual human strength is needed to pit against an inhuman condition.
senses.definition: the property of being physically or mentally strong
senses.definitionSentence: Strength is the property of being physically or mentally strong.
senses.definitionZh: 身体或精神上强大的属性。
senses.exampleZh: 需要个人的力量来对抗非人道的状况。

senses.example: But strength and poignancy develop thenceforth, and the windmill and deathbed episodes gather the threads of realization of the wonderfulness of the old boy.

senses.definitionZh: 被描述为丰富的东西大量存在。
senses.exampleZh: 经过数周的降雨，水库的水供应充足，远远超出了即时需求。

senses.example: These droplets are distorted by the normal forces just as a balloon would be pulled or pressed out of shape in one's hands.
senses.definition: form into a spiral shape
senses.definitionSentence: To distort means to form into a spiral shape.
senses.definitionZh: 形成螺旋形状。
senses.exampleZh: 这些水滴会因法向力而变形，就像气球在手中被拉或压变形一样。

senses.example: The editorial, by omitting the words anti-trust enforcement, totally distorted Mr. Kennedy's views.
senses.definition: make false by mutilation or addition; as of a message or story
senses.definitionSentence: To distort means to make false by mutilation or addition; as of a message or story.
senses.definitionZh: 通过毁坏或添加来制造虚假；作为消息或故事。
senses.exampleZh: 该社论省略了“反垄断执法”一词，完全歪曲了肯尼迪先生的观点。

senses.example: Probably, as in Scriptures, a still, small voice would whisper.
senses.definition: speak softly; in a low voice
senses.definitionSentence: To whisper means to speak softly; in a low voice.
senses.definitionZh: 轻声说话；低声。
senses.exampleZh: 也许，就像圣经中那样，一个安静的、微小的声音会低语。

senses.example: It contained a desk, files, a typewriter on a stand, and two big leather armchairs.
senses.definition: hand-operated character printer for printing written messages one character at a time
senses.definitionSentence: Typewriter means hand-operated character printer for printing written messages one character at a time.
senses.definitionZh: 手动字符打印机，用于一次打印一个字符的书面消息。
senses.exampleZh: 里面有一张桌子、文件、架子上的一台打字机和两张大皮扶手椅。

senses.example: They put her in a 4-bed ward.
senses.definition: block forming a division of a hospital (or a suite of rooms) shared by patients who need a similar kind of care
senses.definitionSentence: Ward means block forming a division of a hospital (or a suite of rooms) shared by patients who need a similar kind of care.
senses.definitionZh: 由需要类似护理的患者共享的医院分区（或一套房间）。
senses.exampleZh: 他们把她安置在一个有 4 个床位的病房。

senses.example: A mosquito net wards sleeping children from insects that carry malaria.
senses.definition: watch over or shield from danger or harm; protect
senses.definitionSentence: To ward means to watch over or shield from danger or harm; protect.
senses.definitionZh: 看守或保护免受危险或伤害；保护。
senses.exampleZh: 蚊帐可以保护熟睡的儿童免受携带疟疾的昆虫的侵害。

senses.example: Both candidates campaigned door to door in the city's northern ward before the local election.
senses.definition: a district into which a city or town is divided for the purpose of administration and elections
senses.definitionSentence: Ward is a district into which a city or town is divided for the purpose of administration and elections.
senses.definitionZh: 为了行政管理和选举而将城市或城镇划分为的区。
senses.exampleZh: 地方选举前，两名候选人在该市北部选区挨家挨户拉票。

senses.example: `` My beloved ward, my perennial gadfly '', said the whining voice.
senses.definition: a person who is under the protection or in the custody of another
senses.definitionSentence: Ward is a person who is under the protection or in the custody of another.
senses.definitionZh: 受到他人保护或监管的人。
senses.exampleZh: “我心爱的病房，我常年的牛虻”，哀嚎的声音说道。

senses.example: The shapes of the men ahead of him lacked solidity, as if the whip had stripped them of their very flesh.
senses.definition: the soft tissue of the body of a vertebrate: mainly muscle tissue and fat
senses.definitionSentence: Flesh is the soft tissue of the body of a vertebrate: mainly muscle tissue and fat.
senses.definitionZh: 脊椎动物身体的软组织：主要是肌肉组织和脂肪。
senses.exampleZh: 前面的人形体缺乏坚固性，仿佛鞭子已经剥去了他们的血肉。

senses.example: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.
senses.definition: alternative names for the body of a human being
senses.definitionSentence: Flesh means alternative names for the body of a human being.
senses.definitionZh: 人类身体的别称。
senses.exampleZh: 精神愿意，肉体却软弱。

senses.example: Someone stole my wallet on the train.
senses.definition: take without the owner's consent
senses.definitionSentence: To steal means to take without the owner's consent.
senses.definitionZh: 未经所有者同意而拿走。
senses.exampleZh: 有人在火车上偷了我的钱包。

senses.example: At twenty dollars for a nearly new bicycle, the purchase was an absolute steal.
senses.definition: an advantageous purchase
senses.definitionSentence: Steal is an advantageous purchase.
senses.definitionZh: 一种有利的购买。
senses.exampleZh: 一辆近乎全新的自行车售价为二十美元，绝对是物超所值。

senses.example: The unexpected confession stunned the courtroom into complete silence.
senses.definition: overcome as with astonishment or disbelief
senses.definitionSentence: To stun means to overcome as with astonishment or disbelief.
senses.definitionZh: 克服惊讶或难以置信。
senses.exampleZh: 出乎意料的认罪让法庭陷入一片寂静。

senses.example: Two committees pondered 375 possible Kimpton successors, including Adlai Stevenson, Richard Nixon, and Harvard's Dean McGeorge Bundy.
senses.definition: reflect deeply on a subject
senses.definitionSentence: To ponder means to reflect deeply on a subject.
senses.definitionZh: 深入思考某个主题。
senses.exampleZh: 两个委员会考虑了 375 名可能的金普顿继任者，包括阿德莱·史蒂文森、理查德·尼克松和哈佛大学的院长麦乔治·邦迪。

senses.example: The neighbors accused the man of spousal abuse.
senses.definition: bring an accusation against; level a charge against
senses.definitionSentence: To accuse means to bring an accusation against; level a charge against.
senses.definitionZh: 提出指控；提出指控。
senses.exampleZh: 邻居指控该男子虐待配偶。

senses.example: Then he hunkered down on the heels of his handmade boots, peered into the orderly chaos of axle, shock absorber, and spring.
senses.definition: footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg
senses.definitionSentence: Boot means footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg.
senses.definitionZh: 覆盖整个脚和小腿的鞋类。
senses.exampleZh: 然后他蹲在手工靴子的后跟上，凝视着车轴、减震器和弹簧的有序混乱。

senses.example: Cursing himself for having ridden out the last few days without a rifle in his saddle boot, Russ drew his Colt and examined it briefly.
senses.definition: British term for the luggage compartment in a car
senses.definitionSentence: Boot means British term for the luggage compartment in a car.
senses.definitionZh: 英国术语，指汽车中的行李舱。
senses.exampleZh: 鲁斯咒骂自己这几天骑马出去时马鞍靴里没有装步枪，他拔出他的柯尔特手枪，简单地检查了一下。

senses.example: The giant waves are more dangerous on flat shores than on steep ones.
senses.definition: having a sharp inclination
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as steep is having a sharp inclination.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓陡峭的事物具有急剧的倾斜度。
senses.exampleZh: 平坦海岸上的巨浪比陡峭海岸上的巨浪更危险。

senses.example: The lawyer with whom I studied law steered me off the Socialist track.
senses.definition: direct the course; determine the direction of travelling
senses.definitionSentence: To steer means to direct the course; determine the direction of travelling.
senses.definitionZh: 引导航向；确定行驶方向。
senses.exampleZh: 和我一起学习法律的律师引导我偏离了社会主义轨道。

senses.example: Winston took out a pencil, admired the point, and wrote slowly and heavily, `` Clothes Stand ''.
senses.definition: a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood
senses.definitionSentence: Pencil is a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood.
senses.definitionZh: 一种细长的圆柱形尖头书写工具；一根包裹在木头中的标记物质棒。
senses.exampleZh: 温斯顿拿出一支铅笔，欣赏了这一点，然后缓慢而沉重地写下了“衣架”。

senses.example: The description of the car was immediately broadcast throughout Southern Maryland on police radio.
senses.definition: broadcast over the airwaves, as in radio or television
senses.definitionSentence: To broadcast means to broadcast over the airwaves, as in radio or television.
senses.definitionZh: 通过无线电波进行广播，如广播或电视。
senses.exampleZh: 该车的描述立即通过警察电台广播到马里兰州南部。

senses.example: It probably will be necessary to install an outside antenna, particularly to receive CONELRAD broadcasts.
senses.definition: message that is transmitted by radio or television
senses.definitionSentence: Broadcast means message that is transmitted by radio or television.
senses.definitionZh: 通过无线电或电视传输的消息。
senses.exampleZh: 可能需要安装外部天线，特别是接收 CONELRAD 广播时。

senses.example: The evening broadcast included the weather forecast, national headlines, and a live interview.
senses.definition: a radio or television show
senses.definitionSentence: Broadcast is a radio or television show.
senses.definitionZh: 广播或电视节目。
senses.exampleZh: 晚间广播包括天气预报、全国头条新闻和现场采访。

senses.example: From actions aboard, it is easy to guess that Spencer's boast of twenty staunch followers was a modest estimate ''.
senses.definition: on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle
senses.definitionSentence: Aboard means on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle.
senses.definitionZh: 在轮船、火车、飞机或其他交通工具上。
senses.exampleZh: 从船上的行动，很容易猜测斯宾塞吹嘘的二十个坚定的追随者只是一个适度的估计。

senses.example: All passengers aboard the ferry wore life jackets.
senses.exampleZh: 渡轮上的所有乘客都穿着救生衣。
senses.definitionSentence: On board of; onto or into a ship, boat, train, plane.
senses.definitionZh: 在船上；登上或进入轮船、船、火车、飞机。

senses.example: His face was dark as the sky above it as he stood on the wing and waited for his pilot.
senses.definition: someone who is licensed to operate an aircraft in flight
senses.definitionSentence: Pilot means someone who is licensed to operate an aircraft in flight.
senses.definitionZh: 获得在飞行中操作飞机的许可的人员。
senses.exampleZh: 当他站在机翼上等待飞行员时，他的脸色和头顶的天空一样漆黑。

senses.example: An experienced captain piloted the cargo ship through the narrow channel between hidden reefs.
senses.definition: act as the navigator in a car, plane, or vessel and plan, direct, plot the path and position of the conveyance
senses.definitionSentence: To pilot means to act as the navigator in a car, plane, or vessel and plan, direct, plot the path and position of the conveyance.
senses.definitionZh: 在汽车、飞机或船舶上担任导航员，并计划、指挥、绘制运输工具的路径和位置。
senses.exampleZh: 一位经验丰富的船长驾驶货船穿过暗礁之间的狭窄航道。

senses.example: Aim to balance your employee benefit package.
senses.definition: a collection of things wrapped or boxed together
senses.definitionSentence: Package is a collection of things wrapped or boxed together.
senses.definitionZh: 包裹或装箱在一起的物品的集合。
senses.exampleZh: 旨在平衡您的员工福利计划。

senses.example: The gallery displayed paintings and sculptures in six connected exhibition rooms.
senses.definition: a room or series of rooms where works of art are exhibited
senses.definitionSentence: Gallery is a room or series of rooms where works of art are exhibited.
senses.definitionZh: 展示艺术品的一个或一系列房间。
senses.exampleZh: 画廊在六个相连的展览室中展示了绘画和雕塑。

senses.example: Visitors watched the ceremony from the narrow upper gallery overlooking the hall.
senses.definition: narrow recessed balcony area along an upper floor on the interior of a building; usually marked by a colonnade
senses.definitionSentence: Gallery means narrow recessed balcony area along an upper floor on the interior of a building; usually marked by a colonnade.
senses.definitionZh: 沿着建筑物内部上层的狭窄嵌入式阳台区域；通常以柱廊为标志。
senses.exampleZh: 参观者从俯瞰大厅的狭窄上层画廊观看了仪式。

senses.example: This passion brings on a fit which proves fatal.
senses.definition: bringing death
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as fatal is bringing death.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为致命的东西正在带来死亡。
senses.exampleZh: 这种激情会导致致命的发作。

senses.example: On Sundays they had a large dinner when they returned from church.
senses.definition: the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday
senses.definitionSentence: Dinner is the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday.
senses.definitionZh: 一天中的主餐，在晚上或中午供应。
senses.exampleZh: 周日，他们从教堂回来后吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

senses.example: During much of the fifteen mile ride they had watched a lurid display of lightning in the sky to the east.
senses.definition: the cardinal compass point that is at 90 degrees
senses.definitionSentence: East is the cardinal compass point that is at 90 degrees.
senses.definitionZh: 90 度的罗盘基点。
senses.exampleZh: 在十五英里的骑行过程中，他们看到东方天空中出现了可怕的闪电。

senses.example: The oil boom enriched a lot of local people.
senses.definition: make wealthy or richer
senses.definitionSentence: To enrich means to make wealthy or richer.
senses.definitionZh: 变得富有或更富有。
senses.exampleZh: 石油繁荣让很多当地人致富。

senses.example: "what a nice fellow you are and we all thought you so nasty"- George Meredith.
senses.definition: pleasant or pleasing or agreeable in nature or appearance
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as nice is pleasant or pleasing or agreeable in nature or appearance.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为美好的事物在本质或外观上是令人愉快的、令人愉快的或令人愉快的。
senses.exampleZh: “你真是个好人，我们都觉得你很讨厌”- 乔治·梅雷迪思。

senses.example: He was dozing, perhaps the only sleep he 'd gotten.
senses.definition: sleep lightly or for a short period of time
senses.definitionSentence: To doze means to sleep lightly or for a short period of time.
senses.definitionZh: 浅睡或短时间睡眠。
senses.exampleZh: 他正在打瞌睡，这也许是他唯一的睡眠。

senses.example: Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to the tissues and carries away waste products.
senses.definition: the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped through the body by the heart and contains plasma, blood cells, and platelets
senses.definitionSentence: Blood is the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped through the body by the heart and contains plasma, blood cells, and platelets.
senses.definitionZh: 由心脏泵入体内的液体（在脊椎动物中为红色），含有血浆、血细胞和血小板。
senses.exampleZh: 血液将氧气和营养物质输送到组织并带走废物。

senses.example: Her fashionable suit was elegantly cut and admired by guests for its refined style.
senses.definition: having elegance or taste or refinement in manners or dress
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as fashionable is having elegance or taste or refinement in manners or dress.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓时尚是指在举止或着装方面具有优雅、品味或精致。
senses.exampleZh: 她的时尚套装剪裁优雅，精致的风格受到嘉宾的赞赏。

senses.example: Security footage showed the theft of a laptop from an unlocked office.
senses.definition: the act of taking something from someone unlawfully
senses.definitionSentence: Theft is the act of taking something from someone unlawfully.
senses.definitionZh: 非法从他人手中夺取某物的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 监控录像显示，一台笔记本电脑从未上锁的办公室被盗。

senses.example: The dodo is extinct because no living member of the species has survived.
senses.definition: no longer in existence; lost or especially having died out leaving no living representatives
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as extinct is no longer in existence; lost or especially having died out leaving no living representatives.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为灭绝的东西不再存在；消失或者特别是已经灭绝，没有留下任何活着的代表。
senses.exampleZh: 渡渡鸟已经灭绝，因为该物种中没有任何现存成员能够幸存。

senses.example: Prolong the treatment of the patient.
senses.definition: lengthen or extend in duration or space
senses.definitionSentence: To prolong means to lengthen or extend in duration or space.
senses.definitionZh: 延长或延长持续时间或空间。
senses.exampleZh: 延长患者的治疗时间。

senses.example: The health ministry initiated a nationwide vaccination campaign after the first outbreak was confirmed.
senses.definition: set in motion, start an event or prepare the way for
senses.definitionSentence: To initiate means to set in motion, start an event or prepare the way for.
senses.definitionZh: 开始行动、开始一个事件或为之准备道路。
senses.exampleZh: 确认首次疫情爆发后，卫生部启动了全国范围内的疫苗接种运动。

senses.example: The sun moved slant-wise across the sky and down; the trees ' shadows circled from street to sidewalk, from sidewalk to lawn.
senses.definition: shade within clear boundaries
senses.definitionSentence: Shadow means shade within clear boundaries.
senses.definitionZh: 清晰边界内的阴影。
senses.exampleZh: 太阳倾斜地穿过天空并向下移动；树影从街道绕到人行道，从人行道到草坪。

senses.example: In the fog, the distant figure appeared only as a shadow that vanished when she approached.
senses.definition: something existing in perception only
senses.definitionSentence: Shadow means something existing in perception only.
senses.definitionZh: 仅存在于感知中的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 雾中远处的人影只是一个模糊幻影，她走近时便消失了。

senses.example: The tall office tower shadows the small park, blocking direct sunlight for most of the afternoon.
senses.definition: cast a shadow over
senses.definitionSentence: To shadow means to cast a shadow over.
senses.definitionZh: 投射阴影。
senses.exampleZh: 高大的办公楼遮住了小公园，在下午的大部分时间里阻挡了直射阳光。

senses.example: The police are shadowing her.
senses.definition: follow, usually without the person's knowledge
senses.definitionSentence: To shadow means to follow, usually without the person's knowledge.
senses.definitionZh: 跟随，通常是在人不知情的情况下。
senses.exampleZh: 警察正在跟踪她。

senses.example: She opened the lightweight laptop on her knees and finished the report during the train journey.
senses.definition: a portable computer small enough to use in your lap
senses.definitionSentence: Laptop is a portable computer small enough to use in your lap.
senses.definitionZh: 一种足够小，可以放在膝盖上使用的便携式计算机。
senses.exampleZh: 她在火车旅途中打开膝盖上的轻便笔记本电脑并完成了报告。

senses.example: Since blocks are often defined as a single sector, the terms `block' and `sector' are sometimes used interchangeably.
senses.definition: (computer science) a sector or group of sectors that function as the smallest data unit permitted
senses.definitionSentence: Block means (computer science) a sector or group of sectors that function as the smallest data unit permitted.
senses.definitionZh: （计算机科学）充当允许的最小数据单元的扇区或扇区组。
senses.exampleZh: 由于块通常被定义为单个扇区，因此术语“块”和“扇区”有时可以互换使用。

senses.example: He lives in the next block.
senses.definition: a rectangular area in a city surrounded by streets and usually containing several buildings
senses.definitionSentence: Block is a rectangular area in a city surrounded by streets and usually containing several buildings.
senses.definitionZh: 城市中被街道包围的矩形区域，通常包含多座建筑物。
senses.exampleZh: 他住在下一个街区。

senses.example: Many legislators are already weary and frustrated over the so-far losing battle to block token integration.
senses.definition: stop from happening or developing
senses.definitionSentence: To block means to stop from happening or developing.
senses.definitionZh: 阻止发生或发展。
senses.exampleZh: 许多立法者已经对迄今为止阻止代币整合的失败之战感到疲倦和沮丧。

senses.example: His brother blocked him at every turn.
senses.definition: hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
senses.definitionSentence: To block means to hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of.
senses.definitionZh: 阻碍或阻止某事的进展或成就。
senses.exampleZh: 他的兄弟每次都挡住他。

senses.example: A plumber removed a block of grease and hair that had stopped water flowing through the drainpipe.
senses.definition: an obstruction in a pipe or tube
senses.definitionSentence: Block is an obstruction in a pipe or tube.
senses.definitionZh: 管道或管道中的障碍物。
senses.exampleZh: 一名水管工清除了阻止水流过排水管的一块油脂和头发。

senses.example: She accidentally deleted the recording from the memory card and could not recover the digital file.
senses.definition: wipe out digitally or magnetically recorded information
senses.definitionSentence: To delete means to wipe out digitally or magnetically recorded information.
senses.definitionZh: 擦除数字或磁性记录的信息。
senses.exampleZh: 她不小心从存储卡中删除了录音，并且无法恢复数字文件。

senses.example: How it got out is a mystery.
senses.definition: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained
senses.definitionSentence: Mystery means something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained.
senses.definitionZh: 令人难以理解且无法解释的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 它是如何出去的还是个谜。

senses.example: We disguised our faces before robbing the bank.
senses.definition: make unrecognizable
senses.definitionSentence: To disguise means to make unrecognizable.
senses.definitionZh: 变得无法识别。
senses.exampleZh: 我们在抢劫银行之前伪装了自己的脸。

senses.example: His wig, false beard, and delivery uniform formed a disguise that concealed his identity.
senses.definition: any attire that modifies the appearance in order to conceal the wearer's identity
senses.definitionSentence: Disguise means any attire that modifies the appearance in order to conceal the wearer's identity.
senses.definitionZh: 为了隐藏穿着者身份而改变外观的任何服装。
senses.exampleZh: 他的假发、假胡子和送货制服构成了隐藏身份的伪装。

senses.example: `` Parsifal '' follows July 25, with Hans Knappertsbusch conducting, and he also conducts `` Die Meistersinger '', to be presented Aug. 8 and 12.
senses.definition: the month following June and preceding August
