senses.exampleZh: 即使洗过之后，他的白衬衫上仍然残留着黑色的油渍。

senses.example: Trooper J. A. Grzesiak spotted the wanted car, with three boys, at a Route 2 service station, just outside Annapolis.
senses.definition: catch sight of
senses.definitionSentence: To spot means to catch sight of.
senses.definitionZh: 看到。
senses.exampleZh: 警员 J. A. Grzesiak 在安纳波利斯郊外的 2 号公路服务站发现了这辆通缉汽车，车上载着三个男孩。

senses.example: Killpath pulled one thin leg up, clamping his arms around the shinbone to press his knee into an incredibly scrawny gut.
senses.definition: hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella
senses.definitionSentence: Knee means hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella.
senses.definitionZh: 人腿中连接胫骨和腓骨与股骨的铰链关节，并在前面受到髌骨的保护。
senses.exampleZh: Killpath 拉起一条细腿，双臂夹住胫骨，将膝盖压入骨瘦如柴的肠道。

senses.example: The dress clings to her body.
senses.definition: come or be in close contact with; stick or hold together and resist separation
senses.definitionSentence: To cling means to come or be in close contact with; stick or hold together and resist separation.
senses.definitionZh: 接近或密切接触；粘在一起或保持在一起并抵制分离。
senses.exampleZh: 这件衣服紧贴着她的身体。

senses.example: They lay, with the birds hopping from branch to branch above them and the bright sky peeping down at them.
senses.definition: jump lightly
senses.definitionSentence: To hop means to jump lightly.
senses.definitionZh: 轻轻跳跃。
senses.exampleZh: 他们躺着，鸟儿在他们上方的树枝间跳来跳去，明亮的天空俯视着他们。

senses.example: Did you ever climb up the hill behind your house?
senses.definition: go upward with gradual or continuous progress
senses.definitionSentence: To climb means to go upward with gradual or continuous progress.
senses.definitionZh: 逐渐或持续地向上走。
senses.exampleZh: 你爬过你家后面的小山吗？

senses.example: Sales were climbing after prices were lowered.
senses.definition: go up or advance
senses.definitionSentence: To climb means to go up or advance.
senses.definitionZh: 向上或前进。
senses.exampleZh: 价格降低后销量攀升。

senses.example: On the safety map, a red triangle denotes danger and makes the hazardous area known to readers.
senses.definition: make known; make an announcement
senses.definitionSentence: To denote means to make known; make an announcement.
senses.definitionZh: 表示使已知的意思；发布公告。
senses.exampleZh: 在安全地图上，红色三角形表示危险，让读者了解危险区域。

senses.example: A sign-language interpreter facilitated communication between the deaf patient and the emergency doctor.
senses.definition: be of use
senses.definitionSentence: To facilitate means to be of use.
senses.definitionZh: 方便使用的手段。
senses.exampleZh: 一名手语翻译员帮助聋人患者与急诊医生顺利沟通。

senses.example: Even so, he generally listened and was usually reasonable to those who voiced their objections properly.
senses.definition: showing reason or sound judgment
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as reasonable is showing reason or sound judgment.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓合理的事物是指表现出理由或合理的判断。
senses.exampleZh: 即便如此，他通常会倾听那些正确表达反对意见的人，并且通常很合理。

senses.example: The election debate was broadcast live on TV.
senses.exampleZh: 选举辩论在电视上进行了现场直播。
senses.definitionSentence: Television (television).
senses.definitionZh: 电视（电视）。

senses.example: During summers, business was so brisk that Mrs. Wilcox had two assistants and a messenger.
senses.definition: a person who carries a message
senses.definitionSentence: Messenger is a person who carries a message.
senses.definitionZh: 携带消息的人。
senses.exampleZh: 夏天，生意非常红火，威尔科克斯夫人有两名助手和一名信使。

senses.example: A tall palm rose from a single trunk topped by a crown of broad green leaves.
senses.definition: any plant of the family Palmae having an unbranched trunk crowned by large pinnate or palmate leaves
senses.definitionSentence: Palm means any plant of the family Palmae having an unbranched trunk crowned by large pinnate or palmate leaves.
senses.definitionZh: 具有不分枝的树干、顶部有大的羽状或掌状叶子的棕榈科植物。
senses.exampleZh: 一棵高大的棕榈树从一根树干上升起，树干上有一顶宽阔的绿叶。

senses.example: The clock you heard strike - it's really the town clock - was installed last April by Mrs. Shorter, on her birthday ''.
senses.definition: an anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it)
senses.definitionSentence: Birthday is an anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it).
senses.definitionZh: 一个人出生的日子（或庆祝该日子）的周年纪念日。
senses.exampleZh: 您听到敲击的时钟 - 它实际上是城镇时钟 - 是去年四月肖特夫人在她生日那天安装的。

senses.example: Liberty--perfect liberty--to think or feel or do just as one pleases.
senses.definition: freedom of choice
senses.definitionSentence: Liberty means freedom of choice.
senses.definitionZh: 选择的自由。
senses.exampleZh: 自由——完美的自由——随心所欲地思考、感受或做事。

senses.example: The runners reached the finish line, panting heavily.
senses.definition: breathe noisily, as when one is exhausted
senses.definitionSentence: To pant means to breathe noisily, as when one is exhausted.
senses.definitionZh: 大声呼吸，就像一个人筋疲力尽时一样。
senses.exampleZh: 跑者们气喘吁吁地到达了终点线。

senses.example: I have trouble remembering the names of all my acquaintances.
senses.definition: a person with whom you are acquainted
senses.definitionSentence: Acquaintance is a person with whom you are acquainted.
senses.definitionZh: 与您相识的人。
senses.exampleZh: 我很难记住所有熟人的名字。

senses.example: Our acquaintance began at a conference, but we never became close friends.
senses.definition: a relationship less intimate than friendship
senses.definitionSentence: Acquaintance is a relationship less intimate than friendship.
senses.definitionZh: 一种不如友谊那么亲密的关系。
senses.exampleZh: 我们的相识始于一次会议，但我们从未成为亲密的朋友。

senses.example: His long acquaintance with local history helped him identify the ruined building in the photograph.
senses.definition: personal knowledge or information about someone or something
senses.definitionSentence: Acquaintance means personal knowledge or information about someone or something.
senses.definitionZh: 关于某人或某事的个人知识或信息。
senses.exampleZh: 他对当地历史的长期了解帮助他识别了照片中的废墟建筑。

senses.example: An energetic fund raiser for the college.
senses.definition: possessing or exerting or displaying energy
dictionaryCandidates: 有力的， 精力旺盛的
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as energetic is possessing or exerting or displaying energy.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为精力充沛的事物是指拥有、发挥或展示能量。
senses.exampleZh: 为学院积极筹款。

senses.example: Clarify the mystery surrounding her death.
senses.definition: make clear and (more) comprehensible
senses.definitionSentence: To clarify means to make clear and (more) comprehensible.
senses.definitionZh: 变得清晰且（更）易于理解。
senses.exampleZh: 澄清她的死亡之谜。

senses.example: Some fourteen or fifteen years ago, in an essay I called The Leader Follows - Where?
senses.definition: an analytic or interpretive literary composition
senses.definitionSentence: Essay is an analytic or interpretive literary composition.
senses.definitionZh: 一种分析性或解释性的文学作品。
senses.exampleZh: 大约十四或十五年前，我在一篇名为“领导者跟随 - 哪里？”的文章中。

senses.example: The infant had essayed a few wobbly steps.
senses.definition: make an effort or attempt
senses.definitionSentence: To essay means to make an effort or attempt.
senses.definitionZh: 尝试。
senses.exampleZh: 婴儿的脚步有些摇晃。

senses.example: Too big to be extinguished at once, the forest fires at best could be contained.
senses.definition: put out, as of fires, flames, or lights
senses.definitionSentence: To extinguish means to put out, as of fires, flames, or lights.
senses.definitionZh: 扑灭火、火焰或灯。
senses.exampleZh: 森林大火规模太大，无法立即扑灭，最多只能得到控制。

senses.example: As shown in Figure 1, there is a connection for communication between every pair of points.
senses.definition: two items of the same kind
senses.definitionSentence: Pair means two items of the same kind.
senses.definitionZh: 两个相同种类的物品。
senses.exampleZh: 如图 1 所示，每对点之间都有一个用于通信的连接。

senses.example: Doctors are working hard to keep him alive.
senses.definition: possessing life
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as alive is possessing life.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓活着的东西就是拥有生命。
senses.exampleZh: 医生正在努力挽救他的生命。

senses.example: She was wonderfully alive for her age.
senses.definition: (often followed by `with') full of life and spirit
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as alive is (often followed by `with') full of life and spirit.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“活着”的东西（通常后跟“带有”）充满生命和精神。
senses.exampleZh: 就她的年龄而言，她的生命力非常出色。

senses.example: He pushed the table into a corner.
senses.definition: move with force
senses.definitionSentence: To push means to move with force.
senses.definitionZh: 用力移动。
senses.exampleZh: 他把桌子推到了角落。

senses.meaning: 剧目，常备演出作品清单
senses.example: The opera company's repertoire includes twelve works that it performs regularly throughout the season.
senses.definition: a collection of works (plays, songs, operas, ballets) that an artist or company can perform and do perform for short intervals on a regular schedule
senses.definitionSentence: Repertoire is a collection of works (plays, songs, operas, ballets) that an artist or company can perform and do perform for short intervals on a regular schedule.
senses.definitionZh: 艺术家或公司可以表演并且定期定期短时间表演的作品集（戏剧、歌曲、歌剧、芭蕾舞）。
senses.exampleZh: 该歌剧团的剧目包括十二部作品，在整个演出季定期演出。

senses.example: The red message was urgent and demanded immediate evacuation before the approaching fire reached the town.
senses.definition: compelling immediate action
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as urgent is compelling immediate action.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为紧急的事情是必须立即采取行动。
senses.exampleZh: 红色信息很紧急，要求在迫近的火势到达城镇之前立即疏散。

senses.example: Our central goal should be to provide the greatest positive incentive for these societies to tackle boldly the tasks which they face.
senses.definition: a positive motivational influence
senses.definitionSentence: Incentive is a positive motivational influence.
senses.definitionZh: 一种积极的激励影响。
senses.exampleZh: 我们的中心目标应该是为这些社会提供最大的积极激励，以大胆地解决他们面临的任务。

senses.example: Pure luck saved the hiker when a falling rock missed his head by a few centimetres.
senses.definition: your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)
senses.definitionSentence: Luck means your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you).
senses.definitionZh: 您生活中的整体情况或状况（包括发生在您身上的一切）。
senses.exampleZh: 当一块落石偏离他的头部几厘米时，纯粹的运气救了这位徒步旅行者。

senses.example: It was my good luck to be there.
senses.definition: an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that leads to a favorable outcome
senses.definitionSentence: Luck is an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that leads to a favorable outcome.
senses.definitionZh: 一种未知且不可预测的现象，它会带来有利的结果。
senses.exampleZh: 我很幸运能去那里。

senses.example: May I borrow your lawn mower?
senses.definition: get temporarily
senses.definitionSentence: To borrow means to get temporarily.
senses.definitionZh: 暂时获得。
senses.exampleZh: 我可以借你的割草机吗？

senses.example: For some compulsive reason which would have fascinated Dr. Freud, Communists of all shapes and sizes almost invariably impute to others the very motives which they harbor themselves.
senses.definition: cause to be interested or curious
senses.definitionSentence: To fascinate means to cause to be interested or curious.
senses.definitionZh: 引起兴趣或好奇。
senses.exampleZh: 出于某种令弗洛伊德博士着迷的强迫性原因，各种形状和规模的共产主义者几乎总是将他们自己所怀有的动机归咎于他人。

senses.example: The dancer's grace and confidence fascinated the audience, who could not take their eyes off her.
senses.definition: attract; cause to be enamored
senses.definitionSentence: To fascinate means to attract; cause to be enamored.
senses.definitionZh: 吸引；让人倾心。
senses.exampleZh: 舞者的优雅和自信让观众着迷，目不转睛。

senses.example: With Hudson looking on, his protege Greene picked a fight with the ship's surgeon, Edward Wilson.
senses.definition: a physician who specializes in surgery
senses.definitionSentence: Surgeon is a physician who specializes in surgery.
senses.definitionZh: 专门从事外科手术的医生。
senses.exampleZh: 在哈德森的注视下，他的门生格林与船上的外科医生爱德华·威尔逊发生了争斗。

senses.example: His smile was very mechanical.
senses.definition: using (or as if using) mechanisms or tools or devices
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as mechanical is using (or as if using) mechanisms or tools or devices.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为机械的东西是使用（或好像使用）机制、工具或设备。
senses.exampleZh: 他的笑容非常机械。

senses.example: The curious relationship between Holmes and Scotland Yard provides an important clue to the deeper significance of his eccentric behavior.
senses.definition: evidence that helps to solve a problem
senses.definitionSentence: Clue means evidence that helps to solve a problem.
senses.definitionZh: 有助于解决问题的证据。
senses.exampleZh: 福尔摩斯和苏格兰场之间的奇怪关系为了解他古怪行为的更深层次意义提供了重要线索。

senses.example: The Aricaras broke under the devastating fire, wheeled and retreated.
senses.definition: pull back or move away or backward
senses.definitionSentence: To retreat means to pull back or move away or backward.
senses.definitionZh: 撤退、移开或向后退。
senses.exampleZh: 阿里卡拉号在毁灭性的火力下崩溃，掉头撤退。

senses.example: He jumped to his feet and started to throw punches.
senses.definition: (boxing) a blow with the fist
senses.definitionSentence: Punch means (boxing) a blow with the fist.
senses.definitionZh: （拳击）用拳头击打。
senses.exampleZh: 他跳了起来并开始出拳。

senses.meaning: 戳洞，打孔，打洞，打眼于，穿孔于
senses.example: Use the perforator to punch three holes along the edge of each sheet before filing it in the binder.
senses.definition: make a hole into or between, as for ease of separation
senses.definitionSentence: To punch means to make a hole into or between, as for ease of separation.
senses.definitionZh: 在内部或之间打孔，以便于分离。
senses.exampleZh: 在将其装入活页夹之前，使用打孔器沿每张纸的边缘打三个孔。

senses.example: The general dictated through fear, issuing orders that no citizen was allowed to challenge.
senses.definition: rule as a dictator
senses.definitionSentence: To dictate means to rule as a dictator.
senses.definitionZh: 作为独裁者进行统治。
senses.exampleZh: 将军因恐惧而发号施令，发布任何公民不得质疑的命令。

senses.example: He dictated a report to his secretary.
senses.definition: say out loud for the purpose of recording
senses.definitionSentence: To dictate means to say out loud for the purpose of recording.
senses.definitionZh: 为了录音而大声说出来。
senses.exampleZh: 他向他的秘书口述了一份报告。

senses.definitionSentence: To put clothes on yourself or another person.
senses.definitionZh: 给自己或另一个人穿上衣服。
senses.example: She dressed the child in a warm coat, scarf, and gloves before they went outside.
senses.exampleZh: 出门前，她给孩子穿上暖和的外套，并戴好围巾和手套。
senses.definition: To put clothes on yourself or another person.

senses.example: The man wore a vest and a tie, the woman had on a dark green dress and three strands of pearls.
senses.definition: a one-piece garment for a woman; has skirt and bodice
senses.definitionSentence: Dress is a one-piece garment for a woman; has skirt and bodice.
senses.definitionZh: 女性的一件式服装；有裙子和紧身胸衣。
senses.exampleZh: 男子穿着背心，打着领带，女子穿着深绿色连衣裙，佩戴三串珍珠。

senses.example: The scientist corresponds with colleagues in order to learn about matters relevant to her own research.
senses.definition: having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as relevant is having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为相关的事物与所讨论的主题有关系或有联系。
senses.exampleZh: 科学家与同事通信，以了解与她自己的研究相关的问题。

senses.example: I grok I shall never be lonely again ''.
senses.definition: marked by dejection from being alone
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as lonely is marked by dejection from being alone.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为孤独的事物的特征是因孤独而感到沮丧。
senses.exampleZh: 我明白我再也不会感到孤独了。

senses.example: Spent an anxious night waiting for the test results.
senses.definition: causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as anxious is causing or fraught with or showing anxiety.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为焦虑的事物会引起或充满或表现出焦虑。
senses.exampleZh: 焦急地等待测试结果度过了一个晚上。

senses.meaning: 前夕，重大事件关头，前夜
senses.example: On the eve of the French Revolution.
senses.definition: the period immediately before something
senses.definitionSentence: Eve is the period immediately before something.
senses.definitionZh: 某件事之前的一段时间。
senses.exampleZh: 法国大革命前夕。

senses.example: On a warm summer eve, the family ate outdoors as daylight slowly faded into night.
senses.definition: the latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall)
senses.definitionSentence: Eve is the latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall).
senses.definitionZh: 一天中的后半部分（从下午晚些时候到夜幕降临，日照逐渐减少的时期）。
senses.exampleZh: 在一个温暖的夏夜，一家人在户外吃饭，日光慢慢地变成了夜色。

senses.example: Similar findings have been noted in a patient with congenital absence of the organification enzymes, whose thyroid tissue could only concentrate iodide.
senses.definition: part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function
senses.definitionSentence: Tissue means part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function.
senses.definitionZh: 由具有相似结构和功能的细胞聚集体组成的生物体的一部分。
senses.exampleZh: 在先天性缺乏组织酶的患者中也发现了类似的发现，其甲状腺组织只能浓缩碘化物。

senses.example: The conclusion upon this record is inescapable that such likelihood was proved as to this acquisition ''.
senses.definition: the probability of a specified outcome
senses.definitionSentence: Likelihood is the probability of a specified outcome.
senses.definitionZh: 定结果的概率。
senses.exampleZh: 根据该记录得出的结论是不可避免的，即对于此次收购“证明了这种可能性”。

senses.example: In their very first speeches it was clear that Shakespeare, like a Nostradamus, had foreseen this moment.
senses.definition: realize beforehand
senses.definitionSentence: To foresee means to realize beforehand.
senses.definitionZh: 提前实现。
senses.exampleZh: 在他们的第一次演讲中，很明显莎士比亚就像诺查丹玛斯一样预见到了这一刻。

senses.example: The sudden change of rules bewildered the new employees and left them unsure what to do.
senses.definition: cause to be confused emotionally
senses.definitionSentence: To bewilder means to cause to be confused emotionally.
senses.definitionZh: 导致情感上的混乱。
senses.exampleZh: 突然的规则变化让新员工感到困惑，不知道该怎么办。

senses.definition: join or attach with or as if with glue
senses.definitionSentence: Join or attach with or as if with glue.
senses.definitionZh: 用胶水或如同用胶水一样连接或附着。
senses.example: She glued the broken handle back onto the cup with a strong adhesive.
senses.exampleZh: 她用强力粘合剂将破损的手柄粘回杯子上。

senses.example: She spread glue on both pieces of wood and pressed them together until the adhesive dried.
senses.definition: cement consisting of a sticky substance that is used as an adhesive
senses.definitionSentence: Glue means cement consisting of a sticky substance that is used as an adhesive.
senses.definitionZh: 由用作粘合剂的粘性物质组成的水泥。
senses.exampleZh: 她将胶水涂在两块木头上，然后将它们压在一起，直到粘合剂干燥。

senses.example: It must be washed repeatedly.
senses.definition: several time
senses.definitionSentence: Repeatedly means several time.
senses.definitionZh: 多次。
senses.exampleZh: 必须反复清洗。

senses.example: The company cloaked illegal payments as ordinary consulting fees in its accounts.
senses.definition: hide under a false appearance
senses.definitionSentence: To cloak means to hide under a false appearance.
senses.definitionZh: 隐藏在虚假的外表之下。
senses.exampleZh: 该公司将非法付款伪装成其账户中的普通咨询费。

senses.example: He wrapped a long wool cloak around his shoulders before stepping into the snow.
senses.definition: a loose outer garment
senses.definitionSentence: Cloak is a loose outer garment.
senses.definitionZh: 一件宽松的外衣。
senses.exampleZh: 他在踏入雪地之前将一件长羊毛斗篷裹在肩上。

senses.example: If competition beats you to it, this exciting new product era can have real headaches in store.
senses.definition: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
senses.definitionSentence: Era is a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event.
senses.definitionZh: 一个以独特特征为标志或从固定点或事件计算的时期。
senses.exampleZh: 如果竞争打败了您，那么这个令人兴奋的新产品时代可能会带来真正令人头疼的问题。

senses.example: Made multiple copies of the speech.
senses.definition: having or involving or consisting of more than one part or entity or individual
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as multiple is having or involving or consisting of more than one part or entity or individual.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为多重的事物是指具有或涉及或由多个部分或实体或个体组成。
senses.exampleZh: 制作了演讲稿的多份副本。

senses.example: The pupils multiplied twelve by four and wrote forty-eight as the product.
senses.definition: combine by multiplication
senses.definitionSentence: To obtain a product by combining equal groups of a number or quantity.
senses.definitionZh: 把若干个相同的数或数量组合起来求得乘积。
senses.exampleZh: 学生们用十二乘以四，并写下乘积四十八。

senses.example: The ferry carries passengers and cars across the bay every thirty minutes.
senses.definition: a boat that transports people or vehicles across a body of water and operates on a regular schedule
senses.definitionSentence: Ferry is a boat that transports people or vehicles across a body of water and operates on a regular schedule.
senses.definitionZh: 一种在水域上运送人员或车辆并定期运营的船只。
senses.exampleZh: 渡轮每三十分钟载运乘客和汽车穿越海湾。

senses.example: We ferried across the river on the last scheduled boat of the evening.
senses.definition: travel by ferry
senses.definitionSentence: To ferry means to travel by ferry.
senses.definitionZh: 乘渡轮旅行。
senses.exampleZh: 我们乘坐晚上最后一艘预定的船渡河。

senses.example: From Burlington, outgoing mail could be ferried across Lake Champlain to the railroad at Port Kent, N. Y..
senses.definition: transport from one place to another
senses.definitionSentence: To ferry means to transport from one place to another.
senses.definitionZh: 从一个地方运输到另一个地方。
senses.exampleZh: 从伯灵顿出发，外发邮件可以穿过尚普兰湖运送到纽约州肯特港的铁路。

senses.example: The gatekeeper lived in a small lodge beside the entrance to the country estate.
senses.definition: small house at the entrance to the grounds of a country mansion; usually occupied by a gatekeeper or gardener
senses.definitionSentence: Lodge means small house at the entrance to the grounds of a country mansion; usually occupied by a gatekeeper or gardener.
senses.definitionZh: 乡村宅邸入口处的小房子；通常由看门人或园丁占据。
senses.exampleZh: 看门人住在乡村庄园入口旁边的一间小小屋里。

senses.example: The hikers spent the night in a rustic mountain lodge built from logs.
senses.definition: a small (rustic) house used as a temporary shelter
senses.definitionSentence: Lodge is a small (rustic) house used as a temporary shelter.
senses.definitionZh: 一座用作临时住所的小（乡村）房子。
senses.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者在用原木建造的乡村山间小屋过夜。

senses.example: Where are you lodging in Paris?
senses.definition: be a lodger; stay temporarily
senses.definitionSentence: To lodge means to be a lodger; stay temporarily.
senses.definitionZh: 成为寄宿者；暂时停留。
senses.exampleZh: 您在巴黎住在哪里？

senses.example: These snakes can be identified readily.
senses.definition: without much difficulty
senses.definitionSentence: Readily means without much difficulty.
senses.definitionZh: 没有太大困难。
senses.exampleZh: 这些蛇很容易识别。

senses.meaning: 被观察到的事实，观测结果，观测结论
senses.example: He reported his observations to the mayor.
senses.definition: facts learned by observing
senses.definitionSentence: Observation means facts learned by observing.
senses.definitionZh: 通过观察了解到的事实。
senses.exampleZh: 他向市长报告了他的观察结果。

senses.example: He had had the need to understand what life lurked behind the mask of flesh, behind the oath, the banter, the sadness.
senses.definition: a covering to disguise or conceal the face
senses.definitionSentence: Mask is a covering to disguise or conceal the face.
senses.definitionZh: 伪装或隐藏脸部的覆盖物。
senses.exampleZh: 他需要了解肉体面具背后、誓言、戏谑和悲伤背后潜藏着怎样的生活。

senses.example: The surgeon wore a mask over her nose and mouth to reduce the spread of infection.
senses.definition: a protective covering worn over the face
senses.definitionSentence: Mask is a protective covering worn over the face.
senses.definitionZh: 戴在脸上的防护罩。
senses.exampleZh: 外科医生在鼻子和嘴巴上戴了口罩，以减少感染的传播。

senses.example: That meeting produced the `` spirit of Camp David '' - a spirit, it later turned out, that masked a basic misunderstanding about progress toward a Berlin settlement.
senses.definition: hide under a false appearance
senses.definitionSentence: To mask means to hide under a false appearance.
senses.definitionZh: 隐藏在虚假的外表之下。
senses.exampleZh: 那次会议产生了“戴维营精神”——后来证明，这种精神掩盖了对柏林解决方案进展的基本误解。

senses.example: The child skipped lightly across the playground with small, springing jumps.
senses.definition: jump lightly
senses.definitionSentence: To skip means to jump lightly.
senses.definitionZh: 轻轻跳跃。
senses.exampleZh: 孩子在操场上轻轻地跳跃着。

senses.example: He skipped a row in the text and so the sentence was incomprehensible.
senses.definition: bypass
senses.definitionSentence: To skip means to bypass.
senses.definitionZh: 绕过。
senses.exampleZh: 他在文本中跳过了一行，因此该句子难以理解。

senses.example: A proofreading skip left an important paragraph out of the final printed report.
senses.definition: a mistake resulting from neglect
senses.definitionSentence: Skip is a mistake resulting from neglect.
senses.definitionZh: 由于疏忽而导致的错误。
senses.exampleZh: 校对跳过在最终打印的报告中遗漏了一个重要段落。

senses.definition: attribute or credit to
senses.definitionSentence: Attribute or credit to.
senses.definitionZh: 归因于或归功于。
senses.example: Doctors attributed the sudden illness to contaminated drinking water.
senses.exampleZh: 医生将突发疾病归咎于饮用水被污染。

senses.example: I think these attributes cluster, but I have no evidence.
senses.definition: a construct whereby objects or individuals can be distinguished
senses.definitionSentence: Attribute is a construct whereby objects or individuals can be distinguished.
senses.definitionZh: 一种可以区分对象或个体的构造。
senses.exampleZh: 我认为这些属性是聚类的，但我没有证据。

senses.example: The clinic provides confidential health advice for adolescent patients between thirteen and nineteen years old.
senses.definition: being of the age 13 through 19
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as adolescent is being of the age 13 through 19.
senses.definitionZh: 青少年指的是 13 岁到 19 岁的人。
senses.exampleZh: 该诊所为 13 岁至 19 岁的青少年患者提供保密的健康建议。

senses.example: His adolescent sulking and refusal to accept responsibility seemed immature for a forty-year-old manager.
senses.definition: displaying or suggesting a lack of maturity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as adolescent is displaying or suggesting a lack of maturity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为青少年的事物表现出或暗示着不成熟。
senses.exampleZh: 对于一个四十岁的经理来说，他青少年时期的生闷气和拒绝承担责任似乎很不成熟。

senses.example: The pediatric clinic treats each adolescent from the beginning of puberty until physical maturity.
senses.definition: a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
senses.definitionSentence: Adolescent is a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity.
senses.definitionZh: 青春期开始到成熟之间的青少年。
senses.exampleZh: 儿科诊所为每个青少年提供从青春期开始直至身体成熟的治疗。

senses.example: Adolescent behavior often reflects the rapid physical and emotional changes of the teenage years.
senses.definition: relating to or peculiar to or suggestive of an adolescent
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as adolescent is relating to or peculiar to or suggestive of an adolescent.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为青少年的事物与青少年相关、特有或暗示青少年。
senses.exampleZh: 青少年行为通常反映了青少年时期身体和情绪的快速变化。

senses.example: He became tense before the interview, with tight shoulders and a racing heartbeat.
senses.definition: in or of a state of physical or nervous tension
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as tense is in or of a state of physical or nervous tension.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为紧张的事物处于身体或神经紧张的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 采访前他变得紧张，肩膀紧绷，心跳加速。

senses.example: The climber kept the rope tense so it stayed stretched tightly between the anchors.
senses.definition: taut or rigid; stretched tight
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as tense is taut or rigid; stretched tight.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为紧张的事物是拉紧或僵硬的；绷得很紧。
senses.exampleZh: 登山者保持绳索拉紧，使其在锚点之间保持紧密拉伸。

senses.meaning: 使或变的紧张，紧张，紧张起来
senses.example: He got a phone call from his lawyer that tensed him up.
senses.definition: cause to be tense and uneasy or nervous or anxious
senses.definitionSentence: To tense means to cause to be tense and uneasy or nervous or anxious.
senses.definitionZh: 导致紧张、不安、紧张或焦虑。
senses.exampleZh: 他接到律师打来的电话，这让他紧张起来。

senses.example: The magician amused the children for an hour with comic tricks, stories, and audience games.
senses.definition: occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion
senses.definitionSentence: To amuse means to occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion.
senses.definitionZh: 以令人愉快的、有趣的或愉快的方式进行活动。
senses.exampleZh: 魔术师用喜剧技巧、故事和观众游戏让孩子们开心了一个小时。

senses.example: Eggs, beans, and fish provide protein that the body uses to build and repair tissue.
senses.definition: any of a large group of nitrogenous organic compounds that are essential constituents of living cells; consist of polymers of amino acids; essential in the diet of animals for growth and for repair of tissues; can be obtained from meat and eggs and milk and legumes
senses.definitionSentence: Protein means any of a large group of nitrogenous organic compounds that are essential constituents of living cells; consist of polymers of amino acids; essential in the diet of animals for growth and for repair of tissues; can be obtained from meat and eggs and milk and legumes.
senses.definitionZh: 作为活细胞基本成分的一大类含氮有机化合物中的任何一种；由氨基酸聚合物组成；在动物饮食中对于生长和组织修复至关重要；可以从肉、蛋、奶和豆类中获取。
senses.exampleZh: 鸡蛋、豆类和鱼提供人体用来构建和修复组织的蛋白质。

senses.example: She risked a twenty-dollar stake on the final hand of the card game.
senses.definition: the money risked on a gamble
senses.definitionSentence: Stake is the money risked on a gamble.
senses.definitionZh: 赌博所冒险的资金。
senses.exampleZh: 她在纸牌游戏的最后一手牌中冒着 20 美元赌注的风险。

senses.example: He loathed the idea of drying up swamps or the chills of malaria or of leaving his natural birthright.
senses.definition: low land that is seasonally flooded; has more woody plants than a marsh and better drainage than a bog
senses.definitionSentence: Swamp means low land that is seasonally flooded; has more woody plants than a marsh and better drainage than a bog.
senses.definitionZh: 季节性洪水泛滥的低地；木本植物比沼泽多，排水比沼泽好。
senses.exampleZh: 他厌恶让沼泽干涸、疟疾带来的寒冷或放弃他与生俱来的权利。

senses.example: He stalked into the water and fell heavily over the side of the flat-bottomed barge, his weight nearly swamping the craft.
senses.definition: fill quickly beyond capacity; as with a liquid
senses.definitionSentence: To swamp means to fill quickly beyond capacity; as with a liquid.
senses.definitionZh: 快速填满超过容量；就像液体一样。
senses.exampleZh: 他大步走进水中，重重地从平底驳船的一侧摔了下来，他的体重几乎淹没了驳船。

senses.definition: color with a liquid dye or tint
senses.definitionSentence: Color with a liquid dye or tint.
senses.definitionZh: 用液体染料或色调着色。
senses.example: The craft worker stained the pale wood dark brown with a liquid dye.
senses.exampleZh: 工匠用液体染料将浅色木材染成深棕色。

senses.example: Red wine stains the table cloth.
senses.definition: produce or leave stains
senses.definitionSentence: To stain means to produce or leave stains.
senses.definitionZh: 产生或留下污渍。
senses.exampleZh: 红酒弄脏了桌布。

senses.example: This stain often disrupts the normal cell activity or else colors only the outside.
senses.definition: (microscopy) a dye or other coloring material that is used in microscopy to make structures visible
senses.definitionSentence: Stain means (microscopy) a dye or other coloring material that is used in microscopy to make structures visible.
senses.definitionZh: （显微镜检查）显微镜中使用的染料或其他着色材料，使结构可见。
senses.exampleZh: 这种染色剂通常会破坏正常的细胞活动，或者仅使外部着色。

senses.example: Like certain expensive restaurants, just sitting there gave you the illusion of being wealthy yourself.
senses.definition: having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as wealthy is having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓富有是指拥有充足的金钱或有价值的财产。
senses.exampleZh: 就像某些昂贵的餐厅一样，光是坐在那里就会给你一种自己很富有的错觉。

senses.example: The president's grave expression and solemn voice showed the seriousness of the national crisis.
senses.definition: dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as grave is dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为严肃的事物在方式或性格上是庄严和严肃的，并且致力于遵守诺言。
senses.exampleZh: 总统严肃的表情和庄严的声音显示了国家危机的严重性。

senses.example: He put flowers on his mother's grave.
senses.definition: a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone)
senses.definitionSentence: Grave is a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone).
senses.definitionZh: 埋葬尸体的地方（特别是在地下并有墓碑标记的地方）。
senses.exampleZh: 他在母亲的坟墓上放了鲜花。

senses.example: He studied his reflection in the mirror.
senses.definition: the image of something as reflected by a mirror (or other reflective material)
senses.definitionSentence: Reflection is the image of something as reflected by a mirror (or other reflective material).
senses.definitionZh: 镜子（或其他反光材料）反射的物体的图像。
senses.exampleZh: 他研究了镜子中自己的倒影。

senses.example: Nerves tight as a bowstring, he paused to gather his wits.
senses.definition: mental ability
senses.definitionSentence: Wit means mental ability.
senses.definitionZh: 智力。
senses.exampleZh: 他紧张得像弓弦一样，停下来集中精神。

senses.example: A diplomatic mission of five delegates traveled to negotiate a ceasefire with the neighboring government.
senses.definition: a group of representatives or delegates
senses.definitionSentence: Mission is a group of representatives or delegates.
senses.definitionZh: 一组代表或代表。
senses.exampleZh: 由五名代表组成的外交使团前往与邻国政府谈判停火。

senses.example: (Norman Mailer), but no one can deny that the screen crackles with electricity whenever he is on it.
senses.definition: a white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing
senses.definitionSentence: Screen is a white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing.
senses.definitionZh: 白色或银色表面，可以投影图片以供观看。
senses.exampleZh: （诺曼·梅勒），但没有人可以否认，只要他在屏幕上，屏幕就会发出电流噼啪声。

senses.example: The hospital screens every applicant for training, checking qualifications and practical skills.
senses.definition: examine in order to test suitability
senses.definitionSentence: To screen means to examine in order to test suitability.
senses.definitionZh: 进行检查以测试适用性。
senses.exampleZh: 医院对每一位申请者进行培训筛选，检查资格和实践技能。

senses.example: The cinema screened the restored film by projecting it onto its largest viewing screen.
senses.definition: project onto a screen for viewing
senses.definitionSentence: To screen means to project onto a screen for viewing.
senses.definitionZh: 投影到屏幕上进行观看。
senses.exampleZh: 电影院通过将修复后的电影投影到其最大的观看屏幕上来放映。

senses.example: The company fabricates plastic chairs.
senses.definition: put together out of artificial or natural components or parts
senses.definitionSentence: To fabricate means to put together out of artificial or natural components or parts.
senses.definitionZh: 将人造或天然成分或零件组装在一起。
senses.exampleZh: 该公司生产塑料椅子。

senses.example: The witness fabricated an alibi, inventing a dinner meeting that had never taken place.
senses.definition: make up something artificial or untrue
senses.definitionSentence: To fabricate means to make up something artificial or untrue.
senses.definitionZh: 编造一些人为的或不真实的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 证人伪造了不在场证明，编造了一次从未发生过的晚宴。

senses.example: The furniture was covered with dust.
senses.definition: fine powdery material such as dry earth or pollen that can be blown about in the air
senses.definitionSentence: Dust means fine powdery material such as dry earth or pollen that can be blown about in the air.
senses.definitionZh: 可以在空气中飘扬的细粉状物质，例如干土或花粉。
senses.exampleZh: 家具上布满了灰尘。

senses.example: Dust the warm cakes lightly with powdered sugar before serving them.
senses.definition: distribute loosely
senses.definitionSentence: To dust means to distribute loosely.
senses.definitionZh: 松散地分布。
senses.exampleZh: 上桌前，在热蛋糕上轻轻撒上糖粉。

senses.example: The soldiers who comprised the rank and file of the Civil War armies were an earthy people.
senses.definition: a permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state
senses.definitionSentence: Army is a permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state.
senses.definitionZh: 一个国家或州的陆军陆军的常设组织。
senses.exampleZh: 内战军队的普通士兵是一群朴实的人民。

senses.example: The tailor measured his shoulders, cut the wool, and altered the jacket to fit perfectly.
senses.definition: a person whose occupation is making and altering garments
senses.definitionSentence: Tailor is a person whose occupation is making and altering garments.
senses.definitionZh: 以制作和修改服装为职业的人。
senses.exampleZh: 裁缝测量了他的肩膀，裁剪了羊毛，并修改了夹克以使其完美合身。

senses.example: Without being taught, the salmon's spawning instinct drives it back upstream to reproduce.
senses.definition: inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli
senses.definitionSentence: Instinct means inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli.
senses.definitionZh: 通常对特定刺激做出反应的先天行为模式。
senses.exampleZh: 在没有被教导的情况下，鲑鱼的产卵本能驱使它返回上游繁殖。

senses.example: He always blames someone else in the immediate neighborhood.
senses.definition: a surrounding or nearby region
senses.definitionSentence: Neighborhood is a surrounding or nearby region.
senses.definitionZh: 周围或附近的区域。
senses.exampleZh: 他总是责怪附近的其他人。

senses.example: The author's copyright gives her the exclusive legal right to publish and sell the novel.
senses.definition: a document granting exclusive right to publish and sell literary or musical or artistic work
senses.definitionSentence: Copyright is a document granting exclusive right to publish and sell literary or musical or artistic work.
senses.definitionZh: 授予出版和销售文学或音乐或艺术作品专有权的文件。
senses.exampleZh: 作者的版权赋予她出版和销售小说的专有合法权利。

senses.example: Following single dose treatment, milk should be discarded for 4 days following treatment.
senses.definition: throw or cast away
senses.definitionSentence: To discard means to throw or cast away.
senses.definitionZh: 扔掉或扔掉。
senses.exampleZh: 单剂量治疗后，应在治疗后 4 天内丢弃牛奶。

senses.example: Each hair consists of layers of dead keratinized cells.
senses.definition: a covering for the body (or parts of it) consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures (as on the human head); helps to prevent heat loss
senses.definitionSentence: Hair is a covering for the body (or parts of it) consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures (as on the human head); helps to prevent heat loss.
senses.definitionZh: 身体（或其部分）的覆盖物，由密集生长的线状结构组成（如人的头部）；有助于防止热量损失。
senses.exampleZh: 每根毛发均由死角化细胞层组成。

senses.example: A high-speed shutter has been developed in order to permit photographic observation of any portion of the electrical wire explosion.
senses.definition: a violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction
senses.definitionSentence: Explosion is a violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction.
senses.definitionZh: 由化学或核反应引起的剧烈能量释放。
senses.exampleZh: 已开发出高速快门，以便能够对电线爆炸的任何部分进行摄影观察。

senses.example: He felt no anger towards Kitti, no sense that she had betrayed him.
senses.definition: a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance
senses.definitionSentence: Anger is a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance.
senses.definitionZh: 一种强烈的情绪；一种针对某种真实或假定的不满的感觉。
senses.exampleZh: 他对Kitti没有感到愤怒，也没有感觉到她背叛了他。

senses.example: The men were at first puzzled, then angered by the aimless tacking.
senses.definition: make angry
senses.definitionSentence: To anger means to make angry.
senses.definitionZh: 生气。
senses.exampleZh: 这些人起初感到困惑，然后对这种漫无目的的迎风航行感到愤怒。

senses.example: The historical record described the deaf and dumb child as unable to hear or speak.
senses.definition: unable to speak because of hereditary deafness
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dumb is unable to speak because of hereditary deafness.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为哑巴的人由于遗传性耳聋而无法说话。
senses.exampleZh: 历史记录描述聋哑儿童无法听到或说话。

senses.definitionZh: 一年中最冷的季节；在北半球，它从冬至延伸到春分。
senses.exampleZh: 如果植物在冬季得到照顾和保护，第二年会比第一年更加多产。

senses.example: We wintered on the Riviera.
senses.definition: spend the winter
senses.definitionSentence: To winter means to spend the winter.
senses.definitionZh: 过冬天。
senses.exampleZh: 我们在里维埃拉过冬。

senses.example: During the period of this report, 63 panel exhibits depicting the latest developments in medical research were displayed.
senses.definition: give a description of
senses.definitionSentence: To depict means to give a description of.
senses.definitionZh: 给出描述。
senses.exampleZh: 在本报告期内，共展出了 63 个展示医学研究最新进展的展板。

senses.example: The electric toothbrush moves in a vertical direction, the way dentists recommend.
senses.definition: a person qualified to practice dentistry
senses.definitionSentence: Dentist is a person qualified to practice dentistry.
senses.definitionZh: 具有牙科执业资格的人员。
senses.exampleZh: 电动牙刷按照牙医推荐的方式沿垂直方向移动。

senses.example: The conservator copied the damaged inscription exactly onto a new stone tablet.
senses.definition: make a replica of
senses.definitionSentence: To copy means to make a replica of.
senses.definitionZh: 制作复制品。
senses.exampleZh: 管理员将损坏的铭文准确地复制到新的石碑上。

senses.example: She made a copy of the designer dress.
senses.definition: a thing made to be similar or identical to another thing
senses.definitionSentence: Copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another thing.
senses.definitionZh: 与另一事物相似或相同的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 她复制了设计师礼服。

senses.example: She stayed too late, and when she left, it was dark and time to go home and cook supper for her husband.
senses.definition: prepare for eating by applying heat
senses.definitionSentence: To cook means to prepare for eating by applying heat.
senses.definitionZh: 通过加热来准备进食。
senses.exampleZh: 她呆得太晚了，离开时天已经黑了，该回家给丈夫做晚饭了。

senses.example: The cook, Mateo Garcia, had arrived there long before the herd.
senses.definition: someone who cooks food
senses.definitionSentence: Cook means someone who cooks food.
senses.definitionZh: 烹饪食物的人。
senses.exampleZh: 厨师马特奥·加西亚 (Mateo Garcia) 比牛群早到了那里。

senses.example: A knee injury hampered the runner by slowing her and putting her at a disadvantage in the final.
senses.definition: put at a disadvantage
senses.definitionSentence: Put at a disadvantage.
senses.definitionZh: 置于不利地位。
senses.exampleZh: 膝盖受伤阻碍了跑步者，减慢了她的速度，使她在决赛中处于不利地位。

senses.example: The courier delivered a packet of documents wrapped together in brown paper and string.
senses.definition: a collection of things wrapped or boxed together
senses.definitionSentence: Packet is a collection of things wrapped or boxed together.
senses.definitionZh: 包装或装箱在一起的物品的集合。
senses.exampleZh: 快递员送来了一包用牛皮纸和绳子包裹在一起的文件。

senses.example: He tore open a small packet of sugar and emptied it into his coffee.
senses.definition: a small package or bundle
senses.definitionSentence: Packet is a small package or bundle.
senses.definitionZh: 一个小包裹或捆绑。
senses.exampleZh: 他撕开一小包糖并将其倒入咖啡中。

senses.example: She startled when I walked into the room.
senses.definition: move or jump suddenly, as if in surprise or alarm
senses.definitionSentence: To startle means to move or jump suddenly, as if in surprise or alarm.
senses.definitionZh: 突然移动或跳跃，就好像惊讶或警报一样。
senses.exampleZh: 当我走进房间时，她吓了一跳。

senses.example: Her goodness showed in years of honest work, generous giving, and care for people in need.
senses.definition: moral excellence or admirableness
senses.definitionSentence: Goodness means moral excellence or admirableness.
senses.definitionZh: 道德卓越或令人钦佩。
senses.exampleZh: 她的善良体现在多年的诚实工作、慷慨捐赠和对有需要的人的关心中。

senses.example: Willie's lifetime batting average of.318 is 11 points beyond Mickey's.
senses.definition: the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)
senses.definitionSentence: Lifetime is the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death).
senses.definitionZh: 某事物发挥作用的时期（如出生和死亡之间）。
senses.exampleZh: 威利一生的击球平均值为 318，比米奇高出 11 分。

senses.example: `` Do you feel you can stand up to the next legislative session and defend this contract ''? asked Mrs. Grace O. Peck, representative from Multnomah County, of the commission chairman, Joseph E. Harvey Jr..
senses.definition: protect or fight for as a champion
senses.definitionSentence: To defend means to protect or fight for as a champion.
senses.definitionZh: 保护或作为冠军而战。
senses.exampleZh: ``您认为您可以在下一次立法会议上站起来并捍卫这份合同吗''？摩特诺玛县代表 Grace O. Peck 女士向委员会主席 Joseph E. Harvey Jr. 问道。

senses.example: Hastened the period of time of his recovery.
senses.definition: an amount of time
senses.definitionSentence: Period is an amount of time.
senses.definitionZh: 一段时间。
senses.exampleZh: 加快了他的康复时间。

senses.example: She tracks her period each month and carries sanitary pads for menstrual bleeding.
senses.definition: the monthly discharge of blood from the uterus of nonpregnant women from puberty to menopause
senses.definitionSentence: Period is the monthly discharge of blood from the uterus of nonpregnant women from puberty to menopause.
senses.definitionZh: 非孕妇从青春期到更年期每月从子宫排出的血液量。
senses.exampleZh: 她每个月都会记录自己的经期，并携带卫生巾以应对经血。

senses.example: In England they call a period a stop.
senses.definition: a punctuation mark (.) placed at the end of a declarative sentence to indicate a full stop or after abbreviations
senses.definitionSentence: Period is a punctuation mark (.) placed at the end of a declarative sentence to indicate a full stop or after abbreviations.
senses.definitionZh: 放置在陈述句末尾的标点符号 (.)，用于指示句号或缩写之后。
senses.exampleZh: 在英格兰，他们将句号称为“停止”。

senses.example: The ball has a titanium core.
senses.definition: the center of an object
senses.definitionSentence: Core is the center of an object.
senses.definitionZh: 物体的中心。
senses.exampleZh: 球具有钛芯。

senses.example: Early computers stored each binary bit by magnetizing a tiny ferrite core.
senses.definition: (computer science) a tiny ferrite toroid formerly used in a random access memory to store one bit of data; now superseded by semiconductor memories
senses.definitionSentence: Core means (computer science) a tiny ferrite toroid formerly used in a random access memory to store one bit of data; now superseded by semiconductor memories.
senses.definitionZh: （计算机科学）以前在随机存取存储器中用于存储一位数据的微小铁氧体环形线圈；现在已被半导体存储器取代。
senses.exampleZh: 早期计算机通过磁化微小的铁氧体磁芯来存储每个二进制位。

senses.example: I really dislike this salesman.
senses.definition: have or feel a dislike or distaste for
senses.definitionSentence: To dislike means to have or feel a dislike or distaste for.
senses.definitionZh: 有或感觉不喜欢或厌恶。
senses.exampleZh: 我真的很不喜欢这个推销员。

senses.example: My dislike of him was instinctive.
senses.definition: a feeling of aversion or antipathy
senses.definitionSentence: Dislike is a feeling of aversion or antipathy.
senses.definitionZh: 一种厌恶或反感的感觉。
senses.exampleZh: 我对他的厌恶是本能的。

senses.example: Patient teachers nurtured her talent until the young violinist was ready for the concert stage.
senses.definition: help develop, help grow
senses.definitionSentence: To nurture means to help develop, help grow.
senses.definitionZh: 帮助发展、帮助成长。
senses.exampleZh: 耐心的老师培养了她的才华，直到这位年轻的小提琴家准备好登上音乐会舞台。

senses.meaning: 经得起移植，耐移植，能够经受移植，适宜移种
senses.example: These delicate plants do not transplant easily.
senses.definition: be transplantable
senses.definitionSentence: To transplant means to be transplantable.
senses.definitionZh: 可移植。
senses.exampleZh: 这些娇嫩的植物不容易移植。

senses.example: With sudden energy, she went to the phone and rang Holden's office and asked for him.
senses.definition: electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
senses.definitionSentence: Phone means electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds.
senses.definitionZh: 将声音转换为可远距离传输的电信号，然后将接收到的信号转换回声音的电子设备。
senses.exampleZh: 突然精力充沛，她拿起电话，给霍尔顿的办公室打电话，询问他的情况。

senses.example: Each phone in the pilot's headset converts the radio's electrical signal into sound at one ear.
senses.definition: electro-acoustic transducer for converting electric signals into sounds; it is held over or inserted into the ear
senses.definitionSentence: Phone means electro-acoustic transducer for converting electric signals into sounds; it is held over or inserted into the ear.
senses.definitionZh: 将电信号转换为声音的电声换能器；它被举在耳朵上或插入耳朵中。
senses.exampleZh: 飞行员耳机中的每部电话都会将无线电的电信号转换为一只耳朵的声音。

senses.example: In one company covering the country with a high quality sales force of 10 men, the president personally phones each major account every 6 mos..
senses.definition: get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone
senses.definitionSentence: To phone means to get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone.
senses.definitionZh: 通过电话（与某人）进行或尝试进行通信。
senses.exampleZh: 在一家覆盖全国、拥有 10 名高素质销售人员的公司中，总裁每 6 个月亲自给每个主要客户打电话。

senses.example: But do n't tell that to a veteran of the Fighting Seventh, especially in a saloon on Saturday night.
senses.definition: the seventh and last day of the week; observed as the Sabbath by Jews and some Christians
senses.definitionSentence: Saturday is the seventh and last day of the week; observed as the Sabbath by Jews and some Christians.
senses.definitionZh: 一周的第七天，也是最后一天；犹太人和一些基督徒遵守安息日。
senses.exampleZh: 但是不要告诉战斗第七团的老兵，尤其是在周六晚上的酒吧里。

senses.example: What had been the ambassador's suite was now jagged walls of blackened brick.
senses.definition: apartment consisting of a series of connected rooms used as a living unit (as in a hotel)
senses.definitionSentence: Suite means apartment consisting of a series of connected rooms used as a living unit (as in a hotel).
senses.definitionZh: 由一系列相连的房间组成的公寓，用作居住单元（如酒店）。
senses.exampleZh: 大使套房现在变成了锯齿状的黑色砖墙。

senses.example: Hong Kong interests loudly protest limiting their exports to Britain, while Spanish and Portuguese textiles pour into British market unrestrictedly.
senses.definition: express opposition through action or words
senses.definitionSentence: To protest means to express opposition through action or words.
senses.definitionZh: 通过行动或言语表达反对。
senses.exampleZh: 香港利益集团大声抗议限制对英国的出口，而西班牙和葡萄牙的纺织品却不受限制地涌入英国市场。

senses.example: Good wages, patronage and subscription of various kinds stopped open protest from Negroes.
senses.definition: the act of protesting; a public (often organized) manifestation of dissent
senses.definitionSentence: Protest is the act of protesting; a public (often organized) manifestation of dissent.
senses.definitionZh: 抗议的行为；公开（通常是有组织的）表达异议。
senses.exampleZh: 良好的工资、赞助和各种捐款阻止了黑人的公开抗议。

senses.example: It didn't happen until afterward.
senses.definition: happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
senses.definitionSentence: Afterward means happening at a time subsequent to a reference time.
senses.definitionZh: 在参考时间之后的时间发生。
senses.exampleZh: 直到后来才发生。

senses.example: The reinforced sea wall withstood waves that destroyed several weaker structures along the coast.
senses.definition: stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
senses.definitionSentence: To withstand means to stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something.
senses.definitionZh: 站起来或对某人或某事进行抵抗。
senses.exampleZh: 加固的海堤抵御了摧毁沿海几处较弱结构的海浪。

senses.example: The new material withstands even the greatest wear and tear.
senses.definition: resist or confront with resistance
senses.definitionSentence: To withstand means to resist or confront with resistance.
senses.definitionZh: 抵制或面对阻力。
senses.exampleZh: 新材料可承受最严重的磨损。

senses.example: The music department provided studios for their students.
senses.definition: workplace for the teaching or practice of an art
senses.definitionSentence: Studio means workplace for the teaching or practice of an art.
senses.definitionZh: 艺术教学或实践的工作场所。
senses.exampleZh: 音乐系为学生提供工作室。

senses.example: The antihistamine made her feel more comfortable.
senses.definition: providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal)
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as comfortable is providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal).
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为舒适的东西是提供或体验身体健康或缓解（“舒适”是非正式的）。
senses.exampleZh: 抗组胺药让她感觉更舒服。

senses.example: Some forms of capitalism do indeed work - superb organizations, a credit to any society.
senses.definition: of surpassing excellence
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as superb is of surpassing excellence.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为卓越的东西是超越卓越的。
senses.exampleZh: 某些形式的资本主义确实有效——卓越的组织，对任何社会来说都是一种荣誉。

senses.example: Factory workers earned a production bonus of five hundred dollars for exceeding the quarterly target.
senses.definition: an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output
senses.definitionSentence: Bonus is an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output.
senses.definitionZh: 向员工提供的额外付款（或其他报酬），作为增加产出的手段。
senses.exampleZh: 工厂工人因超额完成季度目标而获得五百美元的生产奖金。

senses.example: A mother can help a child adapt to his difficulties.
senses.definition: adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
senses.definitionSentence: To adapt means to adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions.
senses.definitionZh: 适应或适应新的或不同的条件。
senses.exampleZh: 母亲可以帮助孩子适应他的困难。

senses.example: The overall effect was probably to stimulate more party activity in the communal elections than might have otherwise taken place.
senses.definition: stir feelings in
senses.definitionSentence: To stimulate means to stir feelings in.
senses.definitionZh: 激发感情。
senses.exampleZh: 总体效果可能是在社区选举中刺激更多的政党活动，而不是其他方式。

senses.example: His meeting with the salesmen was the high point of his day.
senses.definition: the social act of assembling for some common purpose
senses.definitionSentence: Meeting is the social act of assembling for some common purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 为了某些共同目的而聚集的社交行为。
senses.exampleZh: 他与销售人员的会面是他这一天的最高潮。

senses.example: Attorneys for the mayor said that an amicable property settlement has been agreed upon.
senses.definition: a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
senses.definitionSentence: Attorney is a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice.
senses.definitionZh: 被授权执业的专业人士；进行诉讼或提供法律建议。
senses.exampleZh: 市长的律师表示，已达成友好财产和解协议。

senses.example: The Belgians - at least officially - departed from the Congo as well, withdrawing all of their uniformed troops.
senses.definition: pull back or move away or backward
senses.definitionSentence: To withdraw means to pull back or move away or backward.
senses.definitionZh: 拉回或移开或向后。
senses.exampleZh: 比利时人 - 至少在官方上 - 也离开了刚果，撤回了所有军装部队。

senses.example: Maybe I should withdraw my advice - no ''?
senses.definition: take back what one has said
senses.definitionSentence: To withdraw means to take back what one has said.
senses.definitionZh: 收回已经说过的话。
senses.exampleZh: 也许我应该撤回我的建议 - 不''？

senses.example: The district attorney's office investigated reports of possible irregularities.
senses.definition: conduct an inquiry or investigation of
senses.definitionSentence: To investigate means to conduct an inquiry or investigation of.
senses.definitionZh: 进行询问或调查。
senses.exampleZh: 地方检察官办公室调查了有关可能存在违规行为的报告。

senses.example: Let's investigate the syntax of Chinese.
senses.definition: investigate scientifically
senses.definitionSentence: To investigate means to investigate scientifically.
senses.definitionZh: 科学地调查。
senses.exampleZh: 让我们研究一下中文的语法。

senses.example: We spread our sleeping bags on the dry floor of the tent.
senses.definition: the inside lower horizontal surface (as of a room, hallway, tent, or other structure)
senses.definitionSentence: Floor is the inside lower horizontal surface (as of a room, hallway, tent, or other structure).
senses.definitionZh: 内部较低水平表面（如房间、走廊、帐篷或其他结构）。
senses.exampleZh: 我们将睡袋铺在帐篷干燥的地板上。

senses.example: He occupied a two bedroom apartment on the fourth floor, using the second bedroom as his office.
senses.definition: a structure consisting of a room or set of rooms at a single position along a vertical scale
senses.definitionSentence: Floor is a structure consisting of a room or set of rooms at a single position along a vertical scale.
senses.definitionZh: 一种结构，由沿垂直尺度位于单个位置的一个房间或一组房间组成。
senses.exampleZh: 他占据了四楼的一套两居室公寓，将第二间卧室用作他的办公室。

senses.example: The witness swore an oath before testifying in court about what she had seen.
senses.definition: (law) a person who testifies under oath in a court of law
senses.definitionSentence: Witness means (law) a person who testifies under oath in a court of law.
senses.definitionZh: （法律）在法庭上宣誓作证的人。
senses.exampleZh: 证人在法庭上就她所看到的情况作证之前宣誓。

senses.example: Those who saw his finished Pieta would take the place of the biblical witnesses.
senses.definition: a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)
senses.definitionSentence: Witness is a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind).
senses.definitionZh: 近距离观察者；观看某物（例如某种展览）的人。
senses.exampleZh: 那些看到他完成的圣母怜子图的人将取代圣经的见证人。

senses.example: She witnessed the accident and had to testify in court.
senses.definition: be a witness to
senses.definitionSentence: To witness means to be a witness to.
senses.definitionZh: 见证。
senses.exampleZh: 她目睹了事故，必须出庭作证。

senses.example: Reliable transport infrastructure requires roads, bridges, rail lines, ports, and maintenance systems.
senses.definition: the basic structure or features of a system or organization
senses.definitionSentence: Infrastructure is the basic structure or features of a system or organization.
senses.definitionZh: 系统或组织的基本结构或功能。
senses.exampleZh: 可靠的交通基础设施需要道路、桥梁、铁路、港口和维护系统。

senses.example: A fountain stands near the centre of the square, roughly midway between its four entrances.
senses.definition: an area that is approximately central within some larger region
senses.definitionSentence: Centre is an area that is approximately central within some larger region.
senses.definitionZh: 某个较大区域内大约位于中心的区域。
senses.exampleZh: 一个喷泉矗立在广场中心附近，大约在四个入口之间的中间。

senses.example: Dark as the inside of a black cat.
senses.definition: devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dark is devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为黑暗的事物缺乏或缺乏光或亮度；阴影或黑色。
senses.exampleZh: 黑暗如黑猫的内部。

senses.example: The dark days of the war.
senses.definition: causing dejection
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dark is causing dejection.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为黑暗的东西正在引起沮丧。
senses.exampleZh: 战争的黑暗日子。

senses.example: Above, the glowing ivory baton of their searchlight pointed at the clouds, diluting the valley's dark to a pallid light.
senses.definition: absence of light or illumination
senses.definitionSentence: Dark means absence of light or illumination.
senses.definitionZh: 没有光或照明。
senses.exampleZh: 上方，他们的探照灯发光的象牙棒指向云层，将山谷的黑暗稀释成苍白的光芒。

senses.example: The hikers reached camp before dark, just as the sun set and night began.
senses.definition: the time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside
senses.definitionSentence: Dark is the time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside.
senses.definitionZh: 日落之后和日出之前的时间，而外面是黑暗的。
senses.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者在天黑前到达营地，太阳落山，夜晚开始。

senses.example: I had once been a witness when Blanche had smiled and said with only minimum ruefulness, `` Oh, my souffle has collapsed ''.
senses.definition: break down, literally or metaphorically
senses.definitionSentence: To collapse means to break down, literally or metaphorically.
senses.definitionZh: 崩溃，无论是字面上还是隐喻上。
senses.exampleZh: 我曾经目睹过布兰奇微笑着，带着最低限度的悔恨地说：“哦，我的蛋奶酥塌了”。

senses.example: The British machine weighs one ton, equivalent to 2,240 pounds.
senses.definition: a British unit of weight equivalent to 2240 pounds
senses.definitionSentence: Ton is a British unit of weight equivalent to 2240 pounds.
senses.definitionZh: 英国重量单位，相当于 2240 磅。
senses.exampleZh: 英国机器重一吨，相当于 2,240 磅。

senses.example: Practical instruction taught the apprentices how to measure timber, cut joints, and operate workshop machinery.
senses.definition: the activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill
senses.definitionSentence: Instruction is the activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill.
senses.definitionZh: 教育或指导的活动；传授知识或技能的活动。
senses.exampleZh: 实践指导教会学徒如何测量木材、切割接头和操作车间机械。

senses.example: What could rescue the bill would be some quick progress on a bill amending the National Defense Education Act of 1958.
senses.definition: free from harm or evil
senses.definitionSentence: To rescue means to free from harm or evil.
senses.definitionZh: 免受伤害或邪恶。
senses.exampleZh: 能够挽救该法案的是修订 1958 年《国防教育法》的法案取得快速进展。

senses.example: Armed supporters rescued the prisoner from police custody while he was being taken to court.
senses.definition: take forcibly from legal custody
senses.definitionSentence: To rescue means to take forcibly from legal custody.
senses.definitionZh: 强行从合法拘留中夺走。
senses.exampleZh: 这名囚犯在被带上法庭时，武装支持者将其从警方拘留所中解救出来。

senses.example: Drought, hail, disease, and insects take their toll of crops.
senses.definition: small air-breathing arthropod
senses.definitionSentence: Insect means small air-breathing arthropod.
senses.definitionZh: 小型呼吸空气节肢动物。
senses.exampleZh: 干旱、冰雹、疾病和昆虫对农作物造成损失。

senses.example: Too awkward with a needle to make her own clothes.
senses.definition: lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as awkward is lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为尴尬的事物是指在方式、动作或表演方面缺乏优雅或技巧。
senses.exampleZh: 用针自己做衣服太笨拙了。

senses.example: The awkward package was too wide to grip and too long to carry through the narrow doorway easily.
senses.definition: difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as awkward is difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为笨拙的东西很难处理或管理，尤其是因为形状。
senses.exampleZh: 这个笨拙的包裹太宽，无法抓握，也太长，无法轻松穿过狭窄的门口。

senses.example: The travel brochure is a small paper booklet with maps, hotel details, and photographs of local sights.
senses.definition: a small book usually having a paper cover
senses.definitionSentence: Brochure is a small book usually having a paper cover.
senses.definitionZh: 一本通常有纸质封面的小书。
senses.exampleZh: 旅行手册是一本小纸质小册子，其中包含地图、酒店详细信息和当地景点的照片。

senses.example: The final exam was damn difficult, far harder than any of the practice papers.
senses.definition: extremely
senses.definitionSentence: Damn means extremely.
senses.definitionZh: 极端。
senses.exampleZh: 期末考试太难了，比任何练习卷都难。

senses.example: `` That damn door '', said the police chief.
senses.definition: used as expletives
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as damn is used as expletives.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为该死的东西被用作咒骂语。
senses.exampleZh: “那扇该死的门”，警察局长说。

senses.example: `` Damn you, Adams '' - Jess was beginning to recover from his initial shock.
senses.definition: wish harm upon; invoke evil upon
senses.definitionSentence: To damn means to wish harm upon; invoke evil upon.
senses.definitionZh: 希望受到伤害；招致邪恶。
senses.exampleZh: “该死的，亚当斯” - 杰西开始从最初的震惊中恢复过来。

senses.example: Damn! I left my passport at home on the morning of the flight.
senses.exampleZh: 该死！航班起飞那天早上，我把护照落在家里了。
senses.definitionSentence: Used to express anger, irritation, disappointment, annoyance, contempt or suprise, etc. See also dammit.
senses.definitionZh: 用于表达愤怒、刺激、失望、恼怒、蔑视或惊讶等。另见该死。

senses.example: At the fair, a small booth sold handmade jewelry and offered a ring-toss game.
senses.definition: a small shop at a fair; for selling goods or entertainment
senses.definitionSentence: Booth is a small shop at a fair; for selling goods or entertainment.
senses.definitionZh: 展会上的一个小商店；用于销售商品或娱乐。
senses.exampleZh: 在展会上，一个小摊位出售手工制作的珠宝，并提供抛环游戏。

senses.example: They went to the Flea Market, expecting to find the treasures of Europe, and found instead a duplication of that long double row of booths in Tours.
senses.definition: small area set off by walls for special use
senses.definitionSentence: Booth means small area set off by walls for special use.
senses.definitionZh: 由墙壁隔开的用于特殊用途的小区域。
senses.exampleZh: 他们去了跳蚤市场，希望能找到欧洲的宝藏，却发现了图尔那长长的双排摊位的复制品。

senses.example: As the lights came up, Andy could see that a number of patrons were already on their way toward the exit.
senses.definition: an opening that permits escape or release
senses.definitionSentence: Exit is an opening that permits escape or release.
senses.definitionZh: 允许逃生或释放的开口。
senses.exampleZh: 当灯光亮起时，安迪可以看到许多顾客已经在走向出口。

senses.example: Passengers exited the aircraft through the rear door and walked across the runway to the terminal.
senses.definition: move out of or depart from
senses.definitionSentence: To exit means to move out of or depart from.
senses.definitionZh: 移出或离开。
senses.exampleZh: 乘客从后门离开飞机，穿过跑道前往航站楼。

senses.example: The tired mothers yawned and struggled to stay awake after caring for crying babies all night.
senses.definition: depleted of strength or energy
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as tired is depleted of strength or energy.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为疲倦的东西是指力量或能量耗尽。
senses.exampleZh: 照顾哭闹的婴儿一整夜后，疲倦的妈妈们打着哈欠，努力保持清醒。

senses.example: Cox argued that the bill is `` probably unconstitutional '' since, he said, it would impair contracts.
senses.definition: make imperfect
senses.definitionSentence: To impair means to make imperfect.
senses.definitionZh: 使不完美。
senses.exampleZh: 考克斯认为该法案“可能违宪”，因为他说，这会损害合同。

senses.example: He built a modest dwelling near the pond.
senses.definition: housing that someone is living in
senses.definitionSentence: Dwelling means housing that someone is living in.
senses.definitionZh: 有人居住的住房。
senses.exampleZh: 他在池塘附近建造了一座简陋的住宅。

senses.example: Presumably, he missed the train.
senses.definition: by reasonable assumption
senses.definitionSentence: Presumably means by reasonable assumption.
senses.definitionZh: 通过合理的假设。
senses.exampleZh: 据推测，他错过了火车。

senses.example: Winston followed her around the room, collecting the small frail objects (Christmas, birthday, and anniversary) and wrapping them in tissue paper.
senses.definition: period extending from Dec. 24 to Jan. 6
senses.definitionSentence: Christmas means period extending from Dec. 24 to Jan. 6.
senses.definitionZh: 从 12 月 24 日到 1 月 6 日期间。
senses.exampleZh: 温斯顿跟着她在房间里走来走去，收集易碎的小物品（圣诞节、生日和周年纪念日）并用薄纸包裹它们。

senses.example: The mountainside grew steeper and she slipped once or twice on the smooth pine needles.
senses.definition: move obliquely or sideways, usually in an uncontrolled manner
senses.definitionSentence: To slip means to move obliquely or sideways, usually in an uncontrolled manner.
senses.definitionZh: 倾斜或侧向移动，通常以不受控制的方式。
senses.exampleZh: 山坡越来越陡，她在光滑的松针上滑倒了一两次。

senses.example: SLIP carried Internet Protocol packets over an old serial telephone line.
senses.exampleZh: 串行线路接口协议通过旧式串行电话线传输互联网协议数据包。
senses.definitionSentence: Serial Line Interface Protocol (SerialLineInterfaceProtocol).
senses.definitionZh: 一种通过串行线路传输网际协议数据包的通信协议。

senses.example: You 'll sleep longer and better, too, awake refreshed and free of hot weather nerves.
senses.definition: stop sleeping
senses.definitionSentence: To awake means to stop sleeping.
senses.definitionZh: 停止睡眠。
senses.exampleZh: 您也会睡得更久、睡得更好，醒来时神清气爽，免受炎热天气的困扰。

senses.example: Lay awake thinking about his new job.
senses.definition: not in a state of sleep; completely conscious
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as awake is not in a state of sleep; completely conscious.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为清醒的事物并不处于睡眠状态；完全有意识。
senses.exampleZh: 躺在床上，想着他的新工作。

senses.example: The mutual interests of management and labor.
senses.definition: common to or shared by two or more parties
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as mutual is common to or shared by two or more parties.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为相互的事物是两个或多个参与方所共有或共享的。
senses.exampleZh: 管理层和劳工的共同利益。

senses.example: Their mutual respect grew as each colleague listened to and supported the other.
senses.definition: concerning each of two or more persons or things; especially given or done in return
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as mutual is concerning each of two or more persons or things; especially given or done in return.
senses.definitionZh: 相互的事物是指涉及两个或两个以上的人或事物中的每一个；特别是给予或做的回报。
senses.exampleZh: 随着每位同事倾听和支持对方，他们的相互尊重不断加深。

senses.example: The driver dimmed the headlights from high beam when another car approached.
senses.definition: switch (a car's headlights) from a higher to a lower beam
senses.definitionSentence: To dim means to switch (a car's headlights) from a higher to a lower beam.
senses.definitionZh: 将（汽车前灯）从较高的光束切换到较低的光束。
senses.exampleZh: 当另一辆车驶近时，司机调暗了远光灯。

senses.definition: a large number of things or people considered together
senses.definitionSentence: A large number of things or people considered together.
senses.definitionZh: 大量的事物或人一起考虑。
senses.example: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium and waited for the gates to open.
senses.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在体育场外等待大门打开。

senses.example: The students crowded the auditorium.
senses.definition: fill or occupy to the point of overflowing
senses.definitionSentence: To crowd means to fill or occupy to the point of overflowing.
senses.definitionZh: 填充或占据到溢出的程度。
senses.exampleZh: 学生们挤满了礼堂。

senses.example: His death marked the ending of an era.
senses.definition: event whose occurrence ends something
senses.definitionSentence: Ending means event whose occurrence ends something.
senses.definitionZh: 其发生结束某事的事件。
senses.exampleZh: 他的去世标志着一个时代的结束。

senses.example: The recent speech of the president augmented tensions in the Near East.
senses.definition: enlarge or increase
dictionaryCandidates: 扩大， 增加， 提高
senses.definitionSentence: To augment means to enlarge or increase.
senses.definitionZh: 扩大或增加。
senses.exampleZh: 总统最近的讲话加剧了近东的紧张局势。

senses.example: The director's deputy chaired the meeting and signed documents on her behalf while she was abroad.
senses.definition: a person appointed to represent or act on behalf of others
senses.definitionSentence: Deputy is a person appointed to represent or act on behalf of others.
senses.definitionZh: 被任命代表他人或代表他人行事的人。
senses.exampleZh: 出国期间，由副主任主持会议并代为签署文件。

senses.example: He spoke in a nervous tone of voice.
senses.definition: the quality of a person's voice
senses.definitionSentence: Tone is the quality of a person's voice.
senses.definitionZh: 一个人的声音的质量。
senses.exampleZh: 他说话的语气很紧张。

senses.example: A clergyman improved the tone of the meeting.
senses.definition: the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people
senses.definitionSentence: Tone is the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people.
senses.definitionZh: 一个地方或情况的总体氛围及其对人们的影响。
senses.exampleZh: 一位牧师改善了会议的气氛。

senses.meaning: 违法的，违反规则的，不合法的，非法的

senses.definitionZh: 法律、官方或公认规则禁止被描述为非法的事物。
senses.exampleZh: 所有悬疑故事的基本前提是善与恶的区别与合法与非法的区别是一致的。

senses.example: The artist mixed a deep red resembling the color of ripe tomatoes and fresh blood.
senses.definition: red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood
senses.definitionSentence: Red means red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood.
senses.definitionZh: 红色或颜料；类似血色的彩色。

senses.example: The company operated in the red last year.

senses.definitionZh: 企业成本超过收入的金额。
senses.exampleZh: 该公司去年出现亏损。

senses.example: A. armata is much more beautiful in color, at least in the female of the species: a rich, velvety, rusty red.
senses.definition: of a color at the end of the color spectrum (next to orange); resembling the color of blood or cherries or tomatoes or rubies
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as red is of a color at the end of the color spectrum (next to orange); resembling the color of blood or cherries or tomatoes or rubies.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为红色的颜色是色谱末端的颜色（橙色旁边）；类似血液、樱桃、西红柿或红宝石的颜色。
senses.exampleZh: A. armata 的颜色更加美丽，至少在该物种的雌性中是这样：浓郁、天鹅绒般的铁锈红色。

senses.example: He had picked out this pathless trail, instead of the common one, in a moment of romantic fancy, to give them privacy on their honeymoon.
senses.definition: something many people believe that is false
senses.definitionSentence: Fancy means something many people believe that is false.
senses.definitionZh: 许多人认为是错误的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 他在浪漫的幻想中选择了这条无路的小路，而不是常见的小路，以便在蜜月期间给他们带来隐私。

senses.definition: a facility equipped with special equipment and personnel for a particular purpose
senses.definitionSentence: A facility equipped with special equipment and personnel for a particular purpose.
senses.definitionZh: 为特定目的配备特殊设备和人员的设施。

senses.example: The responsibilities of a man in his station.

senses.definitionSentence: Station means proper or designated social situation.
senses.definitionZh: 适当的或指定的社交场合。
senses.exampleZh: 一个人在他的岗位上的责任。

senses.example: His hands were trembling when he signed the document.

senses.definitionZh: 快速、不自觉地上下或侧向移动或猛拉。
senses.exampleZh: 当他签署文件时，他的手在颤抖。

senses.example: Presently, the intense absorption of ultra-violet rays in the earth's atmosphere seriously hinders ground observation.
senses.definition: be a hindrance or obstacle to
senses.definitionSentence: To hinder means to be a hindrance or obstacle to.
senses.definitionZh: 成为阻碍或阻碍。
senses.exampleZh: 目前，地球大气层对紫外线的强烈吸收严重阻碍了地面观测。

senses.example: They look after their fields and children and water buffaloes in ten or eleven thousand villages, with an average of 200 souls.
senses.definition: a community of people smaller than a town
senses.definitionSentence: Village is a community of people smaller than a town.
senses.definitionZh: 比城镇更小的居民社区。
senses.exampleZh: 他们在一万个或一万一千个村庄里照顾自己的田地、孩子和水牛，平均有 200 个人。

senses.example: Even the stable garage, which housed nothing now but the scent of rot, had a lawn before it.
senses.definition: a state of decay usually accompanied by an offensive odor
senses.definitionSentence: Rot is a state of decay usually accompanied by an offensive odor.
senses.definitionZh: 一种腐烂状态，通常伴有难闻的气味。

senses.meaning: 胡说，荒唐（表示厌恶或不信）
senses.example: Rot! That excuse is complete nonsense and you know it.
senses.exampleZh: 胡说！那个借口完全是一派胡言，你自己也知道。
senses.definitionSentence: Nonsense, absurd (expressing disgust or disbelief).
senses.definitionZh: 胡言乱语，荒谬（表达厌恶或怀疑）。

senses.example: The meeting became trapped in trivial arguments about paper clips and coffee cups.
senses.definition: concerned with trivialities
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as trivial is concerned with trivialities.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为琐碎的事情与琐碎的事情有关。
senses.exampleZh: 会议陷入了关于回形针和咖啡杯的琐碎争论。

senses.example: The reading program fosters children's language development by giving them books and daily guidance.
senses.definition: help develop, help grow
senses.definitionSentence: To foster means to help develop, help grow.
senses.definitionZh: 帮助发展、帮助成长。
senses.exampleZh: 阅读计划通过为儿童提供书籍和日常指导来促进他们的语言发展。

senses.example: The couple fostered two children until a permanent adoptive family was found.
senses.definition: bring up under fosterage; of children
senses.definitionSentence: To foster means to bring up under fosterage; of children.
senses.definitionZh: 在寄养下抚养长大；儿童。
senses.exampleZh: 这对夫妇收养了两个孩子，直到找到永久的收养家庭。

senses.example: Foster our children's well-being and education.
senses.definition: promote the growth of
senses.definitionSentence: To foster means to promote the growth of.
senses.definitionZh: 促进生长。
senses.exampleZh: 促进我们孩子的福祉和教育。

senses.example: He clambered out of the dwindling wash, the loose dirt flying behind him, and flashed a look about.
senses.definition: the part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock
senses.definitionSentence: Dirt is the part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock.
senses.definitionZh: 地球表面由腐殖质和碎石组成的部分。
senses.exampleZh: 他从逐渐减少的水流中爬出来，松散的泥土在他身后飞舞，他环顾四周。

senses.example: And the career of Konrad Adenauer, who upheld Germany's tradition of rock-like leaders which Bismarck began, draws near the end.
senses.definition: keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last
senses.definitionSentence: To uphold means to keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last.
senses.definitionZh: 保持或维持未改变的状态；导致保留或持续。
senses.exampleZh: 康拉德·阿登纳（Konrad Adenauer）维护了俾斯麦开创的德国坚如磐石的领导人传统，他的职业生涯也接近尾声。

senses.example: Depending on the organism, there may be multiplication in some food or beverage products, i.e., in milk for example.
senses.definition: a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently
senses.definitionSentence: Organism is a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently.
senses.definitionZh: 具有（或可以发展）独立行动或功能的能力的生物。
senses.exampleZh: 根据生物体的不同，某些食品或饮料产品（即牛奶）中可能会出现增殖。

senses.example: The students groaned when the professor got out the exam booklets.
senses.definition: indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
senses.definitionSentence: To groan means to indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure.
senses.definitionZh: 表示疼痛、不适或不满。
senses.exampleZh: 当教授拿出试卷时，学生们发出了呻吟声。

senses.example: She rubbed silver polish onto the dull tray until the cleaning preparation restored its shine.
senses.definition: a preparation used in polishing
senses.definitionSentence: Polish is a preparation used in polishing.
senses.definitionZh: 用于抛光的制剂。
senses.exampleZh: 她在暗淡的托盘上擦拭银色抛光剂，直到清洁剂恢复光泽。

senses.example: Stained with Jacquelyn's ceramic unfired stain, polished, following manufacturer's directions.
senses.definition: make (a surface) shine
senses.definitionSentence: To polish means to make (a surface) shine.
senses.definitionZh: 使（表面）发光。
senses.exampleZh: 使用 Jacquelyn 的陶瓷未烧制着色剂染色，抛光，按照制造商的说明进行。

senses.example: There was the Polish Revolution which we misunderstood and then helped guide along a course favorable to Soviet interests.
senses.definition: of or relating to Poland or its people or culture
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as polish is of or relating to Poland or its people or culture.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为波兰语的事物属于或与波兰或其人民或文化相关。
senses.exampleZh: 我们误解了波兰革命，然后帮助引导它走上有利于苏联利益的道路。

senses.example: If the check is not good and the April 15 or other due date deadline elapses, additions to the tax may be incurred.
senses.definition: the point in time at which something must be completed

senses.definitionZh: 轻轻地投掷或抛掷。

senses.exampleZh: 她把钥匙扔到了房间的另一边，她哥哥接住了它们。

senses.example: With a sudden toss of his head, the horse threw its mane backward.
senses.definition: an abrupt movement
senses.definitionSentence: Toss is an abrupt movement.
senses.definitionZh: 一种突然的动作。

senses.definitionZh: 动物用于运动或抓握的有关节的附属物之一：手臂；腿;翼;鳍状肢。

senses.definitionZh: 一种防止船舶移动的机械装置。

senses.definitionSentence: Anchor is a television reporter who coordinates a broadcast to which several correspondents contribute.
senses.definitionZh: 一名电视记者，负责协调由多名记者参与的广播。

senses.example: Hardly anyone ashore marked her as she anchored stern-to off Berth 29 on the mole.
senses.definition: secure a vessel with an anchor
