senses.definition: filling again by supplying what has been used up
senses.definitionSentence: Replacement means filling again by supplying what has been used up.
senses.definitionZh: 通过供应已用完的物质来重新填充。
senses.exampleZh: 定期补充流失的液体和盐可以防止跑步者出现严重脱水的情况。

senses.example: She permitted her son to visit her estranged husband.
senses.definition: consent to, give permission
senses.definitionSentence: To permit means to consent to, give permission.
senses.definitionZh: 同意、给予许可。
senses.exampleZh: 她允许儿子去看望她分居的丈夫。

senses.example: To go outside the few cities required permits.
senses.definition: a legal document giving official permission to do something
senses.definitionSentence: Permit is a legal document giving official permission to do something.
senses.definitionZh: 给予某事正式许可的法律文件。
senses.exampleZh: 走出少数城市需要许可证。

senses.example: Engineers reinforced the underlying rock beneath the road surface.
senses.definition: located beneath or below
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as underlying is located beneath or below.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为底层的东西位于下方或下方。
senses.exampleZh: 工程师加固了路面下的底层岩石。

senses.example: The roofer sealed the overlap where one sheet of metal lay across the edge of the next.
senses.definition: a flap that lies over another part
senses.definitionSentence: Overlap is a flap that lies over another part.
senses.definitionZh: 位于另一部分之上的翻盖。
senses.exampleZh: 屋顶工密封了重叠处，其中一张金属板横跨另一张金属板的边缘。

senses.example: Bevel and score ends of clay piece A so that they overlap about 1 2 '' and make even thickness.
senses.definition: coincide partially or wholly
senses.definitionSentence: To overlap means to coincide partially or wholly.
senses.definitionZh: 部分或全部重合。
senses.exampleZh: 对粘土片 A 的两端进行斜角和刻痕，使它们重叠约 1 2 英寸，并使厚度均匀。

senses.example: The twin-engine aeroplane accelerated along the runway until its fixed wings lifted it into the air.
senses.definition: an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
senses.definitionSentence: Aeroplane is an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets.
senses.definitionZh: 一种具有固定翼并由螺旋桨或喷气式飞机提供动力的飞机。
senses.exampleZh: 双引擎飞机沿着跑道加速，直到固定翼将其升到空中。

senses.example: Fuchs, after nine and a half years, was released, being given time off for good behavior.
senses.definition: grant freedom to; free from confinement
senses.definitionSentence: To release means to grant freedom to; free from confinement.
senses.definitionZh: 给予自由；不受束缚。
senses.exampleZh: 福克斯在九年后被释放，并因表现良好而获得休假。

senses.example: A copy was released to the press.
senses.definition: prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
senses.definitionSentence: To release means to prepare and issue for public distribution or sale.
senses.definitionZh: 准备和发行以供公开发行或销售。
senses.exampleZh: 向媒体发布了一份副本。

senses.example: There was a sudden release of oxygen.
senses.definition: a process that liberates or discharges something
senses.definitionSentence: Release is a process that liberates or discharges something.
senses.definitionZh: 释放或释放某些东西的过程。
senses.exampleZh: 氧气突然释放。

senses.example: Again, Lawrence thought a little sadly, these were the fees of poverty and ambition.
senses.definition: the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
senses.definitionSentence: Poverty is the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions.
senses.definitionZh: 拥有很少或没有钱以及很少或没有物质财富的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 劳伦斯又有点悲伤地想，这些都是贫穷和野心的代价。

senses.example: The Pathet Lao forces held two northern provinces and openly took the offensive in three more.
senses.definition: the action of attacking an enemy
senses.definitionSentence: Offensive is the action of attacking an enemy.
senses.definitionZh: 攻击敌人的行动。
senses.exampleZh: 巴特寮军队控制了两个北部省份，并在另外三个省份公开发动攻势。

senses.example: Her daughter cared for her in her old age.
senses.definition: a female human offspring
senses.definitionSentence: Daughter is a female human offspring.
senses.definitionZh: 女性人类后代。
senses.exampleZh: 她的女儿在她晚年照顾她。

senses.example: The train came to an abrupt stop without slowing gradually, throwing standing passengers forward.
senses.definition: exceedingly sudden and unexpected
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as abrupt is exceedingly sudden and unexpected.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为突然的事情是非常突然和意外的。
senses.exampleZh: 火车突然停下来，没有逐渐减速，将站立的乘客抛向前。

senses.example: His abrupt reply ended the conversation without a greeting or explanation.
senses.definition: surprisingly and unceremoniously brusque in manner
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as abrupt is surprisingly and unceremoniously brusque in manner.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为突然的事物在方式上令人惊讶且毫不客气。
senses.exampleZh: 他突然的回复结束了谈话，没有打招呼或解释。

senses.example: The road climbs an abrupt mountainside so steep that heavy trucks must use first gear.
senses.definition: extremely steep
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as abrupt is extremely steep.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为突然的事物是极其陡峭的。
senses.exampleZh: 这条路爬上一个陡峭的山坡，非常陡峭，重型卡车必须使用一档。

senses.example: Anthony Steel, as the husband, is a jealous type who argues against her course and sues for divorce, labeling her action adulterous.
senses.definition: institute legal proceedings against; file a suit against
senses.definitionSentence: To sue means to institute legal proceedings against; file a suit against.
senses.definitionZh: 针对以下对象提起法律诉讼；提起诉讼。
senses.exampleZh: 安东尼·斯蒂尔（Anthony Steel）作为丈夫，是一个嫉妒型的人，他反对她的做法并起诉离婚，将她的行为标记为通奸。

senses.example: Artistic mimesis under Christian influence records the involvement of all persons, however humble, in a divine drama.
senses.definition: low or inferior in station or quality
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as humble is low or inferior in station or quality.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为卑微的东西是指地位或质量较低或较差。
senses.exampleZh: 基督教影响下的艺术模仿记录了所有人，无论多么卑微，都参与了一场神圣的戏剧。

senses.example: When the vote was taken they were in the minority.
senses.definition: being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts
senses.definitionSentence: Minority means being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts.
senses.definitionZh: 两个部分中数量较少的一个或与之相关。
senses.exampleZh: 投票时他们属于少数派。

senses.example: Even if there are no livestock, the farmer cannot leave the farm for long periods, particularly during the growing season.
senses.definition: a person who operates a farm
senses.definitionSentence: Farmer is a person who operates a farm.
senses.definitionZh: 经营农场的人。
senses.exampleZh: 即使没有牲畜，农民也不能长时间离开农场，特别是在生长季节。

senses.example: And he would sleep, sleep, and never think of roads and horses ' sore haunches, of colonial wars.
senses.definition: of or relating to or characteristic of or inhabiting a colony
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as colonial is of or relating to or characteristic of or inhabiting a colony.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为殖民地的事物属于殖民地、与殖民地相关、具有殖民地的特征或居住在殖民地。
senses.exampleZh: 他会睡觉，睡觉，永远不会想到道路和马的疼痛，殖民战争。

senses.example: A false calculation caused by one misplaced decimal point produced the wrong total.
senses.definition: erroneous and usually accidental
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as false is erroneous and usually accidental.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为错误的内容是错误的，并且通常是偶然的。
senses.exampleZh: 由于一位小数点放错而导致的错误计算产生了错误的总数。

senses.example: The witness gave false testimony under oath, deliberately pretending that an invented story was true.
senses.definition: not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as false is not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality.
senses.definitionZh: 描述为虚假的内容与事实、现实或现实不符。
senses.exampleZh: 证人在宣誓后提供虚假证词，故意假装编造的故事是真实的。

senses.definitionSentence: To impose a compulsory financial charge on a person, product, or activity.
senses.definitionZh: 向个人、产品或活动强制征收款项。
senses.example: The government taxes tobacco heavily to raise revenue and discourage smoking.
senses.exampleZh: 政府对烟草征收重税，以增加财政收入并抑制吸烟。
senses.definition: To impose a compulsory financial charge on a person, product, or activity.

senses.example: Take into account the difference in city and county taxes, insurance rates, utility rates, and the cost of travel to work.
senses.definition: charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government
senses.definitionSentence: Tax means charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government.
senses.definitionZh: 为支持政府而对公民的人身、财产或活动收取的费用。
senses.exampleZh: 考虑市县税收、保险费率、公用事业费率和上班交通费用的差异。

senses.example: He was tapping his fingers on the table impatiently.
senses.definition: make light, repeated taps on a surface
senses.definitionSentence: To tap means to make light, repeated taps on a surface.
senses.definitionZh: 在表面上轻轻地、重复地点击。
senses.exampleZh: 他不耐烦地用手指敲击着桌子。

senses.example: The brewer tapped the wooden cask by fitting a spout so beer could be drawn from it.
senses.definition: furnish with a tap or spout, so as to be able to draw liquid from it
senses.definitionSentence: To tap means to furnish with a tap or spout, so as to be able to draw liquid from it.
senses.definitionZh: 配备水龙头或喷嘴，以便能够从中吸取液体。
senses.exampleZh: 酿酒师通过安装喷嘴来敲击木桶，以便可以从中抽取啤酒。

senses.example: She turned the kitchen tap and filled a glass with water from the pipe.
senses.definition: a faucet for drawing water from a pipe or cask
senses.definitionSentence: Tap is a faucet for drawing water from a pipe or cask.
senses.definitionZh: 用于从管道或桶中取水的水龙头。
senses.exampleZh: 她打开厨房水龙头，从水管里倒了一杯水。

senses.example: She gave the microphone a gentle tap with one finger to check whether it was working.
senses.definition: a gentle blow
senses.definitionSentence: Tap is a gentle blow.
senses.definitionZh: 轻轻的一击。
senses.exampleZh: 她用一根手指轻轻敲击麦克风以检查其是否正常工作。

senses.example: His social sphere is limited.
senses.definition: a particular environment or walk of life
senses.definitionSentence: Sphere is a particular environment or walk of life.
senses.definitionZh: 特定的环境或行业。
senses.exampleZh: 他的社交范围有限。

senses.example: The sculptor carved a solid sphere whose curved boundary enclosed the entire volume.
senses.definition: a solid figure bounded by a spherical surface (including the space it encloses)
senses.definitionSentence: Sphere is a solid figure bounded by a spherical surface (including the space it encloses).
senses.definitionZh: 由球面（包括其包围的空间）界定的实体图形。
senses.exampleZh: 雕塑家雕刻了一个实心球体，其弯曲边界包围了整个体积。

senses.example: Every point on the surface of a perfect sphere lies the same distance from its center.
senses.definition: a three-dimensional closed surface such that every point on the surface is equidistant from the center
senses.definitionSentence: Sphere is a three-dimensional closed surface such that every point on the surface is equidistant from the center.
senses.definitionZh: 一个三维封闭表面，表面上的每个点到中心的距离都相等。
senses.exampleZh: 完美球体表面上的每个点与其中心的距离相同。

senses.example: There was a congressional probe into the scandal.
senses.definition: an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities
senses.definitionSentence: Probe is an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities.
senses.definitionZh: 对不熟悉或可疑活动的调查。
senses.exampleZh: 国会对此丑闻进行了调查。

senses.example: As the hour progresses, the sensitive seems to probe more deeply and to make more personal and specific statements.
senses.definition: question or examine thoroughly and closely
senses.definitionSentence: To probe means to question or examine thoroughly and closely.
senses.definitionZh: 彻底、仔细地提问或检查。
senses.exampleZh: 随着时间的推移，敏感者似乎会更深入地探究并做出更多个人和具体的陈述。

senses.example: If the farm is rented, the rent must be paid.
senses.definition: a payment or series of payments made by the lessee to an owner for use of some property, facility, equipment, or service
senses.definitionSentence: Rent is a payment or series of payments made by the lessee to an owner for use of some property, facility, equipment, or service.
senses.definitionZh: 承租人为使用某些财产、设施、设备或服务而向业主支付的一笔或一系列付款。
senses.exampleZh: 如果农场是租赁的，则必须支付租金。

senses.example: We rented our apartment to friends while we were abroad.
senses.definition: let for money
senses.definitionSentence: To rent means to let for money.
senses.definitionZh: 为了钱而出租。
senses.exampleZh: 我们在国外时把公寓租给朋友。

senses.example: Since they are all either rented or borrowed, the requested dates for their use have to be far in advance.
senses.definition: engage for service under a term of contract
senses.definitionSentence: To rent means to engage for service under a term of contract.
senses.definitionZh: 根据合同条款从事服务。
senses.exampleZh: 由于它们都是租用或借用的，因此要求的使用日期必须提前很长时间。

senses.meaning: 自发的，自然的，无意识的
senses.example: Observers can see a person engaged in spontaneous behavior, and watch him operating in a totalistic fashion.
senses.definition: happening or arising without apparent external cause
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as spontaneous is happening or arising without apparent external cause.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为自发的事情正在发生或出现，没有明显的外部原因。
senses.exampleZh: 观察者可以看到一个人从事自发行为，并观察他以极权主义的方式运作。

senses.example: He dieted under medical supervision, eating smaller portions to lose excess weight safely.
senses.definition: eat sparingly, for health reasons or to lose weight
senses.definitionSentence: To diet means to eat sparingly, for health reasons or to lose weight.
senses.definitionZh: 出于健康原因或减肥而节食。
senses.exampleZh: 他在医疗监督下节食，吃少量的食物以安全地减掉多余的体重。

senses.example: Her low-sodium diet restricts salty foods in order to control her blood pressure.
senses.definition: the act of restricting your food intake (or your intake of particular foods)
senses.definitionSentence: Diet is the act of restricting your food intake (or your intake of particular foods).
senses.definitionZh: 限制食物摄入量（或特定食物摄入量）的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 她的低钠饮食限制咸味食物，以控制血压。

senses.example: This time he turned westward, to the middle Atlantic coast of North America.
senses.definition: the shore of a sea or ocean
senses.definitionSentence: Coast is the shore of a sea or ocean.
senses.definitionZh: 大海或大洋的海岸。
senses.exampleZh: 这次他转向西行，到达了北美大西洋中部海岸。

senses.example: She stumbled over the tree root.
senses.definition: miss a step and fall or nearly fall
senses.definitionSentence: To stumble means to miss a step and fall or nearly fall.
senses.definitionZh: 错过一步并跌倒或几乎跌倒。
senses.exampleZh: 她被树根绊倒了。

senses.example: The accountant stumbled when she entered the same payment twice and produced an incorrect total.
senses.definition: make an error
senses.definitionSentence: To stumble means to make an error.
senses.definitionZh: 犯错误。
senses.exampleZh: 会计师在两次输入相同的付款并得出错误的总计时犯了错误。

senses.example: The airline steward served drinks and demonstrated the emergency exits before takeoff.
senses.definition: an attendant on an airplane
senses.definitionSentence: Steward is an attendant on an airplane.
senses.definitionZh: 飞机上的乘务员。
senses.exampleZh: 起飞前，空乘人员提供饮料并演示紧急出口。

senses.example: The check had been mailed from Chicago, the envelope bore no return address, and the check was not signed.
senses.definition: a flat (usually rectangular) container for a letter, thin package, etc.
senses.definitionSentence: Envelope is a flat (usually rectangular) container for a letter, thin package, etc.
senses.definitionZh: 用于信件、薄包装等的扁平（通常是矩形）容器。
senses.exampleZh: 支票是从芝加哥寄出的，信封上没有回信地址，支票也没有签名。

senses.example: A protective envelope of membrane surrounds the organ and separates it from nearby tissue.
senses.definition: any wrapper or covering
senses.definitionSentence: Envelope means any wrapper or covering.
senses.definitionZh: 任何包装材料或覆盖物。
senses.exampleZh: 器官周围有一层保护膜，并将其与附近的组织分开。

senses.example: Bill Weigand was good and tired of the wall opposite, and the crack in the plaster.
senses.definition: a long narrow opening
senses.definitionSentence: Crack is a long narrow opening.
senses.definitionZh: 一个狭长的开口。
senses.exampleZh: Bill Weigand 很好，但厌倦了对面的墙和灰泥上的裂缝。

senses.example: A rifle cracked; the square head fell over.
senses.definition: make a very sharp explosive sound
senses.definitionSentence: To crack means to make a very sharp explosive sound.
senses.definitionZh: 发出非常尖锐的爆炸声。
senses.exampleZh: 一支步枪破裂；方头摔倒了。

senses.meaning: 使爆裂，使破裂，分裂，破裂
senses.example: The crack of the ice sheet split its solid surface into two separate pieces.
senses.definition: the act of cracking something
senses.definitionSentence: Crack is the act of cracking something.
senses.definitionZh: 破解某物的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 冰盖的裂缝将其固体表面分成两块。

senses.example: It was not altogether her fault.
senses.definition: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
senses.definitionSentence: Altogether means to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly').
senses.definitionZh: 完全的程度或全部或完全的程度（“整体”通常非正式地用于“完全”）。
senses.exampleZh: 这并不完全是她的错。

senses.example: The blacksmith heated the iron in the forge until it glowed red and became workable.
senses.definition: furnace consisting of a special hearth where metal is heated before shaping
senses.definitionSentence: Forge means furnace consisting of a special hearth where metal is heated before shaping.
senses.definitionZh: 由一个特殊的炉床组成的熔炉，金属在成型前被加热。
senses.exampleZh: 铁匠在熔炉中加热铁，直到它发出红光并变得可以使用。

senses.example: She forged a Green Card.
senses.definition: make a copy of with the intent to deceive
senses.definitionSentence: To forge means to make a copy of with the intent to deceive.
senses.definitionZh: 以欺骗为目的进行复制。
senses.exampleZh: 她伪造了绿卡。

senses.example: The blacksmith forged a steel hinge strong enough to support the castle's heavy gate.
senses.definition: make something, usually for a specific function
senses.definitionSentence: To forge means to make something, usually for a specific function.
senses.definitionZh: 制造某种东西，通常是为了特定的功能。
senses.exampleZh: 铁匠锻造了一个足够坚固的钢铰链来支撑城堡沉重的大门。

senses.example: Hammers rang throughout the forge as workers heated and shaped bars of metal.
senses.definition: a workplace where metal is worked by heating and hammering
senses.definitionSentence: Forge is a workplace where metal is worked by heating and hammering.
senses.definitionZh: 通过加热和锤击加工金属的工作场所。
senses.exampleZh: 当工人们对金属棒进行加热和成型时，锤子在整个锻造厂里响起。

senses.example: Like his friend and contemporary August Strindberg he had little patience with collective mediocrity.
senses.definition: good-natured tolerance of delay or incompetence
senses.definitionSentence: Patience means good-natured tolerance of delay or incompetence.
senses.definitionZh: 对延误或无能的善意容忍。
senses.exampleZh: 和他的朋友、同时代的奥古斯特·斯特林堡一样，他对集体的平庸没有什么耐心。

senses.example: The hem fell shortly below her knees.
senses.definition: at a short distance
senses.definitionSentence: Shortly means at a short distance.
senses.definitionZh: 短距离。
senses.exampleZh: 下摆很快就落到了膝盖以下。

senses.example: From the resulting data the doctor can determine lung defects with hitherto unknown accuracy and detail.
senses.definition: used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time
senses.definitionSentence: Hitherto means used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项 表示在否定陈述中使用，描述迄今为止或目前为止已经存在的情况。
senses.exampleZh: 根据所得数据，医生可以以迄今为止未知的准确性和细节确定肺部缺陷。

senses.example: This low field is prone to flooding because water collects there after every heavy rain.
senses.definition: having a tendency (to); often used in combination
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as prone is having a tendency (to); often used in combination.
senses.definitionZh: 易于……的，有……倾向的。
senses.exampleZh: 这片低洼地很容易发生洪水，因为每次大雨后水都会聚集在那里。

senses.example: The refugees made an urgent plea to the authorities for food, shelter, and safe passage.
senses.definition: a humble request for help from someone in authority
senses.definitionSentence: Plea is a humble request for help from someone in authority.
senses.definitionZh: 来自权威人士的谦虚请求。
senses.exampleZh: 难民紧急请求当局提供食物、住所和安全通道。

senses.example: They gossiped about their neighbor's divorce and repeated details that had been told in confidence.
senses.definition: wag one's tongue; speak about others and reveal secrets or intimacies
senses.definitionSentence: To gossip means to wag one's tongue; speak about others and reveal secrets or intimacies.
senses.definitionZh: 摇摆不定；谈论他人并透露秘密或亲密关系。
senses.exampleZh: 他们闲聊邻居离婚的事，并重复了秘密告知的细节。

senses.exampleZh: 离婚引起了很多流言蜚语。

senses.definitionZh: 一种活泼的兴趣。

senses.meaning: 好看的，漂亮的，美的，美好的
senses.example: Still painting, still a kind of modern impressionist, beautiful canvases of mountains and farms.
senses.definition: delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as beautiful is delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓美丽的事物是指愉悦感官或激发智力或情感上的钦佩。
senses.exampleZh: 仍然是绘画，仍然是一种现代印象派，美丽的山脉和农场的画布。

senses.example: Each lottery ticket carries a number, and a random draw determines who wins the prize.
senses.definition: players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
senses.definitionSentence: Lottery means players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots.
senses.definitionZh: 玩家购买（或给予）机会，奖品通过抽签分配。
senses.exampleZh: 每张彩票都有一个号码，通过随机抽奖决定谁中奖。

senses.meaning: 空想的，古怪的，不可思议的
senses.example: "fantastic figures with bulbous heads the circumference of a bushel"- Nathaniel Hawthorne.

senses.example: A fantastic idea of his own importance.

senses.example: A balanced resistance bridge and a pen recorder are all the electronic instrumentation needed.
senses.definition: a writing implement with a point from which ink flows
senses.definitionSentence: Pen is a writing implement with a point from which ink flows.
senses.definitionZh: 一种书写工具，具有墨水流出的笔尖。
senses.exampleZh: 平衡电阻电桥和笔式录音机都是所需的电子仪器。

senses.example: The baby played safely inside a portable pen whose padded sides kept her away from the stairs.

senses.exampleZh: 婴儿在便携式围栏内安全玩耍，围栏的两侧有衬垫，可让她远离楼梯。

senses.example: The principle that one is innocent until proved guilty.
senses.definition: free from evil or guilt
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as innocent is free from evil or guilt.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为无辜的事物没有邪恶或罪恶感。
senses.exampleZh: 在被证明有罪之前是无罪的原则。

senses.example: The innocent malfeasant, filled with that supreme sense of honor found in bars, insisted upon replacing the destroyed monocle - and did, over the protests of the former owner - with a square monocle.
senses.definition: lacking in sophistication or worldliness
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as innocent is lacking in sophistication or worldliness.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为无辜的东西缺乏成熟度或世俗性。
senses.exampleZh: 这个无辜的恶棍充满了酒吧里那种至高无上的荣誉感，坚持用方形单片眼镜替换了被毁坏的单片眼镜——并且不顾前主人的抗议，确实这么做了。

senses.example: Information beyond nearest neighbor is carried second -, third -, and fourth hand as a distortable rumor.
senses.definition: a person who lives (or is located) near another
senses.definitionSentence: Neighbor is a person who lives (or is located) near another.
senses.definitionZh: 住在（或位于）另一个人附近的人。
senses.exampleZh: 最近邻居之外的信息作为歪曲的谣言被传播到第二手、第三手和第四手。

senses.example: Our farm neighbors the national park, sharing a fence along its eastern boundary.
senses.definition: live or be located as a neighbor
senses.definitionSentence: To neighbor means to live or be located as a neighbor.

senses.exampleZh: 我们的农场毗邻国家公园，沿其东部边界共用栅栏。

senses.example: Equally a master of prose and verse, he recreates the glory of Sweden in the past and continues it into the present.
senses.definition: ordinary writing as distinguished from verse
senses.definitionSentence: Prose means ordinary writing as distinguished from verse.
senses.definitionZh: 与诗歌不同的普通写作。
senses.exampleZh: 他同样是散文和诗歌大师，他再现了瑞典过去的辉煌，并将其延续至今。

senses.example: O ' Banion accepted his platinum watch and the tributes to his loyalty, and proceeded with the bigger and better Republican deal.
senses.definition: something given or done as an expression of esteem
senses.definitionSentence: Tribute means something given or done as an expression of esteem.
senses.definitionZh: 为了表达尊重而给予或做的事情。
senses.exampleZh: 奥巴尼恩接受了他的白金手表和对他忠诚的致敬，并继续进行更大更好的共和党协议。

senses.example: They were rescued from despair at the last minute.
senses.definition: a state in which all hope is lost or absent
senses.definitionSentence: Despair is a state in which all hope is lost or absent.
senses.definitionZh: 一种所有希望都消失或不存在的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 他们在最后一刻被从绝望中解救出来。

senses.example: Would it be feasible to limit the menu in order to reduce feeding costs?
senses.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as feasible is capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为可行的事情能够通过现有的手段和现有的情况来完成。
senses.exampleZh: 限制菜单以降低饲养成本是否可行？

senses.example: He paused on the landing to steady his breathing and then bent to examine the single door by the light of the weak bulb overhead.
senses.definition: electric lamp consisting of a transparent or translucent glass housing containing a wire filament (usually tungsten) that emits light when heated by electricity
senses.definitionSentence: Bulb means electric lamp consisting of a transparent or translucent glass housing containing a wire filament (usually tungsten) that emits light when heated by electricity.
senses.definitionZh: 由透明或半透明玻璃外壳组成的电灯，玻璃外壳内含灯丝（通常是钨丝），通电加热时会发光。
senses.exampleZh: 他在楼梯平台上停了下来，稳定呼吸，然后弯下腰，借助头顶微弱灯泡的光检查那扇门。

senses.example: The rubber bulb of the syringe expands into a round shape when released and forces liquid out when squeezed.
senses.definition: a rounded part of a cylindrical instrument (usually at one end)
senses.definitionSentence: Bulb is a rounded part of a cylindrical instrument (usually at one end).
senses.definitionZh: 圆柱形仪器的圆形部分（通常在一端）。
senses.exampleZh: 注射器的橡胶球在释放时会膨胀成圆形，并在挤压时将液体挤出。

senses.example: The patient entered treatment for heroin addiction after years of injecting the narcotic.
senses.definition: a narcotic that is considered a hard drug; a highly addictive morphine derivative; intravenous injection provides the fastest and most intense rush
senses.definitionSentence: Heroin is a narcotic that is considered a hard drug; a highly addictive morphine derivative; intravenous injection provides the fastest and most intense rush.
senses.definitionZh: 一种麻醉剂，被视为硬性毒品；高度成瘾的吗啡衍生物；静脉注射提供最快、最强烈的冲刺。
senses.exampleZh: 患者在注射麻醉剂多年后开始接受海洛因成瘾治疗。

senses.example: Orders not written down had to be transmitted to the local provincial government.
senses.definition: transfer to another
senses.definitionSentence: To transmit means to transfer to another.
senses.definitionZh: 传输给另一个人。
senses.exampleZh: 未写下的命令必须转发给当地省政府。

senses.example: Wound tumor virus is a leafhopper transmitted virus not easily transmissible by mechanical inoculation (Black, 1944; Brakke et al., 1954).
senses.definition: transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
senses.definitionSentence: To transmit means to transmit or serve as the medium for transmission.
senses.definitionZh: 传输或充当传输的媒介。
senses.exampleZh: 伤口肿瘤病毒是一种叶蝉传播的病毒，不易通过机械接种传播（Black，1944；Brakke 等，1954）。

senses.example: Not only is this kind of duplication wasteful, but it gives the combined system the ability to take freight traffic away from the New York Central and other railroads serving the area.
senses.definition: transporting goods commercially at rates cheaper than express rates
senses.definitionSentence: Freight means transporting goods commercially at rates cheaper than express rates.
senses.definitionZh: 以比快递便宜的价格进行商业运输。
senses.exampleZh: 这种重复不仅浪费，而且使组合系统能够将货运量从纽约中央车站和服务于该地区的其他铁路中转移出来。

senses.example: The freight rate is usually cheaper.
senses.definition: the charge for transporting something by common carrier
senses.definitionSentence: Freight is the charge for transporting something by common carrier.
senses.definitionZh: 通过公共承运人运输物品的费用。
senses.exampleZh: 运费通常比较便宜。

senses.definition: goods carried by a large vehicle
senses.definitionSentence: Freight means goods carried by a large vehicle.
senses.definitionZh: 大型车辆运载的货物。

senses.example: A clause in the contract requires the tenant to pay for any deliberate damage.

senses.example: The clock mechanism uses moving gears and springs to drive the hands.
senses.definition: device consisting of a piece of machinery; has moving parts that perform some function
senses.definitionSentence: Mechanism means device consisting of a piece of machinery; has moving parts that perform some function.
senses.definitionZh: 由机器组成的装置；具有执行某些功能的活动部件。
senses.exampleZh: 时钟机构使用移动齿轮和弹簧来驱动指针。

senses.definition: the atomic process that occurs during a chemical reaction
senses.definitionSentence: Mechanism is the atomic process that occurs during a chemical reaction.

senses.example: Jealous of his success and covetous of his possessions.

senses.definitionSentence: Beam means long thick piece of wood or metal or concrete, etc., used in construction.

senses.definitionSentence: Hostage is a prisoner who is held by one party to insure that another party will meet specified terms.

senses.definitionSentence: To thrill means to cause to be thrilled by some perceptual input.

senses.example: The philosopher defended a realistic theory in which physical objects exist independently of anyone's perceptions.
senses.definition: of or relating to the philosophical doctrine of realism
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as realistic is of or relating to the philosophical doctrine of realism.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为现实的东西属于现实主义的哲学学说或与之相关。
senses.exampleZh: 这位哲学家捍卫了一种现实理论，其中物理对象独立于任何人的感知而存在。

senses.example: But contest definition - that dramatic muscular separation of every muscle group that seems as though it must have been carved by a sculptor's chisel - is something quite different.
senses.definition: of or relating to or consisting of muscle
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as muscular is of or relating to or consisting of muscle.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为肌肉的东西属于肌肉或与肌肉有关或由肌肉组成。
senses.exampleZh: 但比赛的定义——每个肌肉群的戏剧性肌肉分离，看起来好像必须是由雕塑家的凿子雕刻出来的——是完全不同的。

senses.example: The muscular wrestler lifted his opponent with powerful arms and shoulders.
senses.definition: (of a person) possessing physical strength and weight; rugged and powerful
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as muscular is (of a person) possessing physical strength and weight; rugged and powerful.
senses.definitionZh: 肌肉发达是指（人）拥有体力和体重；坚固耐用。
senses.exampleZh: 肌肉发达的摔跤手用有力的手臂和肩膀举起了对手。

senses.example: The practice may go back still farther to the Druids.
senses.definition: to or at a greater distance in time or space (`farther' is used more frequently than `further' in this physical sense)
senses.definitionSentence: Farther means to or at a greater distance in time or space (`farther' is used more frequently than `further' in this physical sense).
senses.definitionZh: 在时间或空间上到达或处于更远的距离（在物理意义上，“更远”比“更远”更频繁地使用）。
senses.exampleZh: 这种做法可以追溯到德鲁伊。

senses.example: In spreading the factories even farther, the automobile may not have changed to any great extent the growth pattern of the cities.
senses.definition: more distant in especially degree
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as farther is more distant in especially degree.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为更远的东西在特定程度上是更遥远的。
senses.exampleZh: 在工厂进一步扩张的过程中，汽车可能并没有在很大程度上改变城市的增长模式。

senses.example: A life characterized by thriftlessness and waste.
senses.definition: the trait of wasting resources
senses.definitionSentence: Waste is the trait of wasting resources.
senses.definitionZh: 浪费资源的特征。
senses.exampleZh: 一种以节俭和浪费为特征的生活。

senses.example: Much of the waste material is carried off in the sewers.
senses.definition: any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted
senses.definitionSentence: Waste means any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted.
senses.definitionZh: 任何未使用并被视为无价值或不需要的材料。
senses.exampleZh: 大部分废物被带入下水道。

senses.example: He wasted his inheritance on his insincere friends.
senses.definition: spend thoughtlessly; throw away
senses.definitionSentence: To waste means to spend thoughtlessly; throw away.
senses.definitionZh: 不加思索地花费；丢弃。
senses.exampleZh: 他把他的遗产浪费在了不真诚的朋友身上。

senses.example: Scotty's father sat sprawled in his chair, angular, alert as a cricket, looking about at the huge stainless-steel appointments of the room with an expression of proprietorship.
senses.definition: leaping insect; male makes chirping noises by rubbing the forewings together
senses.definitionSentence: Cricket means leaping insect; male makes chirping noises by rubbing the forewings together.
senses.definitionZh: 跳跃的昆虫；雄性通过摩擦前翅发出鸣叫声。
senses.exampleZh: 斯科蒂的父亲四肢摊开地坐在椅子上，棱角分明，像蟋蟀一样警觉，带着一种主人的表情环顾着房间里巨大的不锈钢设备。

senses.example: The minister is not preaching this Sunday.
senses.definition: deliver a sermon
senses.definitionSentence: To preach means to deliver a sermon.
senses.definitionZh: 发表布道。
senses.exampleZh: 牧师这周日不讲道。

senses.example: Liz Peabody, he thought, might spend some time grieving for her lost lover, but he doubted that she would launch an investigation.
senses.definition: feel grief
senses.definitionSentence: To grieve means to feel grief.
senses.definitionZh: 感到悲伤。
senses.exampleZh: 他认为莉兹·皮博迪可能会花一些时间为她失去的爱人哀悼，但他怀疑她是否会展开调查。

senses.example: Recently many doctors have installed ultrasonic vibration machines for deep massage of bruises, contusions, and simple bursitis.
senses.definition: an injury that doesn't break the skin but results in some discoloration
senses.definitionSentence: Bruise is an injury that doesn't break the skin but results in some discoloration.
senses.definitionZh: 一种不会破坏皮肤但会导致一些变色的伤害。
senses.exampleZh: 最近很多医生安装了超声波振动机，对跌打损伤、挫伤、单纯性滑囊炎等进行深度按摩。

senses.example: This remark really bruised my ego.
senses.definition: hurt the feelings of
senses.definitionSentence: To bruise means to hurt the feelings of.
senses.definitionZh: 伤害感情。
senses.exampleZh: 这句话确实伤害了我的自尊。

senses.example: Another field had given him fame enough to satisfy any egotist.
senses.definition: the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed
senses.definitionSentence: Fame is the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed.
senses.definitionZh: 受到广泛荣誉和赞誉的状态或品质。
senses.exampleZh: 另一个领域给了他足够的名气，足以满足任何自负者的要求。

senses.example: It places terrific tension on the leg muscles from start to finish of each repetition.
senses.definition: extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as terrific is extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项所描述的事物是非常好的或伟大的；特别用作增强剂。
senses.exampleZh: 从每次重复的开始到结束，它都会给腿部肌肉带来极大的张力。

senses.example: Root and stem tumors from sweet clover plants infected with WTV were quick-frozen in liquid nitrogen, embedded in ice, and cut at 3 - 6 | m in a cryostat maintained at - 16 ` to - 20 `.
senses.definition: fix or set securely or deeply
senses.definitionSentence: To embed means to fix or set securely or deeply.
senses.definitionZh: 牢固或深入地固定或设置。
senses.exampleZh: 将感染 WTV 的甜三叶草植物的根和茎肿瘤在液氮中快速冷冻，包埋在冰中，并在 3 - 6 ℃切割 | m在低温恒温器中保持在-16`至-20`。

senses.example: Nowadays, most bank customers transfer money online instead of visiting a branch.
senses.definition: at the present time, especially when contrasted with the past
senses.definitionSentence: Nowadays means at the present time, especially when contrasted with the past.
senses.definitionZh: “现今、现在”，尤其用于把当前时期与过去相对照。
senses.exampleZh: 如今，大多数银行客户在线转账而不是前往分行。

senses.example: Certainly external forces should not be applied arbitrarily out of mere power available to do so.
senses.definition: happening or arising or located outside or beyond some limits or especially surface
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as external is happening or arising or located outside or beyond some limits or especially surface.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为外部的事物正在发生或出现或位于某些限制之外或特别是表面之外。
senses.exampleZh: 当然，不应仅凭可用的力量任意施加外力。

senses.example: News of the discovery caused a sudden surge in demand, doubling orders within a single afternoon.
senses.definition: a sudden or abrupt strong increase
senses.definitionSentence: Surge is a sudden or abrupt strong increase.
senses.definitionZh: 突然或突然的强烈增加。
senses.exampleZh: 这一发现的消息导致需求突然激增，订单在一个下午就翻了一番。

senses.example: Because of this diversionary attack the main group that had been pinned down on the hill was able to surge forward again.
senses.definition: rise and move, as in waves or billows
senses.definitionSentence: To surge means to rise and move, as in waves or billows.
senses.definitionZh: 上升和移动，如波浪或巨浪。
senses.exampleZh: 由于这次牵制攻击，被困在山上的主力部队得以再次向前推进。

senses.example: The basic problem involved is that a college setting up a graduate school must have an entirely separate faculty for the advanced degree.
senses.definition: the body of teachers and administrators at a school
senses.definitionSentence: Faculty is the body of teachers and administrators at a school.
senses.definitionZh: 学校教师和管理人员的团体。
senses.exampleZh: 涉及的基本问题是，设立研究生院的大学必须拥有完全独立的高级学位师资队伍。

senses.example: With China attacking Formosa and the North Koreans and North Vietnamese liberating the southern half of their respective countries.
senses.definition: give equal rights to; of women and minorities
senses.definitionSentence: To liberate means to give equal rights to; of women and minorities.
senses.definitionZh: 给予平等权利；妇女和少数民族。
senses.exampleZh: 随着中国攻击台湾，朝鲜和北越解放了各自国家的南半部。

senses.example: Both men and women of twenty-one years of age could register and vote upon presenting proof of residence and identification.
senses.definition: enroll to vote
senses.definitionSentence: To register means to enroll to vote.
senses.definitionZh: 登记投票。
senses.exampleZh: 年满二十一岁的男性和女性均可凭居住证明和身份证明进行登记和投票。

senses.example: The clerk registered each birth in the official record before issuing a certificate.
senses.definition: record in writing; enter into a book of names or events or transactions
senses.definitionSentence: To register means to record in writing; enter into a book of names or events or transactions.
senses.definitionZh: 以书面形式记录；进入一本姓名、事件或交易的簿子。
senses.exampleZh: 办事员先把每名新生儿登记在官方记录中，再签发出生证明。

senses.example: They visited the shipyards at Brest and Pierre had to sign the register, vouching for the integrity of the visiting foreigner.
senses.definition: an official written record of names or events or transactions
senses.definitionSentence: Register is an official written record of names or events or transactions.
senses.definitionZh: 姓名、事件或交易的正式书面记录。
senses.exampleZh: 他们参观了布雷斯特的造船厂，皮埃尔必须在登记册上签字，以保证来访外国人的诚实。

senses.example: Every guest wrote a name and arrival time in the hotel register.
senses.definition: a book in which names and transactions are listed
senses.definitionSentence: Register is a book in which names and transactions are listed.
senses.definitionZh: 一本列出姓名和交易的簿子。
senses.exampleZh: 每位客人都在酒店登记册上写下了姓名和抵达时间。

senses.example: She wanted to be with him, to give him the comfort and companionship she knew he needed.
senses.definition: the act of consoling; giving relief in affliction
senses.definitionSentence: Comfort is the act of consoling; giving relief in affliction.
senses.definitionZh: 安慰的行为；在苦难中给予救济。
senses.exampleZh: 她想和他在一起，给他她知道他需要的安慰和陪伴。

senses.example: Everything was orderly and it seemed to be arranged for the workman's comfort, convenience and efficiency.
senses.definition: a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain
senses.definitionSentence: Comfort is a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain.
senses.definitionZh: 一种放松、感觉不到疼痛的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 一切都井然有序，似乎是为了工人的舒适、方便和高效而安排的。

senses.example: Continuing glibly in this vein, he paused to comfort her:.
senses.definition: give moral or emotional strength to
senses.definitionSentence: To comfort means to give moral or emotional strength to.
senses.definitionZh: 给予道德或情感力量。
senses.exampleZh: 他继续以这种方式流畅地说，停下来安慰她：。

senses.example: War changed her fate from a quiet village life to years of exile in a foreign country.
senses.definition: your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)
senses.definitionSentence: Fate means your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you).
senses.definitionZh: 你一生中的整体情况或状况（包括发生在你身上的一切）。
senses.exampleZh: 战争改变了她的命运，从平静的乡村生活变成了在异国他乡多年的流放。

senses.example: The market for software is expected to expand.
senses.definition: (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory
senses.definitionSentence: Software means (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory.
senses.definitionZh: （计算机科学）编写的程序或过程或规则以及与计算机系统操作有关且存储在读/写存储器中的相关文档。
senses.exampleZh: 软件市场预计将扩大。

senses.example: My son is farming in California.
senses.definition: be a farmer; work as a farmer
senses.definitionSentence: To farm means to be a farmer; work as a farmer.
senses.definitionZh: 成为农民；当农民。
senses.exampleZh: 我儿子在加利福尼亚务农。

senses.example: It takes several people to work the farm.
senses.definition: workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit
senses.definitionSentence: Farm means workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit.
senses.definitionZh: 以农场建筑物和耕地为单位组成的工作场所。
senses.exampleZh: 农场需要几个人干活。

senses.example: `` Before then, my sales during much of the year had lagged behind 1960 by 20% '', he says.
senses.definition: hang (back) or fall (behind) in movement, progress, development, etc.
senses.definitionSentence: To lag means to hang (back) or fall (behind) in movement, progress, development, etc.
senses.definitionZh: 在运动、进步、发展等方面悬而未决（向后）或落后（落后）。
senses.exampleZh: “在此之前，我的销售额在一年中的大部分时间都比 1960 年落后了 20%”，他说。

senses.example: The laboratory kept the temperature constant at twenty degrees throughout the experiment.
senses.definition: unvarying in nature
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as constant is unvarying in nature.
senses.definitionZh: 在性质、数值或状态上保持不变。
senses.exampleZh: 实验室在整个实验期间把温度恒定在二十摄氏度。

senses.example: The velocity of light is a constant.
senses.definition: a number representing a quantity assumed to have a fixed value in a specified mathematical context
senses.definitionSentence: Constant is a number representing a quantity assumed to have a fixed value in a specified mathematical context.
senses.definitionZh: 一个数字，表示在指定的数学上下文中假定具有固定值的数量。
senses.exampleZh: 光速是一个常数。

senses.example: The constant hum of machinery continued day and night without interruption.
senses.definition: uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as constant is uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为恒定的东西在时间上不间断并且无限期地持续。
senses.exampleZh: 机器的持续嗡嗡声昼夜不停地持续着。

senses.example: A man constant in adherence to his ideals.
senses.definition: steadfast in purpose or devotion or affection
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as constant is steadfast in purpose or devotion or affection.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为恒定的事物是指坚定不移的目标、奉献或感情。
senses.exampleZh: 一个始终坚持自己理想的人。

senses.example: If the check is not good and the April 15 or other due date deadline elapses, additions to the tax may be incurred.
senses.definition: the month following March and preceding May
senses.definitionSentence: April is the month following March and preceding May.
senses.definitionZh: 三月之后五月之前的月份。
senses.exampleZh: 如果支票不合格且 4 月 15 日或其他截止日期已过，则可能会产生额外税费。

senses.example: The amiable host greeted every visitor warmly and made strangers feel immediately welcome.
senses.definition: diffusing warmth and friendliness
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as amiable is diffusing warmth and friendliness.
senses.definitionZh: 和蔼可亲是指散发温暖和友善。
senses.exampleZh: 和蔼可亲的主人热情地迎接每一位访客，让陌生人立刻感受到宾至如归的感觉。

senses.meaning: 值得做的，值得花时间的
senses.example: Calcium, phosphorus and iron are present in worthwhile amounts, and eleven other minerals also have been found in varying trace amounts.
senses.definition: sufficiently valuable to justify the investment of time or interest
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as worthwhile is sufficiently valuable to justify the investment of time or interest.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为有价值的东西足以证明时间或兴趣的投资是合理的。
senses.exampleZh: 钙、磷和铁的含量相当丰富，还发现了不同微量的其他 11 种矿物质。

senses.example: He just shot at the board and then drew circles around the holes to form a bull's-eye.
senses.definition: fire a shot
senses.definitionSentence: To shoot means to fire a shot.
senses.definitionZh: 开枪。
senses.exampleZh: 他只是向木板射击，然后在孔周围画圆圈以形成靶心。

senses.example: After the spring rain, the pruned rosebush shot fresh buds and branches from its bare stems.
senses.definition: produce buds, branches, or germinate
senses.definitionSentence: To shoot means to produce buds, branches, or germinate.
senses.definitionZh: 产生芽、枝条或发芽。
senses.exampleZh: 春雨过后，修剪过的蔷薇从光秃秃的茎上抽出了新鲜的芽和枝条。

senses.meaning: 实质上的，实际上的，事实上的
senses.example: The once elegant temple lay in virtual ruin.
senses.definition: being actually such in almost every respect
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as virtual is being actually such in almost every respect.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为虚拟的东西实际上在几乎所有方面都是如此。
senses.exampleZh: 这座曾经优雅的寺庙实际上已成为废墟。

senses.example: Certainly, one of the best ways of warning the world against anti-Semitism is to demonstrate its workings as a dangerous weapon.
senses.definition: involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dangerous is involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为危险的事物涉及或导致危险或风险；容易受到伤害或伤害。
senses.exampleZh: 当然，警告世界反对反犹太主义的最佳方式之一就是展示其作为危险武器的作用。

senses.example: His legs suddenly feel heavy and unaccountably weary, as if he had walked for miles, instead of strolling a few hundred yards along the old campus paths.
senses.definition: walk leisurely and with no apparent aim
senses.definitionSentence: To stroll means to walk leisurely and with no apparent aim.
senses.definitionZh: 悠闲地行走，没有明显的目标。
senses.exampleZh: 他的双腿突然感到沉重和莫名其妙的疲倦，就好像他已经走了几英里，而不是沿着旧校园小路漫步了几百码。

senses.example: Signals received from the depths of space.
senses.definition: (usually plural) the deepest and most remote part
senses.definitionSentence: Depth means (usually plural) the deepest and most remote part.
senses.definitionZh: （通常是复数）最深和最远的部分。
senses.exampleZh: 从太空深处接收到的信号。

senses.example: We should discourage this practice among our youth.
senses.definition: try to prevent; show opposition to
senses.definitionSentence: To discourage means to try to prevent; show opposition to.
senses.definitionZh: 试图阻止；表示反对。
senses.exampleZh: 我们应该劝阻年轻人这种做法。

senses.example: He seemed very pleased with himself, as though some intricate scheme was working out exactly as he had planned.
senses.definition: having many complexly arranged elements; elaborate
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as intricate is having many complexly arranged elements; elaborate.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为复杂的事物是指具有许多复杂排列的元素；精心制作的。
senses.exampleZh: 他似乎对自己非常满意，就好像某个复杂的计划正在完全按照他的计划进行。

senses.meaning: 严格的，要求严守规则的
senses.example: Russia's young gymnasts have studied dance before having the rigorous training on apparatus.
senses.definition: demanding strict attention to rules and procedures
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as rigorous is demanding strict attention to rules and procedures.
senses.definitionZh: 严格是指要求严格遵守规则和程序。
senses.exampleZh: 俄罗斯年轻体操运动员在接受严格的器械训练之前先学习了舞蹈。

senses.example: A nice bachelor apartment in a place called the Lancaster Arms ''.
senses.definition: a man who has never been married
senses.definitionSentence: Bachelor is a man who has never been married.
senses.definitionZh: 从未结过婚的男人。
senses.exampleZh: 一套漂亮的单身公寓，位于一个名为 Lancaster Arms 的地方。

senses.example: We taxied from the airport to the hotel and paid the driver at the entrance.
senses.definition: ride in a taxicab
senses.definitionSentence: To taxi means to ride in a taxicab.
senses.definitionZh: 乘坐出租车。
senses.exampleZh: 我们从机场打车到酒店，在入口处给司机付​​了钱。

senses.example: The plane taxied down the runway.
senses.definition: travel slowly
senses.definitionSentence: To taxi means to travel slowly.
senses.definitionZh: 缓慢行驶。
senses.exampleZh: 飞机沿着跑道滑行。

senses.example: Then they took a taxi to Trastevere.
senses.definition: a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
senses.definitionSentence: Taxi is a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money.
senses.definitionZh: 由一个人驾驶的汽车，其工作是将乘客带到他们想去的地方以换取金钱。
senses.exampleZh: 然后他们乘坐出租车前往特拉斯提弗列。

senses.example: Thus, the larvae of the intruder can develop at the expense of the rightful inhabitants and the store of beebread.
senses.definition: a person who inhabits a particular place
senses.definitionSentence: Inhabitant is a person who inhabits a particular place.

senses.definitionSentence: Shampoo is the act of washing your hair with shampoo.

senses.definitionSentence: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.

senses.definition: an ornament or utensil made of brass
senses.definitionSentence: Brass is an ornament or utensil made of brass.
senses.definitionZh: 由黄铜制成的装饰品或器皿。
senses.exampleZh: 架子上陈列着抛光黄铜，如烛台、碗和装饰盘。

senses.definitionSentence: Something described as raw is (used especially of commodities) being unprocessed or manufactured using only simple or minimal processes.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为原始的东西（特别是商品）未经加工或仅使用简单或最少的过程制造。

senses.example: Could he honestly believe it would be good for Carla to have those old prophets gripping her imagination now?
senses.definition: someone who speaks by divine inspiration; someone who is an interpreter of the will of God
senses.definitionSentence: Prophet means someone who speaks by divine inspiration; someone who is an interpreter of the will of God.
senses.definitionZh: 通过神圣灵感说话的人；上帝旨意的解释者。

senses.example: She rapped lightly on the window three times to attract the driver's attention.
senses.definition: make light, repeated taps on a surface
senses.definitionSentence: To rap means to make light, repeated taps on a surface.
senses.definitionZh: 在表面上轻轻地、重复地敲击。

senses.example: A gentle rap on the office door announced that a visitor was waiting outside.

senses.example: Conchita kept an eye on the twins and little Elena, trying to keep them from falling into the creek by which they persisted in playing.

senses.definitionZh: 同一次怀孕同时出生的两个后代中的任何一个。
senses.exampleZh: 孔奇塔一直注视着双胞胎和小埃琳娜，试图防止他们掉进他们坚持玩耍的小溪里。

senses.example: The ruthless commander ordered the village destroyed without mercy for its innocent residents.
senses.definition: without mercy or pity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as ruthless is without mercy or pity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为无情的事物是没有怜悯或怜悯的。

senses.example: Will his words come to be treasured and quoted through the years?
senses.definition: hold dear
senses.definitionSentence: To treasure means to hold dear.
senses.definitionZh: 珍惜。

senses.definitionZh: 向另一方付款的义务。
senses.exampleZh: 未偿还的银行贷款显示为公司必须偿还的负债。

senses.example: In his haste to leave he forgot his book.
senses.definition: the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
senses.definitionSentence: Haste is the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner.
senses.definitionZh: 匆忙且粗心地行动的行为。
senses.exampleZh: 在匆忙离开时，他忘记了他的书。

senses.example: He felt a kind of religious zeal.
senses.definition: a feeling of strong eagerness (usually in favor of a person or cause)
senses.definitionSentence: Zeal is a feeling of strong eagerness (usually in favor of a person or cause).
senses.definitionZh: 一种强烈渴望的感觉（通常支持某个人或事业）。
senses.exampleZh: 他感受到了一种宗教热情。

senses.example: It would have been easy to identify as opium by its odor.
senses.definition: any property detected by the olfactory system
senses.definitionSentence: Odor means any property detected by the olfactory system.
senses.definitionZh: 嗅觉系统检测到的任何特性。
senses.exampleZh: 通过气味很容易识别出鸦片。

senses.example: The parallel bars, horse, buck, springboard, horizontal bar, rings, and mats formerly in the school gyms were replaced by baseball, volleyball, basketball and football.
senses.definition: a game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands
senses.definitionSentence: Volleyball is a game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands.
senses.definitionZh: 一项两队用手将充气球击过高网的运动。
senses.exampleZh: 学校体育馆原来的双杠、马、巴克、跳板、单杠、吊环、垫子被棒球、排球、篮球、足球取代。

senses.example: The judge entered the courtroom wearing a long black ceremonial robe.
senses.definition: outerwear consisting of a long flowing garment used for official or ceremonial occasions
senses.definitionSentence: Robe means outerwear consisting of a long flowing garment used for official or ceremonial occasions.
senses.definitionZh: 由用于官方或仪式场合的长而飘逸的服装组成的外衣。
senses.exampleZh: 法官穿着黑色长袍进入法庭。

senses.example: He was freshly shaved, and if there had been any alcohol in him we could never have missed detecting some scent of it on the massive gusts of his laughter.
senses.definition: any property detected by the olfactory system
senses.definitionSentence: Scent means any property detected by the olfactory system.
senses.definitionZh: 嗅觉系统检测到的任何特性。
senses.exampleZh: 他刚刮完胡子，如果他体内有酒精的话，我们绝不会错过在他大笑时闻到的一些酒精气味。

senses.example: The hound scented the missing child on a jacket and followed the smell into the woods.
senses.definition: catch the scent of; get wind of
senses.definitionSentence: To scent means to catch the scent of; get wind of.
senses.definitionZh: 捕捉到气味；得到风声。
senses.exampleZh: 猎犬在夹克上闻到了失踪孩子的气味，然后循着气味进入了树林。

senses.example: Al's Little Cafe was small, dark, narrow, and filled with the mingled scent of beer, tobacco smoke, and Italian cooking.
senses.definition: a distinctive odor that is pleasant
senses.definitionSentence: Scent is a distinctive odor that is pleasant.
senses.definitionZh: 一种令人愉悦的独特气味。
senses.exampleZh: 艾尔的小咖啡馆又小又黑又窄，充满了啤酒、烟草烟雾和意大利烹饪的混合香味。

senses.example: The burglars robbed him of all his money.
senses.definition: take something away by force or without the consent of the owner
senses.definitionSentence: To rob means to take something away by force or without the consent of the owner.
senses.definitionZh: 强行或未经所有者同意而拿走某物。
senses.exampleZh: 窃贼抢走了他所有的钱。

senses.example: The surveyor measured the boundary as ten rods, with each rod equal to sixteen and a half feet.
senses.definition: a linear measure of 16.5 feet
senses.definitionSentence: Rod is a linear measure of 16.5 feet.
senses.definitionZh: 16.5 英尺的线性尺寸。
senses.exampleZh: 测量员将边界测量为十根杆，每根杆等于十六英尺半。

senses.example: The artisan weaves wool threads over and under one another to make cloth.
senses.definition: create a piece of cloth by interlacing strands of fabric, such as wool or cotton
senses.definitionSentence: To weave means to create a piece of cloth by interlacing strands of fabric, such as wool or cotton.
senses.definitionZh: 通过交织织物（例如羊毛或棉）来制作一块布。
senses.exampleZh: 工匠将羊毛线相互编织以制作布料。

senses.example: Nothing broken that can n't be mended ''.
senses.definition: restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
senses.definitionSentence: To mend means to restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken.
senses.definitionZh: 通过更换零件或将撕裂或损坏的部件组装起来来恢复。
senses.exampleZh: 没有什么坏了不能修补的''。

senses.definitionSentence: A deep, prolonged, and very loud sound.
senses.definitionZh: 低沉、持续而非常响亮的声音。
senses.example: The roar of the jet engines drowned out every conversation near the runway.
senses.exampleZh: 喷气发动机的轰鸣声淹没了跑道附近的所有交谈。
senses.definition: A deep, prolonged, and very loud sound.

senses.example: "desperadoes from the hills regularly roared in to take over the town"-R.A.Billington.
senses.definition: act or proceed in a riotous, turbulent, or disorderly way
senses.definitionSentence: To roar means to act or proceed in a riotous, turbulent, or disorderly way.
senses.definitionZh: 以暴乱、骚乱或无序的方式行动或进行。
senses.exampleZh: “山上的亡命之徒经常咆哮着占领小镇”-R.A.Billington。

senses.example: `` Hell, yes '', I roared back between dusty lips.
senses.definition: make a loud noise, as of animal
senses.definitionSentence: To roar means to make a loud noise, as of animal.
senses.definitionZh: 发出巨大的声音，如动物发出的声音。
senses.exampleZh: “天哪，是的”，我在布满灰尘的嘴唇之间咆哮着。

senses.example: How efficient and necessary are your intra company vehicles?
senses.definition: a conveyance that transports people or objects
senses.definitionSentence: Vehicle is a conveyance that transports people or objects.
senses.definitionZh: 运送人或物体的交通工具。
senses.exampleZh: 您的公司内部车辆的效率和必要性如何？

senses.example: When something unexpected happened, one always asked for water if one were a woman, brandy if one were a man.
senses.definition: distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice
senses.definitionSentence: Brandy means distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice.
senses.definitionZh: 从葡萄酒或发酵果汁中蒸馏出来的。
senses.exampleZh: 当发生意外的事情时，如果是女人，总是要水，如果是男人，总是要白兰地。

senses.example: But the closing aircraft showed no sign of deviating from their original course.
senses.definition: turn aside; turn away from
senses.definitionSentence: To deviate means to turn aside; turn away from.
senses.definitionZh: 转向；转身离开。
senses.exampleZh: 但接近的飞机没有显示出偏离原来航线的迹象。

senses.example: `` Yes, it sounds great '', I said, `` but suppose you do n't think of yourself as an impressionist painter ''?
senses.definition: an artist who paints
senses.definitionSentence: Painter is an artist who paints.
senses.definitionZh: 绘画的艺术家。
senses.exampleZh: ``是的，听起来很棒''，我说，``但是假设你不认为自己是印象派画家''？

senses.example: Publicity accounted for 1.1 per cent of the initial contacts with new members.
senses.definition: a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution
senses.definitionSentence: Publicity is a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution.
senses.definitionZh: 代表某些产品、事业、想法、个人或机构发布的消息。
senses.exampleZh: 宣传占与新成员初次接触的 1.1%。

senses.example: `` All you have to do is ask '', he retorted hopefully.
senses.definition: answer back
senses.definitionSentence: To retort means to answer back.
senses.definitionZh: 回答。
senses.exampleZh: “你所要做的就是问”，他满怀希望地反驳道。

senses.example: When told she was too young to lead, she replied with the sharp retort, 'Then why do you keep asking me to solve your problems?'
senses.definition: a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)
senses.definitionSentence: Retort is a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one).
senses.definitionZh: 对问题或评论的快速回复（尤其是诙谐或批评的）。
senses.exampleZh: 当被告知她还太年轻，无法领导时，她尖锐地反驳道：“那你为什么一直要求我解决你的问题？”

senses.example: In the sermon, unrepentant souls were warned of punishment in hell after death.
senses.definition: (religion) the world of the dead
senses.definitionSentence: Hell means (religion) the world of the dead.
senses.definitionZh: （宗教）死者的世界。
senses.exampleZh: 在布道中，不悔改的灵魂被警告死后将在地狱受到惩罚。

senses.meaning: 见鬼，该死（表示惊讶或恼怒）
senses.example: What the hell happened to the files on this computer?
senses.exampleZh: 见鬼！这台电脑里的文件到底怎么了？
senses.definitionSentence: Hell, damn (expressing surprise or annoyance).
senses.definitionZh: 地狱，该死（表达惊讶或烦恼）。

senses.example: The landlady owns the apartment building and collects rent from its tenants.
senses.definition: a landlord who is a woman
senses.definitionSentence: Landlady is a landlord who is a woman.
senses.definitionZh: 一位女性房东。
senses.exampleZh: 女房东拥有公寓楼并向租户收取租金。

senses.example: It was nine o ' clock in the morning: the hour which, like a spade turning clods of earth, exposed to the day a myriad of busy creatures that had lain dormant in the quiet night.
senses.definition: a sturdy hand shovel that can be pushed into the earth with the foot
senses.definitionSentence: Spade is a sturdy hand shovel that can be pushed into the earth with the foot.
senses.definitionZh: 一把坚固的手铲，可以用脚将其推入泥土中。
senses.exampleZh: 那是早上九点：这个时刻，就像一把铲子翻动土块，让无数在静夜中休眠的忙碌生物暴露在白昼之下。

senses.example: The Catholics had the largest cemetery, near the Neversink River where Main Street ran south; Stevie whistled when he passed these alien grounds.
senses.definition: being or from or characteristic of another place or part of the world
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as alien is being or from or characteristic of another place or part of the world.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为外星人的东西是来自世界另一个地方或世界的另一个地方或世界的另一个地方或部分的特征。
senses.exampleZh: 天主教徒拥有最大的墓地，靠近涅沃辛克河，主街向南延伸；当史蒂夫经过这些陌生的土地时，他吹起了口哨。

senses.example: If you are a nonresident alien and a resident of Puerto Rico, your return is also due June 15, 1962, or the 15 th day of the 6 th month after the close of your fiscal year.
senses.definition: a person who comes from a foreign country; someone who does not owe allegiance to your country
senses.definitionSentence: Alien is a person who comes from a foreign country; someone who does not owe allegiance to your country.
senses.definitionZh: 来自外国的人；不效忠于你的国家的人。
senses.exampleZh: 如果您是非居民外国人且是波多黎各居民，您的纳税申报表也应于 1962 年 6 月 15 日或您的财政年度结束后第 6 个月的 15 天提交。

senses.example: The science-fiction film follows an alien that arrives on Earth from a distant planet.
senses.definition: a form of life assumed to exist outside the Earth or its atmosphere
senses.definitionSentence: Alien is a form of life assumed to exist outside the Earth or its atmosphere.
senses.definitionZh: 一种假定存在于地球或其大气层之外的生命形式。
senses.exampleZh: 这部科幻电影讲述了一个外星人从遥远的星球来到地球的故事。

senses.example: The will aliened the property to the heirs.
senses.definition: transfer property or ownership
senses.definitionSentence: To alien means to transfer property or ownership.
senses.definitionZh: 转让财产或所有权。
senses.exampleZh: 遗嘱将财产转让给继承人。

senses.example: The whale surfaced to breathe through the blowhole on top of its head.
senses.definition: any of the larger cetacean mammals having a streamlined body and breathing through a blowhole on the head
senses.definitionSentence: Whale means any of the larger cetacean mammals having a streamlined body and breathing through a blowhole on the head.
senses.definitionZh: 任何较大的鲸类哺乳动物，具有流线型身体并通过头部的气孔呼吸。
senses.exampleZh: 鲸鱼浮出水面，通过头顶的气孔呼吸。

senses.example: We gave them a set of dishes for a wedding present.
senses.definition: a piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food
senses.definitionSentence: Dish is a piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food.
senses.definitionZh: 一种餐具，通常用作盛放或盛放食物的容器。
senses.exampleZh: 我们送给他们一套餐具作为结婚礼物。

senses.example: The house was a mess.
senses.definition: a state of confusion and disorderliness
senses.definitionSentence: Mess is a state of confusion and disorderliness.
senses.definitionZh: 一种混乱和无序的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 房子一片狼藉。

senses.example: They caught Trig stealing liquor from the officers ' mess, and he got a couple of girls in trouble.
senses.definition: a (large) military dining room where service personnel eat or relax
senses.definitionSentence: Mess is a (large) military dining room where service personnel eat or relax.
senses.definitionZh: 一个（大型）军事餐厅，军人可在此用餐或放松。
senses.exampleZh: 他们抓到特里格从军官食堂偷酒，他给几个女孩带来了麻烦。

senses.example: The failed investment left the family in a financial mess with debts they could not repay.
senses.definition: informal terms for a difficult situation
senses.definitionSentence: Mess means informal terms for a difficult situation.
senses.definitionZh: 表示困难情况的非正式术语。
senses.exampleZh: 失败的投资使家庭陷入财务困境，无法偿还债务。

senses.example: Innumerable stars filled the clear desert sky, far too many for us to count.
senses.definition: too numerous to be counted
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as innumerable is too numerous to be counted.
senses.definitionZh: 形容为无数的东西多得难以计数。
senses.exampleZh: 晴朗的沙漠天空布满了无数的星星，多得我们数不过来。

senses.example: The athlete threw the flat circular disc across the field during practice.
senses.definition: a flat circular plate
senses.definitionSentence: Disc is a flat circular plate.
senses.definitionZh: 该义项在此处指“圆盘”，即扁平的圆形物体。
senses.exampleZh: 运动员在练习期间将扁平圆盘扔过场地。

senses.example: The computer reads magnetic information stored on the flat surface of the disc.
senses.definition: (computer science) a memory device consisting of a flat disk covered with a magnetic coating on which information is stored
senses.definitionSentence: Disc means (computer science) a memory device consisting of a flat disk covered with a magnetic coating on which information is stored.
senses.definitionZh: （计算机科学）一种存储设备，由覆盖有磁性涂层的平坦磁盘组成，上面存储信息。
senses.exampleZh: 计算机读取存储在磁盘平坦表面上的磁性信息。

senses.example: David finished shaving, washed his face clean of lather, and combed and retied his hair.
senses.definition: remove body hair with a razor
senses.definitionSentence: To shave means to remove body hair with a razor.
senses.definitionZh: 用剃刀去除体毛。
senses.exampleZh: David 刮完胡子，洗干净脸上的泡沫，梳理并重新扎起头发。

senses.example: Wrap the baby before taking her out.
senses.definition: arrange or fold as a cover or protection
senses.definitionSentence: To wrap means to arrange or fold as a cover or protection.
senses.definitionZh: 布置或折叠作为覆盖或保护。
senses.exampleZh: 在带宝宝出去之前将她包裹起来。

senses.example: They lay on his lap, palms up, stiffly motionless, the tapered fingers a little thick at the joints.
senses.definition: (anatomy) the point of connection between two bones or elements of a skeleton (especially if it allows motion)
senses.definitionSentence: Joint means (anatomy) the point of connection between two bones or elements of a skeleton (especially if it allows motion).
senses.definitionZh: （解剖学）两个骨骼或骨架元素之间的连接点（特别是如果它允许运动）。
senses.exampleZh: 他们躺在他的腿上，手掌朝上，僵硬地一动不动，锥形的手指在关节处有点粗。

senses.example: Sealant was applied around the joint where the two water pipes connect.
senses.definition: junction by which parts or objects are joined together
senses.definitionSentence: Joint means junction by which parts or objects are joined together.
senses.definitionZh: 将部件或物体连接在一起的连接点。
senses.exampleZh: 在两根水管连接处的接头周围涂抹了密封剂。

senses.example: The two chambers held a joint session in which members of both met and voted together.
senses.definition: united or combined
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as joint is united or combined.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为联合的事物是联合或组合的。
senses.exampleZh: 两院举行联席会议，两院议员共同开会并投票。

senses.example: The carpenter jointed two pieces of wood.
senses.definition: provide with a joint
senses.definitionSentence: To joint means to provide with a joint.
senses.definitionZh: 提供接合。
senses.exampleZh: 木匠连接了两块木头。

senses.example: The carpenter jointed the boards so their fitted edges locked firmly together.
senses.definition: fit as if by joints
senses.definitionSentence: To joint means to fit as if by joints.
senses.definitionZh: 像通过连接一样配合。
senses.exampleZh: 木匠将木板连接起来，使它们的安装边缘牢固地锁定在一起。

senses.meaning: 令人兴奋的，使人激动的
senses.example: An exciting account of her trip.
senses.definition: creating or arousing excitement
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as exciting is creating or arousing excitement.
senses.definitionZh: 令人兴奋的事物是指创造或引起兴奋。
senses.exampleZh: 对她的旅行的激动人心的描述。

senses.example: The oak's thick trunk supports its branches and is covered with rough bark.
senses.definition: the main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber
senses.definitionSentence: Trunk is the main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber.
senses.definitionZh: 树的主干；通常覆盖有树皮；树干通常是木材的商业用途部分。
senses.exampleZh: 橡树粗壮的树干支撑着它的树枝，并覆盖着粗糙的树皮。

senses.example: The protective vest covers the trunk of the body but leaves the head, neck, arms, and legs exposed.
senses.definition: the body excluding the head and neck and limbs
senses.definitionSentence: Trunk is the body excluding the head and neck and limbs.
senses.definitionZh: 不包括头部、颈部和四肢的身体。
senses.exampleZh: 防护背心覆盖身体躯干，但头部、颈部、手臂和腿部暴露在外。

senses.example: The elephant used its flexible trunk to lift water and spray its back.
senses.definition: a long flexible snout as of an elephant
senses.definitionSentence: Trunk is a long flexible snout as of an elephant.
senses.definitionZh: 一个长而灵活的鼻子，就像大象一样。
senses.exampleZh: 大象利用其灵活的鼻子举起水并喷洒背部。

senses.example: He put his golf bag in the trunk.
senses.definition: compartment in an automobile that carries luggage or shopping or tools
senses.definitionSentence: Trunk means compartment in an automobile that carries luggage or shopping or tools.
senses.definitionZh: 汽车中携带行李或购物或工具的隔间。
senses.exampleZh: 他把高尔夫球包放在后备箱里。

senses.example: The car remained stationary with the engine running.
senses.definition: standing still
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as stationary is standing still.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为静止的东西是静止的。
senses.exampleZh: 汽车保持静止，发动机运转。

senses.example: The radioactivity of fallout decays rapidly at first.
senses.definition: lose a stored charge, magnetic flux, or current
senses.definitionSentence: To decay means to lose a stored charge, magnetic flux, or current.
senses.definitionZh: 失去存储的电荷、磁通量或电流。
senses.exampleZh: 沉降物的放射性首先迅速衰减。

senses.example: Without the decay of a sense of objective reference (except as the imitation of mystery), the stress on subjective invention would never have been stimulated into being.
senses.definition: the process of gradually becoming inferior
senses.definitionSentence: Decay is the process of gradually becoming inferior.
senses.definitionZh: 逐渐变得劣等的过程。
senses.exampleZh: 如果没有客观参考感的衰退（除了对神秘的模仿），对主观发明的强调永远不会被激发出来。

senses.example: Dead fledgling birds, their squashed looking nakedness and the odor of decay that clung to the hand when they had been buried in our graveyard in front of the purple flags.
senses.definition: the organic phenomenon of rotting
senses.definitionSentence: Decay is the organic phenomenon of rotting.
senses.definitionZh: 腐烂的有机现象。
senses.exampleZh: 死去的雏鸟，它们被压扁了，赤身裸体，当它们被埋在我们墓地紫色旗帜前时，手上残留着腐烂的气味。

senses.example: In chess, each player moves sixteen pieces and tries to checkmate the opposing king.
senses.definition: a board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules; the object is to checkmate the opponent's king
senses.definitionSentence: Chess is a board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules; the object is to checkmate the opponent's king.
senses.definitionZh: 一种棋盘游戏，两名玩家按照特定规则移动 16 个棋子；目标是将死对方的王。
senses.exampleZh: 在国际象棋中，每个玩家移动 16 个棋子并尝试将对方的国王。

senses.example: For many of these measurements the chest must be opened, but the blood vessels and the heart itself remain undisturbed.
senses.definition: the part of the human torso between the neck and the diaphragm or the corresponding part in other vertebrates
senses.definitionSentence: Chest is the part of the human torso between the neck and the diaphragm or the corresponding part in other vertebrates.

senses.definitionSentence: Clutch is a woman's strapless purse that is carried in the hand.
senses.definitionZh: 一款女士手提的无肩带钱包。
senses.exampleZh: 她将手机和口红放在一个小无肩带手拿包中。

senses.example: Still clutching the razor, Roberts came up into a crouch, shaking his head.
senses.definition: take hold of; grab
senses.definitionSentence: To clutch means to take hold of; grab.
senses.definitionZh: 抓住；抓住。
senses.exampleZh: 罗伯茨仍然抓着剃须刀，蹲下身子，摇着头。

senses.example: Cast fearful glances at the large dog.
senses.definition: timid by nature or revealing timidity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as fearful is timid by nature or revealing timidity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为害怕的事物本质上是胆怯的或表现出胆怯的。
senses.exampleZh: 向大狗投去恐惧的目光。

senses.example: The accent above the vowel shows which syllable receives stress.
senses.definition: a diacritical mark used to indicate stress or placed above a vowel to indicate a special pronunciation
senses.definitionSentence: Accent is a diacritical mark used to indicate stress or placed above a vowel to indicate a special pronunciation.

senses.exampleZh: 元音上方的重音显示哪个音节受到重音。

senses.example: The room was decorated in shades of grey with distinctive red accents.
senses.definition: special importance or significance
senses.definitionSentence: Accent means special importance or significance.
senses.definitionZh: 重音表示特殊重要性或意义。
senses.exampleZh: 房间以灰色色调装饰，并带有独特的红色点缀。

senses.example: The report accents the urgent need for clean water by placing it first among the relief priorities.
senses.definition: to stress, single out as important
senses.definitionSentence: Accent means to stress, single out as important.
senses.definitionZh: 强调，挑出同样重要。
senses.exampleZh: 该报告强调了对清洁水的迫切需求，将其列为救灾重点之一。

senses.example: The bride walked into the ceremony wearing her wedding dress.
senses.definition: a woman participant in her own marriage ceremony
senses.definitionSentence: Bride is a woman participant in her own marriage ceremony.
senses.definitionZh: 一位参加自己婚礼的女性。
senses.exampleZh: 新娘穿着婚纱走进仪式。

senses.example: Moist air produced reddish-brown rust across the exposed iron gate.
senses.definition: a red or brown oxide coating on iron or steel caused by the action of oxygen and moisture
senses.definitionSentence: Rust is a red or brown oxide coating on iron or steel caused by the action of oxygen and moisture.
senses.definitionZh: 铁或钢上因氧气和湿气的作用而形成的红色或棕色氧化物涂层。
senses.exampleZh: 潮湿的空气在裸露的铁门上产生红棕色的锈迹。

senses.example: Only authorized staff may read the confidential government report.
senses.definition: the level of official classification for documents next above restricted and below secret; available only to persons authorized to see documents so classified
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as confidential is the level of official classification for documents next above restricted and below secret; available only to persons authorized to see documents so classified.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓机密是指高于受限和低于秘密的文档的官方分类级别；仅可供有权查看此类机密文件的人员使用。
senses.exampleZh: 只有授权人员才能阅读机密政府报告。

senses.example: The strings were draped around flowers in tall silver bowls (page 261).
senses.definition: a round vessel that is open at the top; used chiefly for holding food or liquids
senses.definitionSentence: Bowl is a round vessel that is open at the top; used chiefly for holding food or liquids.
senses.definitionZh: 顶部开口的圆形容器；主要用于盛放食物或液体。
senses.exampleZh: 绳子挂在高银碗里的花朵周围（第 261 页）。

senses.example: The player rolled the weighted wooden bowl along a curved path toward the target ball.
senses.definition: a wooden ball (with flattened sides so that it rolls on a curved course) used in the game of lawn bowling
senses.definitionSentence: Bowl is a wooden ball (with flattened sides so that it rolls on a curved course) used in the game of lawn bowling.
senses.definitionZh: 一种用于草地保龄球比赛的木球（侧面扁平，以便在弯曲的球场上滚动）。
senses.exampleZh: 玩家将加重的木碗沿着弯曲的路径滚向目标球。

senses.example: The central bank tried to rein inflation by tightening control over the money supply.
senses.definition: control and direct with or as if by reins
senses.definitionSentence: To rein means to control and direct with or as if by reins.
senses.definitionZh: 用缰绳或仿佛用缰绳来控制和指挥。
senses.exampleZh: 央行试图通过加强对货币供应的控制来抑制通货膨胀。

senses.example: "influenced by ethnic and cultural ties"- J.F.Kennedy.
senses.definition: denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as ethnic is denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为民族的东西是指、源自或独特于一群人建立的生活方式。
senses.exampleZh: “受到种族和文化纽带的影响”- J.F.Kennedy。

senses.example: We had to punish the dog for soiling the floor again.
senses.definition: impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
senses.definitionSentence: To punish means to impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on.
senses.definitionZh: 施加惩罚；施加惩罚。
senses.exampleZh: 我们不得不惩罚这只狗，因为它再次弄脏了地板。

senses.example: The road begins a steep descent from the mountain pass down to the valley floor.
senses.definition: a downward slope or bend
senses.definitionSentence: Descent is a downward slope or bend.
senses.definitionZh: 向下的斜坡或弯曲。
