senses.definition: properties attributable to your ancestry
senses.definitionSentence: Descent means properties attributable to your ancestry.
senses.definitionZh: 归属于您的祖先的财产。
senses.exampleZh: 在他的父亲方面，他有德国血统，在他的母亲方面，他来自古老的瑞典贵族。

senses.example: At the climax of the infection, the patient's fever and breathing problems were most severe.
senses.definition: the most severe stage of a disease
senses.definitionSentence: Climax is the most severe stage of a disease.
senses.definitionZh: 疾病最严重的阶段。
senses.exampleZh: 在感染高峰期，患者的发烧和呼吸问题最为严重。

senses.example: They ate the cafeteria food with its orange sauces and Scotty gazed without interest at his food, the teachers, the heroic baronial windows, and the bright ranks of college banners.
senses.definition: flavorful relish or dressing or topping served as an accompaniment to food
senses.definitionSentence: Sauce means flavorful relish or dressing or topping served as an accompaniment to food.
senses.definitionZh: 作为食物佐料的美味佐料或调料或配料。
senses.exampleZh: 他们吃着自助餐厅的食物和橙汁，斯科蒂毫无兴趣地凝视着他的食物、老师、英勇的贵族窗户和明亮的大学横幅。

senses.example: Scientists identified organic remains in the rock from carbon-rich traces left by once-living organisms.
senses.definition: being or relating to or derived from or having properties characteristic of living organisms
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as organic is being or relating to or derived from or having properties characteristic of living organisms.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为有机的东西是存在于或与活的有机体相关、或源自于或具有活的有机体的特性特征。
senses.exampleZh: 科学家从曾经有生命的生物体留下的富含碳的痕迹中识别出岩石中的有机残留物。

senses.example: A beautiful outdoor setting for the wedding.
senses.definition: located, suited for, or taking place in the open air
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as outdoor is located, suited for, or taking place in the open air.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为户外的事物位于、适合于或发生在露天。
senses.exampleZh: 美丽的户外婚礼场地。

senses.example: A spoonful of sharp pickle gave the plain meat a salty, tangy relish.
senses.definition: the taste experience when a savoury condiment is taken into the mouth
senses.definitionSentence: Relish is the taste experience when a savoury condiment is taken into the mouth.
senses.definitionZh: 一种咸味调味品放入口中时的味觉体验。
senses.exampleZh: 一勺尖锐的泡菜给普通的肉带来了咸味和浓郁的味道。

senses.example: Hoag descended the stone steps to the street and looked up at the building.
senses.definition: move downward and lower, but not necessarily all the way
senses.definitionSentence: To descend means to move downward and lower, but not necessarily all the way.
senses.definitionZh: 向下移动和降低，但不一定是一直移动。
senses.exampleZh: 霍格走下石阶来到街道上，抬头看着这座建筑。

senses.example: She was descended from an old Italian noble family.
senses.definition: come from; be connected by a relationship of blood, for example
senses.definitionSentence: To descend means to come from; be connected by a relationship of blood, for example.
senses.definitionZh: 来自；例如，通过血缘关系相连。
senses.exampleZh: 她是意大利古老贵族家庭的后裔。

senses.example: The senior professor would not descend to falsifying results merely to win another research grant.
senses.definition: do something that one considers to be below one's dignity
senses.definitionSentence: To descend means to do something that one considers to be below one's dignity.
senses.definitionZh: 做一些人们认为有损尊严的事情。
senses.exampleZh: 这位资深教授不会仅仅为了赢得另一项研究资助而伪造结果。

senses.example: He hated tight starched collars.
senses.definition: closely constrained or constricted or constricting
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as tight is closely constrained or constricted or constricting.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“紧”的东西是被紧密约束或收缩或收缩的。
senses.exampleZh: 他讨厌浆过的紧身衣领。

senses.example: Nerves tight as a bowstring, he paused to gather his wits.
senses.definition: pulled or drawn tight
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as tight is pulled or drawn tight.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“紧”的东西被拉紧或拉紧。
senses.exampleZh: 他紧张得像弓弦一样，停下来集中精神。

senses.example: "a person is blind to the extent that he must devise alternative techniques to do efficiently those things he would do with sight if he had normal vision"--Kenneth Jernigan.
senses.definition: unable to see
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as blind is unable to see.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为盲人的东西无法看见。
senses.exampleZh: “一个人失明到了一定程度，他必须设计替代技术来有效地完成那些如果他有正常视力的话他可以用视力做的事情”——肯尼思·杰尼根。

senses.example: She lived by the rules, never compromising, never blinded or diverted by circumstance.
senses.definition: render unable to see
senses.definitionSentence: To blind means to render unable to see.
senses.definitionZh: 无法看见。
senses.exampleZh: 她遵守规则，从不妥协，从不被环境蒙蔽或转移注意力。

senses.example: Hands on Bible, seaman Lodley and carpenter Staffe swore that Juet had tried to persuade them to keep muskets and swords in their cabins.

senses.definitionSentence: Sword is a cutting or thrusting weapon that has a long metal blade and a hilt with a hand guard.
senses.definitionZh: 一种切割或刺击武器，具有长金属刀片和带护手的刀柄。
senses.exampleZh: 手握圣经，海员洛德利和木匠斯塔夫发誓，尤特曾试图说服他们将步枪和剑留在他们的船舱里。

senses.example: "Selfish men were...trying to make capital for themselves out of the sacred cause of civil rights"- Maria Weston Chapman.

senses.definitionSentence: Something described as selfish is concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others.

senses.example: The party leader addressed the men in the movement as comrades.
senses.definition: used as a term of address for those male persons engaged in the same movement

senses.definitionZh: 对从事同一运动的男性的称呼。
senses.exampleZh: 党的领导人称呼运动中的人们为同志。

senses.definitionZh: 美国液体单位，等于 32 液量盎司；四夸脱等于一加仑。

senses.definitionZh: 在纸、纸板或塑料上书写或印刷的标签，贴在某物上以表明其所有者、性质、价格等。
senses.exampleZh: （这些酶制剂作为枯草芽孢杆菌、米曲霉、尼日尔菌和黄曲霉的发酵提取物出现在当今的饲料标签上。）。

senses.example: Have you examined this problem of increasing consumer sophistication from the standpoint of your own company?

senses.definition: the face of a timepiece; graduated to show the hours
senses.definitionSentence: Dial is the face of a timepiece; graduated to show the hours.
senses.definitionZh: 钟表的表面；刻度显示时间。
senses.exampleZh: 他看着手表的夜光表盘。

senses.example: You must take the receiver off the hook before you dial.

senses.definitionSentence: To dial means to operate a dial to select a telephone number.
senses.definitionZh: 操作拨号来选择电话号码。
senses.exampleZh: 拨号前您必须将听筒摘机。

senses.example: A prototype which fulfills the requirements was developed and thoroughly tested.

senses.definitionZh: 标准或典型示例。
senses.exampleZh: 开发了满足要求的原型并进行了彻底测试。

senses.example: The corrupt official accepted secret payments in exchange for public contracts.
senses.definition: not straight; dishonest or immoral or evasive

senses.exampleZh: 腐败官员接受秘密付款以换取公共合同。

senses.example: Socrates was accused of corrupting young men.
senses.definition: corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality
senses.definitionSentence: To corrupt means to corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality.
senses.definitionZh: 道德上的腐败或因不节制或淫荡而腐败。

senses.example: During the slow buildup, the essence of a policy or a man is concealed under embroidered details, fine words, strutting gestures.

senses.definitionZh: 防止被看见或发现。

senses.example: She conceals her anger well.

senses.definitionSentence: To conceal means to hold back; keep from being perceived by others.
senses.definitionZh: 隐瞒；避免被别人察觉。
senses.exampleZh: 她很好地隐藏了自己的愤怒。

senses.example: The camel carried supplies across the desert and conserved water for the long journey.
senses.definition: cud-chewing mammal used as a draft or saddle animal in desert regions
senses.definitionSentence: Camel means cud-chewing mammal used as a draft or saddle animal in desert regions.
senses.definitionZh: 反刍哺乳动物，在沙漠地区用作役畜或骑乘动物。

senses.example: Then came coconuts, eggs, and rice wine.
senses.definition: fermented juice (of grapes especially)
senses.definitionSentence: Wine means fermented juice (of grapes especially).
senses.definitionZh: 发酵汁（尤其是葡萄汁）。
senses.exampleZh: 然后是椰子、鸡蛋和米酒。

senses.example: Trees bent under the fierce winds.
senses.definition: air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure
senses.definitionSentence: Wind means air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure.
senses.definitionZh: 空气从高压区域移动到低压区域（有时具有相当大的力量）。
senses.exampleZh: 树木在狂风中弯曲。

senses.example: He put the key in the old clock and gave it a good wind.

senses.definitionZh: 缠绕或扭转的行为。

senses.definitionSentence: To wind means to coil the spring of (some mechanical device) by turning a stem.
senses.definitionZh: 通过转动阀杆来卷绕（某些机械装置）的弹簧。
senses.exampleZh: 她通过转动钥匙并拉紧内部弹簧来给时钟上发条。

senses.example: The road winds around the lake.
senses.definition: extend in curves and turns
senses.definitionSentence: To wind means to extend in curves and turns.
senses.definitionZh: 以曲线和转弯延伸。
senses.exampleZh: 道路绕湖蜿蜒。

senses.example: Eugene was not entirely silent, or openly rude - unless asking Harold to move to another chair and placing himself in the fauteuil that creaked so alarmingly was an act of rudeness.

senses.example: The crude weapons and rude agricultural implements of early man.

senses.exampleZh: 早期人类的原始武器和原始农具。

senses.example: The bartender winked back at him and palmed the bill.

senses.definitionZh: 通过眨眼发出信号。

senses.definition: gleam or glow intermittently
senses.definitionSentence: To wink means to gleam or glow intermittently.

senses.definitionSentence: To offend means to cause to feel resentment or indignation.
senses.definitionZh: 引起怨恨或愤慨。
senses.exampleZh: 她的无礼言论冒犯了我。

senses.definition: inspired by love for your country
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as patriotic is inspired by love for your country.
senses.definitionZh: 所谓爱国是源于对国家的热爱。
senses.exampleZh: 然后，几年后，非美活动委员会在马丁·迪斯的领导下，嘲笑了数百名正派的爱国公民。

senses.example: When the hay wagon had gone, and an interval passed, a huckster's cart might turn the corner.
senses.definition: grass mowed and cured for use as fodder
senses.definitionSentence: Hay means grass mowed and cured for use as fodder.
senses.definitionZh: 割下并腌制用作饲料的草。
senses.exampleZh: 当干草车开走并经过一段时间后，小贩的推车可能会转弯。

senses.example: The audience filled all the seats inside the Wollman enclosure and overflowed onto the lawns outside the fence.
senses.definition: flow or run over (a limit or brim)
senses.definitionSentence: To overflow means to flow or run over (a limit or brim).
senses.definitionZh: 溢出或溢出（限制或边缘）。
senses.exampleZh: 观众挤满了沃尔曼围场内的所有座位，并涌到了围墙外的草坪上。

senses.example: A crude cabin of logs with bark still on them.
senses.definition: not carefully or expertly made
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as crude is not carefully or expertly made.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为粗糙的东西并不是精心或专业制作的。
senses.exampleZh: 一间简陋的原木小屋，上面还残留着树皮。

senses.example: The refinery turns crude oil into processed fuels and chemicals.
senses.definition: not refined or processed
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as crude is not refined or processed.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为原油的东西未经精炼或加工。
senses.exampleZh: 炼油厂将原油转化为加工燃料和化学品。

senses.example: The undecided council vibrated between raising taxes and cutting services, unable to commit to either course.
senses.definition: be undecided about something; waver between conflicting positions or courses of action
senses.definitionSentence: To vibrate means to be undecided about something; waver between conflicting positions or courses of action.
senses.definitionZh: 对某事犹豫不决；在相互冲突的立场或行动方针之间摇摆不定。
senses.exampleZh: 犹豫不决的议会在提高税收和削减服务之间摇摆不定，无法承诺任何一条路线。

senses.example: `` It always comes in threes '', she sighed heavily.
senses.definition: heave or utter a sigh; breathe deeply and heavily
senses.definitionSentence: To sigh means to heave or utter a sigh; breathe deeply and heavily.
senses.definitionZh: 发出或发出一声叹息；深呼吸。
senses.exampleZh: “它总是三个一组”，她重重地叹了口气。

senses.example: In most schools physical education is compulsory.
senses.definition: required by rule
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as compulsory is required by rule.
senses.definitionZh: 规则要求描述为强制性的内容。
senses.exampleZh: 在大多数学校，体育课是必修课。

senses.example: The paramedic checked the patient's pulse at her wrist and counted seventy-two beats per minute.
senses.definition: the rhythmic contraction and expansion of the arteries with each beat of the heart
senses.definitionSentence: Pulse is the rhythmic contraction and expansion of the arteries with each beat of the heart.
senses.definitionZh: 每次心脏跳动时动脉的有节奏的收缩和扩张。
senses.exampleZh: 急救人员在患者腕部测量脉搏，数得每分钟七十二次。

senses.example: He read a chapter every night before falling asleep.
senses.definition: a subdivision of a written work; usually numbered and titled
senses.definitionSentence: Chapter is a subdivision of a written work; usually numbered and titled.
senses.definitionZh: 书面作品的细分；通常有编号和标题。
senses.exampleZh: 他每天晚上入睡前都会读一章。

senses.example: The industrial revolution opened a new chapter in British history.
senses.definition: any distinct period in history or in a person's life
senses.definitionSentence: Chapter means any distinct period in history or in a person's life.
senses.definitionZh: 历史或个人生活中的任何特定时期。
senses.exampleZh: 工业革命揭开了英国历史的新篇章。

senses.example: Mrs. Shaefer never got around to joining the thousand or so people who paid Lee some $ 30000 for his ozone machines.
senses.definition: a colorless gas (O3) soluble in alkalis and cold water; a strong oxidizing agent; can be produced by electric discharge in oxygen or by the action of ultraviolet radiation on oxygen in the stratosphere (where it acts as a screen for ultraviolet radiation)
senses.definitionSentence: Ozone is a colorless gas (O3) soluble in alkalis and cold water; a strong oxidizing agent; can be produced by electric discharge in oxygen or by the action of ultraviolet radiation on oxygen in the stratosphere (where it acts as a screen for ultraviolet radiation).
senses.definitionZh: 一种无色气体（O3），溶于碱和冷水；强氧化剂；可以通过氧气中的放电或紫外线辐射对平流层中的氧气（充当紫外线辐射的屏障）的作用而产生。
senses.exampleZh: 谢弗夫人从未抽出时间加入到向李支付约 30,000 美元购买臭氧机的数千人行列。

senses.example: Pat him on the shoulder.
senses.definition: hit lightly
senses.definitionSentence: To pat means to hit lightly.
senses.definitionZh: 轻轻地击打。
senses.exampleZh: 拍拍他的肩膀。

senses.example: The grandparents spoiled the child with unlimited sweets, expensive toys, and freedom from every rule.
senses.definition: treat with excessive indulgence
senses.definitionSentence: To spoil means to treat with excessive indulgence.
senses.definitionZh: 过度放纵。
senses.exampleZh: 祖父母用无限的糖果、昂贵的玩具和不受任何规则束缚的自由来宠坏孩子。

senses.example: One careless revelation spoiled the surprise party that friends had planned for weeks.
senses.definition: make a mess of, destroy or ruin
senses.definitionSentence: To spoil means to make a mess of, destroy or ruin.
senses.definitionZh: 弄乱、破坏或破坏。
senses.exampleZh: 一次不小心的揭露破坏了朋友们计划了数周的惊喜派对。

senses.example: But she sat on in stubborn silence.
senses.definition: tenaciously unwilling or marked by tenacious unwillingness to yield
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as stubborn is tenaciously unwilling or marked by tenacious unwillingness to yield.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为顽固的东西是顽强地不愿意屈服或以顽强地不愿意屈服为标志。
senses.exampleZh: 但她顽固地沉默着。

senses.definition: during the night of the present day
senses.definitionSentence: During the night of the present day.
senses.definitionZh: 今天晚上。
senses.example: The temperature will fall below freezing tonight after the sun sets.
senses.exampleZh: 今晚太阳落山后，气温将降至冰点以下。

senses.example: `` I asked her why she could n't do it tomorrow, but it seems the muse is working good tonight and she's afraid to let it go ''.
senses.definition: the present or immediately coming night
senses.definitionSentence: Tonight is the present or immediately coming night.
senses.definitionZh: 当前或即将到来的夜晚。
senses.exampleZh: ``我问她为什么明天不能做，但看来缪斯今晚运转良好，她不敢放手''。

senses.example: She peeled the onion bulb and sliced its layered white flesh.
senses.definition: the bulb of an onion plant
senses.definitionSentence: Onion is the bulb of an onion plant.
senses.definitionZh: 洋葱植物的球茎。
senses.exampleZh: 她剥了洋葱球的皮，并将其分层的白色果肉切成片。

senses.example: We spent the afternoon sightseeing at the old castle, cathedral, and city museum.
senses.definition: going about to look at places of interest
senses.definitionSentence: Sightseeing means going about to look at places of interest.
senses.definitionZh: 去参观名胜古迹。
senses.exampleZh: 下午我们参观了古城堡、大教堂和城市博物馆。

senses.example: With wet boots and tired legs, the hikers padded heavily through the mud toward camp.
senses.definition: walk heavily and firmly, as when weary, or through mud
senses.definitionSentence: To pad means to walk heavily and firmly, as when weary, or through mud.
senses.definitionZh: 沉重而坚定地行走，如疲倦时或穿过泥浆。
senses.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者的靴子湿漉漉的，双腿疲惫不堪，沉重地穿过泥泞，向营地走去。

senses.example: A soft foam pad protected her injured knee from pressure.
senses.definition: a flat mass of soft material used for protection, stuffing, or comfort
senses.definitionSentence: Pad is a flat mass of soft material used for protection, stuffing, or comfort.
senses.definitionZh: 一块扁平的柔软材料，用于保护、填充或舒适。
senses.exampleZh: 柔软的泡沫垫保护她受伤的膝盖免受压力。

senses.example: The theoretical physicist develops mathematical models rather than building practical machines.
senses.definition: concerned with theories rather than their practical applications
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as theoretical is concerned with theories rather than their practical applications.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为理论的东西涉及理论而不是其实际应用。
senses.exampleZh: 理论物理学家开发数学模型而不是建造实用机器。

senses.example: "would have scarce arrived before she would have found some excuse to leave"- W.B.Yeats.
senses.definition: only a very short time before
senses.definitionSentence: Scarce means only a very short time before.
senses.definitionZh: 只有很短的时间。
senses.exampleZh: “在她找到借口离开之前几乎不会到达”- W.B.Yeats。

senses.example: Fresh vegetables were scarce during the drought.
senses.definition: deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as scarce is deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为稀缺的东西是指与需求相比数量或数量不足。
senses.exampleZh: 干旱期间新鲜蔬菜稀缺。

senses.example: These frequencies are amplified and detected by the FM receiver after each burst of transmitted energy and, after the `` pill '' has been calibrated, precise internal pressure indications can be obtained.
senses.definition: increase in size, volume or significance
senses.definitionSentence: To amplify means to increase in size, volume or significance.
senses.definitionZh: 增加尺寸、体积或重要性。
senses.exampleZh: 这些频率在每次传输能量突发后由 FM 接收器放大和检测，并且在“药丸”校准后，可以获得精确的内部压力指示。

senses.example: The archer drew the bow, aimed the arrow at the center of the target, and released the string.
senses.definition: a weapon for shooting arrows, composed of a curved piece of resilient wood with a taut cord to propel the arrow
senses.definitionSentence: Bow is a weapon for shooting arrows, composed of a curved piece of resilient wood with a taut cord to propel the arrow.
senses.definitionZh: 一种射箭的武器，由一块弯曲的弹性木材组成，带有拉紧的绳索来推动箭头。
senses.exampleZh: 弓箭手拉开弓，把箭瞄准靶心，然后松开弓弦。

senses.example: He pointed the bow of the boat toward the finish line.
senses.definition: front part of a vessel or aircraft
senses.definitionSentence: Bow means front part of a vessel or aircraft.

senses.example: He bowed before the King.

senses.definitionZh: 弯曲头部或身体的上半部分以表示尊重或问候的姿势。
senses.exampleZh: 他在国王面前鞠躬。

senses.example: She bowed before the Queen.
senses.definition: bend one's back forward from the waist on down
senses.definitionSentence: To bow means to bend one's back forward from the waist on down.
senses.definitionZh: 将背部从腰部向下向前弯曲。
senses.exampleZh: 她在女王面前鞠躬。

senses.meaning: 偷偷地做，鬼鬼祟祟做事
senses.example: Warren eased his rifle's safety off and gently, slowly sneaked another clip of ammunition from one of the cloth bandoleers that marked the upper part of his body with an X.
senses.definition: put, bring, or take in a secretive or furtive manner
senses.definitionSentence: To sneak means to put, bring, or take in a secretive or furtive manner.
senses.definitionZh: 以秘密或偷偷摸摸的方式放置、携带或拿走。

senses.example: They made a sneak inspection before dawn, entering quietly so the factory managers would not be warned.
senses.definition: marked by quiet and caution and secrecy; taking pains to avoid being observed
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sneak is marked by quiet and caution and secrecy; taking pains to avoid being observed.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为潜行的事物的特点是安静、谨慎和保密；努力避免被观察。
senses.exampleZh: 他们在天亮之前进行了一次偷偷检查，悄悄地进入，这样工厂的管理人员就不会受到警告。

senses.example: The thief sneaked a silver bracelet from the counter while the jeweler helped another customer.

senses.example: A number of religions also satisfy for many the need of being linked with the ultimate and eternal.

senses.definitionZh: 被描述为永恒的事物是指永远或无限期地持续下去。
senses.exampleZh: 许多宗教也满足了许多人与终极和永恒联系的需要。

senses.definitionSentence: To harbor means to keep in one's possession; of animals.
senses.definitionZh: 占有；的动物。

senses.example: Poor winds and fog locked her up in a harbor the crew called `` Lousie Bay ''.

senses.definitionSentence: Harbor is a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo.
senses.definitionZh: 一个受庇护的港口，船舶可以在此装卸货物。
senses.exampleZh: 恶劣的风和雾将她锁在了船员们称为“路易斯湾”的港口中。

senses.example: Turn the lid clockwise in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

senses.definitionZh: 将成分彻底混合在一起的行为。

senses.example: O ' Banion's first conflict with the police came in 1909, at seventeen, when he was committed to Bridewell Prison for three months for burglary; two years later he served another three months for assault.

senses.definitionZh: 某人威胁或企图进行人身攻击，如果不制止，该人似乎能够造成人身伤害。

senses.example: In this manner, he seeks to expunge from his own soul the guilt pangs caused by his personal assaults against the English at Dunkirk.
senses.definition: close fighting during the culmination of a military attack
senses.definitionSentence: Assault means close fighting during the culmination of a military attack.
senses.definitionZh: 军事攻击达到高潮时的近距离战斗。

senses.example: The mugger assaulted the woman.

senses.definitionSentence: To assault means to attack someone physically or emotionally.
senses.definitionZh: 对某人进行身体或情感攻击。
senses.exampleZh: 抢劫犯袭击了该女子。

senses.example: A Confederate observed that the Yankees were: `` thicker than lise on a hen and a dam site ornraier ''.

senses.definitionZh: 成年雌性鸡。

senses.example: The building's southern orientation lets its main windows face the midday sun.
senses.definition: position or alignment relative to points of the compass or other specific directions
senses.definitionSentence: Orientation means position or alignment relative to points of the compass or other specific directions.

senses.definitionZh: 将某物从一个位置移动到另一个位置的行为。

senses.example: I transferred my stock holdings to my children.

senses.definitionSentence: To transfer means to move from one place to another.
senses.definitionZh: 从一个地方移动到另一个地方。
senses.exampleZh: 将患者转移到另一家医院。

senses.example: He stuffed his laundry into a large bag.

senses.definitionZh: 一种具有单个开口的柔性容器。

senses.exampleZh: 现在，三月份，整个老挝都陷入了围困状态。

senses.example: Questions and, particularly, exclamations are usually channeled along informal, horizontal lines not indicated in Figure 3 and seldom are carried beyond the nearest neighbor.

senses.exampleZh: 问题，特别是感叹词通常沿着图 3 中未标明的非正式水平线传递，并且很少超出最近的邻居。

senses.example: On the pommel horse, the gymnast performed scissors by swinging his legs past each other like two blades.

senses.definitionSentence: Scissors is a gymnastic exercise performed on the pommel horse when the gymnast moves his legs as the blades of scissors move.

senses.example: She sprayed perfume on her wrists, and the toiletry released a fragrant floral scent.

senses.definitionSentence: Perfume is a toiletry that emits and diffuses a fragrant odor.

senses.example: Halfway across the house, he could have smelled her morning perfume.

senses.definitionSentence: Perfume is a distinctive odor that is pleasant.
senses.definitionZh: 一种令人愉悦的独特气味。

senses.example: Orange blossoms perfumed the air in the garden.
senses.definition: fill or impregnate with an odor

senses.definition: belonging to or lasting from times long ago
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as antique is belonging to or lasting from times long ago.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为古董的东西属于很久以前或从很久以前开始一直存在。
senses.exampleZh: 古老的恐惧，日子会逐渐变暗，直至完全黑暗。

senses.example: A suit of rather antique appearance.
senses.definition: out of fashion
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as antique is out of fashion.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为古董的东西已经过时了。
senses.exampleZh: 一套外观相当古色古香的套装。

senses.example: The dealer valued the eighteenth-century cabinet as a rare and beautiful antique.
senses.definition: any piece of furniture or decorative object or the like produced in a former period and valuable because of its beauty or rarity
senses.definitionSentence: Antique means any piece of furniture or decorative object or the like produced in a former period and valuable because of its beauty or rarity.
senses.definitionZh: 任何一件在以前的时期生产的、因其美丽或稀有而有价值的家具或装饰品等。
senses.exampleZh: 经销商认为这个十八世纪的柜子是一件稀有而美丽的古董。

senses.example: We went antiquing on Saturday.
senses.definition: shop for antiques
senses.definitionSentence: To antique means to shop for antiques.
senses.definitionZh: 购买古董。
senses.exampleZh: 星期六我们去古董了。

senses.example: If the site is on a reservoir, the level of the water at various seasons as it affects recreation should be studied.
senses.definition: lake used to store water for community use
senses.definitionSentence: Reservoir means lake used to store water for community use.
senses.definitionZh: 用于储存水供社区使用的湖泊。
senses.exampleZh: 如果该地点位于水库上，则应研究不同季节的水位，因为它会影响休闲活动。

senses.example: Tests showed that the tumor was benign, so it would not invade nearby tissue or spread.
senses.definition: not dangerous to health; not recurrent or progressive (especially of a tumor)
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as benign is not dangerous to health; not recurrent or progressive (especially of a tumor).
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为良性的东西对健康没有危险；不复发或进展（尤其是肿瘤）。
senses.exampleZh: 测试表明肿瘤是良性的，因此不会侵入附近组织或扩散。

senses.example: Regional stereotypes have been part of America since its founding.
senses.definition: a conventional or formulaic conception or image
senses.definitionSentence: Stereotype is a conventional or formulaic conception or image.
senses.definitionZh: 一种传统的或公式化的概念或图像。
senses.exampleZh: 自美国成立以来，地区刻板印象一直是美国的一部分。

senses.example: The court convicted him of rape for forcing the victim into sexual intercourse without consent.
senses.definition: the crime of forcing a woman to submit to sexual intercourse against her will
senses.definitionSentence: Rape is the crime of forcing a woman to submit to sexual intercourse against her will.
senses.definitionZh: 违背妇女意愿强迫其发生性交的犯罪。
senses.exampleZh: 法院因他未经受害人同意而强迫发生性关系而判处他强奸罪。

senses.example: The woman was raped on her way home at night.
senses.definition: force (someone) to have sex against their will
senses.definitionSentence: To rape means to force (someone) to have sex against their will.
senses.definitionZh: 强迫（某人）违背其意愿发生性行为。
senses.exampleZh: 女子晚上回家途中被强奸。

senses.example: This kind of food is not nourishing for young children.
senses.definition: provide with nourishment
senses.definitionSentence: To nourish means to provide with nourishment.
senses.definitionZh: 提供营养。
senses.exampleZh: 这种食物对幼儿来说没有营养。

senses.example: Industrial pollution contaminated the river with toxic chemicals and killed thousands of fish.
senses.definition: undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities
senses.definitionSentence: Pollution means undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities.
senses.definitionZh: 由于人类活动而使自然环境受到有害物质污染的不良状态。
senses.exampleZh: 工业污染使有毒化学物质污染了河流，导致数千条鱼死亡。

senses.example: After completing the nursing course, she received a diploma certifying her qualification.
senses.definition: a document certifying the successful completion of a course of study
senses.definitionSentence: Diploma is a document certifying the successful completion of a course of study.
senses.definitionZh: 证明成功完成学习课程的文件。
senses.exampleZh: 完成护理课程后，她获得了证明其资格的文凭。

senses.example: He slid in at her side, tucked a cigar into his mouth, and politely proffered one to her.
senses.definition: a roll of tobacco for smoking
senses.definitionSentence: Cigar is a roll of tobacco for smoking.
senses.definitionZh: 用于吸烟的一卷烟草。
senses.exampleZh: 他溜到她身边，把一支雪茄塞进嘴里，礼貌地递给她一支。

senses.example: A square peg in a round hole.
senses.definition: having four equal sides and four right angles or forming a right angle
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as square is having four equal sides and four right angles or forming a right angle.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为正方形的东西有四个相等的边和四个直角或形成一个直角。
senses.exampleZh: 圆孔中的方钉。

senses.example: The square official rejected the bribe and applied the rule fairly to everyone.
senses.definition: characterized by honesty and fairness
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as square is characterized by honesty and fairness.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为方的东西的特点是诚实和公平。
senses.exampleZh: 广场官员拒绝了贿赂，并将该规则公平地应用于每个人。

senses.example: In place of the police headquarters was a new square filled with rubble.
senses.definition: an open area at the meeting of two or more streets
senses.definitionSentence: Square is an open area at the meeting of two or more streets.
senses.definitionZh: 两条或更多街道交汇处的开放区域。
senses.exampleZh: 警察总部的地方是一个充满瓦砾的新广场。

senses.example: You can compute the area of a square if you know the length of its sides.
senses.definition: (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon
senses.definitionSentence: Square means (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon.
senses.definitionZh: （几何学）具有四个等边和四个直角的平面矩形；四边形正多边形。
senses.exampleZh: 如果知道正方形的边长，就可以计算正方形的面积。

senses.example: We were hiking in Colorado.
senses.definition: walk a long way, as for pleasure or physical exercise
senses.definitionSentence: To hike means to walk a long way, as for pleasure or physical exercise.
senses.definitionZh: 走很长的路，用于娱乐或体育锻炼。
senses.exampleZh: 我们在科罗拉多州徒步旅行。

senses.example: The landlord hiked up the rents.
senses.definition: increase
senses.definitionSentence: To hike means to increase.
senses.definitionZh: 增加。
senses.exampleZh: 房东提高了租金。

senses.example: The doctor placed a protective patch over the injured eye while it healed.
senses.definition: a protective cloth covering for an injured eye
senses.definitionSentence: Patch is a protective cloth covering for an injured eye.
senses.definitionZh: 覆盖受伤眼睛的防护布。
senses.exampleZh: 医生在受伤的眼睛愈合时放置了一个保护罩。

senses.example: A few yards beyond the group of men, a man's nude body lay face down on a patch of thick green dichondra.
senses.definition: a small area of ground covered by specific vegetation
senses.definitionSentence: Patch is a small area of ground covered by specific vegetation.
senses.definitionZh: 被特定植被覆盖的一小块地面区域。
senses.exampleZh: 在这群男人之外几码处，一个男人赤裸的身体面朝下躺在一片浓密的绿色杜鹃花上。

senses.example: The field was patched with snow.
senses.definition: provide with a patch; also used metaphorically
senses.definitionSentence: To patch means to provide with a patch; also used metaphorically.
senses.definitionZh: 修补，补。
senses.exampleZh: 田野被雪覆盖了。

senses.example: Lolotte held a patch of leather, Rev steadied something, a tiny brad, waiting for George's poised hammer.
senses.definition: a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
senses.definitionSentence: Patch is a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole.
senses.definitionZh: 一块用作装饰或修补或覆盖洞的布。
senses.exampleZh: 洛洛特拿着一块皮革，雷夫稳住了一个东西，一个小角钉，等待乔治的锤子。

senses.example: The physicist used particle detectors and mathematical models to study the fundamental behavior of matter.
senses.definition: a scientist trained in physics
senses.definitionSentence: Physicist is a scientist trained in physics.
senses.definitionZh: 受过物理学训练的科学家。
senses.exampleZh: 物理学家使用粒子探测器和数学模型来研究物质的基本行为。

senses.example: The museum's oriental art gallery displays ceramics, textiles, and paintings from China, Japan, and Korea.
senses.definition: denoting or characteristic of countries of Asia
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as oriental is denoting or characteristic of countries of Asia.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为东方的东西是指亚洲国家的特征或特征。

senses.example: The old immigration record used the now-offensive term 'Oriental' for an Asian resident.
senses.definition: a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans)
senses.definitionSentence: Oriental is a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans).
senses.definitionZh: 东方种族的成员；这个词被亚洲人（尤其是亚裔美国人）视为冒犯性的。
senses.exampleZh: 旧的移民记录对亚洲居民使用了现在具有攻击性的术语“东方”。

senses.example: He felt envy when his colleague received the promotion and salary he wanted.
senses.definition: a feeling of grudging admiration and desire to have something that is possessed by another
senses.definitionSentence: Envy is a feeling of grudging admiration and desire to have something that is possessed by another.
senses.definitionZh: 一种勉强的钦佩和渴望拥有他人所拥有的东西的感觉。
senses.exampleZh: 当他的同事得到他想要的升职和薪水时，他感到嫉妒。

senses.example: She envied her friend's peaceful home and wished she had the same security.
senses.definition: be envious of; set one's heart on

senses.definitionZh: 嫉妒；专心致志。
senses.exampleZh: 她羡慕朋友平静的家，希望自己也能拥有同样的安全感。

senses.example: The old fable tells of a magical giant who carried the moon across the sky each night.
senses.definition: a story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
senses.definitionSentence: Fable is a story about mythical or supernatural beings or events.
senses.definitionZh: 关于神话或超自然生物或事件的故事。
senses.exampleZh: 这个古老的寓言讲述了一个神奇的巨人每晚都带着月亮穿过天空。

senses.example: But hear Harrison E. Salisbury, former Moscow correspondent of The New York Times, and author of `` To Moscow - And Beyond ''.
senses.definition: a journalist employed to provide news stories for newspapers or broadcast media
senses.definitionSentence: Correspondent is a journalist employed to provide news stories for newspapers or broadcast media.
senses.definitionZh: 受雇为报纸或广播媒体提供新闻报道的记者。
senses.exampleZh: 但听听哈里森·E·索尔兹伯里 (Harrison E. Salisbury)，他是《纽约时报》前驻莫斯科记者，也是《前往莫斯科 - 超越》一书的作者。

senses.meaning: 借口，掩饰真实原因的托词

senses.definitionZh: 用来隐藏计划的东西；为了掩盖真实原因而捏造的虚构原因。

senses.definitionZh: 一年的第一个月；冬至后10天开始。

senses.definitionZh: 物体质量与其速度的乘积。
senses.exampleZh: 粒子的动量是从陨石速度推导出来的。

senses.definitionSentence: Momentum is an impelling force or strength.
senses.definitionZh: 一种推动力或强度。

senses.example: After a minute he went on, `` People must think the curse is on me, seeing you fresh as an apple and me old and gray ''.

senses.definitionSentence: Apple means fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh.
senses.definitionZh: 果皮呈红色、黄色或绿色、果肉甜到酸、酥脆、呈白色的水果。

senses.example: After the reservoir fell to a record low, the city imposed drastic limits on household water use.
senses.definition: forceful and extreme and rigorous
senses.definitionSentence: Forceful, extreme, or severe in effect or action.
senses.definitionZh: 在效果或行动上强烈、极端或严厉。

senses.definitionZh: 北和东之间的中点； 45 度。

senses.example: Silicon purified from mineral compounds is used as a semiconductor in computer chips.

senses.definitionZh: 一种四价非金属元素；它是地壳中仅次于氧的最丰富的元素；出现在粘土、长石、花岗岩、石英和沙子中；用作晶体管中的半导体。

senses.example: The majesty of the vast cathedral was evident in its towering arches and immense dome.
senses.definition: impressiveness in scale or proportion
senses.definitionSentence: Majesty means impressiveness in scale or proportion.
senses.definitionZh: 规模或比例上令人印象深刻。
senses.exampleZh: 巨大大教堂的威严在其高耸的拱门和巨大的圆顶中显而易见。

senses.example: The detective hinted that the missing key might be hidden inside the clock.

senses.definitionZh: 不直接明说，而是间接地暗示某事。

senses.definitionZh: 间接建议。

senses.example: She had lost a bottle of opium - but that was on the trip from New Orleans.

senses.example: The USB interface links the computer to the external storage device.
senses.definition: (computer science) computer circuit consisting of the hardware and associated circuitry that links one device with another (especially a computer and a hard disk drive or other peripherals)
senses.definitionSentence: Interface means (computer science) computer circuit consisting of the hardware and associated circuitry that links one device with another (especially a computer and a hard disk drive or other peripherals).
senses.definitionZh: （计算机科学）计算机电路，由将一个设备与另一个设备（尤其是计算机和硬盘驱动器或其他外围设备）连接的硬件和相关电路组成。
senses.exampleZh: USB 接口将计算机连接到外部存储设备。

senses.example: For breakfast he ate a bowl of cereal made from toasted oats, wheat, and corn grains.
senses.definition: foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses
senses.definitionSentence: Cereal means foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses.

senses.example: He poured milk over a bowl of grain cereal for breakfast.

senses.definitionSentence: Cereal is a breakfast food prepared from grain.

senses.example: Cereal crops such as wheat, rice, and oats are grown for their grain.

senses.example: I scheduled an exam for this afternoon.

senses.definitionSentence: To schedule means to make a schedule; plan the time and place for events.

senses.exampleZh: 我安排了今天下午的考试。

senses.example: Are you watching work schedules for boiler operators, guards, and other 24 - hour day, 7 - day week operations in order to minimize overtime?

senses.definitionSentence: Schedule is a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to.

senses.exampleZh: 卫星导航引导飞机沿着航线安全飞向跑道。

senses.example: And another time, without accusation: `` You never wore that scarf I bought you ''.
senses.definition: a garment worn around the head or neck or shoulders for warmth or decoration
senses.definitionSentence: Scarf is a garment worn around the head or neck or shoulders for warmth or decoration.
senses.definitionZh: 一种戴在头部、颈部或肩部的服装，用于保暖或装饰。
senses.exampleZh: 还有一次，没有指责：“你从来没有戴过我给你买的那条围巾”。

senses.example: I wish you luck when you try scaring that kid ''.
senses.definition: cause fear in

senses.definitionZh: 引起恐惧。
senses.exampleZh: 当你试图吓唬那个孩子时，我祝你好运”。

senses.example: A bomb scare led them to evacuate the building.
senses.definition: sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events
senses.definitionSentence: Scare means sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events.
senses.definitionZh: 对预期事件突然发生的大规模恐惧和焦虑。
senses.exampleZh: 炸弹恐慌导致他们疏散大楼。

senses.example: `` Witt House happily announces the engagement of Fran Horowitz to Erwin Schwartz of Fife House ''.
senses.definition: a mutual promise to marry
senses.definitionSentence: Engagement is a mutual promise to marry.
senses.definitionZh: 双方共同承诺结婚。
senses.exampleZh: ``Witt House 高兴地宣布 Fran Horowitz 与 Fife House 的 Erwin Schwartz 订婚''。

senses.example: She has a dental engagement at ten, arranged several weeks in advance.
senses.definition: a meeting arranged in advance
senses.definitionSentence: Engagement is a meeting arranged in advance.
senses.definitionZh: 提前安排的会议。
senses.exampleZh: 她十点钟要去看牙医，提前几周安排。

senses.example: This brought in everybody from both sides, while the spectators stood up and added to the uproar.
senses.definition: a state of commotion and noise and confusion
senses.definitionSentence: Uproar is a state of commotion and noise and confusion.
senses.definitionZh: 一种骚动、噪音和混乱的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 这让双方的所有人都进来了，而观众们也站了起来，加剧了骚动。

senses.example: A mouse takes much more room than a trackball.
senses.definition: a hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen as you move it around on a pad; on the bottom of the device is a ball that rolls on the surface of the pad
senses.definitionSentence: Mouse is a hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen as you move it around on a pad; on the bottom of the device is a ball that rolls on the surface of the pad.
senses.definitionZh: 一种手动操作的电子设备，当您在垫子上移动光标时，它可以控制计算机屏幕上光标的坐标；设备底部有一个在垫子表面滚动的球。
senses.exampleZh: 鼠标比轨迹球占用更多空间。

senses.example: We classify mice as `` straight haired '' or `` wavy haired '', but a hairless mouse appears.
senses.definition: any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails
senses.definitionSentence: Mouse means any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails.
senses.definitionZh: 众多小型啮齿动物中的任何一种，通常类似于小型大鼠，具有尖尖的鼻子和细长的身体上的小耳朵，以及细长的通常无毛的尾巴。
senses.exampleZh: 我们将小鼠分类为“直毛”或“波浪毛”，但出现了无毛小鼠。

senses.example: The court appointed an uncle to tutor the orphan and protect his interests.
senses.definition: act as a guardian to someone
senses.definitionSentence: To tutor means to act as a guardian to someone.
senses.definitionZh: 充当某人的监护人。
senses.exampleZh: 法院指定了一位叔叔来辅导孤儿并保护他的利益。

senses.example: They are relentlessly rebuffed on all sides by a waitress, the police, and an intruding government tutor.
senses.definition: a person who gives private instruction (as in singing, acting, etc.)
senses.definitionSentence: Tutor is a person who gives private instruction (as in singing, acting, etc.).
senses.definitionZh: 提供私人指导的人（如歌唱、表演等）。
senses.exampleZh: 他们遭到女服务员、警察和闯入的政府家庭教师的无情拒绝。

senses.meaning: 社交的，好交际的，友善的，合群的
senses.example: Americans are sociable and gregarious.
senses.definition: inclined to or conducive to companionship with others
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as sociable is inclined to or conducive to companionship with others.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为善于交际的事物倾向于或有利于与他人交往。
senses.exampleZh: 美国人善于交际、合群。

senses.example: There had been nothing evil or dirty in his intentions.
senses.definition: (of behavior or especially language) characterized by obscenity or indecency
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dirty is (of behavior or especially language) characterized by obscenity or indecency.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为肮脏的事物（行为或特别是语言）以淫秽或不雅为特征。
senses.exampleZh: 他的意图没有任何邪恶或肮脏的地方。

senses.example: Put his dirty feet on the clean sheet.
senses.definition: soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dirty is soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为脏的东西是指被污垢或污垢弄脏或可能弄脏的东西。
senses.exampleZh: 将他的脏脚放在干净的床单上。

senses.example: Practically all forecasts mention new and exciting products on the horizon.
senses.definition: a prediction about how something (as the weather) will develop
senses.definitionSentence: Forecast is a prediction about how something (as the weather) will develop.
senses.definitionZh: 对某事（如天气）将如何发展的预测。
senses.exampleZh: 几乎所有预测都提到即将出现的令人兴奋的新产品。

senses.example: The programs in infrared spectroscopy are undergoing reorientation toward wavelength standards in the far infrared, the application of infrared techniques to solid state studies, and increased emphasis on high resolution instrumentation.
senses.definition: having or employing wavelengths longer than light but shorter than radio waves; lying outside the visible spectrum at its red end
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as infrared is having or employing wavelengths longer than light but shorter than radio waves; lying outside the visible spectrum at its red end.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为红外线的东西具有或采用比光长但比无线电波短的波长；位于可见光谱的红端之外。
senses.exampleZh: 红外光谱学项目正在向远红外波长标准、红外技术在固态研究中的应用以及对高分辨率仪器的日益重视进行重新定位。

senses.example: She is mourning her dead child.
senses.definition: feel sadness
senses.definitionSentence: To mourn means to feel sadness.
senses.definitionZh: 感到悲伤。
senses.exampleZh: 她正在哀悼死去的孩子。

senses.example: He loathed the idea of drying up swamps or the chills of malaria or of leaving his natural birthright.
senses.definition: a sensation of cold that often marks the start of an infection and the development of a fever
senses.definitionSentence: Chill is a sensation of cold that often marks the start of an infection and the development of a fever.
senses.definitionZh: 一种寒冷的感觉，通常标志着感染的开始和发烧的发展。
senses.exampleZh: 他厌恶让沼泽干涸、疟疾带来的寒冷或放弃他与生俱来的权利。

senses.example: The birth of the myth compensates for the death of the ideal.
senses.definition: a traditional story accepted as history; serves to explain the world view of a people
senses.definitionSentence: Myth is a traditional story accepted as history; serves to explain the world view of a people.
senses.definitionZh: 被接受为历史的传统故事；旨在解释一个民族的世界观。
senses.exampleZh: 神话的诞生弥补了理想的消亡。

senses.example: When she awoke the clarity was back in her eyes.
senses.definition: the quality of clear water
senses.definitionSentence: Clarity is the quality of clear water.
senses.definitionZh: 清澈的水的质量。
senses.exampleZh: 当她醒来时，她的眼睛又恢复了清澈。

senses.example: Here was stored $ 1000000 worth of bonded whisky.
senses.definition: a liquor made from fermented mash of grain
senses.definitionSentence: Whisky is a liquor made from fermented mash of grain.
senses.definitionZh: 一种由发酵谷物糊制成的酒。
senses.exampleZh: 这里存放着价值100万美元的保税威士忌。

senses.example: It's no use pretending that all conditioners are quiet, but the noise they produce can be kept to a minimum.
senses.definition: make believe with the intent to deceive
senses.definitionSentence: To pretend means to make believe with the intent to deceive.
senses.definitionZh: 以欺骗为目的的假装。
senses.exampleZh: 假装所有空调都很安静是没有用的，但它们产生的噪音可以保持在最低限度。

senses.example: Dangling their legs in the water to catch pretend fish.
senses.definition: imagined as in a play
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as pretend is imagined as in a play.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“假装”的事物是在戏剧中想象出来的。
senses.exampleZh: 将双腿悬在水中捕捉假鱼。

senses.example: The surgeon scanned the X-ray.
senses.definition: examine minutely or intensely
senses.definitionSentence: To scan means to examine minutely or intensely.
senses.definitionZh: 仔细或深入地检查。
senses.exampleZh: 外科医生扫描了 X 射线。

senses.definition: examine hastily
senses.definitionSentence: To scan means to examine hastily.
senses.definitionZh: 匆忙检查。
senses.exampleZh: 她在等出租车时浏览了报纸头条。

senses.example: I have never asked for an easy task, but I am weary of the strife ''.
senses.definition: lack of agreement or harmony

senses.definitionZh: 缺乏一致或和谐。
senses.exampleZh: 我从来不要求轻松的任务，但我厌倦了冲突”。

senses.example: An attempt should be made to see if electricity, in its most latent stage, has any action on the magnet as such ''.
senses.definition: (physics) a device that attracts iron and produces a magnetic field
senses.definitionSentence: Magnet means (physics) a device that attracts iron and produces a magnetic field.
senses.definitionZh: （物理学）一种吸引铁并产生磁场的装置。
senses.exampleZh: 应该尝试看看电力在其最潜在的阶段是否对磁铁有任何作用“”。

senses.example: Cashier the literal sense of this word.

senses.definitionZh: 丢弃或废除。

senses.definitionSentence: Litre is a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters (or approximately 1.75 pints).
senses.definitionZh: 容量的公制单位，以前定义为标准条件下一公斤纯水的体积；现在等于 1,000 立方厘米（或大约 1.75 品脱）。

senses.definitionZh: 人类。

senses.definitionZh: 为了安抚神灵而杀死（动物或人）的行为。

senses.example: Depending on the organism, there may be multiplication in some food or beverage products, i.e., in milk for example.

senses.definitionSentence: Milk is a white nutritious liquid secreted by mammals and used as food by human beings.

senses.definitionSentence: To stride means to walk with long steps.

senses.example: A member of the IRSAC staff (E. van de Walle) was recently delegated to cooperate with AIMO in the development of demographic statistics in this territory.

senses.example: Each local branch elected a delegate to vote on its behalf at the national conference.

senses.example: Tolek Alterman had returned from the colonies in Palestine and, before the national leadership, exalted the miracles of drying up swamps and irrigating the desert.

senses.definitionSentence: To irrigate means to supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams.
senses.definitionZh: 供水，如渠道、沟渠或溪流。

senses.example: Several slugs fired into the bed jerked aside the blanket to reveal an apparently lifeless hand.
senses.definition: bedding that keeps a person warm in bed

senses.example: Fresh snow blanketed the fields and covered every road and rooftop.

senses.definitionSentence: To blanket means to form a blanket-like cover (over).

senses.definitionSentence: To assassinate means to murder; especially of socially prominent persons.
senses.definitionZh: 谋杀；尤其是社会知名人士。
senses.exampleZh: 安瓦尔·萨达特被暗杀是因为很多人不喜欢他与以色列的和平政治。

senses.example: He seemed to be muttering, his voice surprisingly clear.

senses.example: I'll tackle this difficult task.

senses.definitionSentence: To tackle means to accept as a challenge.
senses.definitionZh: 接受挑战。
senses.exampleZh: 我将解决这项艰巨的任务。

senses.definitionSentence: To blush means to turn red, as if in embarrassment or shame.
senses.definitionZh: 脸红，好像感到尴尬或羞耻。

senses.example: The missionary school combined ordinary lessons with religious instruction.

senses.definitionSentence: Missionary means someone sent on a mission--especially a religious or charitable mission to a foreign country.

senses.example: The effects will be violent and probably bloody.
senses.definition: having or covered with or accompanied by blood

senses.definition: an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)
senses.definitionSentence: Tube is an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city).
senses.definitionZh: 在地表以下（通常在城市）运行的电气化铁路。
senses.exampleZh: 在巴黎，地铁系统被称为“地铁”，在伦敦，它被称为“地铁”或“地下”

senses.example: Electrical literature contained numerous references to lightning that had magnetized iron and had altered the polarity of compass needles.
senses.definition: navigational instrument for finding directions
senses.definitionSentence: Compass means navigational instrument for finding directions.
senses.definitionZh: 用于寻找方向的导航仪器。
senses.exampleZh: 电气文献中多次提到闪电使铁磁化并改变了指南针的极性。

senses.example: The student used a compass to draw a perfect circle around the marked center.
senses.definition: drafting instrument used for drawing circles
senses.definitionSentence: Compass means drafting instrument used for drawing circles.
senses.definitionZh: 用于画圆的绘图工具。
senses.exampleZh: 学生使用圆规围绕标记的中心画一个完美的圆。

senses.example: The other patrons were taxi drivers and art students and small shopkeepers.
senses.definition: a merchant who owns or manages a shop
senses.definitionSentence: Shopkeeper is a merchant who owns or manages a shop.
senses.definitionZh: 拥有或管理商店的商人。
senses.exampleZh: 其他顾客是出租车司机、艺术学生和小店主。

senses.example: The assembly plant is an enormous facility.
senses.definition: a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry
senses.definitionSentence: Facility is a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry.
senses.definitionZh: 提供特定服务或用于特定行业的建筑物或场所。
senses.exampleZh: 装配厂是一个巨大的设施。

senses.example: He was famous for his facility as an archer.
senses.definition: skillful performance or ability without difficulty
senses.definitionSentence: Facility means skillful performance or ability without difficulty.
senses.definitionZh: 没有困难的熟练表现或能力。
senses.exampleZh: 他以弓箭手的技巧而闻名。

senses.example: "although dull at classical learning, at mathematics he was uncommonly quick"- Thackeray.
senses.definition: slow to learn or understand; lacking intellectual acuity
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dull is slow to learn or understand; lacking intellectual acuity.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为“迟钝”的东西是指学习或理解缓慢；缺乏智力敏锐度。
senses.exampleZh: “尽管他在古典学习方面很迟钝，但在数学方面他却异常敏捷”——萨克雷。

senses.example: How dull and dreary the world is.
senses.definition: lacking in liveliness or animation
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as dull is lacking in liveliness or animation.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为沉闷的东西缺乏活力或动画。
senses.exampleZh: 这个世界是多么的沉闷和沉闷。

senses.example: The local anesthetic dulled sensation in her hand until the fingers felt numb.
senses.definition: make numb or insensitive
senses.definitionSentence: To dull means to make numb or insensitive.
senses.definitionZh: 变得麻木或麻木。
senses.exampleZh: 局部麻醉剂使她的手感觉迟钝，直到手指感到麻木。

senses.example: With a small bomb, I tuck it between Cadillacs.
senses.definition: fit snugly into
senses.definitionSentence: To tuck means to fit snugly into.
senses.definitionZh: 紧密地贴合。
senses.exampleZh: 用一枚小炸弹，我把它塞在凯迪拉克之间。

senses.example: The seamstress stitched a narrow tuck into the blouse to shape the fabric.
senses.definition: a narrow flattened pleat or fold that is stitched in place
senses.definitionSentence: Tuck is a narrow flattened pleat or fold that is stitched in place.
senses.definitionZh: 缝合到位的狭窄扁平褶皱或折叠。
senses.exampleZh: 裁缝师在衬衫上缝了一个窄褶边，以塑造面料的形状。

senses.example: He lay there, snoring and whistling.
senses.definition: make whistling sounds
senses.definitionSentence: To whistle means to make whistling sounds.
senses.definitionZh: 发出口哨声。
senses.exampleZh: 他躺在那里，打呼噜，吹着口哨。

senses.example: In Keng Kok, the City of Silkworms, the Prime Minister bought fried chickens and fried cicadas, and two notebooks for me.
senses.definition: a book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda
senses.definitionSentence: Notebook is a book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda.
senses.definitionZh: 一本有空白页的书，用于记录笔记或备忘录。
senses.exampleZh: 在蚕城景角，总理给我买了炸鸡和炸蝉，还有两本笔记本。

senses.example: The wolf hunted deer with its pack across the northern forest.
senses.definition: any of various predatory carnivorous canine mammals of North America and Eurasia that usually hunt in packs
senses.definitionSentence: Wolf means any of various predatory carnivorous canine mammals of North America and Eurasia that usually hunt in packs.
senses.definitionZh: 北美和欧亚大陆通常成群捕食的各种掠食性肉食性犬科哺乳动物。
senses.exampleZh: 狼带着狼群在北部森林中猎杀鹿。

senses.example: The parties were on the whole unprepared for elections, while the people were still experiencing post independence let-down and suffering the after effects of poor harvests in 1957.
senses.definition: the yield from plants in a single growing season
senses.definitionSentence: Harvest is the yield from plants in a single growing season.
senses.definitionZh: 植物在单个生长季节的产量。
senses.exampleZh: 各政党总体上还没有为选举做好准备，而人民仍在经历独立后的失望和 1957 年歉收的后遗症。

senses.example: Fry the onions in hot oil until they become soft and golden.
senses.definition: cook on a hot surface using fat
senses.definitionSentence: To fry means to cook on a hot surface using fat.
senses.definitionZh: 使用脂肪在热表面上烹饪。
senses.exampleZh: 将洋葱放入热油中煎至变软并呈金黄色。

senses.example: The playground near the nursery is reserved for the small fry, children too young for the main sports field.
senses.definition: a young person of either sex
senses.definitionSentence: Fry is a young person of either sex.
senses.definitionZh: 一名年轻人，性别不限。
senses.exampleZh: 托儿所附近的操场是为小鱼儿预留的，太小的孩子无法进入主要运动场。

senses.example: He suffered from fatigue and emotional tension.
senses.definition: (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense
senses.definitionSentence: Tension means (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense.
senses.definitionZh: （心理学）精神或情绪紧张或悬念的状态。
senses.exampleZh: 他感到疲劳和情绪紧张。

senses.example: The company reports earnings quarterly, once every three months.
senses.definition: in three month intervals
senses.definitionSentence: Quarterly means in three month intervals.
senses.definitionZh: 以三个月为间隔。
senses.exampleZh: 公司每季度报告一次收益，每三个月报告一次。

senses.example: There will be a large drawing of a sunbonnet girl with eyes that flash at the guests.
senses.definition: gleam or glow intermittently
senses.definitionSentence: To flash means to gleam or glow intermittently.
senses.definitionZh: 间歇性地闪烁或发光。
senses.exampleZh: 将会有一幅巨大的太阳帽女孩的画，她的眼睛向客人闪烁。

senses.example: A flash sewn on his sleeve indicated the unit he belonged to.
senses.definition: a bright patch of color used for decoration or identification
senses.definitionSentence: Flash is a bright patch of color used for decoration or identification.
senses.definitionZh: 用于装饰或识别的明亮色块。
senses.exampleZh: 他袖子上缝有闪光，表明他所属的单位。

senses.example: If I had the chance I'd do it in a flash.
senses.definition: a very short time (as the time it takes the eye to blink or the heart to beat)
senses.definitionSentence: Flash is a very short time (as the time it takes the eye to blink or the heart to beat).
senses.definitionZh: 闪光的时间非常短（就像眼睛眨眼或心脏跳动所需的时间）。
senses.exampleZh: 如果有机会我会立刻做。

senses.example: The headlines flashed on the screen.
senses.definition: appear briefly
senses.definitionSentence: To flash means to appear briefly.
senses.definitionZh: 短暂出现。
senses.exampleZh: 标题在屏幕上闪烁。

senses.example: Sending angry letters to the papers.
senses.definition: feeling or showing anger
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as angry is feeling or showing anger.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为愤怒的事物是指感觉或表现出愤怒。
senses.exampleZh: 向报纸发送愤怒的信件。

senses.example: The cut became angry, red, swollen, and painfully inflamed.
senses.definition: severely inflamed and painful
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as angry is severely inflamed and painful.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为愤怒的东西会严重发炎和疼痛。
senses.exampleZh: 伤口变得发炎、发红、肿胀并且发炎，疼痛难忍。

senses.example: The ship appeared as a distinct silhouette.
senses.definition: easy to perceive; especially clearly outlined
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as distinct is easy to perceive; especially clearly outlined.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为独特的事物很容易被感知；特别清晰地概述。
senses.exampleZh: 这艘船呈现出清晰的轮廓。

senses.example: The word `nationalism' is used in at least two distinct senses.
senses.definition: (often followed by `from') not alike; different in nature or quality
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as distinct is (often followed by `from') not alike; different in nature or quality.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为不同的事物（通常后跟“来自”）并不相似；性质或质量不同。
senses.exampleZh: “民族主义”一词至少有两种不同的含义。

senses.example: Farmers were uneasy until rain finally came.
senses.definition: lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as uneasy is lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance.
senses.definitionZh: 所描述的不安是指缺乏安全感或无法提供轻松或保证。
senses.exampleZh: 农民们焦躁不安，直到下雨终于来了。

senses.example: The unexplained footsteps made her uneasy, and she anxiously checked that every door was locked.
senses.definition: causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as uneasy is causing or fraught with or showing anxiety.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为不安的事物导致或充满或表现出焦虑。
senses.exampleZh: 不明原因的脚步声让她心神不安，她焦急地检查每扇门是否都锁好了。

senses.example: She opted for the job on the East coast.
senses.definition: select as an alternative over another
senses.definitionSentence: To opt means to select as an alternative over another.
senses.definitionZh: 选择作为替代方案。
senses.exampleZh: 她选择了东海岸的工作。

senses.example: "Satire is a sort of glass, wherein beholders do generally discover everybody's face but their own"--Jonathan Swift.
senses.definition: witty language used to convey insults or scorn
senses.definitionSentence: Satire means witty language used to convey insults or scorn.
senses.definitionZh: 用于表达侮辱或蔑视的诙谐语言。

senses.example: `` Penny's always glad to see me over there '', he mused bleakly.
senses.definition: showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as glad is showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为高兴的东西是表现出或引起快乐和愉悦；特别开心。
senses.exampleZh: “佩妮总是很高兴看到我在那里”，他忧郁地沉思道。

senses.example: I would be glad to help carry the boxes and assemble the furniture whenever you are ready.
senses.definition: eagerly disposed to act or to be of service
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as glad is eagerly disposed to act or to be of service.

senses.exampleZh: 只要您准备好，我很乐意帮助搬运箱子并组装家具。

senses.definitionSentence: Grass means narrow-leaved green herbage: grown as lawns; used as pasture for grazing animals; cut and dried as hay.
senses.definitionZh: 窄叶绿色牧草：种植为草坪；用作放牧动物的牧场；像干草一样切割和干燥。

senses.example: Phil turned away and opened his locker, and then he heard Mike Deegan say: `` You 're yellow, Rossoff ''!

senses.definitionSentence: Locker is a storage compartment for clothes and valuables; usually it has a lock.

senses.definitionSentence: Locker is a fastener that locks or closes.
senses.definitionZh: 一种锁定或关闭的紧固件。

senses.meaning: 偶然的，临时的，特殊场合的，非经常的

senses.definitionSentence: Something described as occasional is occurring from time to time.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为偶然的事情时常发生。

senses.definition: conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being

senses.exampleZh: 农场为儿童提供一个健康的环境。

senses.example: In hunger stimulates man too the situation is very similar.
senses.definition: a physiological need for food; the consequence of food deprivation
senses.definitionSentence: Hunger is a physiological need for food; the consequence of food deprivation.

senses.definitionZh: 感觉需要吃东西。

senses.definitionSentence: To violate means to fail to agree with; be in violation of; as of rules or patterns.
senses.definitionZh: 不同意；违反；作为规则或模式。
senses.exampleZh: 这句话违反了语法规则。

senses.definitionZh: 三个等项的乘积。
senses.exampleZh: 四的立方是六十四，因为四乘以三。

senses.definitionSentence: Cube is a hexahedron with six equal squares as faces.
senses.definitionZh: 一个六面体，有六个相等的正方形作为面。
senses.exampleZh: 孩子搭出一个有六个相等正方形表面和八个顶点的立方体。

senses.example: Every star seemed to flare with new intensity.

senses.definitionSentence: To flare means to burn brightly.
senses.definitionZh: 明亮地燃烧。
senses.exampleZh: 每颗星星似乎都以新的强度闪耀。

senses.example: We knew the enemy was subdued, because a flare was fired as the signal.
senses.definition: a burst of light used to communicate or illuminate
senses.definitionSentence: Flare is a burst of light used to communicate or illuminate.
senses.definitionZh: 用于通信或照明的突发光。
senses.exampleZh: 我们知道敌人被制服了，因为信号弹被发射了。

senses.example: The rescue team fired a bright flare into the night sky to mark its position.

senses.definitionSentence: Flare is a device that produces a bright light for warning or illumination or identification.

senses.example: The mine processes copper ore because the rock contains enough valuable metal to extract.

senses.definitionSentence: Ore is a mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined.

senses.example: Burly leathered men and wrinkled women in drab black rags carried on in a primitive way, almost unchanged from feudal times.
senses.definition: of or relating to or characteristic of feudalism
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as feudal is of or relating to or characteristic of feudalism.

senses.example: The latter measures the heat carried away by the bloodstream as an indication of the velocity of the blood flow.
senses.definition: distance travelled per unit time
senses.definitionSentence: Velocity means distance travelled per unit time.
senses.definitionZh: 单位时间内行驶的距离。
senses.exampleZh: 后者测量血流带走的热量，作为血流速度的指示。

senses.example: Show her the new swimming pool and she would say, slapping her ankle, `` I suppose this must be where you breed your gigantic mosquitoes ''.
senses.definition: so exceedingly large or extensive as to suggest a giant or mammoth
senses.definitionSentence: Something described as gigantic is so exceedingly large or extensive as to suggest a giant or mammoth.
senses.definitionZh: 被描述为巨大的东西是如此巨大或广泛以至于暗示着巨人或猛犸象。

senses.example: The mother deserted her children.

senses.definitionZh: 离开需要或依赖你的人；陷入困境。
senses.exampleZh: 母亲抛弃了她的孩子。

senses.example: A site may be a rundown slum or a desolate piece of desert in appearance today but have excellent potentials for the future with a little development or water.
senses.definition: arid land with little or no vegetation
senses.definitionSentence: Desert means arid land with little or no vegetation.
senses.definitionZh: 植被很少或没有植被的干旱土地。
senses.exampleZh: 某个地点今天看起来可能是一个破败的贫民窟或一片荒凉的沙漠，但只要进行一点开发或水，未来就有巨大的潜力。

senses.example: Yes, the Pope could die and quickly be made a saint.

senses.definitionSentence: Saint is a person who has died and has been declared a saint by canonization.
senses.definitionZh: 已经去世并被册封为圣人的人。
senses.exampleZh: 是的，教皇可能会死并很快被封为圣人。

senses.example: Many other (probably nearly all) snakes at maturity are already more than half their final length.

senses.definitionSentence: Snake means limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous.
senses.definitionZh: 无肢、有鳞的细长爬行动物；有些是有毒的。
senses.exampleZh: 许多其他（可能几乎所有）蛇在成熟时已经超过其最终长度的一半。

senses.example: The river snakes through the valley.
senses.definition: form a snake-like pattern
senses.definitionSentence: To snake means to form a snake-like pattern.
senses.definitionZh: 形成蛇状图案。
senses.exampleZh: 河流蜿蜒穿过山谷。

senses.example: Haying time was close at hand, and they needed some strong branches to repair a hay rack.
senses.definition: framework for holding objects
senses.definitionSentence: Rack means framework for holding objects.
senses.definitionZh: 用于容纳物体的框架。
senses.exampleZh: 割草时间即将到来，他们需要一些坚固的树枝来修理干草架。

senses.example: This Sparky can rack and single-foot and he's the fastest thing in Washoe County.
senses.definition: go at a rack
senses.definitionSentence: To rack means to go at a rack.
senses.definitionZh: 去机架。

senses.meaning: 文件夹，装散页或图纸的扁平薄袋

senses.exampleZh: 他记得她是因为她带着一大笔投资组合。

senses.example: In such a case the defendant should serve as a clear example and not have to be tied to the issue by argument.

senses.definitionZh: 在法庭上提起诉讼的个人或机构；被起诉或指控的人。

senses.definitionZh: 让某人做某事。
senses.exampleZh: 毛茸茸的毛毛虫，长着敏感角的蜗牛，挣扎着的蚱蜢被长长的后腿抓住并被命令“吐烟草，吐”。

senses.example: And the tone she commands is always beautiful in sound.
